/**
 * @module layouts/MuiSidebar
 * @description Protected navigation drawer supporting permanent mini/full modes and temporary mobile overlay.
 */

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { NavLink, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { useTheme } from "@mui/material/styles";
import useMediaQuery from "@mui/material/useMediaQuery";
import Box from "@mui/material/Box";
import Drawer from "@mui/material/Drawer";
import List from "@mui/material/List";
import ListItemButton from "@mui/material/ListItemButton";
import ListItemIcon from "@mui/material/ListItemIcon";
import Divider from "@mui/material/Divider";
import Avatar from "@mui/material/Avatar";
import Tooltip from "@mui/material/Tooltip";
import IconButton from "@mui/material/IconButton";
import Menu from "@mui/material/Menu";
import MenuItem from "@mui/material/MenuItem";
import Typography from "@mui/material/Typography";
import ChevronLeftIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ChevronLeft";
import ChevronRightIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ChevronRight";
import MoreVertIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MoreVert";
import DashboardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Dashboard";
import SmartToyIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SmartToy";
import DescriptionIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Description";
import StorefrontIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Storefront";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Person";
import LogoutIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Logout";
import useLogout from "../hooks/useLogout.js";
import { useSelector } from "react-redux";
import { selectAuthUser } from "../redux/features/authSlice.js";
import { MuiRecentChat } from "../components/chat/index.js";
import Logo from "./Logo.jsx";
import {
  APPBAR_MIN_HEIGHT,
  ROUTES,
  SIDEBAR_FULL_WIDTH,
  SIDEBAR_MINI_WIDTH,
} from "../utils/constants.js";
import { getAvatarUrl } from "../utils/avatarUtils.js";

/**
 * Navigation route item definitions.
 * @constant
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<{ path: string, icon: import('react').ElementType, label: string, exact: boolean }>}
 */
const NAV_ITEMS = Object.freeze([
  {
    path: ROUTES.DASHBOARD,
    icon: DashboardIcon,
    label: "Dashboard",
    exact: true,
  },
  { path: ROUTES.CHAT, icon: SmartToyIcon, label: "Chat", exact: false },
  { path: ROUTES.REPORTS, icon: DescriptionIcon, label: "Reports", exact: false },
  { path: ROUTES.BRANCHES, icon: StorefrontIcon, label: "Branches", exact: false },
  { path: ROUTES.PROFILE, icon: PersonIcon, label: "Profile", exact: true },
]);

/**
 * Navigation drawer component with responsive layout variants and avatar profile controls.
 *
 * @component MuiSidebar
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {'mini'|'full'} props.mode - Sidebar width density mode on desktop screens.
 * @param {() => void} props.onToggleMode - Callback toggling between mini and full modes.
 * @param {boolean} props.mobileOpen - Whether the mobile drawer overlay is visible.
 * @param {() => void} props.onMobileClose - Callback closing the mobile drawer overlay.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered drawer navigation component.
 */
const MuiSidebar = ({ mode, onToggleMode, mobileOpen, onMobileClose }) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const user = useSelector(selectAuthUser);
  const logout = useLogout();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down("md"));
  const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState(null);

  /** The temporary overlay always presents full affordances. */
  const effectiveMode = isMobile ? "full" : mode;
  const isMini = effectiveMode === "mini";
  const drawerWidth = isMini ? SIDEBAR_MINI_WIDTH : SIDEBAR_FULL_WIDTH;

  const initials = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) return "?";
    const first = user.firstName?.[0] ?? "";
    const last = user.lastName?.[0] ?? "";
    return (first + last).toUpperCase();
  }, [user]);

  const displayName = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) return "User";
    const first = user.firstName?.trim() ?? "";
    const last = user.lastName?.trim() ?? "";
    return first || last ? `${first} ${last}`.trim() : "User";
  }, [user]);

  const isSelected = (path) => location.pathname === path;

  const handleMenuOpen = (event) => setAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
  const handleMenuClose = () => setAnchorEl(null);

  const handleProfileClick = () => {
    handleMenuClose();
    if (onMobileClose) onMobileClose();
    navigate(ROUTES.PROFILE);
  };

  const handleLogoutClick = () => {
    handleMenuClose();
    if (onMobileClose) onMobileClose();
    void logout();
  };

  const headerContent = isMini ? (
    /* Mini: the lone, centered mode toggle (owner directive). */
    <IconButton
      size="small"
      aria-label="Expand sidebar"
      onClick={onToggleMode}
      sx={{ color: "text.secondary", flexShrink: 0 }}
    >
      <ChevronRightIcon fontSize="small" />
    </IconButton>
  ) : (
    /* Full (or overlay): Logo left, mode/close toggle right. */
    <>
      <Logo to={ROUTES.DASHBOARD} sx={{ minWidth: 0 }} />
      <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }} />
      <IconButton
        size="small"
        aria-label={isMobile ? "Close navigation" : "Collapse sidebar"}
        onClick={isMobile ? onMobileClose : onToggleMode}
        sx={{ color: "text.secondary", flexShrink: 0 }}
      >
        <ChevronLeftIcon fontSize="small" />
      </IconButton>
    </>
  );

  const sidebarContent = (
    <Box
      component="nav"
      sx={{
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        height: "100%",
        overflow: "hidden",
        bgcolor: "background.paper",
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: isMini ? "center" : "flex-start",
          minHeight: APPBAR_MIN_HEIGHT,
          px: 1,
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: "divider",
        }}
      >
        {headerContent}
      </Box>

      {/* Navigation & Recent Chats Container */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          flexGrow: 1,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          minHeight: 0,
          overflow: "hidden",
          py: 1,
        }}
      >
        <List dense disablePadding aria-label="Main navigation" sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            const labelNode = (
              <Typography
                variant="body2"
                noWrap
                sx={{ fontWeight: 500, ml: 1 }}
              >
                {item.label}
              </Typography>
            );
            return (
              <Tooltip
                key={item.path}
                title={isMini ? item.label : ""}
                placement="right"
                arrow
              >
                <ListItemButton
                  component={NavLink}
                  to={item.path}
                  end={item.exact}
                  selected={isSelected(item.path)}
                  sx={{
                    mx: 1,
                    my: 0.25,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    justifyContent: isMini ? "center" : "flex-start",
                    px: isMini ? 0 : 1.5,
                    py: 0.75,
                    "&:hover": {
                      bgcolor: "action.hover",
                    },
                  }}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    if (item.path === ROUTES.CHAT) {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      navigate(ROUTES.CHAT, { state: { newChatAt: Date.now() } });
                    }
                    if (isMobile) onMobileClose();
                  }}
                >
                  <ListItemIcon
                    sx={{
                      minWidth: isMini ? 0 : 32,
                      justifyContent: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    <Icon fontSize="small" />
                  </ListItemIcon>
                  {isMini ? null : labelNode}
                </ListItemButton>
              </Tooltip>
            );
          })}
        </List>

        {/* Encapsulated Recent Chats Section */}
        <MuiRecentChat isMini={isMini} onMobileClose={onMobileClose} />
      </Box>

      <Divider />

      {/* Avatar menu anchor */}
      <Box sx={{ px: 1, py: 1.5 }}>
        {isMini ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center" }}>
            <Tooltip title={displayName} placement="right" arrow>
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                aria-label="User menu"
                onClick={handleMenuOpen}
                sx={{ p: 0 }}
              >
                <Avatar
                  src={getAvatarUrl(user?.avatar) || undefined}
                  alt={displayName}
                  sx={{
                    width: 32,
                    height: 32,
                    fontSize: "0.75rem",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    bgcolor: "primary.main",
                  }}
                >
                  {initials}
                </Avatar>
              </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <Box
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            onClick={handleMenuOpen}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                handleMenuOpen(event);
              }
            }}
            sx={{
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 1,
              width: "100%",
              px: 0.75,
              py: 0.5,
              borderRadius: 1,
              cursor: "pointer",
              "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
            }}
          >
            <Avatar
              src={getAvatarUrl(user?.avatar) || undefined}
              alt={displayName}
              sx={{
                width: 28,
                height: 28,
                fontSize: "0.8125rem",
                fontWeight: 600,
                bgcolor: "primary.main",
              }}
            >
              {initials}
            </Avatar>
            <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                {displayName}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <MoreVertIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />
          </Box>
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Avatar menu — opens up-right of the bottom anchor (§47.3). */}
      <Menu
        anchorEl={anchorEl}
        open={Boolean(anchorEl)}
        onClose={handleMenuClose}
        disableEnforceFocus={true}
        disableRestoreFocus={true}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
        transformOrigin={{
          vertical: "bottom",
          horizontal: isMini ? "left" : "right",
        }}
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            sx: {
              minWidth: 160,
              maxWidth: isMini ? "calc(100vw - 120px)" : "calc(100vw - 280px)",
              mb: 0.5,
            },
          },
          popper: {
            modifiers: [
              {
                name: "flip",
                options: {
                  fallbackPlacements: [
                    "top-start",
                    "bottom-start",
                    "top-end",
                    "bottom-end",
                    "right",
                    "left",
                  ],
                },
              },
              {
                name: "preventOverflow",
                options: { boundary: "viewport", altBoundary: true },
              },
            ],
          },
        }}
      >
        <MenuItem onClick={handleProfileClick}>
          <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 32 }}>
            <PersonIcon fontSize="small" />
          </ListItemIcon>
          Profile
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={handleLogoutClick}>
          <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 32, color: "error.main" }}>
            <LogoutIcon fontSize="small" />
          </ListItemIcon>
          Logout
        </MenuItem>
      </Menu>

    </Box>
  );

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Drawer
        variant="temporary"
        anchor="left"
        open={mobileOpen}
        onClose={onMobileClose}
        disableEnforceFocus
        disableRestoreFocus
        ModalProps={{
          keepMounted: true, // Preserve DOM tree & RTK query subscriptions for instantaneous 120fps opening
        }}
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            sx: { width: SIDEBAR_FULL_WIDTH },
          },
        }}
      >
        {sidebarContent}
      </Drawer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Drawer
      variant="permanent"
      anchor="left"
      open
      sx={{ width: drawerWidth, flexShrink: 0 }}
      slotProps={{
        paper: {
          sx: {
            width: drawerWidth,
            transition: theme.transitions.create("width", {
              duration: theme.transitions.duration.shorter,
            }),
            flexShrink: 0,
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            boxSizing: "border-box",
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      {sidebarContent}
    </Drawer>
  );
};

export default MuiSidebar;

/**
 * @module layouts/PublicLayout
 * @description Public layout shell providing public app-bar, authentication actions, and outlet container.
 */

import { Link as RouterLink, Outlet, useNavigation } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import LoginIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Login';
import LogoutIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Logout';
import PersonAddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonAdd';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import MuiAppbar from '../components/reusable/MuiAppbar.jsx';
import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import LoadingSpinner from '../components/reusable/LoadingSpinner.jsx';
import Logo from './Logo.jsx';
import ThemeToggle from './ThemeToggle.jsx';
import { selectAuthStatus } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import useLogout from '../hooks/useLogout.js';
import {
  AUTH_STATUSES,
  ROUTES,
} from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Public layout wrapper wrapping unauthenticated routes (Landing, Login, Register).
 * Provides the fixed public AppBar with authentication shortcuts and theme toggles.
 *
 * @component PublicLayout
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.children] - Optional custom child content overriding default outlet.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered public layout shell.
 */
export const PublicLayout = ({ children }) => {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const status = useSelector(selectAuthStatus);
  const logout = useLogout();
  const isAuthenticated = status === AUTH_STATUSES.AUTHENTICATED;

  const actions = (
    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
      <ThemeToggle />
      {isAuthenticated ? (
        <Tooltip title="Logout">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            aria-label="Logout"
            onClick={() => void logout()}
            sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}
          >
            <LogoutIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : (
        <>
          <MuiButton
            component={RouterLink}
            to={ROUTES.LOGIN}
            size="small"
            startIcon={<LoginIcon fontSize="small" />}
            sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' }, flexShrink: 0 }}
          >
            Log in
          </MuiButton>
          <IconButton
            component={RouterLink}
            to={ROUTES.LOGIN}
            size="small"
            aria-label="Log in"
            sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
          >
            <LoginIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
          <MuiButton
            component={RouterLink}
            to={ROUTES.REGISTER}
            variant="contained"
            size="small"
            startIcon={<PersonAddIcon fontSize="small" />}
            sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' } }}
          >
            Sign up
          </MuiButton>
          <IconButton
            component={RouterLink}
            to={ROUTES.REGISTER}
            size="small"
            aria-label="Sign up"
            sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
          >
            <PersonAddIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </>
      )}
    </Box>
  );

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        height: '100dvh',
        '@supports not (height: 100dvh)': {
          height: '100vh',
        },
        width: '100vw',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      <MuiAppbar
        variant="public"
        leading={
          <Logo
            showName
            to={isAuthenticated ? ROUTES.LOGIN_REDIRECT : ROUTES.LANDING}
          />
        }
        actions={actions}
      />
      <Box
        component="main"
        id="public-outlet-container"
        sx={{
          flexGrow: 1,
          minHeight: 0,
          height: '100%',
          overflowY: 'auto',
          overflowX: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {navigation.state === 'loading' ? (
          <LoadingSpinner message="Loading..." height="100%" />
        ) : (
          children ?? <Outlet />
        )}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

PublicLayout.propTypes = {
  children: PropTypes.node,
};

export default PublicLayout;

/**
 * @module layouts/ThemeToggle
 * @description Light/dark mode color scheme toggle button for application navigation bars.
 */

import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import LightModeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LightMode';
import DarkModeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DarkMode';
import { useColorScheme } from '@mui/material/styles';

/**
 * Standard color scheme toggle button switching between light and dark modes.
 *
 * @component ThemeToggle
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered color scheme toggle icon button.
 */
export const ThemeToggle = () => {
  const { mode, setMode } = useColorScheme();
  const isLight = mode === 'light';

  return (
    <Tooltip title={isLight ? 'Dark mode' : 'Light mode'}>
      <IconButton
        size="small"
        aria-label="Toggle color scheme"
        onClick={() => setMode(isLight ? 'dark' : 'light')}
      >
        {isLight ? <DarkModeIcon fontSize="small" /> : <LightModeIcon fontSize="small" />}
      </IconButton>
    </Tooltip>
  );
};

export default ThemeToggle;

/**
 * @module pages/BranchDetail
 * @description Master operational branch inspection details and analytics canvas.
 * Implements:
 * - Row 1: Breadcrumbs (Dashboard > Branches > Details) on left + Back to Branches button on right (iconified on xs < 600px).
 * - Row 2: BranchHero (code badge, bilingual name, aliases, status chip, location, manager, phone dial link).
 * - Row 3: BranchAnalyticsCharts (minimum 2 responsive charts side-by-side on md+, stacked on xs/sm: Visit Trend & Real Status Distribution).
 * - Row 4: BranchAuditHistory (historical ledger below charts, spanning full width xs: 12, DataGrid on sm+, Card list on xs, conditional pagination).
 * - Row 5: BranchDangerZone (Archive, Restore, and Permanent Cascade Deletion).
 * - Immediate modal dismissal with inline loading on action triggers.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../components/reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';
import MuiBranchDialog from '../components/branches/MuiBranchDialog.jsx';
import BranchHero from '../components/branches/BranchHero.jsx';
import BranchAnalyticsCharts from '../components/branches/BranchAnalyticsCharts.jsx';
import BranchAuditHistory from '../components/branches/BranchAuditHistory.jsx';
import BranchDangerZone from '../components/branches/BranchDangerZone.jsx';

import {
  useGetBranchByIdQuery,
  useGetBranchMetricsQuery,
  useArchiveBranchMutation,
  useRestoreBranchMutation,
  useDeleteBranchMutation,
} from '../redux/features/branchSlice.js';

/**
 * Branch details and operational analytics canvas view.
 *
 * @component BranchDetail
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch detail page.
 */
export const BranchDetail = memo(() => {
  const { branchId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Dialog and Action Lifecycle states
  const [isEditDialogOpen, setIsEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete' | null

  // Confirmation modal state
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState({
    open: false,
    type: null, // 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete'
  });

  // RTK Query endpoints
  const {
    data: branchData,
    isLoading: isBranchLoading,
    error: branchError,
  } = useGetBranchByIdQuery(branchId, { skip: !branchId });

  const {
    data: metricsData,
    isLoading: isMetricsLoading,
  } = useGetBranchMetricsQuery(branchId, { skip: !branchId });

  const [archiveBranch] = useArchiveBranchMutation();
  const [restoreBranch] = useRestoreBranchMutation();
  const [deleteBranch] = useDeleteBranchMutation();

  const branch = branchData?.branch || branchData;
  const metrics = metricsData?.metrics || metricsData;

  // Open Edit Dialog
  const handleOpenEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setIsEditDialogOpen(true);
  }, []);

  // Open Confirm Modals
  const handleOpenArchive = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'archive' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenRestore = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'restore' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenDelete = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'delete' });
  }, []);

  const handleCloseConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: false, type: null });
  }, []);

  // Execute Confirmed Lifecycle Action with Immediate Dismissal & Inline Loading
  const handleExecuteConfirmedAction = useCallback(async () => {
    const { type } = confirmModal;
    if (!branch?._id) return;

    const targetId = branch._id;
    const targetName = branch.name;

    // 1. Immediately close the modal
    handleCloseConfirm();

    // 2. Set action-scoped loading state
    setActionLoading(type);

    try {
      if (type === 'archive') {
        await archiveBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" archived successfully.`);
      } else if (type === 'restore') {
        await restoreBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" restored successfully.`);
      } else if (type === 'delete') {
        await deleteBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" and associated data permanently deleted.`);
        navigate('/branches');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || `Failed to ${type} branch. Please try again.`);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }, [confirmModal, branch, handleCloseConfirm, archiveBranch, restoreBranch, deleteBranch, navigate]);

  // Handle branch not found or load errors
  if (branchError) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ p: 4, maxWidth: 800, mx: 'auto' }}>
        <MuiEmptyState
          icon={<StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 64, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          title="Branch Not Found"
          subtitle="The requested operational store branch could not be found or has been deleted."
          action={
            <MuiButton variant="contained" component={RouterLink} to="/branches">
              Back to Branches Directory
            </MuiButton>
          }
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 1400, mx: 'auto', p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 } }}>
      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 1: BREADCRUMBS & NAVIGATION RETURN
          Left: Dashboard > Branches > Details
          Right: ← Back to Branches (Iconified on xs < 600px)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
          gap: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          aria-label="branch detail breadcrumbs"
        >
          <RouterLink
            to="/dashboard"
            style={{ textDecoration: 'none', color: 'inherit' }}
          >
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 500, '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' } }}
            >
              Dashboard
            </Typography>
          </RouterLink>
          <RouterLink
            to="/branches"
            style={{ textDecoration: 'none', color: 'inherit' }}
          >
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 500, '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' } }}
            >
              Branches
            </Typography>
          </RouterLink>
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            sx={{ color: 'text.primary', fontWeight: 600 }}
          >
            Details
          </Typography>
        </Breadcrumbs>

        {/* Right: Back to Branches Action */}
        <Box sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="inherit"
            startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/branches"
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
            }}
          >
            Back to Branches
          </MuiButton>

          <Tooltip title="Back to Branches">
            <span>
              <IconButton
                component={RouterLink}
                to="/branches"
                aria-label="Back to branches directory"
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                  border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`,
                  p: 1,
                }}
              >
                <ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 2: BRANCH HERO PROFILE BANNER
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3 } }}>
        {isBranchLoading ? (
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={200} sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5 }} />
        ) : (
          <BranchHero
            branch={branch}
            onEdit={handleOpenEdit}
            onArchive={handleOpenArchive}
            onRestore={handleOpenRestore}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            isActionLoading={Boolean(actionLoading)}
          />
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 3: BRANCH ANALYTICS CHARTS (Minimum 2 charts side-by-side on md+, stacked on xs/sm)
          Chart 1: Audit Visit Frequency Trend
          Chart 2: Operational Status Distribution (Real Schema Statuses)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3 } }}>
        <BranchAnalyticsCharts
          metrics={metrics}
          isLoading={isMetricsLoading}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 4: HISTORICAL AUDIT VISITS LEDGER (Full width xs: 12 below charts)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3 } }}>
        <BranchAuditHistory
          branchId={branchId}
          branchName={branch?.name}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 5: DANGER ZONE (Archive, Restore, Permanent Cascade Delete)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
        <BranchDangerZone
          branch={branch}
          onArchive={handleOpenArchive}
          onRestore={handleOpenRestore}
          onDelete={handleOpenDelete}
          actionLoading={actionLoading}
          isActionLoading={Boolean(actionLoading)}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          MODALS & DIALOGS
          ========================================================================= */}

      {/* Edit Branch Dialog */}
      <MuiBranchDialog
        open={isEditDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsEditDialogOpen(false)}
        branch={branch}
      />

      {/* Lifecycle Confirmation Modal */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={confirmModal.open}
        onClose={handleCloseConfirm}
        onConfirm={handleExecuteConfirmedAction}
        title={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Operational Branch'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'Restore Operational Branch'
            : 'Permanently Delete Branch'
        }
        message={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? `Are you sure you want to archive "${branch?.name}" (${branch?.code || 'N/A'})? It will be safely moved to the Archived tab.`
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? `Are you sure you want to restore "${branch?.name}" (${branch?.code || 'N/A'})? It will become active and available for reports.`
            : `WARNING: You are about to permanently delete "${branch?.name}" (${branch?.code || 'N/A'}). This action CANNOT be undone and will permanently cascade to delete all associated audit reports and audio recordings.`
        }
        confirmText={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Branch'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'Restore Branch'
            : 'Permanently Delete'
        }
        confirmColor={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'warning'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'primary'
            : 'error'
        }
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

BranchDetail.displayName = 'BranchDetail';

export default BranchDetail;

/**
 * @module pages/Branches
 * @description Master operational branch directory and network management page.
 * Implements:
 * - Row 1: Breadcrumbs (Dashboard > Branches) on left + New Branch button on right (iconified on xs < 600px).
 * - Row 2: Single-row responsive BranchControlStrip (zero-lag search, active/archived toggle, grid/list switcher).
 * - Row 3: sm+ DataGrid view or responsive Card Grid view with conditional MuiPagination (totalPages > 1).
 * - Immediate modal dismissal with inline loading on row/card action buttons.
 * - MuiBranchDialog (create & edit with 409 collision highlighting and fullScreen on xs).
 * - MuiConfirmDialog (destructive actions confirmation with disableEnforceFocus & disableRestoreFocus).
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import BranchControlStrip from '../components/branches/BranchControlStrip.jsx';
import BranchDataGrid from '../components/branches/BranchDataGrid.jsx';
import BranchCardGrid from '../components/branches/BranchCardGrid.jsx';
import MuiBranchDialog from '../components/branches/MuiBranchDialog.jsx';

import {
  useGetBranchesQuery,
  useArchiveBranchMutation,
  useRestoreBranchMutation,
  useDeleteBranchMutation,
} from '../redux/features/branchSlice.js';

/**
 * Branches directory page component.
 *
 * @component Branches
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch directory page view.
 */
export const Branches = memo(() => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Control strip states
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('active'); // 'active' | 'archived'
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('grid'); // 'grid' | 'list'
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  // Dialog and Action Lifecycle states
  const [isBranchDialogOpen, setIsBranchDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingBranch, setEditingBranch] = useState(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // { id: string, action: 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete' } | null

  // Confirmation modal state
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState({
    open: false,
    type: null, // 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete'
    branch: null,
  });

  // RTK Query endpoints
  const { data: activeData, isLoading: isActiveLoading } = useGetBranchesQuery({
    page: statusFilter === 'active' ? page : 1,
    limit: 100,
    search: statusFilter === 'active' ? searchQuery : '',
    archived: false,
  });

  const { data: archivedData, isLoading: isArchivedLoading } = useGetBranchesQuery({
    page: statusFilter === 'archived' ? page : 1,
    limit: 100,
    search: statusFilter === 'archived' ? searchQuery : '',
    archived: true,
  });

  const [archiveBranch] = useArchiveBranchMutation();
  const [restoreBranch] = useRestoreBranchMutation();
  const [deleteBranch] = useDeleteBranchMutation();

  const activeBranches = activeData?.branches || [];
  const activeCount = activeData?.pagination?.total ?? activeBranches.length;

  const archivedBranches = archivedData?.branches || [];
  const archivedCount = archivedData?.pagination?.total ?? archivedBranches.length;

  const isCurrentLoading = statusFilter === 'active' ? isActiveLoading : isArchivedLoading;
  const currentBranches = statusFilter === 'active' ? activeBranches : archivedBranches;
  const currentPagination = statusFilter === 'active' ? activeData?.pagination : archivedData?.pagination;
  const totalPages = currentPagination?.totalPages || 1;

  // Search query updater from zero-lag control strip
  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((query) => {
    setSearchQuery(query);
    setPage(1);
  }, []);

  // Status tab switcher
  const handleStatusFilterChange = useCallback((newStatus) => {
    setStatusFilter(newStatus);
    setPage(1);
  }, []);

  // View mode switcher (grid vs list)
  const handleViewModeChange = useCallback((newMode) => {
    setViewMode(newMode);
  }, []);

  // Open Create Dialog
  const handleOpenCreate = useCallback(() => {
    setEditingBranch(null);
    setIsBranchDialogOpen(true);
  }, []);

  // Open Edit Dialog
  const handleOpenEdit = useCallback((branch) => {
    setEditingBranch(branch);
    setIsBranchDialogOpen(true);
  }, []);

  // Navigate to Branch Detail
  const handleView = useCallback((branch) => {
    if (branch?._id) {
      navigate(`/branches/${branch._id}/details`);
    }
  }, [navigate]);

  // Open Archive Confirm Modal
  const handleOpenArchive = useCallback((branch) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'archive',
      branch,
    });
  }, []);

  // Open Restore Confirm Modal
  const handleOpenRestore = useCallback((branch) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'restore',
      branch,
    });
  }, []);

  // Open Permanent Delete Confirm Modal
  const handleOpenDelete = useCallback((branch) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'delete',
      branch,
    });
  }, []);

  // Dismiss Confirm Modal
  const handleCloseConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: false,
      type: null,
      branch: null,
    });
  }, []);

  // Execute Confirmed Lifecycle Action with Immediate Dismissal & Inline Loading
  const handleExecuteConfirmedAction = useCallback(async () => {
    const { type, branch } = confirmModal;
    if (!branch?._id) return;

    const targetId = branch._id;
    const targetName = branch.name;

    // 1. Immediately close the modal to avoid modal locking
    handleCloseConfirm();

    // 2. Mark the target row/card with action-scoped loading
    setActionLoading({ id: targetId, action: type });

    try {
      if (type === 'archive') {
        await archiveBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" archived successfully.`);
      } else if (type === 'restore') {
        await restoreBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" restored successfully.`);
      } else if (type === 'delete') {
        await deleteBranch(targetId).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${targetName}" and associated data permanently deleted.`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || `Failed to ${type} branch. Please try again.`);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }, [confirmModal, handleCloseConfirm, archiveBranch, restoreBranch, deleteBranch]);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 1400, mx: 'auto', p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 } }}>
      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 1: BREADCRUMBS & HEADER ACTION
          Left: Dashboard > Branches Breadcrumbs
          Right: + New Branch (Iconified on xs < 600px)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
          gap: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          aria-label="branch directory breadcrumbs"
        >
          <RouterLink
            to="/dashboard"
            style={{
              textDecoration: 'none',
              color: 'inherit',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{
                color: 'text.secondary',
                fontWeight: 500,
                '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
              }}
            >
              Dashboard
            </Typography>
          </RouterLink>
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.primary',
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            Branches
          </Typography>
        </Breadcrumbs>

        {/* Right: + New Branch Button (Desktop/Tablet full button, Mobile icon-only) */}
        <Box sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <MuiButton
            variant="contained"
            color="primary"
            startIcon={<AddIcon />}
            onClick={handleOpenCreate}
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            New Branch
          </MuiButton>

          <Tooltip title="Add New Branch">
            <span>
              <IconButton
                color="primary"
                onClick={handleOpenCreate}
                aria-label="Add new branch"
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                  bgcolor: 'primary.main',
                  color: 'primary.contrastText',
                  p: 1,
                  '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'primary.dark' },
                }}
              >
                <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 2: SINGLE-ROW RESPONSIVE CONTROL STRIP
          Search (Zero-Lag) | Active/Archived Toggle | Grid/List View Switcher
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3 } }}>
        <BranchControlStrip
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onSearchChange={handleSearchChange}
          statusFilter={statusFilter}
          onStatusFilterChange={handleStatusFilterChange}
          viewMode={viewMode}
          onViewModeChange={handleViewModeChange}
          activeCount={activeCount}
          archivedCount={archivedCount}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 3: BRANCHES DIRECTORY DISPLAY (DATAGRID vs CARD GRID)
          - sm+: DataGrid if viewMode === 'grid', CardGrid if viewMode === 'list'
          - xs: Always CardGrid (DataGrid hidden on mobile)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
        {/* Desktop & Tablet DataGrid View (sm+ only, when grid mode selected) */}
        {viewMode === 'grid' && (
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' } }}>
            <BranchDataGrid
              branches={currentBranches}
              isLoading={isCurrentLoading}
              onView={handleView}
              onEdit={handleOpenEdit}
              onArchive={handleOpenArchive}
              onRestore={handleOpenRestore}
              onDelete={handleOpenDelete}
              actionLoading={actionLoading}
              actionLoadingId={actionLoading?.id || null}
              emptyTitle={
                searchQuery
                  ? `No ${statusFilter} branches match "${searchQuery}"`
                  : `No ${statusFilter} branches found`
              }
              emptyDescription={
                searchQuery
                  ? 'Try clearing the search query to see all branches.'
                  : statusFilter === 'archived'
                  ? 'Archived store branches will appear here.'
                  : 'Register your first store branch to start logging audits.'
              }
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Card Grid View (Mobile xs always, or sm+ when list mode selected) */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: viewMode === 'list' ? 'block' : { xs: 'block', sm: 'none' },
          }}
        >
          <BranchCardGrid
            branches={currentBranches}
            isLoading={isCurrentLoading}
            onView={handleView}
            onEdit={handleOpenEdit}
            onArchive={handleOpenArchive}
            onRestore={handleOpenRestore}
            onDelete={handleOpenDelete}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            actionLoadingId={actionLoading?.id || null}
            page={page}
            totalPages={totalPages}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            emptyTitle={
              searchQuery
                ? `No ${statusFilter} branches match "${searchQuery}"`
                : `No ${statusFilter} branches found`
            }
            emptyDescription={
              searchQuery
                ? 'Try clearing the search query to see all branches.'
                : statusFilter === 'archived'
                ? 'Archived store branches will appear here.'
                : 'Register your first store branch to start logging audits.'
            }
          />
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          MODALS & DIALOGS
          ========================================================================= */}

      {/* Create & Edit Modal Dialog */}
      <MuiBranchDialog
        open={isBranchDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsBranchDialogOpen(false)}
        branch={editingBranch}
      />

      {/* Action Confirmation Modal (Immediate Dismissal with Inline Spinner) */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={confirmModal.open}
        onClose={handleCloseConfirm}
        onConfirm={handleExecuteConfirmedAction}
        title={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Operational Branch'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'Restore Operational Branch'
            : 'Permanently Delete Branch'
        }
        message={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? `Are you sure you want to archive "${confirmModal.branch?.name}" (${confirmModal.branch?.code || 'N/A'})? It will be safely moved to the Archived tab.`
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? `Are you sure you want to restore "${confirmModal.branch?.name}" (${confirmModal.branch?.code || 'N/A'})? It will become active and available for reports.`
            : `WARNING: You are about to permanently delete "${confirmModal.branch?.name}" (${confirmModal.branch?.code || 'N/A'}). This action CANNOT be undone and will permanently cascade to delete all associated audit reports and audio recordings.`
        }
        confirmText={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Branch'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'Restore Branch'
            : 'Permanently Delete'
        }
        confirmColor={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'warning'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
            ? 'primary'
            : 'error'
        }
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

Branches.displayName = 'Branches';

export default Branches;

/**
 * @module pages/Chat
 * @description Clean native MUI X Chat canvas mounted inside AppShell outlet.
 * Uses thread-only native layout (sidebar and appbar supplied by AppShell).
 * Powered by idiomatic MuiChatAdapter connecting to Express 5 SSE streaming pipeline and apiSlice.
 * Enforces zero-lag composer typing, side-by-side message alignment, and seamless Turn 1 lifecycle.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { ChatBox } from '@mui/x-chat';

import { selectCurrentUser } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import {
  selectActiveModel,
  selectThinkingBudget,
  selectLanguage,
  selectSttEngine,
  setActiveChatId,
  setActiveModel,
  setThinkingBudget,
  setLanguage,
  setSttEngine,
  useGetChatByIdQuery,
} from '../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { MuiChatAdapter } from '../adapters/MuiChatAdapter.js';
import { ChatAdapterContext } from '../contexts/ChatAdapterContext.js';
import {
  MuiChatEmptyState,
  MuiComposerInput,
  MuiComposerTopToolbar,
  MuiComposerBottomToolbar,
  MuiMessageContent,
  MuiChatMessageListContent,
} from '../components/chat/index.js';
import { CHAT_PAGINATION } from '../utils/constants.js';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS } from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Built-in feature toggles: thread-only mode (sidebar and header supplied by AppShell).
 * Multi-modal attachments enabled with native validation boundaries from ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.
 * @constant
 */
const FEATURES = Object.freeze({
  conversationList: false,
  conversationHeader: false,
  suggestions: false,
  scrollToBottom: true,
  autoScroll: true,
  attachments: {
    maxFileCount: ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILES_COUNT,
    maxFileSize: ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES,
  },
});

/**
 * Slot component overrides:
 * - personalized empty state
 * - zero-lag MuiComposerInput overriding native textarea
 * - MuiComposerTopToolbar for horizontal attachment cards preview
 * - MuiComposerBottomToolbar housing attach button (left) and send button (right)
 * - null overrides for default buttons to ensure single ownership
 * - MuiMessageContent for user message 3-row architecture & assistant delegation
 * - null overrides for avatar, authorName, and external actions to ensure clean user card layout
 * @constant
 */
const SLOTS = Object.freeze({
  emptyState: MuiChatEmptyState,
  composerInput: MuiComposerInput,
  composerToolbar: MuiComposerBottomToolbar,
  composerAttachmentList: MuiComposerTopToolbar,
  composerAttachButton: null,
  composerSendButton: null,
  messageContent: MuiMessageContent,
  messageAvatar: null,
  messageAuthorName: null,
  messageActions: null,
});

/**
 * SlotProps: Zero-lag composer configuration & message list sizing.
 * Disables all CSS transitions and animations on composer descendants to ensure instantaneous typing.
 * @constant
 */
const SLOT_PROPS = Object.freeze({
  composerRoot: {
    sx: {
      maxWidth: 760,
      mx: 'auto',
      mb: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
      p: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1 },
      width: { xs: 'calc(100% - 16px)', sm: '100%' },
      boxSizing: 'border-box',
      borderRadius: 2,
      border: '1px solid',
      borderColor: 'divider',
      bgcolor: 'background.paper',
      boxShadow: 1,
      transition: 'none !important',
      '&:focus-within': {
        borderColor: 'primary.main',
        boxShadow: (theme) => `0 0 0 1px ${theme.palette.primary.main}`,
      },
      '& .MuiInputBase-root, & .MuiInputBase-input': {
        transition: 'none !important',
      },
    },
  },
  composerInput: {
    placeholder: 'Message your personal AI agent...',
  },
  messageList: {
    slots: {
      messageListContent: MuiChatMessageListContent,
    },
    sx: {
      width: '100%',
      flexGrow: 1,
      '& .MuiChatMessageList-content': {
        maxWidth: 850,
        mx: 'auto',
        width: '100%',
        px: { xs: 0, sm: 2 },
      },
    },
  },
});

/**
 * ChatBox canvas styling: neutralizes user bubble background (zero blue fill) and enforces right-docked scrollbar.
 * @constant
 */
const CHATBOX_SX = Object.freeze({
  height: '100%',
  width: '100%',
  flex: '1 1 0%',
  minHeight: 0,
  border: 'none',
  borderRadius: 0,
  bgcolor: 'transparent',
  '& .MuiChatComposer-root': {
    pb: 'calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))',
  },
  '& .MuiChatMessage-root': {
    px: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
  },
  '& .MuiChatMessage-roleUser .MuiChatMessage-bubble, & .MuiChatMessage-roleUser .MuiChatMessageContent-root, & [data-is-own-message="true"] .MuiChatMessage-bubble': {
    bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
    color: 'text.primary !important',
    border: 'none !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatMessage-roleAssistant .MuiChatMessage-bubble, & .MuiChatMessage-roleAssistant .MuiChatMessageContent-root': {
    bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
    color: 'text.primary !important',
    border: 'none !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatMessage-roleUser .MuiChatMessageMeta-root, & [data-is-own-message="true"] .MuiChatMessageMeta-root': {
    color: 'text.secondary !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatStreamingIndicator-bubble, & [class*="MuiChatStreamingIndicator-bubble"]': {
    bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
    backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
    boxShadow: 'none !important',
    border: 'none !important',
    padding: '0 !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatStreamingIndicator-root, & [class*="MuiChatStreamingIndicator-root"]': {
    bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
    backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
    boxShadow: 'none !important',
    border: 'none !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatTypingIndicator-root, & [class*="MuiChatTypingIndicator-root"]': {
    bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
    backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
    boxShadow: 'none !important',
    border: 'none !important',
    padding: '0 !important',
  },
  '& .MuiChatScrollToBottomAffordance-root, & [class*="MuiChatScrollToBottomAffordance"]': {
    backgroundColor: 'background.paper !important',
    color: 'text.primary !important',
    borderRadius: '50% !important',
    boxShadow: 3,
    zIndex: 10,
    '&:hover': {
      backgroundColor: 'background.paper !important',
      boxShadow: 6,
    },
  },
});

/**
 * AI Chat and operational canvas view.
 *
 * @component Chat
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Clean native ChatBox interface.
 */
export const Chat = () => {
  const { chatId } = useParams();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser);
  const activeModel = useSelector(selectActiveModel);
  const thinkingBudget = useSelector(selectThinkingBudget);
  const language = useSelector(selectLanguage);
  const sttEngine = useSelector(selectSttEngine);
  const reduxActiveChatId = useSelector((state) => state.chat.activeChatId);

  // Instantiates the idiomatic MuiChatAdapter with live store dispatcher and lifecycle callbacks
  const adapter = useMemo(() => {
    return new MuiChatAdapter({
      dispatch,
      onSessionCreated: ({ chatId: createdId }) => {
        if (createdId) {
          dispatch(setActiveChatId(createdId));
        }
      },
      onTurnCompleted: ({ chatId: completedId }) => {
        // Stream completed: messages stay rendered in store without being wiped by route navigation.
        // The browser URL was already synchronized via replaceState on session creation.
        if (completedId) {
          dispatch(setActiveChatId(completedId));
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        if (err?.name !== 'AbortError') {
          console.warn('[Chat] Stream notice:', err?.message || err);
        }
      },
    });
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Synchronize activeChatId in Redux on route param changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatId) {
      dispatch(setActiveChatId(chatId));
    } else {
      dispatch(setActiveChatId(null));
      adapter.clearActiveChatId?.();
    }
  }, [dispatch, chatId, adapter]);

  // Handle Google Drive OAuth callback redirect parameters (?google_auth=success or ?google_auth=error)
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const googleAuth = params.get('google_auth');
    if (googleAuth) {
      if (googleAuth === 'success') {
        toast.success(
          'Google Drive connected successfully! Your Personal AI Agent can now author docs and sheets in your Drive.'
        );
      } else if (googleAuth === 'error') {
        const message = params.get('message') || 'Authentication failed or was cancelled.';
        toast.error(`Failed to connect Google Drive: ${message}`);
      }
      const newSearch = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      newSearch.delete('google_auth');
      newSearch.delete('message');
      const searchStr = newSearch.toString();
      const newUrl = `${location.pathname}${searchStr ? `?${searchStr}` : ''}`;
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newUrl);
    }
  }, [location.search, location.pathname]);

  // Hydrate config if opening an existing chat thread
  const {
    data: chatData,
    error: chatError,
    isError: isChatError,
  } = useGetChatByIdQuery(
    { chatId, limit: CHAT_PAGINATION.MESSAGES_PAGE_SIZE },
    { skip: !chatId }
  );

  // Handle non-existent or inaccessible chat session (404 / 400)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatId && isChatError) {
      const isNotFound =
        chatError?.status === 404 ||
        chatError?.status === 400 ||
        chatError?.data?.message?.toLowerCase()?.includes('not found') ||
        chatError?.data?.message?.toLowerCase()?.includes('invalid');

      const errorMessage =
        chatError?.data?.message ||
        (isNotFound ? 'Chat not found or has been deleted.' : 'Failed to load chat.');

      toast.error(errorMessage, { toastId: 'chat-not-found-error' });

      if (isNotFound || chatError?.status === 404) {
        dispatch(setActiveChatId(null));
        adapter.clearActiveChatId?.();
        navigate('/chat', { replace: true, state: { newChatAt: Date.now() } });
      }
    }
  }, [chatId, isChatError, chatError, dispatch, adapter, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatId && chatData?.chat?.config) {
      const cfg = chatData.chat.config;
      if (cfg.model) dispatch(setActiveModel(cfg.model));
      if (cfg.thinkingBudget !== undefined) dispatch(setThinkingBudget(cfg.thinkingBudget));
      if (cfg.language) dispatch(setLanguage(cfg.language));
    } else if (!chatId && user?.settings) {
      // Pristine /chat session: initialize from user account defaults
      if (user.settings.agentConfig?.defaultModel) {
        dispatch(setActiveModel(user.settings.agentConfig.defaultModel));
      }
      if (user.settings.agentConfig?.defaultThinkingBudget !== undefined) {
        dispatch(setThinkingBudget(user.settings.agentConfig.defaultThinkingBudget));
      }
      if (user.settings.agentConfig?.defaultLanguage) {
        dispatch(setLanguage(user.settings.agentConfig.defaultLanguage));
      }
      if (user.settings.sttEngine) {
        dispatch(setSttEngine(user.settings.sttEngine));
      }
    }
  }, [chatId, chatData, user, dispatch]);

  // Derive stable session key: matches conversation ID if viewing existing thread,
  // or unique new-chat token if user requested a fresh canvas via sidebar "+" or nav item.
  const sessionKey = chatId || (location.state?.newChatAt ? `new-${location.state.newChatAt}` : `new-${location.key}`);

  // Derive current user identity for MUI X Chat
  const currentUser = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) {
      return { id: 'supervisor', name: 'Supervisor' };
    }
    return {
      id: user._id || user.id || 'supervisor',
      name:
        user.fullName ||
        `${user.firstName || ''} ${user.lastName || ''}`.trim() ||
        'Supervisor',
    };
  }, [user]);

  // Stable author resolver ensuring user turn is on right and assistant turn is on left
  const getMessageAuthorId = useCallback(
    (msg) => {
      if (msg?.role === 'user' || msg?.author?.role === 'user') {
        return currentUser?.id || 'supervisor';
      }
      return 'assistant';
    },
    [currentUser?.id]
  );

  // Route synchronization callback on conversation selection
  const handleActiveConversationChange = useCallback(
    (newId) => {
      if (newId) {
        navigate(`/chat/${newId}`);
      } else {
        navigate('/chat');
      }
    },
    [navigate],
  );


  // Keep active chat ID, current user, model, thinkingBudget, language, and sttEngine synchronized on state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const effectiveChatId = chatId || reduxActiveChatId || null;
    if (effectiveChatId) {
      adapter.setActiveChatId(effectiveChatId);
    } else if (location.state?.newChatAt) {
      adapter.clearActiveChatId?.();
    }
    adapter.setCurrentUser(currentUser);
    adapter.setModel(activeModel);
    adapter.setThinkingBudget(thinkingBudget);
    adapter.setLanguage(language);
    adapter.setSttEngine(sttEngine);
  }, [adapter, chatId, reduxActiveChatId, location.state?.newChatAt, currentUser, activeModel, thinkingBudget, language, sttEngine]);

  return (
    <ChatAdapterContext.Provider value={adapter}>
      <ChatBox
        key={sessionKey}
        adapter={adapter}
        layoutMode="standard"
        activeConversationId={chatId || undefined}
        onActiveConversationChange={handleActiveConversationChange}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        getMessageAuthorId={getMessageAuthorId}
        features={FEATURES}
        slots={SLOTS}
        slotProps={SLOT_PROPS}
        sx={CHATBOX_SX}
      />
    </ChatAdapterContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default Chat;

/**
 * @module pages/Dashboard
 * @description Central executive operational intelligence canvas and supervisor dashboard.
 * Composes:
 * - Row 1: Header title, subtitle, and responsive quick action shortcuts (Chat inspection & add branch).
 * - Row 2: 4 KPI metric stat cards (Active Branches, Total Inspections, Audits This Week, Open Issues).
 * - Row 3: Side-by-side analytical charts (@mui/x-charts):
 *     Left: Top Visited Branches inspection frequency distribution (BarChart).
 *     Right: 14-day continuous audit volume trajectory (LineChart).
 * - Row 4: Recent operational inspections ledger (desktop high-density table and mobile card stack).
 */

import { memo, useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import DashboardQuickActions from '../components/dashboard/DashboardQuickActions.jsx';
import DashboardKpiDeck from '../components/dashboard/DashboardKpiDeck.jsx';
import DashboardBranchVisitChart from '../components/dashboard/DashboardBranchVisitChart.jsx';
import DashboardAuditTrendChart from '../components/dashboard/DashboardAuditTrendChart.jsx';
import DashboardRecentAuditsLedger from '../components/dashboard/DashboardRecentAuditsLedger.jsx';
import MuiBranchDialog from '../components/branches/MuiBranchDialog.jsx';
import { useGetDashboardMetricsQuery } from '../redux/features/dashboardSlice.js';

/**
 * Executive operational intelligence dashboard canvas.
 *
 * @component Dashboard
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered executive dashboard canvas.
 */
export const Dashboard = memo(() => {
  const [isBranchDialogOpen, setIsBranchDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: metrics,
    isLoading,
    isError,
    error,
    refetch,
  } = useGetDashboardMetricsQuery();

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: { xs: '100%', xl: 1600 },
        mx: 'auto',
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2, md: 2.5, lg: 3, xl: 3.5 },
      }}
    >
      {/* =========================================================================
          ROW 1: HEADER & ACTIONS
          Left: Executive Title & Subtitle
          Right: Quick Action Shortcuts with In-Place Branch Add & Chat Inspection
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
          gap: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 },
          mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: { sm: 1 }, mr: { sm: 2 } }}>
          <Typography
            variant="h5"
            component="h1"
            sx={{
              fontWeight: 800,
              letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
              fontSize: { xs: '1.2rem', sm: '1.35rem', md: '1.5rem', lg: '1.65rem' },
              color: 'text.primary',
            }}
          >
            Operational Dashboard
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              fontSize: { xs: '0.78rem', sm: '0.82rem', md: '0.875rem' },
              mt: 0.25,
            }}
          >
            Platform-wide inspection intelligence and store network oversight
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <DashboardQuickActions onAddBranch={() => setIsBranchDialogOpen(true)} />
      </Box>

      {/* Error Banner with Retry Interaction */}
      {isError && (
        <Alert
          severity="error"
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{ mb: 3, borderRadius: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}
          action={
            <MuiButton
              color="inherit"
              size="small"
              onClick={refetch}
              startIcon={<RefreshIcon fontSize="small" />}
            >
              Retry
            </MuiButton>
          }
        >
          {error?.message || 'Failed to retrieve operational metrics. Please check your network connection.'}
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          MAIN EXECUTIVE CANVAS CONTENT
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Stack spacing={{ xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 }}>
        {/* ROW 2: KPI DECK (4 Cards, 100% fullwidth on xs, 2x2 on sm, 1x4 on md+) */}
        <DashboardKpiDeck kpis={metrics?.kpis} isLoading={isLoading} />

        {/* ROW 3: ANALYTICS CHARTS (Side-by-Side on lg+, Stacked on xs/sm/md) */}
        <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2, sm: 2.5 }}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 12, md: 12, lg: 6, xl: 6 }}>
            <DashboardBranchVisitChart
              data={metrics?.branchVisitFrequency}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 12, md: 12, lg: 6, xl: 6 }}>
            <DashboardAuditTrendChart
              data={metrics?.auditVolumeTrend}
              isLoading={isLoading}
            />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        {/* ROW 4: RECENT INSPECTIONS LEDGER (Mobile Card Deck & sm+ Table with Telegram Share) */}
        <DashboardRecentAuditsLedger
          reports={metrics?.recentReports}
          isLoading={isLoading}
        />
      </Stack>

      {/* Repurposed Modal Feature: In-Place Branch Creation */}
      <MuiBranchDialog
        open={isBranchDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsBranchDialogOpen(false)}
        onSuccess={() => {
          refetch();
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

Dashboard.displayName = 'Dashboard';

export default Dashboard;

/**
 * @module pages/Login
 * @description Enterprise authentication login page for Personal AI Agent.
 * Zero-lag form responsiveness with mode: 'onBlur', zero debounces, and zero watch calls.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import LockOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../components/reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import GoogleSsoButton from '../components/auth/GoogleSsoButton.jsx';
import { useLoginMutation } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import {
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  ROUTES,
  API_BASE_URL,
} from '../utils/constants.js';

/** Stable adornment icons preventing unnecessary sub-tree reconciliations */
const EMAIL_ADORNMENT = <EmailOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />;
const PASSWORD_ADORNMENT = <LockOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />;

/**
 * Enterprise login page presenting authentication form card with react-hook-form validation.
 * Strictly adheres to single-user architecture with zero "Remember Me" logic.
 *
 * @component Login
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered login page presentation.
 */
export const Login = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [login, { isLoading }] = useLoginMutation();
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const err = params.get('error');
    if (err === 'GOOGLE_SSO_NOT_CONFIGURED') {
      return 'Google SSO is not configured on this server. Please sign in with email and password.';
    }
    return err ? `Sign in error: ${err}` : '';
  });
  const [ssoPrompt, setSsoPrompt] = useState(false);
  const [isGoogleLoading, setIsGoogleLoading] = useState(false);

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || ROUTES.DASHBOARD;

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
    },
  });

  const handleGoogleSso = () => {
    setIsGoogleLoading(true);
    window.location.href = `${API_BASE_URL}/auth/google/sso`;
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data) => {
    setServerError('');
    setSsoPrompt(false);
    try {
      await login(data).unwrap();
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err?.data?.errorCode === 'SSO_PASSWORD_NOT_SET') {
        setSsoPrompt(true);
        setServerError(
          err?.data?.message ||
          "This account was registered using Google Sign-In and does not have an email password yet. Please click 'Sign in with Google' below, or set a password in your Profile."
        );
      } else {
        const message =
          err?.data?.message ||
          err?.message ||
          err?.error ||
          'Invalid credentials. Please verify your email and password.';
        setServerError(message);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Container maxWidth="xs" sx={{ py: { xs: 4, sm: 8 } }}>
      <Card
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 4 },
          borderRadius: 3,
          textAlign: 'center',
          boxShadow: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
              ? '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
              : '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            p: 1.5,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: 'primary.light',
            color: 'primary.dark',
            mb: 2,
          }}
        >
          <LockOutlinedIcon fontSize="medium" />
        </Box>

        <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={700} gutterBottom sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '1.25rem', sm: '1.5rem' } }}>
          Welcome Back
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          Sign in to access your Personal AI Agent dashboard and field records.
        </Typography>

        {serverError && (
          <Alert
            severity={ssoPrompt ? 'info' : 'error'}
            sx={{
              mb: 2.5,
              textAlign: 'left',
              '& .MuiAlert-message': { width: '100%' },
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="body2">
              {serverError}
            </Typography>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate sx={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <Grid container spacing={1.5}>
            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Email Address"
                placeholder="name@company.com"
                autoComplete="email"
                autoFocus
                startAdornment={EMAIL_ADORNMENT}
                error={Boolean(errors.email)}
                helperText={errors.email?.message}
                disabled={isLoading}
                {...register('email', {
                  required: 'Email address is required',
                  pattern: {
                    value: EMAIL_REGEX,
                    message: 'Please enter a valid email address',
                  },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                startAdornment={PASSWORD_ADORNMENT}
                error={Boolean(errors.password)}
                helperText={errors.password?.message}
                disabled={isLoading}
                {...register('password', {
                  required: 'Password is required',
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12} >
              <MuiButton
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                size="medium"
                disabled={isLoading}
                sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                startIcon={isLoading ? <CircularProgress size={18} color="inherit" /> : null}
              >
                {isLoading ? 'Signing In...' : 'Sign In'}
              </MuiButton>
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, height: '1px', bgcolor: 'divider' }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ px: 2, color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  OR
                </Typography>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, height: '1px', bgcolor: 'divider' }} />
              </Box>
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <GoogleSsoButton
                label="Sign in with Google"
                onClick={handleGoogleSso}
                isLoading={isGoogleLoading}
                disabled={isLoading || isGoogleLoading}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', mt: 1 }}>
          <MuiButton
            component={Link}
            to={ROUTES.REGISTER}
            variant="text"
            size="small"
            sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 500 }}
          >
            Don't have an account? Register
          </MuiButton>
        </Box>
      </Card>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default Login;

/**
 * @module pages/NotFound
 * @description Fully functional 404 Not Found error page with vector SVG illustration,
 * context-aware destination recovery (Dashboard vs Home), and previous view rewind.
 */

import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import HomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Home';
import DashboardIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Dashboard';
import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import { selectIsAuthenticated } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import { ROUTES } from '../utils/constants.js';
import notFoundSvg from '../assets/notFound_404.svg';

/**
 * 404 Not Found error page with SVG illustration and context-aware recovery actions.
 *
 * @component NotFound
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered 404 error page view.
 */
export const NotFound = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated);

  const destinationRoute = isAuthenticated ? ROUTES.DASHBOARD : ROUTES.LANDING;
  const destinationLabel = isAuthenticated ? 'Back to Dashboard' : 'Back to Home';
  const DestinationIcon = isAuthenticated ? DashboardIcon : HomeIcon;

  return (
    <Container
      maxWidth="md"
      sx={{
        minHeight: '80vh',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        py: { xs: 6, sm: 10 },
        textAlign: 'center',
      }}
    >
      <Box
        component="img"
        src={notFoundSvg}
        alt="404 Page Not Found"
        sx={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: { xs: 280, sm: 380, md: 440 },
          height: 'auto',
          mb: 4,
          userSelect: 'none',
        }}
      />

      <Typography variant="h4" fontWeight={700} color="text.primary" gutterBottom>
        Page Not Found
      </Typography>

      <Typography
        variant="body1"
        color="text.secondary"
        sx={{ maxWidth: 520, mb: 4, lineHeight: 1.6 }}
      >
        The page or operational view you are looking for does not exist, has been relocated,
        or the URL may contain a typo.
      </Typography>

      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          gap: 2,
          flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
          width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <MuiButton
          component={Link}
          to={destinationRoute}
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<DestinationIcon />}
          sx={{ px: 3, py: 1 }}
        >
          {destinationLabel}
        </MuiButton>

        <MuiButton
          variant="outlined"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
          sx={{ px: 3, py: 1 }}
        >
          Go Back
        </MuiButton>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default NotFound;
