````jsx
/**
 * @module pages/Profile
 * @description Supervisor Profile, Account Governance, AI Inference Settings, Directives SSOT, and Cloud Integrations canvas.
 * Follows declarative orchestrator architecture, importing domain components from components/profile/*.
 */

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Tabs from '@mui/material/Tabs';
import Tab from '@mui/material/Tab';
import PersonIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Person';
import LockOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';
import SmartToyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SmartToyOutlined';
import RuleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Rule';
import CloudQueueIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloudQueue';
import SendIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Send';

import { selectAuthUser } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import ProfileHeaderHero from '../components/profile/ProfileHeaderHero.jsx';
import ProfileAccountTab from '../components/profile/ProfileAccountTab.jsx';
import ProfileSecurityTab from '../components/profile/ProfileSecurityTab.jsx';
import ProfileAgentConfigTab from '../components/profile/ProfileAgentConfigTab.jsx';
import ProfileDirectivesTab from '../components/profile/ProfileDirectivesTab.jsx';
import CloudIntegrationsTab from '../components/profile/CloudIntegrationsTab.jsx';
import ProfileTelegramTab from '../components/profile/ProfileTelegramTab.jsx';
import ProfileDangerZone from '../components/profile/ProfileDangerZone.jsx';

const TAB_INDEX_MAP = {
  account: 0,
  security: 1,
  'ai-agent': 2,
  directives: 3,
  'cloud-integrations': 4,
  telegram: 5,
};

const TAB_NAME_MAP = {
  0: 'account',
  1: 'security',
  2: 'ai-agent',
  3: 'directives',
  4: 'cloud-integrations',
  5: 'telegram',
};

/**
 * Supervisor Profile and Governance Page.
 *
 * @component Profile
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered profile canvas.
 */
export const Profile = () => {
  const user = useSelector(selectAuthUser);
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const tabParam = searchParams.get('tab');
  const activeTab = useMemo(() => {
    if (tabParam && TAB_INDEX_MAP[tabParam] !== undefined) {
      return TAB_INDEX_MAP[tabParam];
    }
    return 0; // Default to Account Profile
  }, [tabParam]);

  const handleTabChange = (_event, newIndex) => {
    const tabName = TAB_NAME_MAP[newIndex] || 'account';
    setSearchParams({ tab: tabName }, { replace: true });
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        overflowY: 'auto',
        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2.5, md: 3.5 },
        bgcolor: 'background.default',
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 960, mx: 'auto' }}>
        {/* User Identity Header Hero */}
        <ProfileHeaderHero user={user} />

        {/* Section Navigation Tabs */}
        <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: { xs: 2, sm: 3 } }}>
          <Tabs
            value={activeTab}
            onChange={handleTabChange}
            variant="scrollable"
            scrollButtons="auto"
            allowScrollButtonsMobile
            aria-label="Profile and Governance Tabs"
            sx={{
              minHeight: { xs: 40, sm: 48 },
              '& .MuiTabs-scrollButtons': {
                width: 36,
                transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease',
                '&.Mui-disabled': {
                  opacity: 0.2,
                  cursor: 'default',
                  pointerEvents: 'none',
                },
                '&:not(.Mui-disabled)': {
                  opacity: 0.85,
                  color: 'primary.main',
                  '&:hover': {
                    opacity: 1,
                    bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  },
                },
              },
              '& .MuiTab-root': {
                fontWeight: 600,
                textTransform: 'none',
                fontSize: { xs: '0.75rem', sm: '0.875rem' },
                minHeight: { xs: 40, sm: 48 },
                py: { xs: 0.5, sm: 1 },
                px: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2 },
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              },
            }}
          >
            <Tab
              icon={<PersonIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="Account Profile"
              id="profile-tab-0"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-0"
            />
            <Tab
              icon={<LockOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="Security & Password"
              id="profile-tab-1"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-1"
            />
            <Tab
              icon={<SmartToyOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="AI Agent & Inference"
              id="profile-tab-2"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-2"
            />
            <Tab
              icon={<RuleIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="Directives & Templates"
              id="profile-tab-3"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-3"
            />
            <Tab
              icon={<CloudQueueIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="Cloud Workspace"
              id="profile-tab-4"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-4"
            />
            <Tab
              icon={<SendIcon fontSize="small" />}
              iconPosition="start"
              label="Telegram Channels"
              id="profile-tab-5"
              aria-controls="profile-tabpanel-5"
            />
          </Tabs>
        </Box>

        {/* Tab 0: Account Profile & Photo Deck + Danger Zone */}
        {activeTab === 0 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-0" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-0">
            <ProfileAccountTab user={user} />
            <ProfileDangerZone />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Tab 1: Security & Password Management */}
        {activeTab === 1 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-1" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-1">
            <ProfileSecurityTab user={user} />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Tab 2: AI Agent & Inference Configuration */}
        {activeTab === 2 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-2" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-2">
            <ProfileAgentConfigTab user={user} />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Tab 3: Supervisor Directives & Report Templates SSOT */}
        {activeTab === 3 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-3" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-3">
            <ProfileDirectivesTab user={user} />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Tab 4: Cloud Workspace & Google Drive Integration */}
        {activeTab === 4 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-4" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-4">
            <CloudIntegrationsTab />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Tab 5: Telegram Operational Channels */}
        {activeTab === 5 && (
          <Box role="tabpanel" id="profile-tabpanel-5" aria-labelledby="profile-tab-5">
            <ProfileTelegramTab user={user} />
          </Box>
        )}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Profile;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module pages/Register
 * @description Enterprise onboarding registration page for Personal AI Agent.
 * Zero-lag form responsiveness with mode: 'onBlur', zero debounces, and zero watch calls.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import PersonAddOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonAddOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import LockOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../components/reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import GoogleSsoButton from '../components/auth/GoogleSsoButton.jsx';
import { useRegisterMutation } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import {
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  PASSWORD_REGEX,
  ROUTES,
  API_BASE_URL,
} from '../utils/constants.js';

/** Stable adornment icons preventing unnecessary sub-tree reconciliations */
const EMAIL_ADORNMENT = <EmailOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />;
const PASSWORD_ADORNMENT = <LockOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />;

/**
 * Enterprise registration page for Personal AI Agent platform.
 * Streamlined 3-field layout (Email, Password, Confirm Password).
 * First and last names are auto-derived seamlessly and fully manageable in /profile.
 *
 * @component Register
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered registration page presentation.
 */
export const Register = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [registerUser, { isLoading }] = useRegisterMutation();
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState('');
  const [isGoogleLoading, setIsGoogleLoading] = useState(false);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm({
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
    },
  });

  const handleGoogleSso = () => {
    setIsGoogleLoading(true);
    window.location.href = `${API_BASE_URL}/auth/google/sso`;
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data) => {
    setServerError('');
    try {
      await registerUser({
        email: data.email,
        password: data.password,
      }).unwrap();

      toast.success('Account created successfully! Please sign in with your credentials.');
      navigate(ROUTES.LOGIN, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      const message =
        err?.message ||
        err?.data?.message ||
        err?.error ||
        'Registration failed. Please check your information and try again.';
      setServerError(message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Container maxWidth="xs" sx={{ py: { xs: 4, sm: 8 } }}>
      <Card
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 4 },
          borderRadius: 3,
          textAlign: 'center',
          boxShadow: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
              ? '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
              : '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            p: 1.5,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: 'primary.light',
            color: 'primary.dark',
            mb: 2,
          }}
        >
          <PersonAddOutlinedIcon fontSize="medium" />
        </Box>

        <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={700} gutterBottom sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '1.25rem', sm: '1.5rem' } }}>
          Create Your Account
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          Set up your Personal AI Agent for autonomous field operations and daily workflows.
        </Typography>

        {serverError && (
          <Alert
            severity={serverError.includes('Google Sign-In') ? 'info' : 'error'}
            sx={{ mb: 2.5, textAlign: 'left', '& .MuiAlert-message': { width: '100%' } }}
          >
            <Typography variant="body2">{serverError}</Typography>
            {serverError.includes('Google Sign-In') && (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <MuiButton
                  size="small"
                  variant="contained"
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={handleGoogleSso}
                  disabled={isGoogleLoading}
                  startIcon={isGoogleLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : null}
                  sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600 }}
                >
                  {isGoogleLoading ? 'Connecting to Google...' : 'Sign in with Google'}
                </MuiButton>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate sx={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <Grid container spacing={1.5}>
            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Email Address"
                placeholder="name@company.com"
                autoComplete="email"
                autoFocus
                startAdornment={EMAIL_ADORNMENT}
                error={Boolean(errors.email)}
                helperText={errors.email?.message}
                disabled={isLoading}
                {...register('email', {
                  required: 'Email address is required',
                  pattern: {
                    value: EMAIL_REGEX,
                    message: 'Please enter a valid email address',
                  },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                startAdornment={PASSWORD_ADORNMENT}
                error={Boolean(errors.password)}
                helperText={
                  errors.password?.message ||
                  'Min 8 characters with upper, lower, number & symbol.'
                }
                disabled={isLoading}
                {...register('password', {
                  required: 'Password is required',
                  pattern: {
                    value: PASSWORD_REGEX,
                    message:
                      'Must include at least 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, and 1 special symbol (@$!%*?&)',
                  },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Confirm Password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                startAdornment={PASSWORD_ADORNMENT}
                error={Boolean(errors.confirmPassword)}
                helperText={errors.confirmPassword?.message}
                disabled={isLoading}
                {...register('confirmPassword', {
                  required: 'Please confirm your password',
                  validate: (val, formValues) =>
                    val === formValues.password || 'Passwords do not match',
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <MuiButton
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                size="medium"
                disabled={isLoading}
                sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                startIcon={isLoading ? <CircularProgress size={18} color="inherit" /> : null}
              >
                {isLoading ? 'Creating Account...' : 'Create Account'}
              </MuiButton>
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, height: '1px', bgcolor: 'divider' }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ px: 2, color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  OR
                </Typography>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, height: '1px', bgcolor: 'divider' }} />
              </Box>
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={12}>
              <GoogleSsoButton
                label="Sign up with Google"
                onClick={handleGoogleSso}
                isLoading={isGoogleLoading}
                disabled={isLoading || isGoogleLoading}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', mt: 1 }}>
          <MuiButton
            component={Link}
            to={ROUTES.LOGIN}
            variant="text"
            size="small"
            sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 500 }}
          >
            Already have an account? Sign In
          </MuiButton>
        </Box>
      </Card>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default Register;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module pages/ReportDetail
 * @description Master Inspection Report Detail Dossier & 5 Corporate Delivery Channels canvas.
 * Implements:
 * - Row 1: Breadcrumbs (Dashboard > Reports > Details) on left + Back button on right (iconified on xs < 600px).
 * - Row 2: ReportHero (Inspection date Gregorian + Ethiopian ዓ.ም, Shift hours, Supervisor author, status, Edit/Archive/Restore).
 * - Row 3: ReportDeliveryActionBar (The 5 delivery channels: Clipboard, UTF-8 BOM txt, Print/PDF, Drive, Telegram).
 * - Row 4: ReportAmharicDossier (Authoritative SSOT Amharic text with Ge'ez typography).
 * - Row 5: Subdocuments Deck (Visits Ledger, Activities Checklist, Issues Triage, Supervisory Comments).
 * - Row 6: ReportAudioPlayerDeck (Evidentiary voice notes with HTML5 player).
 * - Row 7: ReportDangerZone (Archive, Restore, Permanent Cascade Deletion).
 * - Dedicated @media print stylesheet for high-fidelity vector printing and clean page breaks.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlined';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../components/reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

import ReportHero from '../components/reports/ReportHero.jsx';
import ReportAmharicDossier from '../components/reports/ReportAmharicDossier.jsx';
import ReportVisitsLedger from '../components/reports/ReportVisitsLedger.jsx';
import ReportActivitiesCard from '../components/reports/ReportActivitiesCard.jsx';
import ReportIssuesCard from '../components/reports/ReportIssuesCard.jsx';
import ReportCommentsCard from '../components/reports/ReportCommentsCard.jsx';
import ReportAudioPlayerDeck from '../components/reports/ReportAudioPlayerDeck.jsx';
import ReportDangerZone from '../components/reports/ReportDangerZone.jsx';

import {
  useGetReportByIdQuery,
  useUpdateReportMutation,
  useArchiveReportMutation,
  useRestoreReportMutation,
  useDeleteReportMutation,
} from '../redux/features/reportSlice.js';

/**
 * Report detail view orchestrator.
 *
 * @component ReportDetail
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered report detail page view.
 */
export const ReportDetail = memo(() => {
  const { reportId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Dialog and Action Lifecycle states
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // { id: string, action: 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete' } | null
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState({
    open: false,
    type: null, // 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete'
  });

  // Fetch report by ID
  const { data: reportData, isLoading, isError, error } = useGetReportByIdQuery(reportId);
  const report = reportData?.report || reportData?.doc || reportData;

  const [updateReport] = useUpdateReportMutation();
  const [archiveReport] = useArchiveReportMutation();
  const [restoreReport] = useRestoreReportMutation();
  const [deleteReport] = useDeleteReportMutation();

  // Item-level update handlers for in-place subdocument edits
  const handleUpdateActivities = useCallback(
    async (updatedActivities) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, activities: updatedActivities }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Activity updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update activity.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateIssues = useCallback(
    async (updatedIssues) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, issues: updatedIssues }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Issue updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update issue.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateComments = useCallback(
    async (updatedComments) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, comments: updatedComments }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Observation updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update observation.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateVisits = useCallback(
    async (updatedVisits) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, visits: updatedVisits }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Branch visit updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update visit.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  // Navigation handlers
  const handleEdit = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(`/reports/${reportId}/edit`);
  }, [navigate, reportId]);

  // Confirmation triggers
  const handleOpenArchiveConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'archive' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenRestoreConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'restore' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenDeleteConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'delete' });
  }, []);

  const handleCloseConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: false, type: null });
  }, []);

  // Modal execution handler with immediate dismissal and action-scoped loading
  const handleConfirmAction = useCallback(async () => {
    const { type } = confirmModal;
    if (!reportId) return;

    handleCloseConfirm();
    setActionLoading({ id: reportId, action: type });

    try {
      if (type === 'archive') {
        await archiveReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report archived successfully.');
      } else if (type === 'restore') {
        await restoreReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report restored to active status.');
      } else if (type === 'delete') {
        await deleteReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report and all voice recordings permanently deleted.');
        navigate('/reports');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || `Failed to ${type} report.`);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }, [confirmModal, handleCloseConfirm, reportId, archiveReport, restoreReport, deleteReport, navigate]);

  // Loading skeleton representation
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 1400, mx: 'auto', p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5, md: 3 }, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={40} sx={{ borderRadius: 1.5 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={160} sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={60} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={220} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
            <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={200} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
            <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={200} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // Error or Not Found state
  if (isError || !report) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ p: 4, width: '100%', maxWidth: 800, mx: 'auto' }}>
        <MuiEmptyState
          icon={<ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56, color: 'error.main' }} />}
          title="Operational Report Not Found"
          subtitle={error?.data?.message || error?.message || 'The requested operational report could not be located or may have been permanently purged.'}
          action={
            <MuiButton variant="contained" component={RouterLink} to="/reports" startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}>
              Back to Reports
            </MuiButton>
          }
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  const isArchived = Boolean(report.isArchived);
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        mx: 'auto',
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        // Dedicated Print Stylesheet Injection
        '@media print': {
          p: 0,
          m: 0,
          '& .MuiBreadcrumbs-root, & .report-back-btn, & .report-action-bar, & .report-danger-zone, & .report-audio-deck, & button': {
            display: 'none !important',
          },
          '& .MuiPaper-root': {
            border: 'none !important',
            boxShadow: 'none !important',
            p: 1,
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      {/* ROW 1: Breadcrumbs on Left + Back to Reports Button on Right */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
        }}
      >
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }} />}
          aria-label="report details navigation breadcrumb"
          sx={{
            '& .MuiBreadcrumbs-ol': { alignItems: 'center' },
            '& .MuiTypography-root': { fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.875rem' } },
          }}
        >
          <Typography
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/dashboard"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
          >
            Dashboard
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/reports"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
          >
            Reports
          </Typography>
          <Typography color="text.primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Details
          </Typography>
        </Breadcrumbs>

        {/* Back to Reports Action Button */}
        <Box className="report-back-btn">
          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="inherit"
            startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/reports"
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            Back to Reports
          </MuiButton>

          {/* xs mobile icon button */}
          <Tooltip title="Back to Reports" arrow>
            <IconButton
              component={RouterLink}
              to="/reports"
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="Back to reports"
              sx={{
                display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`,
              }}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* ROW 2: Report Hero Profile & Metadata Banner */}
      <ReportHero
        report={report}
        onEdit={!isArchived ? handleEdit : undefined}
        onArchive={!isArchived ? handleOpenArchiveConfirm : undefined}
        onRestore={isArchived ? handleOpenRestoreConfirm : undefined}
        actionLoading={actionLoading}
      />

      {/* ROW 3: Synthesized Authoritative Corporate Amharic Dossier */}
      <ReportAmharicDossier transcription={report.transcription} />

      {/* ROW 5: Structured Subdocument Panels Deck with Item-Level Editing */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
        {/* Branch Visits Ledger */}
        <ReportVisitsLedger
          visits={report.visits || []}
          onUpdateVisits={!isArchived ? handleUpdateVisits : undefined}
        />

        {/* Operational Activities & Issues Side-by-Side on md+ */}
        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 6 }}>
            <ReportActivitiesCard
              activities={report.activities || []}
              onUpdateActivities={!isArchived ? handleUpdateActivities : undefined}
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 6 }}>
            <ReportIssuesCard
              issues={report.issues || []}
              onUpdateIssues={!isArchived ? handleUpdateIssues : undefined}
            />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        {/* Supervisory Observations */}
        <ReportCommentsCard
          comments={report.comments || []}
          onUpdateComments={!isArchived ? handleUpdateComments : undefined}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* ROW 6: Evidentiary Voice Notes & Audio Player Deck */}
      <ReportAudioPlayerDeck audios={report.audios || []} />

      {/* ROW 7: Danger Zone */}
      <ReportDangerZone
        isArchived={isArchived}
        onArchive={handleOpenArchiveConfirm}
        onRestore={handleOpenRestoreConfirm}
        onDelete={handleOpenDeleteConfirm}
        actionLoading={actionLoading}
      />

      {/* Confirmation Modal for Destructive Operations */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={confirmModal.open}
        title={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Operational Report?'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Operational Report?'
              : 'Permanently Delete Report (Cascade)?'
        }
        message={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'This report will be archived and hidden from active listings. It can be restored at any time within 30 days.'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'This report will be restored back to the active operational registry.'
              : 'This will permanently delete the report and unlink all physical voice recordings from the server. This action cannot be undone.'
        }
        confirmText={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Report'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Report'
              : 'Delete Permanently'
        }
        confirmColor={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'warning'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'success'
              : 'error'
        }
        onConfirm={handleConfirmAction}
        onClose={handleCloseConfirm}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

ReportDetail.displayName = 'ReportDetail';

export default ReportDetail;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module pages/ReportEdit
 * @description Supervised Operational Report Editor Page.
 * Directly re-purposes production-grade modular subdocument cards:
 * - Row 1: Breadcrumbs (Dashboard > Reports > Edit) on left + Discard & Return button on right.
 * - Row 2: Shift Schedule & Inspection Date Card with MuiDatePicker and circular MuiTimePicker.
 * - Row 3: Authoritative Amharic Dossier Card (ReportAmharicDossier) with in-place text editing.
 * - Row 4: Branch Visits Ledger (ReportVisitsLedger) with in-place arrival/departure timing updates.
 * - Row 5: Operational Activities (ReportActivitiesCard) & Issues (ReportIssuesCard) side-by-side.
 * - Row 6: Supervisory Observations (ReportCommentsCard) with in-place adding and editing.
 * - Row 7: Danger Zone (ReportDangerZone) with soft-archive, restore, and cascade permanent deletion.
 * - Destructive action confirmation via MuiConfirmDialog.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, memo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlined';
import ScheduleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ScheduleOutlined';
import SaveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SaveOutlined';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiDatePicker from '../components/reusable/MuiDatePicker.jsx';
import MuiTimePicker from '../components/reusable/MuiTimePicker.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../components/reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

import ReportAmharicDossier from '../components/reports/ReportAmharicDossier.jsx';
import ReportVisitsLedger from '../components/reports/ReportVisitsLedger.jsx';
import ReportActivitiesCard from '../components/reports/ReportActivitiesCard.jsx';
import ReportIssuesCard from '../components/reports/ReportIssuesCard.jsx';
import ReportCommentsCard from '../components/reports/ReportCommentsCard.jsx';
import ReportDangerZone from '../components/reports/ReportDangerZone.jsx';

import {
  useGetReportByIdQuery,
  useUpdateReportMutation,
  useArchiveReportMutation,
  useRestoreReportMutation,
  useDeleteReportMutation,
} from '../redux/features/reportSlice.js';
import { computeShiftDuration } from '../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Supervised operational report editor page component.
 *
 * @component ReportEdit
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered report editor page view.
 */
export const ReportEdit = memo(() => {
  const { reportId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // RTK Query hooks
  const { data: reportData, isLoading, isError, error } = useGetReportByIdQuery(reportId);
  const report = reportData?.report || reportData?.doc || reportData;

  const [updateReport] = useUpdateReportMutation();
  const [archiveReport] = useArchiveReportMutation();
  const [restoreReport] = useRestoreReportMutation();
  const [deleteReport] = useDeleteReportMutation();

  // Shift schedule and inspection date local state
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('');
  const [clockIn, setClockIn] = useState('');
  const [clockOut, setClockOut] = useState('');
  const [isShiftSaving, setIsShiftSaving] = useState(false);

  // Sync initial shift data when report loads
  useEffect(() => {
    if (report) {
      if (report.date) {
        setSelectedDate(new Date(report.date).toISOString().split('T')[0]);
      }
      if (report.clockIn) {
        setClockIn(report.clockIn);
      }
      if (report.clockOut) {
        setClockOut(report.clockOut);
      }
    }
  }, [report]);

  // Modal and Action Loading lifecycle states
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // { id, action }
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState({ open: false, type: null });

  // Navigation handlers
  const handleReturn = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(`/reports/${reportId}/details`);
  }, [navigate, reportId]);

  // Resilient change handlers extracting primitive string values
  const handleDateChange = useCallback((val) => {
    const str = typeof val === 'object' && val !== null ? (val.gregorian ?? val.value ?? val.target?.value ?? '') : (val || '');
    setSelectedDate(str);
  }, []);

  const handleClockInChange = useCallback((val) => {
    const str = typeof val === 'object' && val !== null ? (val.value ?? val.target?.value ?? '') : (val || '');
    setClockIn(str);
  }, []);

  const handleClockOutChange = useCallback((val) => {
    const str = typeof val === 'object' && val !== null ? (val.value ?? val.target?.value ?? '') : (val || '');
    setClockOut(str);
  }, []);

  // Shift schedule update handler
  const handleUpdateShift = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedDate) {
      toast.error('Please select an inspection date.');
      return;
    }
    const cleanIn = typeof clockIn === 'string' ? clockIn.trim() : (clockIn?.value ?? '');
    const cleanOut = typeof clockOut === 'string' ? clockOut.trim() : (clockOut?.value ?? '');
    if (!cleanIn) {
      toast.error('Clock-in time is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!cleanOut) {
      toast.error('Clock-out time is required.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      setIsShiftSaving(true);
      await updateReport({
        reportId,
        date: selectedDate,
        clockIn: cleanIn,
        clockOut: cleanOut,
      }).unwrap();
      toast.success('Shift schedule and inspection date updated.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update shift schedule.');
    } finally {
      setIsShiftSaving(false);
    }
  }, [reportId, selectedDate, clockIn, clockOut, updateReport]);

  // Item-level mutation handlers for subdocuments
  const handleUpdateActivities = useCallback(
    async (updatedActivities) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, activities: updatedActivities }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Activity updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update activity.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateIssues = useCallback(
    async (updatedIssues) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, issues: updatedIssues }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Issue updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update issue.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateComments = useCallback(
    async (updatedComments) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, comments: updatedComments }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Observation updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update observation.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateVisits = useCallback(
    async (updatedVisits) => {
      try {
        const payloadVisits = updatedVisits.map((v) => ({
          branch: typeof v.branch === 'object' ? v.branch?._id || v.branch : v.branch,
          clockIn: v.clockIn,
          clockOut: v.clockOut,
        }));
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, visits: payloadVisits }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Branch visit updated successfully.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update visit.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  const handleUpdateTranscription = useCallback(
    async (newTranscription) => {
      try {
        const res = await updateReport({ reportId, transcription: newTranscription }).unwrap();
        toast.success('Amharic dossier transcription updated.');
        return res;
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update transcription.');
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [reportId, updateReport]
  );

  // Danger Zone confirmation triggers
  const handleOpenArchiveConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'archive' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenRestoreConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'restore' });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenDeleteConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: true, type: 'delete' });
  }, []);

  const handleCloseConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: false, type: null });
  }, []);

  const handleConfirmAction = useCallback(async () => {
    const { type } = confirmModal;
    if (!reportId) return;

    handleCloseConfirm();
    setActionLoading({ id: reportId, action: type });

    try {
      if (type === 'archive') {
        await archiveReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report archived successfully.');
        navigate('/reports');
      } else if (type === 'restore') {
        await restoreReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report restored to active status.');
      } else if (type === 'delete') {
        await deleteReport(reportId).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report permanently deleted.');
        navigate('/reports');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || `Failed to ${type} report.`);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }, [confirmModal, handleCloseConfirm, reportId, archiveReport, restoreReport, deleteReport, navigate]);

  // Loading skeleton representation
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 1400, mx: 'auto', p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5, md: 3 }, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={40} sx={{ borderRadius: 1.5 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={160} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={220} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={220} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // Error or Not Found state
  if (isError || !report) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ p: 4, width: '100%', maxWidth: 800, mx: 'auto' }}>
        <MuiEmptyState
          icon={<ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56, color: 'error.main' }} />}
          title="Operational Report Not Found"
          subtitle={error?.data?.message || error?.message || 'The requested operational report could not be located.'}
          action={
            <MuiButton variant="contained" component={RouterLink} to="/reports" startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}>
              Back to Reports
            </MuiButton>
          }
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  const isArchived = Boolean(report.isArchived);
  const shiftDuration = computeShiftDuration(clockIn, clockOut);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        mx: 'auto',
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
      }}
    >
      {/* ROW 1: Breadcrumbs on Left + Discard & Return Button on Right */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
        }}
      >
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }} />}
          aria-label="report edit navigation breadcrumb"
          sx={{
            '& .MuiBreadcrumbs-ol': { alignItems: 'center' },
            '& .MuiTypography-root': { fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.875rem' } },
          }}
        >
          <Typography
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/dashboard"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
          >
            Dashboard
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/reports"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
          >
            Reports
          </Typography>
          <Typography color="text.primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Edit
          </Typography>
        </Breadcrumbs>

        {/* Discard & Return Action */}
        <Box>
          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="inherit"
            startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
            onClick={handleReturn}
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            Discard & Return
          </MuiButton>

          {/* xs mobile icon button */}
          <Tooltip title="Discard & Return" arrow>
            <IconButton
              onClick={handleReturn}
              color="inherit"
              aria-label="Discard and return"
              sx={{
                display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`,
              }}
            >
              <ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* ROW 2: Shift Schedule & Inspection Date Card */}
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 2.5,
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
            gap: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 },
            borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
            pb: 1.5,
          }}
        >
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <ScheduleOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
                Shift Schedule & Inspection Date
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                Manage the operational inspection date and supervisor working hours.
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          {/* Executive Header Controls: Duration Badge + Save Schedule Action */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 1.5,
              width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
              justifyContent: { xs: 'space-between', sm: 'flex-end' },
            }}
          >
            {shiftDuration ? (
              <Chip
                label={`Duration: ${shiftDuration}`}
                color="primary"
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
              />
            ) : null}
            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              size="small"
              startIcon={isShiftSaving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <SaveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              onClick={handleUpdateShift}
              disabled={isShiftSaving || isArchived}
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'none' }}
            >
              {isShiftSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Schedule'}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
            <MuiDatePicker
              label="Inspection Date"
              value={selectedDate}
              onChange={handleDateChange}
              fullWidth
              size="small"
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
            <MuiTimePicker
              label="Work Clock-In"
              value={clockIn}
              onChange={handleClockInChange}
              fullWidth
              size="small"
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
            <MuiTimePicker
              label="Work Clock-Out"
              value={clockOut}
              onChange={handleClockOutChange}
              fullWidth
              size="small"
            />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Paper>

      {/* ROW 3: Synthesized Authoritative Corporate Amharic Dossier */}
      <ReportAmharicDossier
        transcription={report.transcription}
        onUpdateTranscription={!isArchived ? handleUpdateTranscription : undefined}
      />

      {/* ROW 4: Structured Subdocument Panels Deck with Item-Level Editing */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
        {/* Branch Visits Ledger */}
        <ReportVisitsLedger
          visits={report.visits || []}
          onUpdateVisits={!isArchived ? handleUpdateVisits : undefined}
        />

        {/* Operational Activities & Issues Side-by-Side on lg+ */}
        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 6 }}>
            <ReportActivitiesCard
              activities={report.activities || []}
              onUpdateActivities={!isArchived ? handleUpdateActivities : undefined}
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 6 }}>
            <ReportIssuesCard
              issues={report.issues || []}
              onUpdateIssues={!isArchived ? handleUpdateIssues : undefined}
            />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        {/* Supervisory Observations */}
        <ReportCommentsCard
          comments={report.comments || []}
          onUpdateComments={!isArchived ? handleUpdateComments : undefined}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* ROW 5: Danger Zone */}
      <ReportDangerZone
        isArchived={isArchived}
        onArchive={handleOpenArchiveConfirm}
        onRestore={handleOpenRestoreConfirm}
        onDelete={handleOpenDeleteConfirm}
        actionLoading={actionLoading}
      />

      {/* Confirmation Modal for Destructive Operations */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={confirmModal.open}
        title={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Operational Report?'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Operational Report?'
              : 'Permanently Delete Report (Cascade)?'
        }
        message={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'This report will be archived and hidden from active listings. It can be restored at any time within 30 days.'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'This report will be restored back to the active operational registry.'
              : 'This will permanently delete the report and unlink all physical voice recordings from the server. This action cannot be undone.'
        }
        confirmText={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Report'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Report'
              : 'Delete Permanently'
        }
        confirmColor={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'warning'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'success'
              : 'error'
        }
        onConfirm={handleConfirmAction}
        onClose={handleCloseConfirm}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

ReportEdit.displayName = 'ReportEdit';

export default ReportEdit;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module pages/Reports
 * @description Master operational reports archive and inspection dossier directory.
 * Implements:
 * - Row 1: Breadcrumbs (Dashboard > Reports) on left + Start Inspection button on right (iconified on xs < 600px).
 * - Row 2: Single-row responsive ReportControlStrip (zero-lag search, branch selector, date filter, active/archived toggle, grid/list switcher).
 * - Row 3: sm+ DataGrid view or responsive Card Grid view with conditional MuiPagination (totalPages > 1).
 * - Immediate modal dismissal with inline loading on row/card action buttons.
 * - MuiConfirmDialog (destructive actions confirmation with disableEnforceFocus & disableRestoreFocus).
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import ChatOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChatOutlined';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../components/reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import ReportControlStrip from '../components/reports/ReportControlStrip.jsx';
import ReportDataGrid from '../components/reports/ReportDataGrid.jsx';
import ReportCardGrid from '../components/reports/ReportCardGrid.jsx';

import {
  useGetReportsQuery,
  useArchiveReportMutation,
  useRestoreReportMutation,
  useDeleteReportMutation,
} from '../redux/features/reportSlice.js';
import { useGetBranchesQuery } from '../redux/features/branchSlice.js';

/**
 * Operational reports archive page component.
 *
 * @component Reports
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered reports archive page view.
 */
export const Reports = memo(() => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm')); // vw < 600px

  // Control strip filter states
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [branchFilter, setBranchFilter] = useState('');
  const [dateFilter, setDateFilter] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('active'); // 'active' | 'archived'
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('table'); // 'table' | 'cards'
  const [paginationModel, setPaginationModel] = useState({ page: 0, pageSize: 10 });

  // Action Lifecycle & Confirmation states
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // { id: string, action: 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete' } | null
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState({
    open: false,
    type: null, // 'archive' | 'restore' | 'delete'
    report: null,
  });

  // Fetch branches dataset for dropdown filter
  const { data: branchesData } = useGetBranchesQuery({ limit: 100, archived: false });
  const branches = branchesData?.branches || [];

  // Active reports query
  const { data: activeData, isLoading: isActiveLoading } = useGetReportsQuery({
    page: statusFilter === 'active' ? paginationModel.page + 1 : 1,
    limit: paginationModel.pageSize,
    search: statusFilter === 'active' ? searchQuery : '',
    branch: statusFilter === 'active' ? branchFilter : undefined,
    date: statusFilter === 'active' ? dateFilter : undefined,
    archived: false,
  });

  // Archived reports query
  const { data: archivedData, isLoading: isArchivedLoading } = useGetReportsQuery({
    page: statusFilter === 'archived' ? paginationModel.page + 1 : 1,
    limit: paginationModel.pageSize,
    search: statusFilter === 'archived' ? searchQuery : '',
    branch: statusFilter === 'archived' ? branchFilter : undefined,
    date: statusFilter === 'archived' ? dateFilter : undefined,
    archived: true,
  });

  // Mutations
  const [archiveReport] = useArchiveReportMutation();
  const [restoreReport] = useRestoreReportMutation();
  const [deleteReport] = useDeleteReportMutation();

  const activeReports = activeData?.reports || activeData?.docs || [];
  const activeCount = activeData?.totalDocs ?? activeReports.length;

  const archivedReports = archivedData?.reports || archivedData?.docs || [];
  const archivedCount = archivedData?.totalDocs ?? archivedReports.length;

  const isCurrentLoading = statusFilter === 'active' ? isActiveLoading : isArchivedLoading;
  const currentReports = statusFilter === 'active' ? activeReports : archivedReports;
  const currentTotalDocs = statusFilter === 'active' ? (activeData?.totalDocs || 0) : (archivedData?.totalDocs || 0);
  const currentTotalPages = statusFilter === 'active' ? (activeData?.totalPages || 1) : (archivedData?.totalPages || 1);

  // Search updater from zero-lag control strip
  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((query) => {
    setSearchQuery(query);
    setPaginationModel((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 0 }));
  }, []);

  // Branch filter change
  const handleBranchChange = useCallback((branchId) => {
    setBranchFilter(branchId);
    setPaginationModel((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 0 }));
  }, []);

  // Date filter change
  const handleDateChange = useCallback((date) => {
    setDateFilter(date);
    setPaginationModel((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 0 }));
  }, []);

  // Status tab switcher
  const handleStatusFilterChange = useCallback((newStatus) => {
    setStatusFilter(newStatus);
    setPaginationModel((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 0 }));
  }, []);

  // View mode switcher (grid vs list)
  const handleViewModeChange = useCallback((newMode) => {
    setViewMode(newMode);
  }, []);

  // Navigation handlers
  const handleView = useCallback((report) => {
    navigate(`/reports/${report._id}/details`);
  }, [navigate]);

  const handleEdit = useCallback((report) => {
    navigate(`/reports/${report._id}/edit`);
  }, [navigate]);

  // Confirmation triggers
  const handleOpenArchiveConfirm = useCallback((report) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'archive',
      report,
    });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenRestoreConfirm = useCallback((report) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'restore',
      report,
    });
  }, []);

  const handleOpenDeleteConfirm = useCallback((report) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      open: true,
      type: 'delete',
      report,
    });
  }, []);

  const handleCloseConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setConfirmModal({ open: false, type: null, report: null });
  }, []);

  // Modal execution handler with immediate dismissal and action-scoped loading
  const handleConfirmAction = useCallback(async () => {
    const { type, report } = confirmModal;
    if (!report?._id) return;

    // Dismiss modal instantly
    handleCloseConfirm();
    setActionLoading({ id: report._id, action: type });

    try {
      if (type === 'archive') {
        await archiveReport(report._id).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report archived successfully.');
      } else if (type === 'restore') {
        await restoreReport(report._id).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report restored to active status.');
      } else if (type === 'delete') {
        await deleteReport(report._id).unwrap();
        toast.success('Operational report and all voice recordings permanently deleted.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || `Failed to ${type} report.`);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  }, [confirmModal, handleCloseConfirm, archiveReport, restoreReport, deleteReport]);

  // Mobile card pagination page change
  const handleCardPageChange = useCallback((newPage) => {
    setPaginationModel((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: newPage - 1 }));
  }, []);

  // DataGrid pagination model change
  const handlePaginationModelChange = useCallback((newModel) => {
    setPaginationModel(newModel);
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        mx: 'auto',
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
      }}
    >
      {/* ROW 1: Breadcrumbs on Left + Call-to-Action on Right */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
        }}
      >
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }} />}
          aria-label="reports navigation breadcrumb"
          sx={{
            '& .MuiBreadcrumbs-ol': { alignItems: 'center' },
            '& .MuiTypography-root': { fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.875rem' } },
          }}
        >
          <Typography
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/dashboard"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              fontWeight: 500,
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', textDecoration: 'underline' },
            }}
          >
            Dashboard
          </Typography>
          <Typography color="text.primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Reports
          </Typography>
        </Breadcrumbs>

        {/* Action Button: Start Inspection in Chat */}
        <Box>
          <MuiButton
            variant="contained"
            color="primary"
            startIcon={<ChatOutlinedIcon />}
            component={RouterLink}
            to="/chat"
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            Start Inspection in Chat
          </MuiButton>

          {/* xs mobile icon button */}
          <Tooltip title="Start Inspection in Chat" arrow>
            <IconButton
              component={RouterLink}
              to="/chat"
              color="primary"
              aria-label="Start inspection in chat"
              sx={{
                display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                bgcolor: 'primary.main',
                color: 'primary.contrastText',
                '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'primary.dark' },
              }}
            >
              <ChatOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* ROW 2: Single-Row Responsive Control Strip */}
      <ReportControlStrip
        searchQuery={searchQuery}
        onSearchChange={handleSearchChange}
        branchFilter={branchFilter}
        onBranchChange={handleBranchChange}
        branches={branches}
        dateFilter={dateFilter}
        onDateChange={handleDateChange}
        statusFilter={statusFilter}
        onStatusFilterChange={handleStatusFilterChange}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        onViewModeChange={handleViewModeChange}
        activeCount={activeCount}
        archivedCount={archivedCount}
        disabled={isCurrentLoading && !currentReports.length}
      />

      {/* ROW 3: Main Data Display (DataGrid vs Cards) */}
      <Box sx={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 0, flexGrow: 1 }}>
        {isMobile || viewMode === 'cards' || viewMode === 'list' ? (
          <ReportCardGrid
            reports={currentReports}
            isLoading={isCurrentLoading}
            onView={handleView}
            onEdit={handleEdit}
            onArchive={handleOpenArchiveConfirm}
            onRestore={handleOpenRestoreConfirm}
            onDelete={handleOpenDeleteConfirm}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            page={paginationModel.page + 1}
            totalPages={currentTotalPages}
            onPageChange={handleCardPageChange}
            emptyTitle={
              statusFilter === 'archived'
                ? 'No archived reports'
                : searchQuery || branchFilter || dateFilter
                  ? 'No matching reports found'
                  : 'No inspection reports recorded'
            }
            emptyDescription={
              statusFilter === 'archived'
                ? 'Archived inspection reports will appear here.'
                : searchQuery || branchFilter || dateFilter
                  ? 'Try adjusting your search query, branch filter, or date.'
                  : 'Start a voice inspection in Chat to generate your first corporate report.'
            }
            emptyAction={
              statusFilter === 'active' && !searchQuery && !branchFilter && !dateFilter ? (
                <MuiButton
                  variant="contained"
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to="/chat"
                  startIcon={<ChatOutlinedIcon />}
                >
                  Start Inspection in Chat
                </MuiButton>
              ) : null
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <ReportDataGrid
            reports={currentReports}
            isLoading={isCurrentLoading}
            onView={handleView}
            onEdit={handleEdit}
            onArchive={handleOpenArchiveConfirm}
            onRestore={handleOpenRestoreConfirm}
            onDelete={handleOpenDeleteConfirm}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            isArchived={statusFilter === 'archived'}
            rowCount={currentTotalDocs}
            paginationModel={paginationModel}
            onPaginationModelChange={handlePaginationModelChange}
            paginationMode="server"
            emptyTitle={
              statusFilter === 'archived'
                ? 'No archived reports'
                : searchQuery || branchFilter || dateFilter
                  ? 'No matching reports found'
                  : 'No inspection reports recorded'
            }
            emptyDescription={
              statusFilter === 'archived'
                ? 'Archived operational reports will appear here.'
                : searchQuery || branchFilter || dateFilter
                  ? 'Try adjusting your search query, branch filter, or date.'
                  : 'Start a voice inspection in Chat to generate your first corporate report.'
            }
            emptyAction={
              statusFilter === 'active' && !searchQuery && !branchFilter && !dateFilter ? (
                <MuiButton
                  variant="contained"
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to="/chat"
                  startIcon={<ChatOutlinedIcon />}
                >
                  Start Inspection in Chat
                </MuiButton>
              ) : null
            }
          />
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Confirmation Modal for Destructive Operations */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={confirmModal.open}
        title={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Operational Report?'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Operational Report?'
              : 'Permanently Delete Report (Cascade)?'
        }
        message={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'This report will be archived and hidden from active listings. It can be restored at any time within 30 days.'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'This report will be restored back to the active operational registry.'
              : 'This will permanently delete the report and unlink all physical voice recordings from the server. This action cannot be undone.'
        }
        confirmText={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'Archive Report'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'Restore Report'
              : 'Delete Permanently'
        }
        confirmColor={
          confirmModal.type === 'archive'
            ? 'warning'
            : confirmModal.type === 'restore'
              ? 'success'
              : 'error'
        }
        onConfirm={handleConfirmAction}
        onClose={handleCloseConfirm}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

Reports.displayName = 'Reports';

export default Reports;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module theme/AppTheme
 * @description Root Material UI ThemeProvider integrating design tokens, CSS variables, and component customizations.
 */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { ThemeProvider, createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';

import {
  inputsCustomizations,
  dataDisplayCustomizations,
  feedbackCustomizations,
  navigationCustomizations,
  surfacesCustomizations,
  chartsCustomizations,
  dataGridCustomizations,
  datePickersCustomizations,
} from './customizations';

import { colorSchemes, typography, shadows, shape } from './themePrimitives';

/**
 * Top-level Material UI Theme Provider component.
 * Configures MUI v6 CSS variables, color schemes, typography, and component overrides.
 *
 * @component AppTheme
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} props.children - Child components to wrap.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} The theme provider wrapping children with CssBaseline.
 */
export const AppTheme = ({ children }) => {
  const theme = useMemo(
    () =>
      createTheme({
        cssVariables: {
          colorSchemeSelector: 'data-mui-color-scheme',
          cssVarPrefix: 'template',
        },
        colorSchemes,
        typography,
        shadows,
        shape,
        components: {
          MuiCssBaseline: {
            styleOverrides: {
              html: {
                height: '100%',
                width: '100%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                margin: 0,
                padding: 0,
                WebkitTextSizeAdjust: '100%',
              },
              body: {
                height: '100%',
                width: '100%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                margin: 0,
                padding: 0,
              },
              '#root': {
                height: '100%',
                width: '100%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
              },
            },
          },
          ...inputsCustomizations,
          ...dataDisplayCustomizations,
          ...feedbackCustomizations,
          ...navigationCustomizations,
          ...surfacesCustomizations,
          ...chartsCustomizations,
          ...dataGridCustomizations,
          ...datePickersCustomizations,
          MuiChatStreamingIndicator: {
            styleOverrides: {
              root: {
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                boxShadow: 'none !important',
                border: 'none !important',
              },
              bubble: {
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                boxShadow: 'none !important',
                border: 'none !important',
                padding: '0 !important',
              },
            },
          },
          MuiChatTypingIndicator: {
            styleOverrides: {
              root: {
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                boxShadow: 'none !important',
                border: 'none !important',
                padding: '0 !important',
              },
            },
          },
          MuiChatScrollToBottomAffordance: {
            styleOverrides: {
              root: ({ theme }) => ({
                backgroundColor: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.background.paper} !important`,
                color: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.text.primary} !important`,
                borderRadius: '50% !important',
                border: '1px solid !important',
                borderColor: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.divider} !important`,
                boxShadow: `${theme.shadows[3]} !important`,
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                zIndex: 10,
                '&:hover': {
                  backgroundColor: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.action.hover || (theme.vars || theme).palette.background.paper} !important`,
                  boxShadow: `${theme.shadows[6]} !important`,
                },
                ...theme.applyStyles('dark', {
                  backgroundColor: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.background.paper} !important`,
                  borderColor: `${(theme.vars || theme).palette.divider} !important`,
                  boxShadow: `${theme.shadows[4]} !important`,
                }),
              }),
            },
          },
        },
      }),
    []
  );

  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme} disableTransitionOnChange>
      <CssBaseline enableColorScheme />
      {children}
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
};

AppTheme.propTypes = {
  children: PropTypes.node,
};

export default AppTheme;
````

````javascript
  MuiSelect: {

            0.15
          )}, inset 0 -1px 0 1px hsla(220, 0%, 0%, 0.7)`,
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module theme/useThemeMode
 * @description Hook providing the active theme mode and toggle function bridging MUI v6 useColorScheme.
 */
import { useColorScheme } from '@mui/material/styles';

/**
 * Custom hook providing the active theme mode and toggle function.
 * Bridges MUI v6 useColorScheme with layout navigation and control bars.
 *
 * @function useThemeMode
 * @returns {{ mode: 'light' | 'dark', toggleTheme: () => void, setMode: (mode: string) => void }}
 */
export const useThemeMode = () => {
  const { mode, systemMode, setMode } = useColorScheme();
  const currentMode = mode === 'system' ? systemMode : mode;
  const effectiveMode = currentMode || 'light';

  return {
    mode: effectiveMode,
    setMode,
    toggleTheme: () => setMode(effectiveMode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'),
  };
};

export default useThemeMode;

````

````jsx
/**

 * Adheres strictly to Google Brand Standards with official 4-color SVG logo,
 * authentic typography, theme-aware surface styling, and accessible 44px touch targets.

import { forwardRef } from 'react';

import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**

 */

/**

 * @param {function} [props.onClick] - Click handler triggering OAuth redirect.

 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether button shows loading spinner.

export const GoogleSsoButton = forwardRef(
  ({ label = 'Sign in with Google', onClick, disabled = false, isLoading = false, ...rest }, ref) => {

GoogleSsoButton.displayName = 'GoogleSsoButton';

GoogleSsoButton.propTypes = {
````
