/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchAnalyticsCharts
 * @description Side-by-side responsive analytical charts for operational branch inspection metrics (Row 3).
 * Integrates:
 * 1. Chart 1: Inspection Visit Volume & Audit Frequency Trend.
 * 2. Chart 2: Operational Status Distribution (comparing actual schema statuses:
 *    Issues: reported, in_progress, completed, no_issue; Activities: completed, in_progress).
 * Strictly zero fake stubs (no fake "open/clean" stubs).
 * Uses standard MUI breakpoints: Side by side on md+, stacking on xs and sm.
 */

import { memo, useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import { BarChart } from '@mui/x-charts/BarChart';
import AssessmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AssessmentOutlined';
import TimelineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TimelineOutlined';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

/**
 * Static frozen chart layout tokens and series/axis specifications.
 * Strictly adheres to MUI X Charts performance guidelines (MUI MCP):
 * 1. Module-level frozen constants guarantee 100% stable object and array references.
 * 2. Explicit unique 'id' attributes on all series and axes prevent selector regeneration.
 * 3. Uses official 'dataset' + 'dataKey' pattern to decouple series definitions from dynamic data.
 * @constant
 */
const CHART_MARGIN = Object.freeze({ top: 20, bottom: 30, left: 40, right: 20 });
const AXIS_TICK_STYLE = Object.freeze({ fontSize: 11 });
const MIN_CHART_WIDTH = 120; // Safe threshold ensuring drawingArea.width (width - 60) is always > 0

/**
 * Frozen slotProps configuring item-level tooltips.
 * Strictly adheres to MUI X Charts documentation (MUI MCP):
 * Bypasses default axis-level tooltip (ChartsAxisTooltipContent / useAxesTooltip),
 * completely eliminating the upstream Reselect runInputStabilityCheck warning.
 * @constant
 */
const CHART_SLOT_PROPS = Object.freeze({
  tooltip: Object.freeze({
    trigger: 'item',
  }),
});

/**
 * Frozen axisHighlight turning off axis-level tracking bands.
 * @constant
 */
const CHART_AXIS_HIGHLIGHT = Object.freeze({
  x: 'none',
  y: 'none',
});

/**
 * Stable frozen linear y-axis definition.
 * @constant
 */
const DEFAULT_Y_AXIS = Object.freeze([
  {
    id: 'default-y-axis',
    scaleType: 'linear',
  },
]);

// Static definitions for Chart 1: Audit Visit Volume Trend
const TREND_SERIES = Object.freeze([
  {
    type: 'bar',
    id: 'trend-audits-series',
    dataKey: 'count',
    label: 'Audits Logged',
    color: '#1976d2',
    valueFormatter: (value) => `${value ?? 0} visit${value === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
  },
]);

const TREND_X_AXIS = Object.freeze([
  {
    id: 'trend-dates-axis',
    scaleType: 'band',
    dataKey: 'date',
    tickLabelStyle: AXIS_TICK_STYLE,
  },
]);

// Static definitions for Chart 2: Operational Status Distribution
const STATUS_SERIES = Object.freeze([
  {
    type: 'bar',
    id: 'status-activities-series',
    dataKey: 'activities',
    label: 'Activities',
    color: '#2e7d32',
    valueFormatter: (value) => `${value ?? 0} recorded`,
  },
  {
    type: 'bar',
    id: 'status-issues-series',
    dataKey: 'issues',
    label: 'Issues Flagged',
    color: '#d32f2f',
    valueFormatter: (value) => `${value ?? 0} flagged`,
  },
]);

const STATUS_X_AXIS = Object.freeze([
  {
    id: 'status-categories-axis',
    scaleType: 'band',
    dataKey: 'category',
    tickLabelStyle: AXIS_TICK_STYLE,
  },
]);

/**
 * Resilient chart container measuring its own settled DOM width via ResizeObserver.
 * Shields SVG elements from rendering during initial CSS flex layout settlements,
 * eliminating negative SVG attribute warnings (<rect width="-17">).
 *
 * @component ChartContainer
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {(measuredWidth: number) => import('react').ReactNode} props.children - Render function.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered container.
 */
const ChartContainer = memo(({ children }) => {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const [measuredWidth, setMeasuredWidth] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const initialRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (initialRect.width > 0) {
      setMeasuredWidth(initialRect.width);
    }

    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      const observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          const w = entry.contentRect.width;
          if (w > 0) {
            setMeasuredWidth(w);
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe(el);
      return () => observer.disconnect();
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box
      ref={containerRef}
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        height: 260,
        minWidth: 0,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
      }}
    >
      {measuredWidth >= MIN_CHART_WIDTH ? (
        children(measuredWidth)
      ) : (
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={250} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
});

ChartContainer.displayName = 'ChartContainer';
ChartContainer.propTypes = {
  children: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
};

/**
 * Branch analytical charts displaying visit trends and real status distributions.
 *
 * @component BranchAnalyticsCharts
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} [props.metrics] - Aggregation metrics from getBranchMetrics query.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether metrics data is loading.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered side-by-side analytical charts.
 */
export const BranchAnalyticsCharts = memo(({
  metrics,
  isLoading = false,
}) => {
  // 1. Process Audit Volume Trend Dataset (bound via dataKey)
  const trendDataset = useMemo(() => {
    const rawTrend = metrics?.auditVolumeTrend;
    if (!Array.isArray(rawTrend) || rawTrend.length === 0) return null;

    return rawTrend.map((item) => {
      const parts = String(item.date).split('-');
      const label = parts.length >= 3 ? `${parts[1]}/${parts[2]}` : item.date;
      return {
        date: label,
        count: Number(item.count) || 0,
      };
    });
  }, [metrics?.auditVolumeTrend]);

  // 2. Process Operational Issues & Activities Dataset (bound via dataKey)
  const statusDataset = useMemo(() => {
    const rawIssues = metrics?.issuesByStatus;
    const rawActivities = metrics?.activitiesByStatus;

    // Normalize rawIssues whether backend returns an object or array
    const issuesObj = Array.isArray(rawIssues)
      ? Object.fromEntries(rawIssues.map((item) => [item.status, Number(item.count) || 0]))
      : typeof rawIssues === 'object' && rawIssues !== null
      ? rawIssues
      : {};

    // Normalize rawActivities whether backend returns an object or array
    const activitiesObj = Array.isArray(rawActivities)
      ? Object.fromEntries(rawActivities.map((item) => [item.status, Number(item.count) || 0]))
      : typeof rawActivities === 'object' && rawActivities !== null
      ? rawActivities
      : {};

    const totalIssues = Object.values(issuesObj).reduce((acc, val) => acc + (Number(val) || 0), 0);
    const totalActivities = Object.values(activitiesObj).reduce((acc, val) => acc + (Number(val) || 0), 0);

    if (totalIssues === 0 && totalActivities === 0) return null;

    return [
      {
        category: 'Completed',
        activities: Number(activitiesObj.completed) || 0,
        issues: Number(issuesObj.completed) || 0,
      },
      {
        category: 'In Progress',
        activities: Number(activitiesObj.in_progress) || 0,
        issues: Number(issuesObj.in_progress) || 0,
      },
      {
        category: 'Flagged',
        activities: 0,
        issues: Number(issuesObj.reported) || 0,
      },
      {
        category: 'No Issue',
        activities: 0,
        issues: Number(issuesObj.no_issue) || 0,
      },
    ];
  }, [metrics?.issuesByStatus, metrics?.activitiesByStatus]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Grid container spacing={2.5}>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={320} sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5 }} />
        </Grid>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={320} sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5 }} />
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Grid container spacing={2.5}>
      {/* =========================================================================
          CHART 1: INSPECTION VISIT VOLUME TREND (Side-by-side on md+, stacked on xs/sm)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
            borderRadius: 2.5,
            height: '100%',
            minWidth: 0,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          }}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
            <TimelineOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                Audit Visit Volume Trend
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                Inspection visit frequency across recent audits
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          {/* Chart Content */}
          {trendDataset && trendDataset.length > 0 ? (
            <ChartContainer>
              {(measuredWidth) => (
                <BarChart
                  width={measuredWidth}
                  height={250}
                  dataset={trendDataset}
                  xAxis={TREND_X_AXIS}
                  yAxis={DEFAULT_Y_AXIS}
                  series={TREND_SERIES}
                  margin={CHART_MARGIN}
                  slotProps={CHART_SLOT_PROPS}
                  axisHighlight={CHART_AXIS_HIGHLIGHT}
                />
              )}
            </ChartContainer>
          ) : (
            <Box sx={{ py: 4, my: 'auto' }}>
              <MuiEmptyState
                icon={<TimelineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
                title="No Audit History Yet"
                subtitle="Inspection visits logged for this branch will chart here automatically."
              />
            </Box>
          )}
        </Paper>
      </Grid>

      {/* =========================================================================
          CHART 2: OPERATIONAL STATUS DISTRIBUTION (Side-by-side on md+, stacked on xs/sm)
          Actual schema statuses: Issues (reported, in_progress, completed, no_issue)
          Activities (completed, in_progress)
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
            borderRadius: 2.5,
            height: '100%',
            minWidth: 0,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          }}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
            <AssessmentOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                Operational Status Breakdown
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                Real schema status distribution across recorded issues and activities
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          {/* Chart Content */}
          {statusDataset && statusDataset.length > 0 ? (
            <ChartContainer>
              {(measuredWidth) => (
                <BarChart
                  width={measuredWidth}
                  height={250}
                  dataset={statusDataset}
                  xAxis={STATUS_X_AXIS}
                  yAxis={DEFAULT_Y_AXIS}
                  series={STATUS_SERIES}
                  margin={CHART_MARGIN}
                  slotProps={CHART_SLOT_PROPS}
                  axisHighlight={CHART_AXIS_HIGHLIGHT}
                />
              )}
            </ChartContainer>
          ) : (
            <Box sx={{ py: 4, my: 'auto' }}>
              <MuiEmptyState
                icon={<AssessmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
                title="No Operational Findings"
                subtitle="Tasks and checklist statuses recorded during inspections will chart here."
              />
            </Box>
          )}
        </Paper>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  );
});

BranchAnalyticsCharts.displayName = 'BranchAnalyticsCharts';

BranchAnalyticsCharts.propTypes = {
  metrics: PropTypes.shape({
    totalAudits: PropTypes.number,
    auditVolumeTrend: PropTypes.arrayOf(
      PropTypes.shape({
        date: PropTypes.string,
        count: PropTypes.number,
      })
    ),
    issuesByStatus: PropTypes.oneOfType([
      PropTypes.object,
      PropTypes.arrayOf(

          status: PropTypes.string,
          count: PropTypes.number,
        })
      ),
    ]),
    activitiesByStatus: PropTypes.oneOfType([
      PropTypes.object,
      PropTypes.arrayOf(
        PropTypes.shape({
          status: PropTypes.string,
          count: PropTypes.number,
        })
      ),
    ]),
  }),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default BranchAnalyticsCharts;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchAuditHistory
 * @description Historical inspections ledger component (Row 4).
 * Spans full width (xs: 12) placed below the analytics charts.
 * Features:
 * - Fluid flex columns with minWidth (Zero static widths) via getAuditHistoryColumns.
 * - Displays actual schema statuses (Activities: completed, in_progress; Issues: reported, in_progress, completed, no_issue).
 * - sm+ DataGrid table view / xs responsive card list.
 * - Reusable MuiPagination (conditional: renders only if totalPages > 1).
 */

import { useState, useMemo, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import HistoryEduOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HistoryEduOutlined';
import EventOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EventOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import OpenInNewIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInNew';

import MuiDataGrid from '../reusable/MuiDataGrid.jsx';
import MuiPagination from '../reusable/MuiPagination.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';
import { getAuditHistoryColumns } from '../columns/auditHistoryColumns.jsx';
import { useGetReportsQuery } from '../../redux/features/reportSlice.js';

/**
 * Historical inspections visits ledger component.
 *
 * @component BranchAuditHistory
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} props.branchId - Active operational branch identifier.
 * @param {string} [props.branchName=''] - Active branch name.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered audit history ledger.
 */
export const BranchAuditHistory = memo(({
  branchId,
  branchName = '',
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  // Query reports scoped to this branch
  const { data, isLoading } = useGetReportsQuery({
    branch: branchId,
    page,
    limit: 10,
  });

  const reports = data?.reports || [];
  const pagination = data?.pagination;
  const totalReports = pagination?.total ?? reports.length;
  const totalPages = pagination?.totalPages || 1;

  // Navigate to report dossier
  const handleViewReport = useCallback((report) => {
    if (report?._id) {
      navigate(`/reports/${report._id}/details`);
    }
  }, [navigate]);

  // Memoized column configurations with fluid flex weights
  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      getAuditHistoryColumns({
        branchId,
        onViewReport: handleViewReport,
      }),
    [branchId, handleViewReport]
  );

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2.5,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        width: '100%',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header Strip */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          mb: 2.5,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <HistoryEduOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
              Historical Audit Visits Ledger
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
              Full chronological inspection records and status audits for {branchName || 'this branch'}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        <Chip
          label={`${totalReports} Audit${totalReports === 1 ? '' : 's'} Total`}
          size="small"
          variant="outlined"
          color="primary"
          sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          DESKTOP & TABLET VIEW: sm+ Reusable MuiDataGrid with Fluid Flex Columns
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' }, width: '100%' }}>
        <MuiDataGrid
          rows={reports}
          columns={columns}
          loading={isLoading}
          getRowId={(row) => row._id}
          emptyIcon={<HistoryEduOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          emptyTitle="No Inspection Visits Found"
          emptySubtitle="Audits logged for this branch through chat or the report editor will appear here."
          autoHeight
        />
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          MOBILE VIEW: xs Responsive Cards List
          ========================================================================= */}
      <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' }, flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
        {reports.length === 0 && !isLoading ? (
          <Box sx={{ py: 3 }}>
            <MuiEmptyState
              icon={<HistoryEduOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
              title="No Audits Found"
              subtitle="Inspection visits logged for this branch will appear here."
            />
          </Box>
        ) : (
          reports.map((report) => {
            const dateStr = report?.date ? new Date(report.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : 'N/A';
            const visit = (report?.visits || []).find(
              (v) => String(v.branch?._id || v.branch) === String(branchId)
            ) || report?.visits?.[0];
            const shiftHours = visit?.clockIn && visit?.clockOut
              ? `${visit.clockIn} - ${visit.clockOut}`
              : report?.clockIn && report?.clockOut
              ? `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut}`
              : '08:30 - 17:00';

            const activities = report?.activities || [];
            const completedActivities = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'completed').length;
            const inProgressActivities = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'in_progress').length;

            const issues = report?.issues || [];
            const reportedIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'reported').length;
            const inProgressIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'in_progress').length;
            const completedIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'completed').length;

            return (
              <Card
                key={report._id}
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                }}
              >
                <CardContent sx={{ p: 2 }}>
                  {/* Date and Action */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                      <EventOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'primary.main' }} />
                      <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {dateStr}
                      </Typography>
                      {report?.ethiopianDate && (
                        <Chip
                          label={report.ethiopianDate}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                          sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}
                        />
                      )}
                    </Box>
                    <Tooltip title="View Report Dossier">
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        color="primary"
                        onClick={() => handleViewReport(report)}
                        aria-label="View report"
                      >
                        <OpenInNewIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Tooltip>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Shift Timing */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, mb: 1 }}>
                    <AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                      Shift: {shiftHours}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Real Status Badges */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mt: 1 }}>
                    {completedActivities > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={`${completedActivities} act. done`}
                        size="small"
                        color="success"
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {inProgressActivities > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={`${inProgressActivities} act. pending`}
                        size="small"
                        color="warning"
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {reportedIssues > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={`${reportedIssues} issues flagged`}
                        size="small"
                        color="error"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {inProgressIssues > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={`${inProgressIssues} issues in progress`}
                        size="small"
                        color="warning"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {completedIssues > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={`${completedIssues} issues resolved`}
                        size="small"
                        color="success"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* =========================================================================
          CONDITIONAL PAGINATION: Only rendered if totalPages > 1
          ========================================================================= */}
      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <Box sx={{ mt: 3, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <MuiPagination
            page={page}
            totalPages={totalPages}
            onChange={setPage}
          />
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

BranchAuditHistory.displayName = 'BranchAuditHistory';

BranchAuditHistory.propTypes = {
  branchId: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
  branchName: PropTypes.string,
};

export default BranchAuditHistory;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchCard
 * @description Operational store branch card component for list and mobile views.
 * Features:
 * - Operational uppercase code badge
 * - Bilingual branch name and alias subtitles
 * - Store manager name and direct click-to-dial telephone link
 * - Municipal subcity and physical address landmark
 * - Two-phase action lifecycle with inline mutation loading spinner
 * - Responsive iconification on mobile viewports (< 600px).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import CardActions from '@mui/material/CardActions';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Link from '@mui/material/Link';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import PersonOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';
import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import { getCleanAliases } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Branch card representation for list view and mobile screens.
 *
 * @component BranchCard
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.branch - Branch document data.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation to branch details.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onEdit - Open edit modal.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onArchive - Open archive confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onRestore - Open restore confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onDelete - Open permanent delete confirmation.
 * @param {object|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - Legacy fallback ID of mutating branch.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch card.
 */
export const BranchCard = memo(({
  branch,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
}) => {
  const isArchived = Boolean(branch.isArchived);
  const activeLoading = actionLoading || (actionLoadingId ? { id: actionLoadingId } : null);
  const isCardBusy = Boolean(activeLoading && activeLoading.id === branch._id);

  const isArchiveLoading = isCardBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'archive' || (!activeLoading?.action && !isArchived));
  const isRestoreLoading = isCardBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'restore' || (!activeLoading?.action && isArchived));
  const isDeleteLoading = isCardBusy && activeLoading?.action === 'delete';

  const cleanAliases = getCleanAliases(branch.aliases, branch.name);
  const visibleAliases = cleanAliases.slice(0, 2);
  const remainingCount = cleanAliases.length - visibleAliases.length;

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        borderRadius: 2,
        height: '100%',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease',
        '&:hover': {
          borderColor: 'primary.main',
          boxShadow: (theme) => `0 4px 12px ${theme.palette.action.hover}`,
        },
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
        {/* Top Header: Code Badge and Status Chip */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            mb: 1.5,
          }}
        >
          <Chip
            label={branch.code || 'N/A'}
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            color="primary"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}
          />
          <MuiStatusChip status={isArchived ? 'archived' : 'active'} />
        </Box>

        {/* Branch Name & Secondary Aliases */}
        <Box sx={{ mb: 1.5 }}>
          <Typography
            variant="subtitle1"
            sx={{
              fontWeight: 700,
              color: 'text.primary',
              lineHeight: 1.3,
            }}
          >
            {branch.name}
          </Typography>
          {visibleAliases.length > 0 && (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, mt: 0.25, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
              >
                {visibleAliases.join(' • ')}
              </Typography>
              {remainingCount > 0 && (
                <Tooltip title={cleanAliases.slice(2).join(', ')} arrow>
                  <Typography
                    component="span"
                    variant="caption"
                    sx={{
                      color: 'primary.main',
                      fontSize: '0.72rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}
                  >
                    +{remainingCount} more
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>

        {/* Location Landmark & Subcity */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 0.75, mb: 0.75 }}>
          <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.2 }} />
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
            <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary' }}>
              {branch.location?.subcity || 'Addis Ababa'}
            </Box>
            {branch.location?.address && ` • ${branch.location.address}`}
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Store Manager */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, mb: 0.75 }}>
          <PersonOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
            Manager:{' '}
            <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'text.primary' }}>
              {branch.managerName || 'Unassigned'}
            </Box>
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Contact Telephone Link */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
          <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
          {branch.contactPhone ? (
            <Link
              href={`tel:${branch.contactPhone}`}
              underline="hover"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                color: 'primary.main',
                fontWeight: 500,
              }}
            >
              {branch.contactPhone}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
              No phone listed
            </Typography>
          )}
        </Box>
      </CardContent>

      {/* Card Actions Deck: Immediate Dismissal + Inline Loading */}
      <CardActions
        sx={{
          px: 2,
          py: 1.5,
          borderTop: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}
      >
        {/* Left: View Details */}
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="outlined"
          color="inherit"
          onClick={() => onView(branch)}
          disabled={isCardBusy}
          startIcon={<VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          sx={{
            textTransform: 'none',
            fontSize: '0.8125rem',
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
          }}
        >
          Details
        </Button>
        <Tooltip title="View Details">
          <span>
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              onClick={() => onView(branch)}
              disabled={isCardBusy}
              aria-label="view branch details"
              sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
            >
              <VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </span>
        </Tooltip>

        {/* Right: Lifecycle Actions (Active: Edit, Archive / Archived: Restore, Delete) */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
          {!isArchived ? (
            <>
              {/* Edit Branch */}
              <Tooltip title="Edit Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={() => onEdit(branch)}
                    disabled={isCardBusy}
                    aria-label="edit branch"
                  >
                    <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>

              {/* Archive Branch with Inline Spinner */}
              <Tooltip title="Archive Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={() => onArchive(branch)}
                    disabled={isCardBusy}
                    aria-label="archive branch"
                  >
                    {isArchiveLoading ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                    ) : (
                      <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    )}
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Restore Branch with Inline Spinner */}
              <Tooltip title="Restore Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    onClick={() => onRestore(branch)}
                    disabled={isCardBusy}
                    aria-label="restore branch"
                  >
                    {isRestoreLoading ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                    ) : (
                      <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    )}
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>

              {/* Permanent Cascade Delete with Inline Spinner */}
              <Tooltip title="Permanently Delete (Cascade)">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    color="error"
                    onClick={() => onDelete(branch)}
                    disabled={isCardBusy}
                    aria-label="permanently delete branch"
                  >
                    {isDeleteLoading ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                    ) : (
                      <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    )}
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </CardActions>
    </Card>
  );
});

BranchCard.displayName = 'BranchCard';

BranchCard.propTypes = {
  branch: PropTypes.shape({
    _id: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
    code: PropTypes.string,
    name: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
    aliases: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.string),
    location: PropTypes.shape({
      city: PropTypes.string,
      subcity: PropTypes.string,
      address: PropTypes.string,
    }),
    managerName: PropTypes.string,
    contactPhone: PropTypes.string,
    isArchived: PropTypes.bool,
  }).isRequired,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
};

export default BranchCard;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchCardGrid
 * @description Responsive card grid layout for operational branches.
 * Used on mobile viewports (< 600px) or when List view mode is selected on tablet/desktop.
 * Uses Material-UI Grid container and embeds conditional MuiPagination (only if totalPages > 1).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';
import BranchCard from './BranchCard.jsx';
import MuiPagination from '../reusable/MuiPagination.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

/**
 * Grid of branch cards with responsive columns and conditional pagination.
 *
 * @component BranchCardGrid
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.branches=[]] - Branch documents.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether data is loading.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation to branch details.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onEdit - Open edit modal.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onArchive - Open archive confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onRestore - Open restore confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onDelete - Open permanent delete confirmation.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - ID of branch undergoing mutation.
 * @param {number} [props.page=1] - Active page number (1-based).
 * @param {number} [props.totalPages=1] - Total calculated pages.
 * @param {(page: number) => void} [props.onPageChange] - Page change handler.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyTitle='No operational branches found'] - Custom empty title.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyDescription='No branches match your current criteria.'] - Custom empty subtitle.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch card grid.
 */
export const BranchCardGrid = memo(({
  branches = [],
  isLoading = false,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
  page = 1,
  totalPages = 1,
  onPageChange,
  emptyTitle = 'No operational branches found',
  emptyDescription = 'There are no store branches registered matching your current criteria.',
}) => {
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
          <Grid key={i} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
            <Skeleton
              variant="rounded"
              height={220}
              sx={{ borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: 'action.hover' }}
            />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>
    );
  }

  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ py: 4 }}>
        <MuiEmptyState
          icon={<StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          title={emptyTitle}
          subtitle={emptyDescription}
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {branches.map((branch) => (
          <Grid key={branch._id} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
            <BranchCard
              branch={branch}
              onView={onView}
              onEdit={onEdit}
              onArchive={onArchive}
              onRestore={onRestore}
              onDelete={onDelete}
              actionLoading={actionLoading}
              actionLoadingId={actionLoadingId}
            />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>

      {/* Conditional Pagination: Only renders if totalPages > 1 */}
      {totalPages > 1 && onPageChange && (
        <Box sx={{ mt: 3, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <MuiPagination
            page={page}
            totalPages={totalPages}
            onChange={onPageChange}
          />
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
});

BranchCardGrid.displayName = 'BranchCardGrid';

BranchCardGrid.propTypes = {
  branches: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
  page: PropTypes.number,
  totalPages: PropTypes.number,
  onPageChange: PropTypes.func,
  emptyTitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptyDescription: PropTypes.string,
};

export default BranchCardGrid;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchControlStrip
 * @description Single-row responsive control strip for the Branches directory page (Row 2).
 * Integrates:
 * 1. Zero-lag keystroke search decoupled via React 19 useTransition (Invariant 43).
 * 2. Active vs Archived segmented toggle with dynamic counts.
 * 3. Grid vs List view switcher (DataGrid vs Cards) with responsive collapse and xs hiding.
 * Strictly maintains a single non-wrapping row across all standard MUI breakpoints (xs, sm, md, lg, xl).
 */

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useTransition, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import GridViewOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GridViewOutlined';
import ViewListOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewListOutlined';

/**
 * Control strip for filtering and switching views on the branches directory.
 *
 * @component BranchControlStrip
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} props.searchQuery - Active search query value.
 * @param {(query: string) => void} props.onSearchChange - Search update callback.
 * @param {'active'|'archived'} props.statusFilter - Active status filter tab.
 * @param {(status: 'active'|'archived') => void} props.onStatusFilterChange - Status tab change callback.
 * @param {'grid'|'list'} props.viewMode - Current view mode.
 * @param {(mode: 'grid'|'list') => void} props.onViewModeChange - View mode change callback.
 * @param {number} [props.activeCount=0] - Number of active branches.
 * @param {number} [props.archivedCount=0] - Number of archived branches.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether controls are disabled.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered control strip element.
 */
export const BranchControlStrip = memo(({
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  statusFilter = 'active',
  onStatusFilterChange,
  viewMode = 'grid',
  onViewModeChange,
  activeCount = 0,
  archivedCount = 0,
  disabled = false,
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [hasText, setHasText] = useState(Boolean(searchQuery));

  // Synchronize internal input value if external query changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (inputRef.current && inputRef.current.value !== searchQuery) {
      inputRef.current.value = searchQuery || '';
      setHasText(Boolean(searchQuery));
    }
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // Handle native typing at hardware speed with zero React overhead
  const handleInput = useCallback((e) => {
    const nextVal = e.target.value;
    setHasText(Boolean(nextVal));
    startTransition(() => {
      onSearchChange(nextVal);
    });
  }, [onSearchChange]);

  // Clear search query immediately
  const handleClear = useCallback(() => {
    if (inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.value = '';
      inputRef.current.focus();
    }
    setHasText(false);
    onSearchChange('');
  }, [onSearchChange]);

  // Handle status toggle change
  const handleStatusChange = useCallback((_, newStatus) => {
    if (newStatus !== null && newStatus !== statusFilter) {
      onStatusFilterChange(newStatus);
    }
  }, [statusFilter, onStatusFilterChange]);

  // Handle view layout switch
  const handleViewChange = useCallback((_, newView) => {
    if (newView !== null && newView !== viewMode) {
      onViewModeChange(newView);
    }
  }, [viewMode, onViewModeChange]);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        gap: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5, md: 2 },
        width: '100%',
        flexWrap: 'nowrap',
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      {/* 1. Zero-lag Search Input */}
      <TextField
        inputRef={inputRef}
        defaultValue={searchQuery}
        onInput={handleInput}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            handleClear();
          }
        }}
        placeholder={
          isMobile
            ? 'Search...'
            : 'Search branches bilingually (e.g. Bole, ቦሌ, BOLE-01)...'
        }
        size="small"
        disabled={disabled}
        sx={{
          flex: { xs: 1, lg: 'none' },
          width: { lg: 380, xl: 420 },
          minWidth: 0,
          '& .MuiInputBase-root': {
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          },
          '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
            py: 0.8,
            fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.875rem' },
          },
        }}
        slotProps={{
          input: {
            startAdornment: (
              <InputAdornment position="start">
                <SearchIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: 20 }} />
              </InputAdornment>
            ),
            endAdornment: hasText ? (
              <InputAdornment position="end">
                <Tooltip title="Clear search">
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    aria-label="Clear search input"
                    onClick={handleClear}
                    edge="end"
                    sx={{ p: 0.5 }}
                  >
                    <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                  </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
              </InputAdornment>
            ) : null,
          },
        }}
      />

      {/* Trailing Controls Cluster (Always on same horizontal row) */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5 },
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        {/* 2. Active vs Archived Segmented Toggle */}
        <ToggleButtonGroup
          value={statusFilter}
          exclusive
          onChange={handleStatusChange}
          size="small"
          aria-label="Filter operational status"
          sx={{
            flexShrink: 0,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            '& .MuiToggleButton-root': {
              px: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5, md: 2 },
              py: 0.6,
              fontSize: { xs: '0.75rem', sm: '0.8125rem' },
              fontWeight: 500,
              textTransform: 'none',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`,
              '&.Mui-selected': {
                bgcolor: 'primary.main',
                color: 'primary.contrastText',
                fontWeight: 600,
                '&:hover': {
                  bgcolor: 'primary.dark',
                },
              },
            },
          }}
        >
          <ToggleButton value="active" aria-label="Active branches">
            <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline' } }}>
              Active ({activeCount})
            </Box>
            <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline', sm: 'none' } }}>
              {activeCount} Act
            </Box>
          </ToggleButton>
          <ToggleButton value="archived" aria-label="Archived branches">
            <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline' } }}>
              Archived ({archivedCount})
            </Box>
            <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline', sm: 'none' } }}>
              {archivedCount} Arc
            </Box>
          </ToggleButton>
        </ToggleButtonGroup>

        {/* 3. Grid vs List View Switcher (Hidden on xs, icon-only on sm/md, icon+text on lg+) */}
        <ToggleButtonGroup
          value={viewMode}
          exclusive
          onChange={handleViewChange}
          size="small"
          aria-label="Toggle view display mode"
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
            flexShrink: 0,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            '& .MuiToggleButton-root': {
              px: { sm: 1, md: 1.5 },
              py: 0.6,
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              fontWeight: 500,
              textTransform: 'none',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`,
              '&.Mui-selected': {
                bgcolor: 'action.selected',
                color: 'primary.main',
                fontWeight: 600,
              },
            },
          }}
        >
          <ToggleButton value="grid" aria-label="DataGrid view">
            <Tooltip title="DataGrid view">
              <Box sx={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                <GridViewOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { sm: 'none', lg: 'inline' } }}>
                  Grid
                </Box>
              </Box>
            </Tooltip>
          </ToggleButton>
          <ToggleButton value="list" aria-label="Card list view">
            <Tooltip title="Card list view">
              <Box sx={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                <ViewListOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { sm: 'none', lg: 'inline' } }}>
                  List
                </Box>
              </Box>
            </Tooltip>
          </ToggleButton>
        </ToggleButtonGroup>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
});

BranchControlStrip.displayName = 'BranchControlStrip';

BranchControlStrip.propTypes = {
  searchQuery: PropTypes.string,
  onSearchChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  statusFilter: PropTypes.oneOf(['active', 'archived']),
  onStatusFilterChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  viewMode: PropTypes.oneOf(['grid', 'list']),
  onViewModeChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  activeCount: PropTypes.number,
  archivedCount: PropTypes.number,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default BranchControlStrip;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchDangerZone
 * @description Danger zone card for operational branch details view (Row 5).
 * Houses soft archival, restoration, and irreversible cascade hard deletion actions.
 * Enforces immediate confirmation dismissal and displays inline loading states.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import WarningAmberOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';

/**
 * Branch danger zone component for destructive lifecycle management.
 *
 * @component BranchDangerZone
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.branch - Branch document.
 * @param {() => void} props.onArchive - Archive trigger.
 * @param {() => void} props.onRestore - Restore trigger.
 * @param {() => void} props.onDelete - Permanent cascade delete trigger.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Active lifecycle action ('archive' | 'restore' | 'delete').
 * @param {boolean} [props.isActionLoading=false] - Whether an action mutation is currently executing.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch danger zone card.
 */
export const BranchDangerZone = memo(({
  branch,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  isActionLoading = false,
}) => {
  const isArchived = Boolean(branch?.isArchived);
  const isBusy = Boolean(actionLoading || isActionLoading);
  const isArchiveLoading = actionLoading === 'archive' || (isActionLoading && !isArchived);
  const isRestoreLoading = actionLoading === 'restore' || (isActionLoading && isArchived && actionLoading !== 'delete');
  const isDeleteLoading = actionLoading === 'delete';

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2.5,
        borderColor: 'error.main',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        width: '100%',
      }}
    >
      {/* Title Strip */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 1.5 }}>
        <WarningAmberOutlinedIcon color="error" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
        <Typography variant="h6" color="error" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
          Danger Zone
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mb: 2 }}>
        Manage lifecycle states for this operating location. Irreversible actions will permanently delete records across the platform.
      </Typography>

      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 2,
        }}
      >
        {!isArchived ? (
          /* Active Branch Option: Archive */
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              gap: 1.5,
              p: 2,
              borderRadius: 2,
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
            }}
          >
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Archive this Branch
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                Hides this branch from active report generation. Historical audit reports are preserved.
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Button
              variant="outlined"
              color="warning"
              size="small"
              onClick={onArchive}
              disabled={isBusy}
              startIcon={
                isArchiveLoading ? (
                  <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                ) : (
                  <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                )
              }
              sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, flexShrink: 0 }}
            >
              Archive Branch
            </Button>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          /* Archived Branch Options: Restore and Permanent Cascade Deletion */
          <>
            {/* Restore */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                gap: 1.5,
                p: 2,
                borderRadius: 2,
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              }}
            >
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  Restore this Branch
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  Reactivates this branch for operational report creation and supervisor audits.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                size="small"
                onClick={onRestore}
                disabled={isBusy}
                startIcon={
                  isRestoreLoading ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                  ) : (
                    <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  )
                }
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                Restore Branch
              </Button>
            </Box>

            {/* Permanent Cascade Deletion */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                gap: 1.5,
                p: 2,
                borderRadius: 2,
                bgcolor: (theme) => `rgba(${theme.palette.error.mainChannel} / 0.08)`,
                border: (theme) => `1px dashed ${theme.palette.error.main}`,
              }}
            >
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="error" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  Permanently Delete Branch (Cascade)
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  Irreversibly deletes this branch, all associated inspection reports, audio files, and database records.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                color="error"
                size="small"
                onClick={onDelete}
                disabled={isBusy}
                startIcon={
                  isDeleteLoading ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                  ) : (
                    <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  )
                }
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                Delete Permanently
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </>
        )}
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
});

BranchDangerZone.displayName = 'BranchDangerZone';

BranchDangerZone.propTypes = {
  branch: PropTypes.shape({
    _id: PropTypes.string,
    name: PropTypes.string,
    code: PropTypes.string,
    isArchived: PropTypes.bool,
  }),
  onArchive: PropTypes.func,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.string,
  isActionLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default BranchDangerZone;

/**
 * @module components/branches/BranchDataGrid
 * @description Operational store branches DataGrid view component.
 * Rendered on sm+ viewports. Wraps reusable MuiDataGrid with colocated branch columns,
 * fluid proportional flex widths, and inline loading action buttons.
 */

import { useMemo, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';
import MuiDataGrid from '../reusable/MuiDataGrid.jsx';
import { getBranchColumns } from '../columns/branchColumns.jsx';

/**
 * DataGrid table component for operational branches.
 *
 * @component BranchDataGrid
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.branches=[]] - Array of branch documents.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Data fetching state.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation handler to branch details.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onEdit - Edit modal trigger handler.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onArchive - Archive confirmation trigger.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onRestore - Restore confirmation trigger.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} props.onDelete - Permanent cascade delete trigger.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - ID of branch undergoing an active mutation.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyTitle='No branches found'] - Custom empty state title.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyDescription='No branches match your current filter.'] - Custom empty subtitle.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Branch DataGrid element.
 */
export const BranchDataGrid = memo(({
  branches = [],
  isLoading = false,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
  emptyTitle = 'No operational branches found',
  emptyDescription = 'There are no store branches registered matching your current criteria.',
}) => {
  // Construct memoized column definitions with handlers and action state
  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      getBranchColumns({
        onView,
        onEdit,
        onArchive,
        onRestore,
        onDelete,
        actionLoading,
        actionLoadingId,
      }),
    [onView, onEdit, onArchive, onRestore, onDelete, actionLoading, actionLoadingId]
  );

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
      <MuiDataGrid
        rows={branches}
        columns={columns}
        loading={isLoading}
        getRowId={(row) => row._id}
        emptyIcon={<StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
        emptyTitle={emptyTitle}
        emptySubtitle={emptyDescription}
        autoHeight
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

BranchDataGrid.displayName = 'BranchDataGrid';

BranchDataGrid.propTypes = {
  branches: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
  emptyTitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptyDescription: PropTypes.string,
};

export default BranchDataGrid;

/**

/**

 * @param {() => void} props.onRestore - Restore trigger handler.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Active lifecycle action ('archive' | 'restore' | 'delete').
 * @param {boolean} [props.isActionLoading=false] - Whether an action mutation is currently executing.

export const BranchHero = memo(({

}) => {

  const isRestoreLoading = actionLoading === 'restore' || (isActionLoading && isArchived);

  const cleanAliases = getCleanAliases(branch?.aliases, branch?.name);
  const heroVisibleAliases = cleanAliases.slice(0, 3);
  const heroRemainingCount = cleanAliases.length - heroVisibleAliases.length;

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 },
        borderRadius: 2.5,

    >

        </Box>

        {/* Right: Quick Actions with Mobile Iconification */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          {/* Edit Branch Button */}
          {onEdit && (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="outlined"
                color="inherit"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
                onClick={onEdit}
                disabled={isBusy}
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontWeight: 500,
                }}
              >
                Edit Branch
              </Button>
              <Tooltip title="Edit Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onEdit}
                    disabled={isBusy}
                    aria-label="Edit branch"
                    sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
                  >
                    <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Active: Archive Button */}
          {!isArchived && onArchive && (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="outlined"
                color="warning"
                size="small"
                startIcon={
                  isArchiveLoading ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                  ) : (
                    <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  )
                }
                onClick={onArchive}
                disabled={isBusy}
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontWeight: 500,
                }}
              >
                Archive
              </Button>
              <Tooltip title="Archive Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    color="warning"
                    onClick={onArchive}
                    disabled={isBusy}
                    aria-label="Archive branch"
                    sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
                  >
                    {isArchiveLoading ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                    ) : (
                      <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    )}
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Archived: Restore Button */}
          {isArchived && onRestore && (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="contained"

                size="small"
                startIcon={
                  isRestoreLoading ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />

                    <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  )
                }
                onClick={onRestore}
                disabled={isBusy}
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },

              >

              <Tooltip title="Restore Branch">
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    onClick={onRestore}
                    disabled={isBusy}
                    aria-label="Restore branch"
                    sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}
                  >
                    {isRestoreLoading ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                    ) : (
                      <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    )}
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Main Branch Title & Bounded Deduplicated Aliases */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
        <Typography
          variant="h5"

            fontSize: { xs: '1.25rem', sm: '1.5rem', md: '1.75rem' },

        >

        {cleanAliases.length > 0 && (

      <Box

          gap: 2,
          pt: 2,
          borderTop: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
        }}
      >
        {/* Subcity & City */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
          <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.2 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
              Municipal Subcity
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {branch?.location?.subcity || 'Addis Ababa'}
              {branch?.location?.city ? `, ${branch.location.city}` : ''}

          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Physical Address / Landmark */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
          <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.2 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>

            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
              {branch?.location?.address || 'No landmark specified'}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Store Manager */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
          <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.2 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
              Store Manager
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {branch?.managerName || 'Unassigned'}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Contact Telephone */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
          <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.2 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
              Telephone
            </Typography>
            {branch?.contactPhone ? (
              <Link
                href={`tel:${branch.contactPhone}`}
                underline="hover"
                sx={{
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  fontSize: '0.875rem',
                  color: 'primary.main',
                }}
              >
                {branch.contactPhone}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
                None listed
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
});

BranchHero.displayName = 'BranchHero';

BranchHero.propTypes = {
  branch: PropTypes.shape({
    _id: PropTypes.string,
    code: PropTypes.string,
    name: PropTypes.string,
    aliases: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.string),
    location: PropTypes.shape({
      city: PropTypes.string,
      subcity: PropTypes.string,
      address: PropTypes.string,
    }),
    managerName: PropTypes.string,
    contactPhone: PropTypes.string,
    isArchived: PropTypes.bool,
  }),
  onEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.string,
  isActionLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default BranchHero;
