/**
 * @module components/branches/MuiBranchDialog
 * @description Create & Edit modal dialog for physical operating store branches.
 * Wraps MuiDialog (enforcing disableEnforceFocus & disableRestoreFocus).
 * Strictly adheres to the Zero-Lag Law (Invariant 22, 43): 100% uncontrolled native inputs
 * with defaultValue, eliminating per-keystroke React reconciliations and re-renders.
 * Supports responsive fullScreen on mobile (< 600px) and handles HTTP 409 collisions.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import MuiDialog from '../reusable/MuiDialog.jsx';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import { useCreateBranchMutation, useUpdateBranchMutation } from '../../redux/features/branchSlice.js';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

/**
 * Standard municipal subcities of Addis Ababa.
 * @constant
 */
const ADDIS_ABABA_SUBCITIES = [
  'Bole',
  'Arada',
  'Kirkos',
  'Yeka',
  'Nifas Silk-Lafto',
  'Kolfe Keranio',
  'Gullele',
  'Lideta',
  'Akaky Kaliti',
  'Addis Ketema',
  'Lemi Kura',
];

/**
 * Modal dialog for creating and updating operational store branches with zero typing lag.
 *
 * @component MuiBranchDialog
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} props.open - Modal visibility state.
 * @param {() => void} props.onClose - Modal dismissal handler.
 * @param {object|null} [props.branch=null] - Branch record for edit mode (null for create mode).
 * @param {(savedBranch: object) => void} [props.onSuccess] - Callback invoked on successful save.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered branch dialog element.
 */
export const MuiBranchDialog = memo(({
  open,
  onClose,
  branch = null,
  onSuccess,
}) => {
  const isEditMode = Boolean(branch);
  const formRef = useRef(null);
  const [subcity, setSubcity] = useState('Bole');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const [createBranch, { isLoading: isCreating }] = useCreateBranchMutation();
  const [updateBranch, { isLoading: isUpdating }] = useUpdateBranchMutation();
  const isSubmitting = isCreating || isUpdating;

  // Initialize subcity and reset errors when modal opens or active branch changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setSubcity(branch?.location?.subcity || 'Bole');
      setErrors({});
    }
  }, [open, branch]);

  // Form submission handler using native uncontrolled FormData
  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const form = formRef.current || e?.currentTarget;
    if (!form) return;

    const data = new FormData(form);
    const trimmedName = String(data.get('name') || '').trim();
    const selectedSubcity = subcity || String(data.get('subcity') || '').trim();
    const trimmedCity = String(data.get('city') || 'Addis Ababa').trim();
    const trimmedAddress = String(data.get('address') || '').trim();
    const trimmedManager = String(data.get('managerName') || '').trim();
    const trimmedPhone = String(data.get('contactPhone') || '').trim();

    // Synchronous client validation
    const newErrors = {};
    if (!trimmedName) {
      newErrors.name = 'Branch name is required.';
    } else if (trimmedName.length < 2) {
      newErrors.name = 'Branch name must be at least 2 characters.';
    } else if (trimmedName.length > 50) {
      newErrors.name = 'Branch name cannot exceed 50 characters.';
    }

    if (!selectedSubcity) {
      newErrors.subcity = 'Subcity is required.';
    }

    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }

    const payload = {
      name: trimmedName,
      location: {
        city: trimmedCity || 'Addis Ababa',
        subcity: selectedSubcity,
        address: trimmedAddress,
      },
      managerName: trimmedManager,
      contactPhone: trimmedPhone,
    };

    try {
      let savedResult;
      if (isEditMode) {
        savedResult = await updateBranch({
          branchId: branch._id,
          ...payload,
        }).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${trimmedName}" updated successfully.`);
      } else {
        savedResult = await createBranch(payload).unwrap();
        toast.success(`Branch "${trimmedName}" created successfully.`);
      }

      const savedBranch = savedResult?.branch || savedResult?.data?.branch;
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess(savedBranch);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      // Handle HTTP 409 Conflict: Duplicate branch name collision
      if (
        err?.status === 409 ||
        err?.data?.status === 409 ||
        err?.data?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('already exists')
      ) {
        setErrors((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          name: 'A branch with this name already exists. Please choose a distinct name.',
        }));
      } else {
        toast.error(err?.data?.message || 'Failed to save branch. Please try again.');
      }
    }
  }, [subcity, isEditMode, branch, createBranch, updateBranch, onSuccess, onClose]);

  return (
    <MuiDialog
      open={open}
      onClose={isSubmitting ? undefined : onClose}
      title={isEditMode ? 'Edit Operational Branch' : 'Add Operational Branch'}
      maxWidth="sm"
      fullWidth
      actions={
        <>
          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="inherit"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Cancel
          </MuiButton>
          <MuiButton
            type="submit"
            form="branch-form"
            variant="contained"
            color="primary"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            startIcon={isSubmitting ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : null}
          >
            {isSubmitting
              ? isEditMode ? 'Saving...' : 'Creating...'
              : isEditMode ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Branch'}
          </MuiButton>
        </>
      }
    >
      {/* Dynamic key guarantees instant pristine reset of uncontrolled defaultValue inputs on open/branch change */}
      <Box
        component="form"
        id="branch-form"
        key={open ? (branch?._id || 'new-branch') : 'closed'}
        ref={formRef}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        noValidate
        sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}
      >
        <Grid container spacing={2}>
          {/* Branch Name Field (100% Uncontrolled, Zero Keystroke Lag) */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              name="name"
              label="Branch Name"
              placeholder="e.g. Bole Medhanialem (ቦሌ መድኃኔዓለም)"
              defaultValue={branch?.name || ''}
              onFocus={() => {
                if (errors.name) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: null }));
              }}
              error={Boolean(errors.name)}
              helperText={errors.name || 'Required. Bilingual Amharic and English script supported.'}
              fullWidth
              required
              autoFocus
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              startAdornment={<StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mr: 1, fontSize: 20 }} />}
            />
          </Grid>

          {/* Subcity Selection */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              select
              name="subcity"
              label="Subcity"
              value={subcity}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSubcity(e.target.value);
                if (errors.subcity) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, subcity: null }));
              }}
              error={Boolean(errors.subcity)}
              helperText={errors.subcity || 'Required store municipal subcity.'}
              fullWidth
              required
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              startAdornment={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mr: 1, fontSize: 20 }} />}
            >
              {ADDIS_ABABA_SUBCITIES.map((item) => (
                <MenuItem key={item} value={item}>
                  {item}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </MuiTextField>
          </Grid>

          {/* City Field (Uncontrolled) */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              name="city"
              label="City"
              defaultValue={branch?.location?.city || 'Addis Ababa'}
              fullWidth
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            />
          </Grid>

          {/* Physical Address / Landmark (Uncontrolled) */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              name="address"
              label="Street Address / Landmark"
              placeholder="e.g. Next to Edna Mall, Ground Floor"
              defaultValue={branch?.location?.address || ''}
              fullWidth
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              helperText="Physical street address or nearby commercial landmarks."
            />
          </Grid>

          {/* Store Manager Name (Uncontrolled) */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              name="managerName"
              label="Store Manager Name"
              placeholder="e.g. Tigist Alemu"
              defaultValue={branch?.managerName || ''}
              fullWidth
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              startAdornment={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mr: 1, fontSize: 20 }} />}
            />
          </Grid>

          {/* Contact Telephone (Uncontrolled) */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
            <MuiTextField
              name="contactPhone"
              label="Contact Telephone"
              placeholder="e.g. 0911223344"
              defaultValue={branch?.contactPhone || ''}
              fullWidth
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              startAdornment={<PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mr: 1, fontSize: 20 }} />}
              helperText="Direct operational telephone contact."
            />
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </Box>
    </MuiDialog>
  );
});

MuiBranchDialog.displayName = 'MuiBranchDialog';

MuiBranchDialog.propTypes = {
  open: PropTypes.bool.isRequired,
  onClose: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  branch: PropTypes.object,
  onSuccess: PropTypes.func,
};

export default MuiBranchDialog;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAgentExecutionTimeline
 * @description Single Frameless Vertical Timeline Accordion for agent turns in Operon AI Chat.
 * Combines Row 1 (Deliberative Reasoning) and Row 2 (Autonomous Tool Executions) into a single unified component.
 *
 * Adheres strictly to user architecture requirements:
 * - Single expandable accordion with zero outline and zero background color.
 * - First-line header affordance: ONE line, ALL LEFT-ALIGNED including chevron '>':
 *   [Icon] Operon [...] [timestamp] >
 * - Permanent static anchor: [Icon] Operon is ALWAYS present on the left.
 * - Dynamic trailing payload: dynamically tracks real-time pipeline stages:
 *   uploading -> transcribing -> processing docs -> thinking timer -> tool calls -> settled summary + timestamp.
 * - Zero horizontal overflow (overflowX: hidden) on mobile xs (360px-375px) via textOverflow: 'ellipsis'.
 * - Internal vertical timeline: continuous track (divider) connecting deliberative thought bullet nodes,
 *   multi-modal pipeline stages, and tool execution icon nodes with 1-click JSON inspector.
 * - Strictly theme tokens only (no hardcoded external colors).
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Collapse from '@mui/material/Collapse';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeOutlined';
import KeyboardArrowRightIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowRight';

import { MuiToolCallPart } from './MuiToolCallPart.jsx';

/**
 * Formats timestamp for display (e.g. "06:06 PM").
 * @param {string|Date} dateStr
 * @returns {string} Formatted time string.
 */
const formatTimestamp = (dateStr) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

/**
 * Single Frameless Vertical Timeline Accordion.
 *
 * @component MuiAgentExecutionTimeline
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {Array} [props.reasoningParts=[]] - Deliberative thought stream parts.
 * @param {Array} [props.toolParts=[]] - Autonomous tool call parts.
 * @param {string} [props.pipelineStatus=''] - Real-time pipeline stage string.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isStreaming=false] - Whether response is actively generating.
 * @param {string|Date} [props.createdAt] - Creation timestamp of the turn.
 * @param {string} [props.thoughtDuration] - Persisted measured thought duration in seconds.
 * @param {boolean} [props.hasTextStarted=false] - Whether response text has begun streaming.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered single accordion timeline.
 */
export const MuiAgentExecutionTimeline = ({
  reasoningParts = [],
  toolParts = [],
  pipelineStatus = '',
  isStreaming = false,
  isStopped = false,
  createdAt,
  thoughtDuration,
  hasTextStarted = false,
}) => {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const initialDuration = thoughtDuration && thoughtDuration !== '0.0' ? thoughtDuration : '0.0';
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(initialDuration);
  const startTimeRef = useRef(null);

  // Track reasoning duration timer during streaming
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStreaming) {
      if (!startTimeRef.current) {
        startTimeRef.current = Date.now();
      }
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (startTimeRef.current) {
          const sec = ((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000).toFixed(1);
          setElapsedSeconds(sec);
        }
      }, 100);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    } else {
      if (startTimeRef.current) {
        const sec = ((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000).toFixed(1);
        setElapsedSeconds(sec);
      } else if (thoughtDuration && thoughtDuration !== '0.0') {
        setElapsedSeconds(thoughtDuration);
      }
    }
  }, [isStreaming, thoughtDuration]);

  const hasReasoning = reasoningParts.length > 0 && reasoningParts.some((rp) => rp.text && rp.text.trim());
  const hasTools = toolParts.length > 0;
  const hasTimelineContent = hasReasoning || hasTools;

  const handleToggle = () => {
    if (hasTimelineContent) {
      setIsExpanded((prev) => !prev);
    }
  };

  // Derive dynamic status label after invariant [Icon] Operon
  const displayDuration =
    thoughtDuration && thoughtDuration !== '0.0'
      ? thoughtDuration
      : elapsedSeconds !== '0.0'
        ? elapsedSeconds
        : null;

  let dynamicStatusText = '';
  if (isStreaming) {
    if (pipelineStatus) {
      dynamicStatusText = pipelineStatus;
    } else if (hasReasoning && !hasTextStarted) {
      // Actively thinking before text output starts
      dynamicStatusText = `Thinking... ${elapsedSeconds}s`;
    } else if (hasTools) {
      const activeTool = toolParts[toolParts.length - 1]?.toolInvocation?.toolName || 'tool';
      dynamicStatusText = `Executing ${activeTool}...`;
    } else if (hasReasoning) {
      dynamicStatusText = `Thinking... ${elapsedSeconds}s`;
    } else {
      dynamicStatusText = 'Connecting...';
    }
  } else if (pipelineStatus) {
    dynamicStatusText = pipelineStatus;
  } else if (isStopped) {
    dynamicStatusText = hasTimelineContent
      ? (displayDuration ? `Thought for ${displayDuration}s • Stopped` : 'Stopped')
      : 'Generation stopped';
  } else if (hasTimelineContent) {
    if (hasReasoning && hasTools) {
      dynamicStatusText = displayDuration
        ? `Thought for ${displayDuration}s • ${toolParts.length} operation${toolParts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} executed`
        : `Thought • ${toolParts.length} operation${toolParts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} executed`;
    } else if (hasReasoning) {
      dynamicStatusText = displayDuration ? `Thought for ${displayDuration}s` : 'Thought process';
    } else if (hasTools) {
      dynamicStatusText = `${toolParts.length} operation${toolParts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} executed`;
    }
  }

  const timeString = formatTimestamp(createdAt || new Date());

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
        backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
        border: 'none !important',
        outline: 'none !important',
        boxShadow: 'none !important',
        p: 0,
        m: 0,
        mb: 1,
      }}
    >
      {/* FIRST-LINE HEADER AFFORDANCE: ONE LINE, ALL LEFT-ALIGNED INCLUDING CHEVRON '>', NO OVERFLOW-X ON XS */}
      <Box
        component="button"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleToggle}
        aria-expanded={isExpanded}
        aria-label="Toggle execution timeline details"
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'flex-start',
          gap: 0.75,
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
          border: 'none !important',
          outline: 'none !important',
          bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
          backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
          boxShadow: 'none !important',
          p: 0,
          m: 0,
          cursor: hasTimelineContent ? 'pointer' : 'default',
          userSelect: 'none',
          textAlign: 'left',
          '&:hover': {
            opacity: hasTimelineContent ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        }}
      >
        {/* 1. Icon (Permanent static anchor on the left) */}
        {isStreaming ? (
          <CircularProgress
            size={14}
            thickness={4}
            sx={{ color: 'primary.main', flexShrink: 0 }}
          />
        ) : (
          <AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon
            sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* 2. Brand Label (Permanent static anchor on the left) */}
        <Typography
          variant="body2"
          sx={{
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: 'text.primary',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          Operon
        </Typography>

        {/* 3. Dynamic Real-Time Pipeline Stage Tracking [...] */}
        {dynamicStatusText && (
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.secondary',
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              flexShrink: 1,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              maxWidth: { xs: 160, sm: 340, md: 520 },
            }}
          >
            [{dynamicStatusText}]
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 4. Timestamp (Subtle inline timestamp) */}
        {timeString && (
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              color: 'text.disabled',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              flexShrink: 0,
              ml: 0.25,
            }}
          >
            {timeString}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {/* 5. Chevron '>' (Left-aligned inline alongside text and timestamp) */}
        {hasTimelineContent && (
          <KeyboardArrowRightIcon
            sx={{
              fontSize: 18,
              color: 'text.secondary',
              flexShrink: 0,
              transform: isExpanded ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)',
              transition: 'transform 150ms ease',
            }}
          />
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* INTERNAL VERTICAL TIMELINE BODY (WHEN EXPANDED) */}
      {hasTimelineContent && (
        <Collapse in={isExpanded} timeout="auto" unmountOnExit>
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: 'relative',
              borderLeft: '1.5px solid',
              borderColor: 'divider',
              ml: 1,
              pl: 2,
              mt: 1.5,
              mb: 1,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: 1.5,
            }}
          >
            {/* Deliberative Reasoning Nodes */}
            {reasoningParts.map((rp, idx) => {
              if (!rp.text || !rp.text.trim()) return null;
              return (
                <Box
                  key={rp.id || `reasoning-node-${idx}`}
                  sx={{
                    position: 'relative',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Step Dot Anchor */}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      left: -20,
                      top: 7,
                      width: 7,
                      height: 7,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      bgcolor: 'text.secondary',
                    }}
                  />
                  <Typography
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.84rem',
                      lineHeight: 1.6,
                      color: 'text.secondary',
                      whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                      wordBreak: 'break-word',
                    }}
                  >
                    {rp.text}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              );
            })}

            {/* Autonomous Tool Execution Nodes */}
            {toolParts.map((tp, idx) => (
              <Box
                key={tp.toolInvocation?.toolCallId || `tool-node-${idx}`}
                sx={{
                  position: 'relative',
                  width: '100%',
                }}
              >
                {/* Step Dot Anchor */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    left: -21,
                    top: 8,
                    width: 9,
                    height: 9,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                    border: '1.5px solid',
                    borderColor: 'primary.main',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                />
                <MuiToolCallPart
                  toolInvocation={tp.toolInvocation}
                  stepNumber={toolParts.length > 1 ? idx + 1 : undefined}
                  totalSteps={toolParts.length > 1 ? toolParts.length : undefined}
                />
              </Box>
            ))}
          </Box>
        </Collapse>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiAgentExecutionTimeline.propTypes = {
  reasoningParts: PropTypes.array,
  toolParts: PropTypes.array,
  pipelineStatus: PropTypes.string,
  isStreaming: PropTypes.bool,
  isStopped: PropTypes.bool,
  createdAt: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
  thoughtDuration: PropTypes.string,
  hasTextStarted: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default MuiAgentExecutionTimeline;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAgentMessage
 * @description Outlined Paper card representing an agent turn in Operon AI Chat.
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - 4-Row Visual Topology:
 *   * ROW 1: Deliberative Reasoning Accordion (MuiReasoningAccordion)
 *   * ROW 2: Autonomous Tool Shelf (MuiToolCallPart)
 *   * ROW 3: Primary Conversational Body (MuiAgentMessageBody with dynamic Markdown, tables, ChatCodeBlock)
 *   * ROW 4: Contextual Actions Deck (MuiAgentMessageBottomBar with text-only copy and linear pruning retry)
 * - Universal Error Handling & Failover Awareness (MuiErrorNotice).
 * - Left-aligned geometry with responsive width constraints.
 * - 16px / 1rem typography standard.
 */

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { useMessage, useMessageError, useChatActions, useChatStore, useMessageIds } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';

import { setActiveModel, selectPipelineStatus, selectActiveModel } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { useChatAdapter } from '../../contexts/ChatAdapterContext.js';
import MuiAgentExecutionTimeline from './MuiAgentExecutionTimeline.jsx';
import MuiAgentMessageBody from './MuiAgentMessageBody.jsx';
import MuiAgentMessageBottomBar from './MuiAgentMessageBottomBar.jsx';
import MuiCloudDocumentCard from './MuiCloudDocumentCard.jsx';
import MuiErrorNotice from './MuiErrorNotice.jsx';

/**
 * Primary Agent Turn Container.
 *
 * @component MuiAgentMessage
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} props.messageId - Unique identifier of the assistant message turn.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered agent turn card.
 */
export const MuiAgentMessage = ({ messageId }) => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const adapter = useChatAdapter();
  const message = useMessage(messageId);
  const messageError = useMessageError(messageId);
  const actions = useChatActions(true);
  const store = useChatStore();
  const messageIds = useMessageIds();
  const reduxPipelineStatus = useSelector(selectPipelineStatus);
  const activeModel = useSelector(selectActiveModel);

  // Decompose message parts into semantic layers
  const parts = useMemo(() => message?.parts || [], [message?.parts]);

  const reasoningParts = useMemo(
    () => parts.filter((p) => p.type === 'reasoning'),
    [parts]
  );

  const toolParts = useMemo(
    () => parts.filter((p) => p.type === 'tool' || p.type === 'dynamic-tool'),
    [parts]
  );

  const textParts = useMemo(
    () => parts.filter((p) => p.type === 'text'),
    [parts]
  );

  // Synthesize pure text for copy target (strictly excluding thoughts, tools, metadata)
  const fullText = useMemo(() => {
    if (textParts.length > 0) {
      return textParts.map((p) => p.text).join('\n');
    }
    return message?.text || (typeof message?.content === 'string' ? message.content : '');
  }, [textParts, message]);

  const isStreaming = message?.status === 'streaming';
  const isError = Boolean(
    message?.status === 'error' ||
    Boolean(messageError) ||
    message?.metadata?.isError ||
    message?.finishReason === 'error' ||
    message?.error ||
    message?.metadata?.error
  );
  const isStopped = Boolean(
    message?.status === 'cancelled' ||
    message?.metadata?.isStopped ||
    message?.finishReason === 'stop' ||
    message?.isStopped
  );
  const errorObj = messageError || message?.metadata?.error || message?.error || 'Generation failed.';

  // Linear history pruning & regeneration handler (Case 1: zero phantom user messages)
  const handleRegenerate = useCallback(async (alternateModel) => {
    if (alternateModel) {
      dispatch(setActiveModel(alternateModel));
      adapter?.setModel?.(alternateModel);
    }
    const currentIds = Array.isArray(messageIds) ? messageIds : store?.state?.messageIds || [];
    const turnIndex = currentIds.indexOf(messageId);
    const anchorUserMessageId = turnIndex > 0 ? currentIds[turnIndex - 1] : null;

    // Prune downstream message turns (> turnIndex) from client store to preserve mathematical alternation
    if (turnIndex !== -1 && store && typeof store.update === 'function') {
      const keptIds = currentIds.slice(0, turnIndex + 1);
      const nextMessagesById = {};
      for (const id of keptIds) {
        if (store.state?.messagesById?.[id]) {
          nextMessagesById[id] = store.state.messagesById[id];
        }
      }
      if (nextMessagesById[messageId]) {
        nextMessagesById[messageId] = {
          ...nextMessagesById[messageId],
          text: '',
          content: '',
          parts: [],
          error: undefined,
          metadata: {
            ...(nextMessagesById[messageId].metadata || {}),
            isStopped: false,
            model: alternateModel || activeModel,
          },
        };
      }
      store.update({
        messageIds: keptIds,
        messagesById: nextMessagesById,
      });
    }

    // When an alternate model is specified, bypass native actions.regenerate
    // (which drops the model parameter) and invoke adapter.retryTurn directly
    if (alternateModel && adapter && typeof adapter.retryTurn === 'function') {
      try {
        await adapter.retryTurn({
          conversationId: message?.conversationId || adapter.currentChatId,
          targetAssistantMessageId: messageId,
          anchorUserMessageId,
          model: alternateModel,
          store,
        });
        return;
      } catch (adapterErr) {
        console.warn('[MuiAgentMessage] adapter.retryTurn error with alternateModel:', adapterErr);
      }
    }

    if (actions && typeof actions.regenerate === 'function') {
      try {
        await actions.regenerate(messageId);
        return;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[MuiAgentMessage] actions.regenerate fallback:', err);
      }
    }

    // Direct adapter retryTurn fallback if actions.regenerate failed or not mounted
    if (adapter && typeof adapter.retryTurn === 'function') {
      try {
        await adapter.retryTurn({
          conversationId: message?.conversationId || adapter.currentChatId,
          targetAssistantMessageId: messageId,
          anchorUserMessageId,
          model: alternateModel,
          store,
        });
        return;
      } catch (adapterErr) {
        console.warn('[MuiAgentMessage] adapter.retryTurn error:', adapterErr);
      }
    }

    // Fallback if actions.regenerate not mounted or failed:
    // Resolve anchor user message index and retry it directly
    if (anchorUserMessageId && actions && typeof actions.retry === 'function') {
      await actions.retry(anchorUserMessageId);
    }
  }, [actions, activeModel, adapter, dispatch, message, messageId, messageIds, store]);

  const handleSelectModel = useCallback(
    (newModel) => {
      handleRegenerate(newModel);
    },
    [handleRegenerate]
  );

  // Resilient Continue Generating handler for stopped turns (Model A: In-Place Resumption)
  const handleContinue = useCallback(async () => {
    if (adapter && typeof adapter.continueGeneration === 'function') {
      try {
        await adapter.continueGeneration({
          conversationId: message?.conversationId || adapter.currentChatId,
          messageId,
          store,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[MuiAgentMessage] adapter.continueGeneration error:', err);
      }
    }
  }, [adapter, message, messageId, store]);

  if (!message) return null;

  return (
    <Box
      className="MuiAgentMessage-root"
      sx={{
        position: 'relative',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignSelf: 'flex-start',
        justifySelf: 'start',
        gridArea: 'content',
        mr: 'auto',
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
        backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
        border: 'none !important',
        boxShadow: 'none !important',
        p: 0,
        m: 0,
        color: 'text.primary',
      }}
    >
      {/* ROW 1 + ROW 2 UNIFIED: SINGLE FRAMELESS VERTICAL TIMELINE ACCORDION */}
      <MuiAgentExecutionTimeline
        reasoningParts={reasoningParts}
        toolParts={toolParts}
        pipelineStatus={isStreaming ? reduxPipelineStatus : (message?.metadata?.pipelineStatus || '')}
        isStreaming={isStreaming}
        isStopped={isStopped}
        createdAt={message?.createdAt}
        thoughtDuration={message?.metadata?.thoughtDuration}
        hasTextStarted={Boolean(fullText && fullText.trim())}
      />

      {/* ROW 3: PRIMARY CONVERSATIONAL BODY (DYNAMIC MARKDOWN, TABLES & CHATCODEBLOCK) */}
      <MuiAgentMessageBody text={fullText} isStreaming={isStreaming} />

      {/* ROW 3.5: CLOUD DOCUMENTS & DOWNLOAD ACTION CARDS */}
      <MuiCloudDocumentCard toolParts={toolParts} />

      {/* STOPPED NOTICE WHEN INTERRUPTED BEFORE TEXT OUTPUT */}
      {isStopped && (!fullText || !fullText.trim()) && (
        <Typography
          variant="body2"
          sx={{
            color: 'text.secondary',
            fontStyle: 'italic',
            my: 1,
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
          }}
        >
          Generation stopped by user.
        </Typography>
      )}

      {/* TERMINAL OR MID-STREAM ERROR NOTICE */}
      {isError && (
        <MuiErrorNotice
          error={errorObj}
          onRetry={() => handleRegenerate()}
          failedModel={message?.metadata?.model}
          onSelectModel={handleSelectModel}
          isPartial={Boolean(fullText)}
        />
      )}

      {/* ROW 4: BOTTOM CONTEXTUAL ACTIONS DECK (Rendered after response completes or when stopped) */}
      {!isError && !isStreaming && !store?.state?.isStreaming && (Boolean(fullText && fullText.trim()) || isStopped || (message?.toolCalls && message.toolCalls.length > 0)) && (
        <MuiAgentMessageBottomBar
          text={fullText}
          model={message?.metadata?.model || activeModel}
          usage={message?.metadata?.usage}
          createdAt={message?.createdAt}
          onRegenerate={() => handleRegenerate()}
          onContinue={handleContinue}
          isStreaming={false}
          isStopped={isStopped}
        />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiAgentMessage.propTypes = {
  messageId: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
};

export default MuiAgentMessage;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAgentMessageBody
 * @description Primary conversational body for agent responses.
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - 16px / 1rem typography standard across all body text, lists, and tables (lineHeight: 1.6).
 * - The Zero Hardcoding Law: Pure dynamic Markdown surface supporting all 7 categories
 *   (inspection reports, cross-branch tables, branch rosters, HACCP advisory, emails, math, copilot gates).
 * - Native @mui/x-chat ChatCodeBlock integration with syntax highlighting and 1-click copy.
 * - Responsive styled Material UI tables with subtle zebra striping and horizontal overflow protection.
 * - Streaming markdown repair for unclosed code fences and formatting markers.
 */

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Link from '@mui/material/Link';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';

import Markdown, { RuleType } from 'markdown-to-jsx';
import { ChatCodeBlock } from '@mui/x-chat';

/**
 * Repairs unclosed markdown markers during real-time streaming.
 * @param {string} rawText
 * @returns {string} Repaired markdown text.
 */
const repairStreamingMarkdown = (rawText) => {
  if (!rawText || typeof rawText !== 'string') return '';
  let text = rawText;

  // 1. Repair unclosed fenced code blocks (```)
  const fenceMatches = text.match(/```/g);
  if (fenceMatches && fenceMatches.length % 2 !== 0) {
    text = `${text}\n\`\`\``;
  }

  // 2. Repair unclosed bold (**)
  const textWithoutBlocks = text.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '');
  const boldMatches = textWithoutBlocks.match(/\*\*/g);
  if (boldMatches && boldMatches.length % 2 !== 0) {
    text = `${text}**`;
  }

  return text;
};

/**
 * Custom Markdown overrides for Material UI typography, tables, and links.
 */
const markdownOverrides = {
  h1: {

  thead: {

        {children}
      </TableHead>
    ),
  },
  tbody: {
    component: ({ children, ...props }) => (
      <TableBody {...props}>{children}</TableBody>
    ),
  },
  th: {
    component: ({ children, ...props }) => (
      <TableCell
        sx={{
          fontWeight: 600,
          fontSize: '0.875rem',
          color: 'text.primary',
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: 'divider',
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',

          px: 1.5,
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </TableCell>
    ),
  },
  td: {
    component: ({ children, ...props }) => (
      <TableCell
        sx={{
          fontSize: '0.875rem',
          color: 'text.primary',
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: 'divider',
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
          py: 1,
          px: 1.5,
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </TableCell>
    ),
  },
  tr: {
    component: ({ children, ...props }) => (
      <TableRow
        sx={{
          '&:last-child td': { borderBottom: 0 },
          '&:nth-of-type(even)': {
            bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.action.hover, 0.3),
          },
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </TableRow>
    ),
  },
};

/**
 * Primary Agent Message Body rendering pure dynamic Markdown.
 *
 * @component MuiAgentMessageBody
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} [props.text=''] - Raw or streaming Markdown response text.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isStreaming=false] - Whether response is actively streaming.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered conversational message body.
 */
export const MuiAgentMessageBody = ({ text = '', isStreaming = false }) => {
  const processedText = useMemo(() => {
    if (!text) return '';
    return isStreaming ? repairStreamingMarkdown(text) : text;
  }, [text, isStreaming]);

  const markdownOptions = useMemo(
    () => ({
      forceBlock: true,
      wrapper: Box,
      overrides: markdownOverrides,
      renderRule(next, node, _renderChildren, state) {
        if (node.type === RuleType.codeBlock) {
          return (
            <ChatCodeBlock
              language={node.lang || undefined}
              key={state.key}
              sx={{ my: 1, maxWidth: '100%', overflowX: 'auto' }}
            >
              {node.text}
            </ChatCodeBlock>
          );
        }
        return next();
      },
    }),
    []
  );

  if (!processedText) return null;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        minWidth: 0,
        fontSize: '1rem',
        lineHeight: 1.6,
        color: 'text.primary',
        wordBreak: 'break-word',
      }}
    >
      <Markdown options={markdownOptions}>{processedText}</Markdown>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiAgentMessageBody.propTypes = {
  text: PropTypes.string,
  isStreaming: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default MuiAgentMessageBody;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAgentMessageBottomBar
 * @description Flat transparent actions deck for agent messages.
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - Strict Clipboard Copy Isolation: Copies ONLY the synthesized text response (excluding thoughts, tool JSON, and metadata).
 * - Zero Background Color Invariant: Enforces bgcolor: 'transparent !important' across idle and hover.
 * - Left Cluster: Model metadata and timestamp with optional token telemetry tooltip.
 * - Right Cluster: Text-only [Copy] with animated feedback and [Regenerate] with linear history pruning.
 */

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Popover from '@mui/material/Popover';
import MenuList from '@mui/material/MenuList';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import ContentCopyIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContentCopy';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeOutlined';
import PlayArrowIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlayArrow';
import TelegramIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Telegram';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { useShareTelegramMutation } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { formatModelDisplayName } from '../../utils/constants.js';
import MuiTtsPlayButton from './MuiTtsPlayButton.jsx';

/**
 * Formats timestamp for display.
 * @param {string|Date} dateStr
 * @returns {string} Formatted timestamp string (e.g. "14:35").
 */
const formatTimestamp = (dateStr) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

/**
 * Flat transparent bottom action bar for agent turns.
 *
 * @component MuiAgentMessageBottomBar
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} [props.text=''] - Pure synthesized text to copy.
 * @param {string} [props.model] - Model name used for generation.
 * @param {object} [props.usage] - Token usage telemetry metadata.
 * @param {string|Date} [props.createdAt] - Creation timestamp.
 * @param {Function} [props.onRegenerate] - Callback to trigger turn regeneration.
 * @param {Function} [props.onContinue] - Callback to continue interrupted generation.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isStreaming=false] - Whether response is actively generating.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isStopped=false] - Whether response was interrupted by user stop.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered action bar.
 */
export const MuiAgentMessageBottomBar = ({
  text = '',
  model,
  usage,
  createdAt,
  onRegenerate,
  onContinue,
  isStreaming = false,
  isStopped = false,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copyTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const user = useSelector((state) => state.auth.user);
  const telegram = user?.integrations?.telegram || {};
  const isTelegramConnected = Boolean(telegram.connected);
  const isTelegramEnabled = telegram.enabled !== false;

  const [shareTelegram] = useShareTelegramMutation();
  const [telegramAnchor, setTelegramAnchor] = useState(null);
  const [userSelectedFormat, setUserSelectedFormat] = useState(null);
  const telegramFormat = userSelectedFormat || telegram.defaultFormat || 'text';
  const [sharingChannel, setSharingChannel] = useState(null);

  const telegramChannels = [
    {
      id: 'management',
      label: 'Management (Default)',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.managementChatId),
    },
    {
      id: 'maintenance',
      label: 'Maintenance & Facilities',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.maintenanceChatId),
    },
    {
      id: 'general',
      label: 'General Operations',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.generalChatId),
    },
  ];

  const handleOpenTelegram = (e) => {
    setTelegramAnchor(e.currentTarget);
  };

  const handleCloseTelegram = () => {
    setTelegramAnchor(null);
  };

  const handleShareToTelegramChannel = async (channel) => {
    if (!text || sharingChannel) return;
    setSharingChannel(channel);
    try {
      await shareTelegram({
        text,
        targetChannel: channel,
        asImage: telegramFormat === 'image',
      }).unwrap();

      const modeLabel = telegramFormat === 'image' ? 'Image Card' : 'Text';
      toast.success(`Dispatched to Telegram: ${channel} [${modeLabel}]`);
      handleCloseTelegram();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Telegram dispatch failed');
    } finally {
      setSharingChannel(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(true);
      if (copyTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimeoutRef.current);
      copyTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopied(false);
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }
  };

  const modelLabel = formatModelDisplayName(model);
  const timeLabel = formatTimestamp(createdAt);

  const usageTooltip =
    usage && usage.totalTokens
      ? `Tokens: ${usage.totalTokens} (Prompt: ${usage.promptTokens || 0}, Completion: ${usage.candidatesTokens || 0})`
      : '';

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'flex-start',
        gap: 1.25,
        width: '100%',
        mt: 0.5,
        pt: 0.5,
        userSelect: 'none',
        opacity: isStopped || Boolean(telegramAnchor) ? 1 : { xs: 1, sm: 0 },
        transition: 'opacity 150ms ease',

    >
      {/* 1. Action Buttons Cluster (Left-Aligned) */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
        {/* Continue Generating Button (Rendered when stream was stopped by user and partial text exists) */}
        {isStopped && typeof onContinue === 'function' && Boolean(text && text.trim()) && (
          <Tooltip title="Continue generation from interruption point">
            <Button
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              startIcon={<PlayArrowIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
              onClick={onContinue}
              sx={{
                color: 'primary.main',
                borderColor: 'primary.main',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                textTransform: 'none',
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                fontWeight: 600,
                py: '2px',
                px: 1,
                minHeight: 24,
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                '&:hover': {
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',

            >

        )}

        {/* Copy Response (Text Only) */}
        {Boolean(text && text.trim()) && (

                '&:hover': {
                  color: 'text.primary',

                },
              }}
            >
              {copied ? (
                <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'success.main' }} />
              ) : (
                <ContentCopyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
              )}
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        )}

        {/* Share to Telegram */}
        {Boolean(text && text.trim()) && (
          <>
            <Tooltip title="Share to Telegram">

                    </ToggleButton>
                  </ToggleButtonGroup>

                  <Divider sx={{ my: 0.8 }} />

                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
                    Select Channel:
                  </Typography>

                  <MenuList disablePadding>
                    {telegramChannels.map((item) => {
                      const isDisabled = !item.configured || Boolean(sharingChannel);
                      const menuItem = (
                        <MenuItem
                          key={item.id}
                          onClick={() => item.configured && handleShareToTelegramChannel(item.id)}
                          disabled={isDisabled}
                          sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                            borderRadius: 1,
                            py: 0.6,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            opacity: item.configured ? 1 : 0.6,
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>{item.label}</span>
                          {sharingChannel === item.id ? (
                            <CircularProgress size={12} sx={{ ml: 1 }} />
                          ) : !item.configured ? (
                            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: 'text.disabled' }}>
                              Not set
                            </Typography>
                          ) : null}
                        </MenuItem>
                      );

                      if (!item.configured) {
                        return (
                          <Tooltip key={item.id} title="Chat ID not configured in Profile > Telegram" arrow placement="left">
                            <span>{menuItem}</span>
                          </Tooltip>
                        );
                      }

                      return menuItem;
                    })}
                  </MenuList>
                </>
              )}
            </Popover>
          </>
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* 2. Identity & Time Cluster (Left-Aligned alongside Action Buttons): [Icon + Model + timestamp] */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0, flexShrink: 1 }}>
        <Tooltip title={usageTooltip ? `${modelLabel} • ${usageTooltip}` : modelLabel} arrow>
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                color: 'text.secondary',
                fontWeight: 500,
                maxWidth: { xs: 110, sm: 220 },
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                display: 'inline-block',
                verticalAlign: 'middle',
              }}
            >
              {modelLabel}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Tooltip>

        {timeLabel && (
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              color: 'text.disabled',
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            • {timeLabel}
          </Typography>
        )}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiAgentMessageBottomBar.propTypes = {
  text: PropTypes.string,
  model: PropTypes.string,
  usage: PropTypes.shape({
    promptTokens: PropTypes.number,
    candidatesTokens: PropTypes.number,
    totalTokens: PropTypes.number,
  }),
  createdAt: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
  onRegenerate: PropTypes.func,
  onContinue: PropTypes.func,
  isStreaming: PropTypes.bool,
  isStopped: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default MuiAgentMessageBottomBar;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAttachButton
 * @description Modular attachment trigger button for the chat composer.
 * Renders in the bottom composer toolbar left cluster.
 * Opens the native OS file picker and validates incoming files against
 * ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS and AUDIO_CONSTANTS via validateChatAttachments before
 * registering them into the composer's draft store.
 */

import { useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import AttachFileIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AttachFile';
import { useChatComposer, useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import {
  useUploadAttachmentsMutation,
  useUploadAudioMutation,
  useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { registerUpload } from '../../utils/attachmentRegistry.js';
import { validateChatAttachments, isAudioAttachment } from '../../utils/validateChatAttachment.js';
import { CHAT_FILE_ACCEPT } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * MuiAttachButton component.
 * @param {object} props - Component props.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled] - Optional external disabled override.
 * @returns {React.ReactElement}
 */
export const MuiAttachButton = ({ disabled = false }) => {
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const composer = useChatComposer();
  const status = useChatStatus();
  const [uploadAttachments] = useUploadAttachmentsMutation();
  const [uploadAudio] = useUploadAudioMutation();
  const [deleteComposerAttachment] = useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation();

  const isStreaming = Boolean(status?.isStreaming);
  const isComposerDisabled = Boolean(composer?.disabled);
  const isDisabled = disabled || isStreaming || isComposerDisabled;

  const handleOpenPicker = useCallback(() => {
    if (inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.click();
    }
  }, []);

  const handleFileChange = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
      if (files.length === 0) return;

      const currentFiles = (composer?.attachments || [])
        .map((att) => att.file)
        .filter(Boolean);

      const validation = validateChatAttachments(files, currentFiles, { showToast: true });

      if (validation.isValid && Array.isArray(validation.validFiles) && validation.validFiles.length > 0) {
        validation.validFiles.forEach((file) => {
          if (typeof composer?.addAttachment === 'function') {
            composer.addAttachment(file);
          }

          const isAudio = isAudioAttachment(file);
          const formData = new FormData();
          let mutationPromise;

          if (isAudio) {
            formData.append('audios', file);
            mutationPromise = uploadAudio(formData);
          } else {
            formData.append('attachments', file);
            mutationPromise = uploadAttachments(formData);
          }

          const uploadPromise = mutationPromise
            .unwrap()
            .then((res) => {
              if (isAudio) {
                const audioList = res?.data?.audios || res?.audios || [];
                const first = audioList[0] || null;
                if (first && file) {
                  file._id = first._id || first.id;
                  file.audioId = first._id || first.id;
                  file.fileName = first.fileName;
                  file.publicId = first.publicId;
                  file.cloudUrl = first.cloudUrl;
                }
                return first ? { ...first, isAudio: true } : null;
              }
              const uploadedList = res?.data?.attachments || res?.attachments || [];
              const first = uploadedList[0] || null;
              if (first && file) {
                file._id = first._id || first.id;
                file.fileName = first.fileName;
                file.publicId = first.publicId;
                file.cloudUrl = first.cloudUrl;
              }
              return first ? { ...first, isAudio: false } : null;
            });

          const abortFn = () => {
            try {
              if (mutationPromise && typeof mutationPromise.abort === 'function') {
                mutationPromise.abort();
              }
            } catch {
              // Ignored on abort
            }
          };

          const onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup = (result) => {
            if (result) {
              const publicId = result.publicId;
              const fileName = result.fileName;
              const mimeType = result.mimeType || file.type;
              void deleteComposerAttachment({ publicId, fileName, mimeType });
            }
          };

          registerUpload(file, uploadPromise, abortFn, onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup);
        });
      }

      // Reset native input value so user can re-select the same file if needed
      e.target.value = '';
    },
    [composer, uploadAttachments, uploadAudio, deleteComposerAttachment]
  );

  return (
    <Tooltip title={isDisabled ? '' : 'Attach files'} arrow disableHoverListener={isDisabled}>
      <span>
        <IconButton
          type="button"
          aria-label="Attach files"
          size="small"
          onClick={handleOpenPicker}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          sx={{
            color: 'text.secondary',
            '&:hover': {
              color: 'text.primary',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
            },
            transition: 'none !important',
            p: 0.75,
          }}
        >
          <AttachFileIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
        </IconButton>
        <input
          type="file"
          multiple
          ref={inputRef}
          style={{ display: 'none' }}
          accept={CHAT_FILE_ACCEPT}
          onChange={handleFileChange}
        />
      </span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
};

MuiAttachButton.displayName = 'MuiAttachButton';

export default MuiAttachButton;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiAudioRecorder
 * @description In-composer voice dictation and audio recording component.
 * Integrates useAudioRecorder hook with Addis AI / Gemini STT backend.
 * Features a compact morphing recording HUD with:
 * - Real-time acoustic frequency visualizer bars scaling with voice amplitude
 * - Monospace duration timer with pulsing red recording indicator
 * - 1-click stop & transcribe with automatic Amharic STT injection into composer
 * - Discard / cancel actions cleanly aborting hardware streams
 * - Zero-loss cached audio retry affordance on STT network failures
 * - Empty-audio / silence suppression ignoring empty dictations
 */

import { useState, forwardRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import MicIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Mic';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import DeleteOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { useChatComposer, useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { useAudioRecorder } from '../../hooks/useAudioRecorder.js';
import {
  useTranscribeAudioMutation,
  selectSttEngine,
  selectLanguage,
} from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';

/**
 * MuiAudioRecorder component.
 * Seamlessly morphs between idle microphone button and active recording HUD.
 */
export const MuiAudioRecorder = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const { disabled = false } = props;
  const composer = useChatComposer();
  const { isStreaming } = useChatStatus();
  const [transcribeAudio, { isLoading: isTranscribing }] = useTranscribeAudioMutation();
  const [hasTranscriptionError, setHasTranscriptionError] = useState(false);
  const sttEngine = useSelector(selectSttEngine);
  const language = useSelector(selectLanguage);

  const {
    isRecording,
    formattedDuration,
    audioLevel,
    startRecording,
    stopRecording,
    cancelRecording,
    cachedAudioBlob,
    clearCachedBlob,
  } = useAudioRecorder();

  const isDisabled = Boolean(disabled || isStreaming || composer?.isSubmitting || isTranscribing);

  /**
   * Executes audio transcription via backend /api/v1/chat/transcribe-audio endpoint.
   */
  const executeTranscription = useCallback(
    async (blobToTranscribe) => {
      if (!blobToTranscribe || blobToTranscribe.size === 0) {
        toast.info('No audio detected in recording.');
        clearCachedBlob();
        setHasTranscriptionError(false);
        return;
      }

      setHasTranscriptionError(false);
      const formData = new FormData();
      const ext = blobToTranscribe.type.includes('wav')
        ? '.wav'
        : blobToTranscribe.type.includes('ogg')
          ? '.ogg'
          : '.webm';
      const file = new File([blobToTranscribe], `recording-${Date.now()}${ext}`, {
        type: blobToTranscribe.type || 'audio/webm',
      });
      formData.append('audio', file);
      if (sttEngine) {
        formData.append('engine', sttEngine);
      }
      formData.append('language', language || 'am');

      try {
        const res = await transcribeAudio(formData).unwrap();
        const data = res?.data || res;
        const text = (data?.text || '').trim();

        if (!text || data?.noAudioDetected === true) {
          toast.info('No speech detected in recording.');
          clearCachedBlob();
          setHasTranscriptionError(false);
          return;
        }

        // Speech detected: append to existing composer draft
        const current = composer?.value || '';
        const updated = current.trim() ? `${current.trim()} ${text}` : text;
        if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
          composer.setValue(updated);
        }

        // Synchronize DOM textarea
        const textarea = document.querySelector('textarea[name="chat-prompt-input"]');
        if (textarea) {
          textarea.value = updated;
          textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        toast.success('Voice transcribed successfully.');
        clearCachedBlob();
        setHasTranscriptionError(false);
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to transcribe audio.';
        toast.error(msg);
        setHasTranscriptionError(true);
      }
    },
    [clearCachedBlob, composer, transcribeAudio, sttEngine, language]
  );

  /**
   * Starts microphone recording.
   */
  const handleStart = useCallback(async () => {
    setHasTranscriptionError(false);
    clearCachedBlob();
    await startRecording();
  }, [clearCachedBlob, startRecording]);

  /**
   * Discards active recording without transcribing.
   */
  const handleDiscard = useCallback(() => {
    cancelRecording();
    clearCachedBlob();
    setHasTranscriptionError(false);
  }, [cancelRecording, clearCachedBlob]);

  /**
   * Stops recording and executes speech transcription.
   */
  const handleStopAndTranscribe = useCallback(async () => {
    const blob = await stopRecording();
    if (blob) {
      await executeTranscription(blob);
    }
  }, [executeTranscription, stopRecording]);

  /**
   * Dismisses failed transcription error state.
   */
  const handleDismissError = useCallback(() => {
    setHasTranscriptionError(false);
    clearCachedBlob();
  }, [clearCachedBlob]);

  // State 1: Active Transcription Processing
  if (isTranscribing) {
    return (
      <Box
        ref={ref}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 0.75,
          px: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.25 },
          py: 0.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          maxWidth: { xs: 130, sm: 220 },
          flexShrink: 0,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <CircularProgress size={16} sx={{ color: 'primary.main', flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline' },
            fontSize: '0.75rem',
            color: 'text.secondary',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          Transcribing...
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // State 2: Transcription Error with Zero-Loss 1-Click Retry
  if (hasTranscriptionError && cachedAudioBlob && !isRecording) {
    return (
      <Box
        ref={ref}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 0.75 },
          px: 1,
          py: 0.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(237, 108, 2, 0.12)' : 'rgba(237, 108, 2, 0.08)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'warning.main',
          maxWidth: { xs: 130, sm: 220 },
          flexShrink: 0,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <Tooltip title="Discard recorded audio">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={handleDismissError}
            aria-label="Discard recorded audio"
            sx={{ p: 0.25 }}
          >
            <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>

        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.75rem',
            color: 'warning.main',
            letterSpacing: '0.02em',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {formattedDuration}
        </Typography>

        <Tooltip title="Retry transcription">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={() => executeTranscription(cachedAudioBlob)}
            color="warning"
            aria-label="Retry transcription"
            sx={{ p: 0.25 }}
          >
            <ReplayIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // State 3: Active Recording HUD with Live Waveform Bars
  if (isRecording) {
    return (
      <Box
        ref={ref}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 0.75 },
          px: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.25 },
          py: 0.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          maxWidth: { xs: 130, sm: 220 },
          flexShrink: 0,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {/* Discard button */}
        <Tooltip title="Discard recording">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={handleDiscard}
            color="error"
            aria-label="Discard recording"
            sx={{ p: 0.25 }}
          >
            <DeleteOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>

        {/* Pulsing indicator + Duration timer */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 8,
              height: 8,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              bgcolor: 'error.main',
              flexShrink: 0,
              animation: 'audioPulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out',
              '@keyframes audioPulse': {
                '0%': { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(1)' },
                '50%': { opacity: 0.3, transform: 'scale(0.8)' },
                '100%': { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(1)' },
              },
            }}
          />
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              color: 'text.primary',
              letterSpacing: '0.02em',
            }}
          >
            {formattedDuration}
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Real-time acoustic frequency visualizer bars */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'flex' },
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '2px',
            height: 16,
            px: 0.25,
          }}
        >
          {[0.6, 1.0, 0.4].map((multiplier, idx) => {
            const barHeight = Math.max(
              3,
              Math.min(14, Math.round(audioLevel * 14 * multiplier + 3))
            );
            return (
              <Box
                key={idx}
                sx={{
                  width: 2.5,
                  height: `${barHeight}px`,
                  bgcolor: 'error.main',
                  borderRadius: 0.5,
                  transition: 'height 80ms ease',
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Box>

        {/* Stop and transcribe checkmark button */}
        <Tooltip title="Stop and transcribe">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={handleStopAndTranscribe}
            color="primary"
            aria-label="Stop and transcribe"
            sx={{
              p: 0.25,
              bgcolor: (theme) =>
                theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                  ? 'rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.2)'
                  : 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.12)',
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: (theme) =>
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? 'rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.35)'
                    : 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.22)',
              },
            }}
          >
            <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // State 4: Idle Microphone Trigger Button
  return (
    <Tooltip title="Voice dictation (record & transcribe)">
      <span>
        <IconButton
          ref={ref}
          size="small"
          disabled={isDisabled}
          onClick={handleStart}
          aria-label="Voice dictation"
          sx={{
            p: 0.75,
            color: 'text.secondary',
            transition: 'color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease',
            '&:hover': {
              color: 'primary.main',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              transform: 'scale(1.05)',
            },
            '&.Mui-disabled': {
              color: 'action.disabled',
            },
          }}
        >
          <MicIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
        </IconButton>
      </span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
});

MuiAudioRecorder.displayName = 'MuiAudioRecorder';

export default MuiAudioRecorder;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiChatEmptyState
 * @description Universal empty state greeting for the personal AI agent canvas.
 * Neutral, general-purpose presentation without restrictive domain-specific prompt chips.
 * Eradicates empty-state greeting flicker during route navigation and history loading on /chat/:chatId.
 */

import { useParams } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import SmartToyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SmartToyOutlined';
import { useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { useGetChatByIdQuery } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { CHAT_PAGINATION } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Universal empty state canvas presentation.
 * On root /chat without a conversation ID, displays the onboarding agent greeting.
 * While history is actively loading, suppresses the greeting and presents a centered loading indicator.
 * Decoupled from static chatId presence to avoid perpetual spinner traps on 404 or empty conversation threads.
 *
 * @component MuiChatEmptyState
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered empty state or loading indicator.
 */
export const MuiChatEmptyState = () => {
  const { chatId } = useParams();
  const { isLoading: isQueryLoading, isFetching: isQueryFetching } = useGetChatByIdQuery(
    { chatId, limit: CHAT_PAGINATION.MESSAGES_PAGE_SIZE },
    { skip: !chatId }
  );

  let isLoadingHistory;

  try {
    const status = useChatStatus();
    isLoadingHistory = Boolean(status?.isLoadingHistory);
  } catch {
    // Graceful fallback if rendered outside ChatProvider context in isolated test suites
    isLoadingHistory = false;
  }

  // Prevent flash of empty state greeting only while actively loading or fetching history
  if (isLoadingHistory || (chatId && (isQueryLoading || isQueryFetching))) {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          height: '100%',
          py: 8,
        }}
      >
        <CircularProgress size={28} />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        textAlign: 'center',
        py: { xs: 4, sm: 8 },
        px: 2,
        height: '100%',
        userSelect: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: 64,
          height: 64,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          bgcolor: 'action.hover',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          mb: 2.5,
          color: 'primary.main',
        }}
      >
        <SmartToyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />
      </Box>

      <Typography
        variant="h5"
        component="h1"
        sx={{
          fontWeight: 700,
          color: 'text.primary',
          mb: 1,
          letterSpacing: -0.5,
        }}
      >
        Your Personal AI Agent
      </Typography>

      <Typography
        variant="body2"
        sx={{
          color: 'text.secondary',
          maxWidth: 460,
          lineHeight: 1.6,
        }}
      >
        Ask anything, brainstorm ideas, analyze operational tasks, draft communications, or manage daily workflows.
      </Typography>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiChatEmptyState.displayName = 'MuiChatEmptyState';

export default MuiChatEmptyState;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiChatMessageListContent
 * @description Custom MessageListContent slot component providing:
 * 1. An accessible "Load earlier messages" affordance when hasMoreHistory is true,
 *    guaranteeing reverse pagination works even on short conversations that do not overflow the viewport.
 * 2. Visual loading indicator when history turns are being fetched.
 * 3. Default message items rendering with complete MUI X Chat styling preservation.
 */

import React from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import KeyboardArrowUpIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowUp';
import { styled } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { useChat } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';

const ChatListContentRoot = styled('div', {
  name: 'MuiChatMessageList',
  slot: 'content',
})({
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  display: 'flex',
  flexDirection: 'column',
  width: '100%',
  flex: '1 1 auto',
  minHeight: '100%',
  justifyContent: 'flex-end',
  gap: 'var(--ChatMessageList-gap, 0px)',
});

export const MuiChatMessageListContent = React.forwardRef(function MuiChatMessageListContent(props, ref) {
  const { children, className, ...other } = props;
  const { hasMoreHistory, isLoadingHistory, loadMoreHistory } = useChat();

  return (
    <ChatListContentRoot
      ref={ref}
      className={`MuiChatMessageList-content ${className || ''}`}
      {...other}
    >
      {hasMoreHistory && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            py: 1.5,
            width: '100%',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={
              isLoadingHistory ? (
                <CircularProgress size={13} color="inherit" />
              ) : (
                <KeyboardArrowUpIcon fontSize="small" />
              )
            }
            disabled={isLoadingHistory}
            onClick={() => {
              if (typeof loadMoreHistory === 'function') {
                loadMoreHistory();
              }
            }}
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.78rem',
              fontWeight: 500,
              textTransform: 'none',
              color: 'text.secondary',
              borderColor: 'divider',
              borderRadius: 4,
              px: 2,
              py: 0.35,
              bgcolor: 'background.paper',
              boxShadow: 1,
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                borderColor: 'text.secondary',
                color: 'text.primary',
              },
            }}
          >
            {isLoadingHistory ? 'Loading earlier messages...' : 'Load earlier messages'}
          </Button>
        </Box>
      )}
      {children}
    </ChatListContentRoot>
  );
});

MuiChatMessageListContent.displayName = 'MuiChatMessageListContent';

export default MuiChatMessageListContent;
