/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiCloudDocumentCard
 * @description Rich Cloud Document & Download Action Deck for AI Agent conversational messages.
 * Automatically inspects tool execution parts (create_cloud_document, generate_document_file,
 * manage_google_drive) and renders high-fidelity action cards with direct Google Drive links,
 * authenticated binary download buttons, and format badges (PDF, XLSX, DOCX, CSV, JSON).
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import PictureAsPdfIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PictureAsPdf';
import TableChartIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TableChart';
import DescriptionIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Description';
import ViewWeekIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewWeek';
import CodeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Code';
import ArticleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Article';
import DownloadIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Download';
import OpenInNewIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInNew';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Returns icon, theme color, and format label for a given document type or format.
 * @param {string} formatOrType
 * @returns {{ icon: import('react').ReactNode, color: string, label: string }}
 */
const getFormatMetadata = (formatOrType = '') => {
  const normalized = String(formatOrType).toLowerCase().trim();

  switch (normalized) {
    case 'pdf':
      return {
        icon: <PictureAsPdfIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#E53935',
        label: 'PDF Document',
      };
    case 'sheet':
    case 'gsheet':
      return {
        icon: <TableChartIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#2E7D32',
        label: 'Google Sheet',
      };
    case 'xlsx':
    case 'excel':
    case 'spreadsheet':
      return {
        icon: <TableChartIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#2E7D32',
        label: 'Excel Spreadsheet',
      };
    case 'doc':
    case 'gdoc':
      return {
        icon: <DescriptionIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#1976D2',
        label: 'Google Doc',
      };
    case 'docx':
    case 'word':
      return {
        icon: <DescriptionIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#1976D2',
        label: 'Word Document',
      };
    case 'csv':
      return {
        icon: <ViewWeekIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#ED6C02',
        label: 'CSV Data',
      };
    case 'json':
      return {
        icon: <CodeIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#546E7A',
        label: 'JSON Data',
      };
    case 'markdown':
    case 'md':
    case 'txt':
    default:
      return {
        icon: <ArticleIcon fontSize="small" />,
        color: '#607D8B',
        label: 'Document',
      };
  }
};

/**
 * Extracts all document items from tool parts.
 * @param {Array} toolParts
 * @returns {Array} List of document descriptor objects.
 */
const extractDocumentsFromToolParts = (toolParts = []) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(toolParts) || toolParts.length === 0) return [];

  const items = [];

  for (const part of toolParts) {
    const inv = part?.toolInvocation || part;
    if (!inv) continue;

    const rawOutput = inv.output !== undefined ? inv.output : inv.result;
    if (!rawOutput) continue;

    const out = rawOutput?.data !== undefined ? rawOutput.data : rawOutput;
    const toolName = inv.toolName || inv.name;
    const input = inv.input || inv.args || {};

    if (toolName === 'create_cloud_document' && (out.webViewLink || out.fileId)) {
      items.push({
        id: out.fileId || `doc_${items.length}`,
        title: out.title || input?.title || 'Cloud Document',
        format: out.type || 'doc',
        webViewLink: out.webViewLink,
        downloadUrl: null,
        fileSizeFormatted: null,
        detail: out.folder ? `In Google Drive / ${out.folder}` : 'Saved to Google Drive',
        isCloud: true,
      });
    } else if (toolName === 'generate_document_file' && (out.downloadUrl || out.webViewLink || out.fileId)) {
      items.push({
        id: out.fileId || `gen_${items.length}`,
        title: out.title || out.fileName || input?.title || 'Generated Document',
        format: out.format || 'pdf',
        webViewLink: out.webViewLink,
        downloadUrl: out.downloadUrl,
        fileSizeFormatted: out.fileSizeFormatted,
        detail: out.destination === 'both'
          ? 'Google Drive & Authenticated Download'
          : out.destination === 'google_drive'
            ? 'Saved to Google Drive'
            : 'Ready for Download',
        isCloud: Boolean(out.webViewLink),
      });
    } else if (toolName === 'manage_google_drive' && out.action === 'create_folder' && out.webViewLink) {
      items.push({
        id: out.folderId || `folder_${items.length}`,
        title: out.name || 'Personal AI Agent Folder',
        format: 'folder',
        webViewLink: out.webViewLink,
        downloadUrl: null,
        fileSizeFormatted: null,
        detail: 'Google Drive Directory',
        isCloud: true,
      });
    }
  }

  return items;
};

/**
 * Rich Cloud Document & Download Action Deck.
 *
 * @component MuiCloudDocumentCard
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {Array} props.toolParts - Autonomous tool execution parts from the message.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered document card deck or null.
 */
export const MuiCloudDocumentCard = ({ toolParts = [] }) => {
  const [downloadingId, setDownloadingId] = useState(null);

  const documentItems = extractDocumentsFromToolParts(toolParts);

  if (documentItems.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Performs authenticated file download without page reload.
   */
  const handleDownload = async (item) => {
    if (!item.downloadUrl && !item.id) return;
    try {
      setDownloadingId(item.id);
      const rawUrl = item.downloadUrl || `/api/v1/chat/downloads/${item.id}`;
      // In dev/prod, if rawUrl is relative, fetch from origin with credentials
      const response = await fetch(rawUrl, {
        credentials: 'include',
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Download failed with status ${response.status}`);
      }

      const blob = await response.blob();
      const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const anchor = document.createElement('a');
      anchor.href = blobUrl;
      anchor.download = item.title ? (item.title.includes('.') ? item.title : `${item.title}.${item.format}`) : 'document';
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
      anchor.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
      toast.success('Document downloaded successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(`Download failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setDownloadingId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      className="MuiCloudDocumentCard-deck"
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 1.25,
        my: 1.5,
      }}
    >
      {documentItems.map((item) => {
        const meta = getFormatMetadata(item.format);
        const isDownloading = downloadingId === item.id;

        return (
          <Card
            key={item.id}
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              borderRadius: '10px',
              border: 1,
              borderColor: 'divider',
              bgcolor: (theme) =>
                theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)' : 'background.paper',
              p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 },
              boxShadow: 'none',
              transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease',
              '&:hover': {
                borderColor: meta.color,
                boxShadow: (theme) =>
                  `0 2px 8px ${theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'}`,
              },
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                gap: 1.5,
              }}
            >
              {/* Left: Icon, Format Badge & Title Metadata */}
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    width: 40,
                    height: 40,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    bgcolor: (theme) =>
                      theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                        ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'
                        : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
                    color: meta.color,
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {meta.icon}
                </Box>

                <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap', mb: 0.25 }}>
                    <Typography
                      variant="subtitle2"
                      sx={{
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        fontSize: '0.875rem',
                        color: 'text.primary',
                        lineHeight: 1.2,
                      }}
                      noWrap
                    >
                      {item.title}
                    </Typography>

                    <Chip
                      label={meta.label}
                      size="small"
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.675rem',
                        height: 20,
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        bgcolor: (theme) =>
                          theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                            ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
                            : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)',
                        color: meta.color,
                      }}
                    />
                  </Box>

                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    {item.detail && (
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                        {item.detail}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                    {item.fileSizeFormatted && (
                      <>
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
                          •
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                          {item.fileSizeFormatted}
                        </Typography>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              </Box>

              {/* Right: Interactive Action Buttons */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 1,
                  alignSelf: { xs: 'flex-end', sm: 'center' },
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                {/* Google Drive / Web Link Action */}
                {item.webViewLink && (
                  <MuiButton
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    component="a"
                    href={item.webViewLink}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    startIcon={<OpenInNewIcon fontSize="small" />}
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      py: 0.5,
                      px: 1.25,
                      borderColor: meta.color,
                      color: meta.color,
                      '&:hover': {
                        borderColor: meta.color,
                        bgcolor: (theme) =>
                          theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                            ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'
                            : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
                      },
                    }}
                  >
                    Open in Drive
                  </MuiButton>
                )}

                {/* Authenticated Download Action */}
                {(item.downloadUrl || (!item.webViewLink && item.id)) && (
                  <MuiButton
                    variant="contained"
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    startIcon={
                      isDownloading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <DownloadIcon fontSize="small" />

                    onClick={() => handleDownload(item)}
                    disabled={isDownloading}
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      py: 0.5,
                      px: 1.25,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  >
                    Download
                  </MuiButton>
                )}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiCloudDocumentCard.propTypes = {

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiComposerBottomToolbar
 * @description Ergonomic bottom toolbar for the chat composer (Row 3).
 * Dual-cluster layout:
 * - Left Cluster: MuiAttachButton (and in subsequent steps: Model Selector)
 * - Right Cluster: MuiSendButton (and in subsequent steps: Audio Recorder)
 */

import { forwardRef, useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import MuiSendButton from './MuiSendButton.jsx';
import MuiAttachButton from './MuiAttachButton.jsx';
import MuiAudioRecorder from './MuiAudioRecorder.jsx';
import MuiLiveSttButton from './MuiLiveSttButton.jsx';
import MuiModelSelector from './MuiModelSelector.jsx';

/**
 * MuiComposerBottomToolbar component.
 */
export const MuiComposerBottomToolbar = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const [isLiveSttActive, setIsLiveSttActive] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Box
      ref={ref}
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        width: '100%',
        pt: 0.5,
        px: 0.5,
      }}
    >
      {/* Left Cluster: Attachments & Inference Settings */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <MuiAttachButton disabled={props?.disabled} />
        <MuiModelSelector disabled={props?.disabled} />
      </Box>

      {/* Right Cluster: Audio Dictation, Live STT & Send / Stop Actions */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: isLiveSttActive ? 'none' : 'inline-flex' }}>
          <MuiAudioRecorder disabled={props?.disabled} />
        </Box>
        <MuiLiveSttButton
          disabled={props?.disabled}
          onActiveChange={setIsLiveSttActive}
        />
        <MuiSendButton disabled={props?.disabled} />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiComposerBottomToolbar.displayName = 'MuiComposerBottomToolbar';

export default MuiComposerBottomToolbar;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiComposerInput
 * @description Zero-lag auto-resizing input for MUI X Chat composer powered by InputBase
 * and decoupled from store notification cascades during active typing.
 * Wrapped in React.forwardRef and integrated with react-hook-form using register.
 *
 * Performance Architecture (Zero Keystroke Lag):
 * 1. Monolithic Store Decoupling: In @mui/x-chat, all messages in the thread subscribe
 *    to the central store via useStore. Calling composer.setValue on every keystroke forces
 *    store.setState to loop over all 70-100+ listeners, triggering selector evaluation
 *    waterfalls across the entire chat tree.
 * 2. Uncontrolled DOM Buffer: Operates via an uncontrolled textarea registered with react-hook-form.
 *    Typing within non-empty text executes with 0 store calls and 0 selector re-evaluations,
 *    achieving true 0ms typing response regardless of how many messages are in the conversation.
 * 3. Boolean State Transition: Only notifies store on empty <-> non-empty transitions to toggle
 *    MuiSendButton enablement (hasValue: true / false).
 * 4. Synchronous Pre-Submit Flush: On Enter press or Send button click, the actual DOM text
 *    is synchronously flushed to store.setComposerValue immediately before composer.submit().
 * 5. InputBase multiline Engine: Backed by TextareaAutosize shadow-clone sizing with 0 reflows
 *    when typing on the same line.
 * 6. Hover-Only Vertical Scrollbar: Scrollbar thumb stays 100% transparent during idle drafting,
 *    revealing smoothly strictly on container hover, focus, or active interaction.
 * 7. Tier 2 User Maximization: Top-right toggle (OpenInFull / CloseFullscreen) expands to 50vh canvas
 *    with auto-collapse on message submit.
 * 8. IME Composition Safety: Full Ge'ez synthesis protection against premature Enter send.
 */

import React, { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import InputBase from '@mui/material/InputBase';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import useForkRef from '@mui/utils/useForkRef';
import OpenInFullIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInFull';
import CloseFullscreenIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloseFullscreen';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useChatComposer, useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { getPendingUploadCount } from '../../utils/attachmentRegistry.js';

/**
 * MuiComposerInput component.
 * @param {object} props - Component props passed from ChatBox / ChatComposer slot.
 * @param {React.Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>} ref - Forwarded ref from slot binding.
 * @returns {React.ReactElement}
 */
export const MuiComposerInput = React.forwardRef(function MuiComposerInput(props, ref) {
  const composer = useChatComposer();
  const status = useChatStatus();

  // Internal DOM and lifecycle references
  const textareaRef = useRef(null);
  const isComposingRef = useRef(false);
  const hasTextRef = useRef(Boolean(composer?.value && composer.value.trim().length > 0));
  const lastSyncedComposerValueRef = useRef(composer?.value || '');

  // React Hook Form integration using register (uncontrolled, zero-lag)
  const { register, reset } = useForm({
    defaultValues: {
      messageText: composer?.value || '',
    },
  });
  const { ref: formRef, onChange: formOnChange, name } = register('messageText');

  // Fork forwarded ref, internal textarea ref, and react-hook-form ref
  const forkedRef1 = useForkRef(ref, textareaRef);
  const handleRef = useForkRef(forkedRef1, formRef);

  // Tier 2: User Maximization state (up to 50vh canvas)
  const [isMaximized, setIsMaximized] = useState(false);

  const handleToggleMaximize = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMaximized((prev) => !prev);
    // Preserve focus and caret position at the end of existing drafted text
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const el = textareaRef.current;
      if (el) {
        el.focus();
        const len = el.value.length;
        el.setSelectionRange(len, len);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  // Sync strictly when composer.value changes externally (e.g. post-submit store clear, or voice STT injection).
  // Notice: isMaximized is NEVER a dependency here, guaranteeing expand/collapse never mutates or wipes drafted text.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const storeVal = composer?.value || '';

    // If composer.value did not change from what was last seen/synced, do nothing
    if (storeVal === lastSyncedComposerValueRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    lastSyncedComposerValueRef.current = storeVal;

    if (storeVal === '') {
      // Store cleared (e.g. post-submission): clear DOM input and reset form state
      if (textareaRef.current) {
        textareaRef.current.value = '';
      }
      reset({ messageText: '' });
      hasTextRef.current = false;
      setIsMaximized(false);
    } else if (storeVal !== ' ') {
      // Genuine external text injection (e.g. voice STT dictation or starter prompt chips)
      if (textareaRef.current) {
        textareaRef.current.value = storeVal;
      }
      reset({ messageText: storeVal });
      hasTextRef.current = true;
    }
  }, [composer?.value, reset]);

  // Keystroke handler decoupled from store listener broadcast waterfall
  const handleChange = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      // 1. Run React Hook Form change handler
      formOnChange(e);

      const val = e.target.value;
      const hasTextNow = Boolean(val && val.trim().length > 0);
      const hadTextBefore = hasTextRef.current;

      // 2. Only notify store when transitioning between empty and non-empty (to enable/disable Send button)
      if (!hadTextBefore && hasTextNow) {
        hasTextRef.current = true;
        lastSyncedComposerValueRef.current = val;
        if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
          composer.setValue(val);
        }
      } else if (hadTextBefore && !hasTextNow) {
        hasTextRef.current = false;
        lastSyncedComposerValueRef.current = '';
        if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
          composer.setValue('');
        }
      }
      // While typing within non-empty text: ZERO STORE UPDATES.
      // Eliminates React 19 store broadcasts to the message list.
    },
    [formOnChange, composer]
  );

  // Key down handler: plain Enter creates a newline naturally; Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter submits
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      const isUploading = getPendingUploadCount() > 0;
      const isKeyboardSubmit =
        (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) &&
        e.key === 'Enter' &&
        !e.nativeEvent.isComposing &&
        !isComposingRef.current &&
        !status?.isStreaming &&
        !isUploading &&
        !composer?.disabled &&
        !props.disabled;

      if (isKeyboardSubmit) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const currentVal = textareaRef.current?.value || '';
        const hasAttachments = Boolean(composer?.attachments && composer.attachments.length > 0);
        if (currentVal.trim().length > 0 || hasAttachments) {
          // Synchronously flush full text to store right before submission
          lastSyncedComposerValueRef.current = currentVal;
          if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
            composer.setValue(currentVal);
          }
          void composer.submit();

          // Immediately clear local input to guarantee instantaneous feedback
          if (textareaRef.current) {
            textareaRef.current.value = '';
          }
          reset({ messageText: '' });
          hasTextRef.current = false;
          setIsMaximized(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [composer, status?.isStreaming, props.disabled, reset]
  );

  const handleCompositionStart = useCallback(() => {
    isComposingRef.current = true;
  }, []);

  const handleCompositionEnd = useCallback(() => {
    isComposingRef.current = false;
  }, []);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        transition: 'none !important',
        animation: 'none !important',
      }}
    >
      <InputBase
        multiline
        minRows={isMaximized ? 10 : 3}
        maxRows={isMaximized ? 20 : 8}
        inputRef={handleRef}
        name={name}
        defaultValue=""
        placeholder={props.placeholder || 'Type an operational message, report notes, or question...'}
        disabled={Boolean(props.disabled || composer?.disabled)}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onCompositionStart={handleCompositionStart}
        onCompositionEnd={handleCompositionEnd}
        fullWidth
        sx={{
          width: '100%',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          p: 0,
          transition: 'none !important',
          animation: 'none !important',
          minHeight: isMaximized ? '220px' : '40px',
          maxHeight: isMaximized ? '50vh' : '200px',
          '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            py: 0.75,
            pl: 0.5,
            pr: 4.5, // Clearance for top-right expand/collapse toggle
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: '0.9375rem',
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            color: 'text.primary',
            resize: 'none',
            overflowY: 'auto !important',
            maxHeight: isMaximized ? 'calc(50vh - 20px)' : '185px',
            transition: 'none !important',
            animation: 'none !important',
            // Hover-Only Vertical Scrollbar Invariant
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
            scrollbarColor: 'transparent transparent',
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': {
              width: '6px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-track': {
              background: 'transparent',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::placeholder': {
              color: 'text.disabled',
              opacity: 1,
            },
          },
          // Revealing scrollbar strictly on container hover, focus, or active interaction
          '&:hover .MuiInputBase-input, & .MuiInputBase-input:focus, & .MuiInputBase-input:active': {
            scrollbarColor: (theme) => `${theme.palette.divider} transparent`,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              backgroundColor: (theme) => theme.palette.divider,
            },
          },
        }}
      />

      {/* Expand / Collapse Affordance Icon */}
      <Tooltip title={isMaximized ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'} arrow>
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          aria-label={isMaximized ? 'Collapse composer' : 'Expand composer'}
          onClick={handleToggleMaximize}
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 4,
            right: 4,
            p: 0.5,
            color: 'text.secondary',
            opacity: 0.65,
            transition: 'none !important',
            animation: 'none !important',
            '&:hover': {
              opacity: 1,
              color: 'text.primary',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
            },
          }}
        >
          {isMaximized ? (
            <CloseFullscreenIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
          ) : (
            <OpenInFullIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
          )}
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiComposerInput.displayName = 'MuiComposerInput';

export default React.memo(MuiComposerInput);

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiComposerTopToolbar
 * @description Horizontal scroll preview bar for pending chat composer attachments (Row 1).
 * Serves as the ChatComposerAttachmentList slot override.
 * Invariant: Renders strictly null (0 height, 0 margin) when attachments are empty.
 * When attachments are present, renders a single-row flex container with horizontal scrolling,
 * displaying file thumbnails/type badges, truncated filenames, sizes, and dismiss buttons.
 */

import { forwardRef } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import AudioFileIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AudioFile';
import InsertDriveFileIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InsertDriveFile';
import { useChatComposer } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { getUploadState, removeUpload, usePendingUploadCount } from '../../utils/attachmentRegistry.js';
import { formatBytesToMb } from '../../utils/validateChatAttachment.js';
import { ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS, AUDIO_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Checks if a file represents an audio recording or note.
 * Uses centralized AUDIO_CONSTANTS from utils/constants.js.
 * @param {File} file
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
const isAudioAttachment = (file) => {
  if (!file) return false;
  if (file.type && AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.includes(file.type.toLowerCase())) {
    return true;
  }
  const name = (file.name || '').toLowerCase();
  return AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => name.endsWith(ext));
};

/**
 * Checks if a file represents an image inspection asset.
 * Uses centralized ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS from utils/constants.js.
 * @param {File} file
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
const isImageAttachment = (file) => {
  if (!file) return false;
  if (file.type && ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_IMAGE_MIME_TYPES.includes(file.type.toLowerCase())) {
    return true;
  }
  const name = (file.name || '').toLowerCase();
  return ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => name.endsWith(ext));
};

/**
 * MuiComposerTopToolbar component.
 */
export const MuiComposerTopToolbar = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const composer = useChatComposer();
  const [deleteComposerAttachment] = useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation();
  usePendingUploadCount();
  const attachments = composer?.attachments || [];

  // Zero Attachment Invariant: Collapse completely when no files are pending
  if (attachments.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Box
      ref={ref}
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 1,
        px: 1,
        py: 0.75,
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        overflowX: 'auto',
        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        borderBottom: '1px solid',
        borderColor: 'divider',
        scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
        '&::-webkit-scrollbar': {
          height: 4,
        },
        '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: 'divider',
        },
      }}
    >
      {attachments.map((attachment) => {
        const file = attachment.file;
        const fileName = file?.name || 'File';
        const fileSize = file?.size || 0;
        const isImage = isImageAttachment(file);
        const isAudio = isAudioAttachment(file);
        const uploadState = getUploadState(file);

        return (
          <Box
            key={attachment.localId}
            sx={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 1,
              px: 1,
              py: 0.5,
              borderRadius: 2,
              border: '1px solid',
              borderColor: 'divider',
              bgcolor: 'background.paper',
              maxWidth: 220,
              flexShrink: 0,
              boxShadow: 'none',
              transition: 'none !important',
            }}
          >
            {/* Visual Icon / Thumbnail with Progress Ring */}
            <Box sx={{ position: 'relative', width: 28, height: 28, flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {isImage && attachment.previewUrl ? (
                <Box
                  component="img"
                  src={attachment.previewUrl}
                  alt={fileName}
                  sx={{
                    width: 28,
                    height: 28,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    objectFit: 'cover',
                    display: 'block',
                  }}
                />
              ) : isAudio ? (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: 28,
                    height: 28,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    bgcolor: 'primary.main',
                    color: 'primary.contrastText',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                >
                  <AudioFileIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                </Box>
              ) : (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: 28,
                    height: 28,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    bgcolor: 'action.selected',
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                >
                  <InsertDriveFileIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                </Box>
              )}

              {/* Consumer-Grade Inline Upload Progress Ring */}
              {(attachment.isUploading === true || uploadState.isUploading === true || (typeof attachment.uploadProgress === 'number' && attachment.uploadProgress < 100)) && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: 0,
                    left: 0,
                    width: '100%',
                    height: '100%',
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    bgcolor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                >
                  <CircularProgress
                    size={16}
                    thickness={5}
                    variant={typeof attachment.uploadProgress === 'number' ? 'determinate' : 'indeterminate'}
                    value={typeof attachment.uploadProgress === 'number' ? attachment.uploadProgress : undefined}
                    sx={{ color: '#fff' }}
                  />
                </Box>
              )}
            </Box>

            {/* Truncated File Name & Formatted Size */}
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  display: 'block',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  maxWidth: 120,
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  lineHeight: 1.2,
                }}
              >
                {fileName}
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{
                  color: 'text.secondary',
                  display: 'block',
                  fontSize: '0.65rem',
                  lineHeight: 1.1,
                }}
              >
                {formatBytesToMb(fileSize)}
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            {/* Individual Dismiss Button */}
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              aria-label={`Remove attachment ${fileName}`}
              onClick={() => {
                const uploadResult = removeUpload(file);
                const publicId = uploadResult?.publicId || attachment.publicId;
                const targetFileName = uploadResult?.fileName || attachment.fileName;
                const wasUploading = uploadResult?.wasUploading ?? uploadState.isUploading;

                if (!wasUploading && (publicId || targetFileName)) {
                  void deleteComposerAttachment({
                    publicId,
                    mimeType: uploadResult?.mimeType || file?.type,
                    fileName: targetFileName,
                  });
                }
                if (typeof composer?.removeAttachment === 'function') {
                  composer.removeAttachment(attachment.localId);
                }
              }}
              sx={{
                p: 0.25,
                ml: 0.25,
                color: 'text.disabled',
                '&:hover': {
                  color: 'text.primary',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                },
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
        );
      })}
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiComposerTopToolbar.displayName = 'MuiComposerTopToolbar';

export default MuiComposerTopToolbar;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiErrorNotice
 * @description Universal error notice and recovery strip for failed agent turns.
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - Normalized empathetic error translation (plain English, zero raw database connection strings).
 * - Backend failover loop awareness (indicating when all 5 backend attempts were exhausted).
 * - User recovery affordance: [Retry Turn] executing linear history pruning.
 * - Dynamic unexhausted model chips for quota exhaustion scenarios.
 * - Preserves partial stream tokens on mid-stream socket interruptions.
 */

import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeOutlined';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { AI_MODELS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Normalizes raw network, database, or LLM error strings into empathetic plain English.
 * @param {string|object|Error} rawError
 * @returns {string} Human-friendly translated message.
 */
const normalizeErrorMessage = (rawError) => {
  const msg = String(rawError?.message || (typeof rawError === 'string' ? rawError : JSON.stringify(rawError || '')));
  const code = String(rawError?.code || rawError?.errorCode || '');

  // 1. Google Gemini API Key
  if (
    msg.includes('API_KEY_INVALID') ||
    msg.includes('API key not valid') ||
    msg.includes('invalid api key') ||
    msg.includes('API_KEY_SERVICE_BLOCKED') ||
    msg.includes('MISSING_GEMINI_KEY') ||
    code === 'MISSING_GEMINI_KEY'
  ) {
    return 'Your Google Gemini API key appears to be invalid or unconfigured. Please update your API key in Profile > AI Agent Settings.';
  }

  // 2. Addis AI API Key
  if (
    msg.includes('ADDIS_API_KEY') ||
    msg.includes('Addis AI key') ||
    msg.includes('addisassistant.com')
  ) {
    return 'Your Addis AI key appears to be invalid or unconfigured. Please update your Addis AI key in Profile > AI Agent Settings.';
  }

  // 3. Permission Denied
  if (msg.includes('PERMISSION_DENIED') || msg.includes('permission denied')) {
    return 'Access was denied for your API key. Please check your project permissions in Google AI Studio.';
  }

  // 4. Model Quota & Rate Limit (All Fallbacks Exhausted)
  if (
    msg.includes('429') ||
    msg.includes('RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED') ||
    msg.includes('quota') ||
    code === '429'
  ) {
    return 'All available AI models have temporarily reached their hourly quota limit. You can switch to an alternative model below or retry in a few moments.';
  }

  // 5. Database & Network DNS Connectivity
  if (
    msg.includes('getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND') ||
    msg.includes('MongoServerSelectionError') ||
    msg.includes('ECONNREFUSED')
  ) {
    return 'Database connection is temporarily unreachable. Please verify network connectivity or retry shortly.';
  }

  // 6. Socket / Mid-Stream Disconnection
  if (
    msg.includes('ECONNRESET') ||
    msg.includes('socket hang up') ||
    msg.includes('fetch failed') ||
    msg.includes('DEADLINE_EXCEEDED') ||
    msg.includes('ETIMEDOUT')
  ) {
    return 'The network connection was interrupted during streaming. Partial response has been preserved.';
  }

  // 7. Authentication / Session Expiration
  if (
    msg.includes('401') ||
    msg.includes('token') ||
    msg.includes('Unauthorized') ||
    msg.includes('UNAUTHENTICATED')
  ) {
    return 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.';
  }

  // 8. Upstream Service Unavailable
  if (
    msg.includes('503') ||
    msg.includes('Service Unavailable') ||
    msg.includes('overloaded')
  ) {
    return 'The AI service is currently experiencing high demand across all fallback models. Please retry in a few moments.';
  }

  // 9. Unsupported Media
  if (msg.includes('UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA') || msg.includes('unsupported file type')) {
    return 'The uploaded file format could not be processed. Please upload supported images, PDFs, DOCX, TXT, or MP3/WAV/WebM audio.';
  }

  // 10. Generic Fallback
  return msg.length > 120 || msg.includes('at ') || msg.includes('Error:')
    ? 'An unexpected service error occurred while processing your request. Please try again.'
    : msg || 'Generation failed.';
};

/**
 * User-friendly label for model chip.
 * @param {string} modelId
 * @returns {string} Clean label.
 */
const getModelChipLabel = (modelId) => {
  if (modelId.includes('flash-lite')) return 'Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite';
  if (modelId.includes('flash')) return 'Gemini 2.5 Flash';
  if (modelId.includes('pro')) return 'Gemini 2.5 Pro';
  return modelId;
};

/**
 * Empathetic error recovery component.
 *
 * @component MuiErrorNotice
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string|object} props.error - Raw error message or error descriptor.
 * @param {Function} [props.onRetry] - Retry callback triggering linear pruning.
 * @param {string} [props.failedModel] - The model identifier that failed.
 * @param {Function} [props.onSelectModel] - Callback to switch model and retry.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isPartial=false] - Whether partial response was preserved before failure.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered error notice.
 */
export const MuiErrorNotice = ({
  error,
  onRetry,
  failedModel,
  onSelectModel,
  isPartial = false,
}) => {
  const friendlyMessage = normalizeErrorMessage(error);
  const rawString = String(error?.message || error || '');
  const isQuota =
    rawString.includes('429') ||
    rawString.includes('RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED') ||
    rawString.includes('quota');

  const unexhaustedModels = Array.isArray(AI_MODELS?.SUPPORTED)
    ? AI_MODELS.SUPPORTED.filter((m) => m !== failedModel)
    : [];

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: (theme) =>
          isQuota
            ? alpha(theme.palette.warning.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.35 : 0.25)
            : alpha(theme.palette.error.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.35 : 0.25),
        borderRadius: '12px',
        p: 1.5,
        my: 1,
        bgcolor: (theme) =>
          isQuota
            ? alpha(theme.palette.warning.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.12 : 0.05)
            : alpha(theme.palette.error.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.12 : 0.05),
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 1.25,
      }}
    >
      {/* Primary error message row */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
        <WarningAmberIcon
          sx={{
            color: isQuota ? 'warning.main' : 'error.main',
            fontSize: 20,
            mt: 0.2,
          }}
        />
        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.875rem',
              lineHeight: 1.5,
              color: 'text.primary',
              fontWeight: 500,
            }}
          >
            {isPartial ? 'Streaming interrupted' : 'Failed to respond'}
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              lineHeight: 1.5,
              color: 'text.secondary',
              mt: 0.25,
            }}
          >
            {friendlyMessage}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Alternative model chips if quota limit reached */}
      {isQuota && unexhaustedModels.length > 0 && typeof onSelectModel === 'function' && (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap', mt: 0.5 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
            Try alternative model:
          </Typography>
          {unexhaustedModels.map((modelId) => (
            <Chip
              key={modelId}
              size="small"
              icon={<AutoAwesomeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />}
              label={getModelChipLabel(modelId)}
              onClick={() => onSelectModel(modelId)}
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                bgcolor: 'transparent',
                borderColor: 'divider',
                '&:hover': {
                  borderColor: 'primary.main',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                },
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* User Recovery Action Row */}
      {typeof onRetry === 'function' && (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 1, mt: 0.5 }}>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={onRetry}
            startIcon={<ReplayIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
            sx={{
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              py: 0.4,
              px: 1.5,
              borderRadius: '8px',
              color: 'text.primary',
              borderColor: 'divider',
              bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              '&:hover': {
                borderColor: 'primary.main',
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              },
            }}
          >
            {isPartial ? 'Retry from here' : 'Retry Turn'}
          </Button>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiErrorNotice.propTypes = {
  error: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.object]),
  onRetry: PropTypes.func,
  failedModel: PropTypes.string,
  onSelectModel: PropTypes.func,
  isPartial: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default MuiErrorNotice;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiLiveSttButton
 * @description Decoupled, reusable Live Speech-to-Text (STT) button powered by Addis AI Scribe.
 * When idle, sits side-by-side with the microphone button.
 * When activated, hides the mic and renders an exact visual twin HUD matching MuiAudioRecorder:
 * - Identical container styling, border, and responsive dimensions
 * - Discard button (DeleteOutlineIcon, color: error)
 * - Pulsing live indicator dot + monospace duration timer
 * - Real-time acoustic frequency visualizer bars scaling with voice audioLevel
 * - Finish checkmark button (CheckIcon, color: primary)
 *
 * Agnostic of chat - can be used anywhere in the application.
 */

import { forwardRef, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import GraphicEqIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GraphicEq';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import DeleteOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { useChatComposer, useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { useAddisLiveStt } from '../../hooks/useAddisLiveStt.js';
import { selectLanguage } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';

export const MuiLiveSttButton = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const {
    onTranscript: customOnTranscript,
    onActiveChange,
    disabled = false,
    size = 'small',
    sx = {},
  } = props;

  const composer = useChatComposer();
  const { isStreaming } = useChatStatus();
  const defaultLanguage = useSelector(selectLanguage);

  const baseTextRef = useRef('');

  // Handle live incoming transcripts
  const handleTranscript = useCallback(
    ({ partial, final, text, isFinal }) => {
      if (typeof customOnTranscript === 'function') {
        customOnTranscript({ partial, final, text, isFinal });
        return;
      }

      const base = baseTextRef.current || '';
      const incoming = (final || partial || text || '').trim();
      if (!incoming) return;

      const combined = base.trim() ? `${base.trim()} ${incoming}` : incoming;

      if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
        composer.setValue(combined);
      }

      const textarea = document.querySelector('textarea[name="chat-prompt-input"]');
      if (textarea) {
        textarea.value = combined;
        textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      }

      if (isFinal) {
        baseTextRef.current = combined;
      }
    },
    [composer, customOnTranscript]
  );

  const handleError = useCallback((err) => {
    toast.error(err?.message || 'Addis AI Live STT error.');
  }, []);

  const {
    isListening,
    isConnecting,
    formattedDuration,
    audioLevel,
    startListening,
    stopListening,
    cancelListening,
  } = useAddisLiveStt({
    onTranscript: handleTranscript,
    onError: handleError,
    language: defaultLanguage || 'am',
  });

  // Notify parent toolbar to hide/show the mic button
  useEffect(() => {
    onActiveChange?.(isListening || isConnecting);
  }, [isListening, isConnecting, onActiveChange]);

  const handleStart = useCallback(() => {
    baseTextRef.current = composer?.value || '';
    startListening();
  }, [composer, startListening]);

  const handleStop = useCallback(() => {
    stopListening();
    toast.success('Live transcription complete.');
  }, [stopListening]);

  const handleDiscard = useCallback(() => {
    cancelListening();
    if (typeof composer?.setValue === 'function') {
      composer.setValue(baseTextRef.current || '');
    }
  }, [cancelListening, composer]);

  const isButtonDisabled = Boolean(
    disabled || isStreaming || composer?.isSubmitting
  );

  // State 1: Active Connecting State
  if (isConnecting) {
    return (
      <Box
        ref={ref}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 0.75,
          px: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.25 },
          py: 0.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          maxWidth: { xs: 130, sm: 220 },
          flexShrink: 0,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          ...sx,
        }}
      >
        <CircularProgress size={16} sx={{ color: 'primary.main', flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline' },
            fontSize: '0.75rem',
            color: 'text.secondary',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          Connecting...
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // State 2: Active Listening Recording HUD (Exact Visual Twin of MuiAudioRecorder)
  if (isListening) {
    return (
      <Box
        ref={ref}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 0.75 },
          px: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.25 },
          py: 0.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          maxWidth: { xs: 130, sm: 220 },
          flexShrink: 0,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          ...sx,
        }}
      >
        {/* Discard button */}
        <Tooltip title="Discard live dictation">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={handleDiscard}
            color="error"
            aria-label="Discard live dictation"
            sx={{ p: 0.25 }}
          >
            <DeleteOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>

        {/* Pulsing indicator + Duration timer */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 8,
              height: 8,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              bgcolor: 'error.main',
              flexShrink: 0,
              animation: 'audioPulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out',
              '@keyframes audioPulse': {
                '0%': { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(1)' },
                '50%': { opacity: 0.3, transform: 'scale(0.8)' },
                '100%': { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(1)' },
              },
            }}
          />
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              color: 'text.primary',
              letterSpacing: '0.02em',
            }}
          >
            {formattedDuration}
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Real-time acoustic frequency visualizer bars */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'flex' },
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '2px',
            height: 16,
            px: 0.25,
          }}
        >
          {[0.6, 1.0, 0.4].map((multiplier, idx) => {
            const barHeight = Math.max(
              3,
              Math.min(14, Math.round(audioLevel * 14 * multiplier + 3))
            );
            return (
              <Box
                key={idx}
                sx={{
                  width: 2.5,
                  height: `${barHeight}px`,
                  bgcolor: 'error.main',
                  borderRadius: 0.5,
                  transition: 'height 80ms ease',
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Box>

        {/* Stop and finish checkmark button */}
        <Tooltip title="Finish live dictation">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={handleStop}
            color="primary"
            aria-label="Finish live dictation"
            sx={{
              p: 0.25,
              bgcolor: (theme) =>
                theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                  ? 'rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.2)'
                  : 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.12)',
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: (theme) =>
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? 'rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.35)'
                    : 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.22)',
              },
            }}
          >
            <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // State 3: Idle Live STT Waveform Button
  return (
    <Tooltip title="Live Speech-to-Text (Addis AI)" arrow>
      <span>
        <IconButton
          ref={ref}
          size={size}
          onClick={handleStart}
          disabled={isButtonDisabled}
          color="inherit"
          aria-label="Live Speech-to-Text"
          sx={{
            p: 0.5,
            color: 'text.secondary',
            '&:hover': {
              color: 'text.primary',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
            },
            '&:disabled': {
              color: 'text.disabled',
            },
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          <GraphicEqIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
        </IconButton>
      </span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
});

MuiLiveSttButton.displayName = 'MuiLiveSttButton';

MuiLiveSttButton.propTypes = {
  onTranscript: PropTypes.func,
  onActiveChange: PropTypes.func,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium', 'large']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiLiveSttButton;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiMessageContent
 * @description Slot dispatcher mounted for messageContent in ChatBox.
 * Inspects message role via useMessageContext:
 * - If role === 'user', delegates to MuiUserMessage (Task 8.10 3-row neutral outlined Paper card).
 * - If role === 'assistant', delegates to native ChatMessageContent (preserving all streaming markdown & parts for Task 8.11).
 */

import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import { useMessageContext } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import MuiAgentMessage from './MuiAgentMessage.jsx';
import MuiUserMessage from './MuiUserMessage.jsx';

/**
 * Message content slot dispatcher.
 *
 * @component MuiMessageContent
 * @param {object} props - Props forwarded by MUI X Chat.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered user or assistant message content.
 */
export const MuiMessageContent = () => {
  const context = useMessageContext();
  const isUser = context.role === 'user' || context.isOwnMessage === true;

  if (isUser) {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          gridArea: 'content',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'flex-end',
          width: '100%',
          minWidth: 0,
        }}
      >
        <MuiUserMessage messageId={context.messageId} />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        gridArea: 'content',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        width: '100%',
        minWidth: 0,
      }}
    >
      <MuiAgentMessage messageId={context.messageId} />
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiMessageContent.propTypes = {
  afterContent: PropTypes.node,
};

export default MuiMessageContent;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiModelSelector
 * @description Ergonomic, accessible, zero-lag model selector & inference governance surface
 * for the chat composer (Row 3 Left Cluster).
 *
 * Core Architectural Invariants:
 * 1. Two-Tier Persistent Default Governance:
 *    - Tier 1 (Account Level): Dispatches PATCH /api/v1/users/agent-config saving defaultModel,
 *      defaultThinkingBudget, defaultLanguage, and sttEngine to MongoDB User.settings.
 *    - Tier 2 (Session Level): If in an active conversation (chatId), dispatches PATCH /api/v1/chat/:chatId/config.
 * 2. Zero Keystroke Lag:
 *    - Wrapped in React.memo with shallow prop checks.
 *    - Does NOT subscribe to useChatComposer() or composer.value.
 *    - Local popover anchorEl state prevents composer input re-renders.
 * 3. Flush Horizontal Docking Geometry (sm+):
 *    - On sm+, docks horizontally matching the exact width of the composer root (maxWidth: 760px).
 *    - No bottom border radius (borderRadius: '16px 16px 0 0'), sitting flush atop the composer sheet.
 *    - 100% invisible scrollbars on both Popover and SwipeableDrawer (scrollbarWidth: 'none', webkit display: 'none').
 *    - Horizontal multi-column layout for model cards, STT engines, and language controls.
 * 4. Boundary & Schema Safety:
 *    - Strictly bounds thinkingBudget to [0, 8192] tokens matching Mongoose schema.
 *    - Disabled during active SSE streaming (isStreaming) or voice recording.
 * 5. React 19 Parity:
 *    - Explicit displayName assigned, zero propTypes.
 */

import React, { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Popover from '@mui/material/Popover';
import SwipeableDrawer from '@mui/material/SwipeableDrawer';
import Slider from '@mui/material/Slider';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Checkbox from '@mui/material/Checkbox';
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme, alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import BoltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Bolt';
import PsychologyIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Psychology';
import ScienceIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Science';
import KeyboardArrowDownIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowDown';
import KeyboardArrowUpIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowUp';
import RestartAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestartAlt';
import CheckCircleRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleRounded';
import RadioButtonUncheckedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RadioButtonUnchecked';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { useChatStatus } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import {
  selectActiveModel,
  selectThinkingBudget,
  selectLanguage,
  selectSttEngine,
  selectActiveChatId,
  setActiveModel,
  setThinkingBudget,
  setLanguage,
  setSttEngine,
  useUpdateChatConfigMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { useUpdateAgentConfigMutation } from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import { selectCurrentUser } from '../../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import { AI_MODELS, CHAT_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Model registry metadata for display and capability descriptions.
 */
const MODEL_CARDS = [
  {
    id: AI_MODELS.DEFAULT, // 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite'
    name: 'Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite',
    shortName: 'Flash Lite',
    mobileShortName: 'Lite',
    badge: 'Default · Fast',
    description: 'Ultra-low latency for operational workflows, checklists, and real-time responses.',
    icon: BoltIcon,
    iconColor: 'warning.main',
  },
  {
    id: AI_MODELS.PRO, // 'gemini-3.8-flash'
    name: 'Gemini 3.8 Flash',
    shortName: 'Flash 3.8',
    mobileShortName: '3.8',
    badge: 'Pro · Deep Reasoning',
    description: 'High-capability model for complex multi-branch analytics, synthesis, and deep reporting.',
    icon: PsychologyIcon,
    iconColor: 'primary.main',
  },
  {
    id: AI_MODELS.FALLBACK, // 'gemini-3-flash-preview'
    name: 'Gemini 3 Flash Preview',
    shortName: 'Flash Preview',
    mobileShortName: 'Preview',
    badge: 'Alternative · Experimental',
    description: 'Experimental preview model with latest features and quota failover support.',
    icon: ScienceIcon,
    iconColor: 'secondary.main',
  },
];

/**
 * Speech-to-Text engine registry.
 */
const STT_OPTIONS = [
  { id: 'addis_ai', label: 'Addis AI', subtitle: 'Amharic Native' },
  { id: AI_MODELS.PRO, label: 'Gemini 3.8', subtitle: 'Multilingual' },
  { id: AI_MODELS.DEFAULT, label: 'Gemini Lite', subtitle: 'Fast' },
];

/**
 * Thinking budget preset chips.
 */
const BUDGET_PRESETS = [
  { label: 'Off', value: 0 },
  { label: '1K', value: 1024 },
  { label: '2K', value: 2048 },
  { label: '4K', value: 4096 },
  { label: '8K', value: 8192 },
];

/**
 * MuiModelSelector component.
 */
export const MuiModelSelector = React.memo(
  React.forwardRef(function MuiModelSelector(props, ref) {
    const { disabled = false } = props;
    const theme = useTheme();
    const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));
    const dispatch = useDispatch();
    const { isStreaming } = useChatStatus();

    // Redux selectors
    const activeModel = useSelector(selectActiveModel);
    const thinkingBudget = useSelector(selectThinkingBudget);
    const language = useSelector(selectLanguage);
    const sttEngine = useSelector(selectSttEngine);
    const activeChatId = useSelector(selectActiveChatId);
    const currentUser = useSelector(selectCurrentUser);

    // Mutations for two-tier persistence
    const [updateAgentConfig] = useUpdateAgentConfigMutation();
    const [updateChatConfig] = useUpdateChatConfigMutation();
    const { chatId: routeChatId } = useParams();

    // Local UI states
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState(null);
    const [composerWidth, setComposerWidth] = useState(undefined);
    const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
    const [saveAsDefault, setSaveAsDefault] = useState(true);
    const [localThinkingBudget, setLocalThinkingBudget] = useState(thinkingBudget);

    // Keep local slider synced with Redux store when thinkingBudget changes externally
    useEffect(() => {
      setLocalThinkingBudget(thinkingBudget);
    }, [thinkingBudget]);

    // Active model metadata lookup
    const activeCard = useMemo(
      () => MODEL_CARDS.find((m) => m.id === activeModel) || MODEL_CARDS[0],
      [activeModel]
    );

    const ActiveIcon = activeCard.icon;
    const isOpen = Boolean(anchorEl) || isDrawerOpen;
    const isControlDisabled = Boolean(disabled || isStreaming);

    // Open/Close handlers: dock to Composer Root on sm+
    const handleOpen = useCallback(
      (e) => {
        if (isControlDisabled) return;
        if (isMobile) {
          setIsDrawerOpen(true);
        } else {
          // Locate the enclosing Composer Root container (Paper / form element)
          const target = e.currentTarget;
          const composerRoot =
            target.closest('form') ||
            target.closest('.MuiPaper-root') ||
            target.closest('[class*="composerRoot"]') ||
            target;

          if (composerRoot) {
            const rect = composerRoot.getBoundingClientRect();
            setComposerWidth(rect.width);
            setAnchorEl(composerRoot);
          } else {
            setAnchorEl(target);
          }
        }
      },
      [isControlDisabled, isMobile]
    );

    const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
      setAnchorEl(null);
      setIsDrawerOpen(false);

      // Return focus to composer textarea
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const textarea = document.querySelector(
          'textarea[name="messageText"], textarea[name="chat-prompt-input"]'
        );
        if (textarea) {
          textarea.focus();
        }
      });
    }, []);

    // Dismiss popover on window resize to avoid detached floating anchors
    useEffect(() => {
      const handleResize = () => {
        if (anchorEl) {
          handleClose();
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    }, [anchorEl, handleClose]);

    // Two-tier persistence dispatcher
    const handlePersist = useCallback(
      async ({ newModel, newBudget, newLang, newSttEngine }) => {
        const targetModel = newModel || activeModel;
        const targetBudget = newBudget !== undefined ? newBudget : thinkingBudget;
        const targetLang = newLang || language;
        const rawSttEngine = newSttEngine || sttEngine;
        const targetSttEngine = CHAT_CONSTANTS.STT_ENGINES.includes(rawSttEngine)
          ? rawSttEngine
          : CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE;

        // 1. Synchronously update client Redux state
        if (newModel) dispatch(setActiveModel(newModel));
        if (newBudget !== undefined) dispatch(setThinkingBudget(newBudget));
        if (newLang) dispatch(setLanguage(newLang));
        if (newSttEngine) dispatch(setSttEngine(targetSttEngine));

        try {
          // 2. Tier 1: User Account Default persistence (if checked)
          if (saveAsDefault) {
            await updateAgentConfig({
              defaultModel: targetModel,
              defaultThinkingBudget: targetBudget,
              defaultLanguage: targetLang,
              sttEngine: targetSttEngine,
            }).unwrap();
          }

          // 3. Tier 2: Conversation Session persistence (strictly when in an active URL chat session)
          const targetSessionId = routeChatId || (activeChatId && activeChatId.length === 24 && activeChatId === routeChatId ? activeChatId : null);
          if (targetSessionId) {
            try {
              await updateChatConfig({
                chatId: targetSessionId,
                model: targetModel,
                thinkingBudget: targetBudget,
                language: targetLang,
              }).unwrap();
            } catch (chatCfgErr) {
              console.warn('[MuiModelSelector] Stale chat session config skipped:', chatCfgErr);
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          toast.error(
            err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to persist model configuration.'
          );
        }
      },
      [
        activeModel,
        thinkingBudget,
        language,
        sttEngine,
        dispatch,
        saveAsDefault,
        activeChatId,
        routeChatId,
        updateAgentConfig,
        updateChatConfig,
      ]
    );

    // Model selection
    const handleSelectModel = useCallback(
      (modelId) => {
        if (modelId === activeModel) return;
        void handlePersist({ newModel: modelId });
      },
      [activeModel, handlePersist]
    );

    // STT engine selection
    const handleSelectSttEngine = useCallback(
      (_e, newEngine) => {
        if (!newEngine || newEngine === sttEngine) return;
        void handlePersist({ newSttEngine: newEngine });
      },
      [sttEngine, handlePersist]
    );

    // Language selection
    const handleSelectLanguage = useCallback(
      (_e, newLang) => {
        if (!newLang || newLang === language) return;
        void handlePersist({ newLang: newLang });
      },
      [language, handlePersist]
    );

    // Thinking budget slider local change (fluid 60fps)
    const handleSliderChange = useCallback((_e, val) => {
      setLocalThinkingBudget(val);
    }, []);

    // Thinking budget slider committed (debounced network persist)
    const handleSliderCommit = useCallback(
      (_e, val) => {
        setLocalThinkingBudget(val);
        void handlePersist({ newBudget: val });
      },
      [handlePersist]
    );

    // Reset to baseline defaults
    const handleResetDefaults = useCallback(() => {
      const defaultModel =
        currentUser?.settings?.agentConfig?.defaultModel || AI_MODELS.DEFAULT;
      const defaultBudget =
        currentUser?.settings?.agentConfig?.defaultThinkingBudget ??
        CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET;
      const defaultLang =
        currentUser?.settings?.agentConfig?.defaultLanguage || CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
      const defaultStt =
        currentUser?.settings?.sttEngine || CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE;

      setLocalThinkingBudget(defaultBudget);
      void handlePersist({
        newModel: defaultModel,
        newBudget: defaultBudget,
        newLang: defaultLang,
        newSttEngine: defaultStt,
      });
      toast.info('Restored configuration to account defaults.');
    }, [currentUser, handlePersist]);

    // Format thinking budget display label
    const budgetLabel = useMemo(() => {
      if (localThinkingBudget === 0) return '0 tokens (Off)';
      return `${localThinkingBudget.toLocaleString()} tokens`;
    }, [localThinkingBudget]);

    // Settings sheet inner content (docked horizontally on sm+)
    const settingsContent = (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            pb: 0.75,
            borderBottom: '1px solid',
            borderColor: 'divider',
          }}
        >
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
              Model & Inference Governance
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
              Configure AI reasoning models, voice transcription & language preferences
            </Typography>
          </Box>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            onClick={handleResetDefaults}
            startIcon={<RestartAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
            sx={{
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              color: 'text.secondary',
              '&:hover': { color: 'text.primary' },
            }}
          >
            Reset
          </Button>
        </Box>

        {/* Section 1: Text-to-Text Model Selection (Horizontal 3-column row on sm+) */}
        <Box>
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary', textTransform: 'uppercase', mb: 0.75, display: 'block' }}
          >
            Text Model (Reasoning & Tools)
          </Typography>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', sm: 'repeat(3, 1fr)' },
              gap: 1,
            }}
          >
            {MODEL_CARDS.map((card) => {
              const isSelected = card.id === activeModel;
              const CardIcon = card.icon;
              return (
                <Box
                  key={card.id}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectModel(card.id)}
                  sx={{
                    p: 1.25,
                    borderRadius: 1.5,
                    border: '1px solid',
                    borderColor: isSelected ? 'primary.main' : 'divider',
                    bgcolor: isSelected ? 'action.selected' : 'background.paper',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 0.75,
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                    '&:hover': {
                      borderColor: isSelected ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
                      bgcolor: isSelected ? 'action.selected' : 'action.hover',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                      <CardIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: card.iconColor }} />
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                        {card.shortName}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                    {isSelected ? (
                      <CheckCircleRoundedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'primary.main' }} />
                    ) : (
                      <RadioButtonUncheckedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.disabled' }} />
                    )}
                  </Box>
                  <Typography
                    variant="caption"
                    sx={{
                      color: 'text.secondary',
                      display: '-webkit-box',
                      WebkitLineClamp: 2,
                      WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      lineHeight: 1.3,
                      fontSize: '0.6875rem',
                    }}
                  >
                    {card.description}
                  </Typography>
                  <Chip
                    label={card.badge}
                    size="small"
                    sx={{
                      height: 18,
                      fontSize: '0.625rem',
                      fontWeight: 500,
                      width: 'fit-content',
                      bgcolor: isSelected ? 'primary.main' : 'action.hover',
                      color: isSelected ? 'primary.contrastText' : 'text.secondary',
                    }}
                  />
                </Box>
              );
            })}
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Section 2 & 4: Dual Column Horizontal Row on sm+ (STT Engine & Language Preference) */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', sm: '1fr 1fr' },
            gap: 1.5,
          }}
        >
          {/* Left Column: Speech-to-Text Engine */}
          <Box>
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary', textTransform: 'uppercase', mb: 0.5, display: 'block' }}
            >
              Speech-to-Text Engine
            </Typography>
            <ToggleButtonGroup
              value={sttEngine}
              exclusive
              onChange={handleSelectSttEngine}
              size="small"
              fullWidth
              sx={{
                '& .MuiToggleButton-root': {
                  py: 0.5,
                  px: 0.75,
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                },
              }}
            >
              {STT_OPTIONS.map((stt) => (

            >

              <Typography

                <Box
                  component="span"

                    width: 6,

              {isOpen ? (

              ) : (

        {/* Desktop Presentation: Horizontal Canopy Docked Atop Composer Root */}
        {!isMobile && (
          <Popover
            open={Boolean(anchorEl)}
            anchorEl={anchorEl}
            onClose={handleClose}
            disableEnforceFocus={true}

            marginThreshold={16}
            slotProps={{

                  '&::-webkit-scrollbar': {
                    display: 'none',

                    height: 0,

        {isMobile && (

                borderRadius: 2,
                mx: 'auto',
                mb: 1.5,
              }}
            />
            {settingsContent}
          </SwipeableDrawer>
        )}
      </>
    );
  })
);
