/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiReasoningAccordion
 * @description Collapsible accordion rendering the agent's deliberative reasoning (brain thought stream).
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - Default expanded with live elapsed timer ("Thinking... (X.Xs)") while streaming.
 * - Automatically collapses when complete ("Thought for X.Xs") with clean manual toggle.
 * - Minimal, dignified, neutral aesthetic with zero saturated fills.
 * - Excluded from response copy targets.
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Collapse from '@mui/material/Collapse';
import PsychologyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PsychologyOutlined';
import ExpandMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore';

/**
 * Deliberative reasoning thought stream accordion.
 *
 * @component MuiReasoningAccordion
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} [props.text=''] - Raw thinking / reasoning text content.
 * @param {string} [props.state='done'] - Stream state ('streaming' | 'done').
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered reasoning accordion.
 */
export const MuiReasoningAccordion = ({ text = '', state = 'done' }) => {
  const isStreaming = state === 'streaming';
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(isStreaming);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState('0.0');
  const startTimeRef = useRef(null);

  // Auto-expand on streaming start; auto-collapse on streaming finish if user hasn't intervened
  const userToggledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStreaming) {
      if (!startTimeRef.current) {
        startTimeRef.current = Date.now();
      }
      if (!userToggledRef.current) {
        setIsExpanded(true);
      }
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (startTimeRef.current) {
          const sec = ((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000).toFixed(1);
          setElapsedSeconds(sec);
        }
      }, 100);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    } else {
      if (!userToggledRef.current) {
        setIsExpanded(false);
      }
      if (startTimeRef.current) {
        const sec = ((Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000).toFixed(1);
        setElapsedSeconds(sec);
      }
    }
  }, [isStreaming]);

  if (!text && !isStreaming) return null;

  const handleToggle = () => {
    userToggledRef.current = true;
    setIsExpanded((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const labelText = isStreaming
    ? `Thinking... (${elapsedSeconds}s)`
    : `Thought for ${elapsedSeconds}s`;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'transparent',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        mb: 1.5,
        transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease',
        '&:hover': {
          borderColor: 'text.disabled',
        },
      }}
    >
      {/* Header affordance */}
      <Box
        component="button"
        type="button"
        onClick={handleToggle}
        aria-expanded={isExpanded}
        aria-label="Toggle reasoning details"
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
          p: '7px 12px',
          bgcolor: 'transparent',
          border: 'none',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          textAlign: 'left',
          userSelect: 'none',
          outline: 'none',
          '&:focus-visible': {
            outline: (theme) => `2px solid ${theme.palette.primary.main}`,
            outlineOffset: -2,
          },
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <PsychologyOutlinedIcon
            sx={{
              fontSize: 18,
              color: isStreaming ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
              animation: isStreaming ? 'pulseBrain 1.8s infinite ease-in-out' : 'none',
              '@keyframes pulseBrain': {
                '0%, 100%': { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(1)' },
                '50%': { opacity: 0.65, transform: 'scale(1.08)' },
              },
            }}
          />
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: isStreaming ? 'text.primary' : 'text.secondary',
            }}
          >
            {labelText}
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <ExpandMoreIcon
          sx={{
            fontSize: 18,
            color: 'text.secondary',
            transform: isExpanded ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)',
            transition: 'transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)',
          }}
        />
      </Box>

      {/* Collapsible thought stream body */}
      <Collapse in={isExpanded} timeout="auto" unmountOnExit={false}>
        <Box
          sx={{
            p: '8px 12px 12px 12px',
            borderTop: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            maxHeight: 320,
            overflowY: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <Typography
            component="div"
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              lineHeight: 1.6,
              color: 'text.secondary',
              whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
              wordBreak: 'break-word',
              fontFamily: 'monospace, sans-serif',
              userSelect: 'text',
            }}
          >
            {text || (isStreaming ? 'Synthesizing deliberative strategy...' : '')}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Collapse>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiReasoningAccordion.propTypes = {
  text: PropTypes.string,
  state: PropTypes.oneOf(['streaming', 'done']),
};

export default MuiReasoningAccordion;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiRecentChat
 * @description Encapsulated Recent Chat component adhering to the React Single Responsibility Principle.
 * Manages chat list querying, pinning, accessible inline renaming, deletion modal,
 * and responsive presentation (full list vs. mini icon rail) with zero parent drawer coupling.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { NavLink, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemIcon from '@mui/material/ListItemIcon';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Menu from '@mui/material/Menu';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';

import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import ChatBubbleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChatBubbleOutlined';
import PushPinIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PushPin';
import PushPinOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PushPinOutlined';
import MoreVertIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MoreVert';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';

import { selectCurrentUser } from '../../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import {
  useGetChatsQuery,
  useDeleteChatMutation,
  usePinChatMutation,
  useRenameChatMutation,
  setActiveChatId,
} from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { MuiConfirmDialog } from '../reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import { ROUTES, CHAT_PAGINATION } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Encapsulated Recent Chats component.
 *
 * @component MuiRecentChat
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isMini=false] - Whether sidebar drawer is rendered in collapsed mini mode.
 * @param {() => void} [props.onMobileClose] - Optional callback to close temporary mobile drawer on item selection.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered recent chats interface.
 */
export const MuiRecentChat = ({ isMini = false, onMobileClose }) => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const user = useSelector(selectCurrentUser);
  const reduxActiveChatId = useSelector((state) => state.chat?.activeChatId);

  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  // RTK Query: paginated chat list query governed by centralized constant
  const {
    data: chatData,
    isLoading: isLoadingChats,
    isFetching: isFetchingChats,
  } = useGetChatsQuery(
    { page, limit: CHAT_PAGINATION.RECENT_CHATS_PAGE_SIZE },
    {
      skip: !user,
      refetchOnMountOrArgChange: false,
    }
  );
  const chats = useMemo(() => chatData?.chats || [], [chatData?.chats]);
  const hasNextPage = Boolean(chatData?.pagination?.hasNextPage);

  // Infinite scroll trigger: when scrolling near bottom of drawer list, request next page
  const handleListScroll = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = e.currentTarget;
      if (scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight < 50) {
        if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingChats) {
          setPage((prev) => prev + 1);
        }
      }
    },
    [hasNextPage, isFetchingChats]
  );

  // Adjust state during render if new chat session requested via route state (React recommended pattern)
  const [prevNewChatAt, setPrevNewChatAt] = useState(location.state?.newChatAt);
  if (location.state?.newChatAt !== prevNewChatAt) {
    setPrevNewChatAt(location.state?.newChatAt);
    setPage(1);
  }

  const [deleteChat, { isLoading: isDeletingChat }] = useDeleteChatMutation();
  const [pinChat] = usePinChatMutation();
  const [renameChat, { isLoading: isRenamingChat }] = useRenameChatMutation();

  // 3-dots action menu state
  const [chatMenuAnchorEl, setChatMenuAnchorEl] = useState(null);
  const [activeMenuChat, setActiveMenuChat] = useState(null);

  // Accessible inline renaming state
  const [editingChatId, setEditingChatId] = useState(null);
  const [editingTitle, setEditingTitle] = useState('');
  const editInputRef = useRef(null);
  const editStartTimeRef = useRef(0);

  // Delete confirmation dialog state
  const [deleteConfirmOpen, setDeleteConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  // Auto-focus and select text when entering inline edit mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editingChatId) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (editInputRef.current) {
          editInputRef.current.focus();
          editInputRef.current.select();
        }
      }, 50);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [editingChatId]);

  // Action Menu Handlers
  const handleChatMenuOpen = (event, chat) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    setChatMenuAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
    setActiveMenuChat(chat);
  };

  const handleChatMenuClose = () => {
    setChatMenuAnchorEl(null);
  };

  const handlePinClick = async () => {
    if (!activeMenuChat) return;
    const targetChat = activeMenuChat;
    handleChatMenuClose();
    try {
      setPage(1);
      await pinChat(targetChat._id).unwrap();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[MuiRecentChat] Failed to pin chat:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleRenameClick = () => {
    if (!activeMenuChat) return;
    const targetChat = activeMenuChat;

    // Explicitly blur focused element so closing Menu paper never retains focus while aria-hidden
    if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {
      document.activeElement.blur();
    }

    setChatMenuAnchorEl(null);
    setActiveMenuChat(null);

    editStartTimeRef.current = Date.now();
    setEditingChatId(targetChat._id);
    setEditingTitle(targetChat.title || '');
  };

  const handleSaveInlineRename = async (chatId, currentTitle) => {
    const trimmed = editingTitle.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed === currentTitle) {
      setEditingChatId(null);
      setEditingTitle('');
      return;
    }
    if (isRenamingChat) return;

    try {
      await renameChat({
        chatId,
        title: trimmed,
      }).unwrap();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[MuiRecentChat] Failed to rename chat:', err);
    } finally {
      setEditingChatId(null);
      setEditingTitle('');
    }
  };

  const handleCancelInlineRename = () => {
    setEditingChatId(null);
    setEditingTitle('');
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = () => {
    handleChatMenuClose();
    setDeleteConfirmOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!activeMenuChat) return;
    const targetId = String(activeMenuChat._id);
    try {
      setPage(1);
      await deleteChat(targetId).unwrap();
      const currentBrowserPath = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : '';
      const isViewingTarget =
        currentBrowserPath === `/chat/${targetId}` ||
        currentBrowserPath.startsWith(`/chat/${targetId}/`) ||
        location.pathname === `/chat/${targetId}` ||
        location.pathname.startsWith(`/chat/${targetId}/`) ||
        reduxActiveChatId === targetId;

      if (isViewingTarget) {
        dispatch(setActiveChatId(null));
        navigate(ROUTES.CHAT, { replace: true, state: { newChatAt: Date.now() } });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[MuiRecentChat] Failed to delete chat:', err);
    } finally {
      setDeleteConfirmOpen(false);
      setActiveMenuChat(null);
    }
  };

  // Mini Drawer Render
  if (isMini) {
    const currentPath = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : location.pathname;
    return (
      <Box sx={{ mt: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0, minHeight: 0, overflow: 'hidden', justifyContent: 'flex-start' }}>
        <Divider sx={{ my: 1, mx: 1, flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <Tooltip title="New Chat" placement="right" arrow>
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            aria-label="New chat"
            onClick={() => navigate(ROUTES.CHAT, { state: { newChatAt: Date.now() } })}
            sx={{ mx: 'auto', display: 'flex', mb: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }}
          >
            <AddIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
        <List
          dense
          disablePadding
          aria-label="Recent chats mini"
          sx={{
            flexGrow: 0,
            flexShrink: 0,
            maxHeight: 220,
            overflowY: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'none',
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' },
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 0.5,
            justifyContent: 'flex-start',
          }}
        >
          {chats.slice(0, CHAT_PAGINATION.MINI_DRAWER_CHATS_LIMIT).map((chat) => {
            const chatPath = `/chat/${chat._id}`;
            const isChatSelected = location.pathname === chatPath || currentPath === chatPath;
            return (
              <Tooltip
                key={chat._id}
                title={`${chat.isPinned ? '[Pinned] ' : ''}${chat.title || 'Untitled Chat'}`}
                placement="right"
                arrow
              >
                <ListItemButton
                  component={NavLink}
                  to={chatPath}
                  selected={isChatSelected}
                  sx={{
                    minHeight: 36,
                    height: 36,
                    mx: 1,
                    my: 0.25,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    px: 0,
                    py: 0,
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  <ListItemIcon
                    sx={{
                      minWidth: 0,
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      color: isChatSelected ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
                    }}
                  >
                    {chat.isPinned ? (
                      <PushPinIcon
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: 16,
                          color: 'primary.main',
                          transform: 'rotate(45deg)',
                        }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <ChatBubbleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    )}
                  </ListItemIcon>
                </ListItemButton>
              </Tooltip>
            );
          })}
        </List>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  const currentPath = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : location.pathname;

  // Full Expanded Drawer Render
  return (
    <Box sx={{ mt: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flexGrow: 1, minHeight: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <Divider sx={{ my: 1, mx: 1.5, flexShrink: 0 }} />
      {/* Header section with [+ New Chat] */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          px: 2,
          py: 0.5,
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        <Typography
          variant="overline"
          sx={{
            color: 'text.secondary',
            fontWeight: 700,
            letterSpacing: '0.08em',
            fontSize: '0.7rem',
          }}
        >
          Recent Chats
        </Typography>
        <Tooltip title="New Chat" arrow placement="top">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            aria-label="Create new chat"
            onClick={() => {
              navigate(ROUTES.CHAT, { state: { newChatAt: Date.now() } });
              if (onMobileClose) onMobileClose();
            }}
            sx={{
              p: 0.5,
              color: 'text.secondary',
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main', bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
            }}
          >
            <AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />

        </Tooltip>
      </Box>

      {/* Scrollable chat thread items list */}
      <Box
        onScroll={handleListScroll}
        sx={{
          flexGrow: 1,
          overflowY: 'auto',
          minHeight: 0,
          scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
          '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: 4 },
          '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
            bgcolor: 'action.hover',
            borderRadius: 2,
          },
        }}
      >
        {isLoadingChats && chats.length === 0 ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', py: 2 }}>
            <CircularProgress size={20} />
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <List dense disablePadding aria-label="Recent chats list">
            {chats.map((chat) => {
              const chatPath = `/chat/${chat._id}`;
              const isChatSelected = location.pathname === chatPath || currentPath === chatPath;
              const isEditing = editingChatId === chat._id;

              if (isEditing) {
                return (
                  <Box
                    key={chat._id}
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 0.5,
                      px: 1.5,
                      py: 0.5,
                      mx: 1,
                      my: 0.25,
                      borderRadius: 1,
                      bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                    }}
                  >
                    <TextField
                      inputRef={editInputRef}
                      size="small"
                      value={editingTitle}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditingTitle(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleSaveInlineRename(chat._id, chat.title);
                        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleCancelInlineRename();
                        }
                      }}
                      onBlur={(e) => {
                        if (Date.now() - editStartTimeRef.current < 300) return;
                        if (e.relatedTarget && e.relatedTarget.closest('.inline-rename-btn')) return;
                        handleSaveInlineRename(chat._id, chat.title);
                      }}
                      variant="standard"
                      autoFocus
                      disabled={isRenamingChat}
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          disableUnderline: false,
                          sx: {
                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                            fontWeight: 500,
                            py: 0.25,
                          },
                        },
                      }}
                      sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 0 }}
                    />
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.25, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      <Tooltip title="Save (Enter)" arrow>
                        <IconButton
                          size="small"
                          className="inline-rename-btn"
                          aria-label="Save title"
                          onClick={() => handleSaveInlineRename(chat._id, chat.title)}
                          disabled={isRenamingChat}
                          sx={{
                            p: 0.25,
                            color: 'primary.main',
                            '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
                          }}
                        >
                          <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                      <Tooltip title="Cancel (Esc)" arrow>
                        <IconButton
                          size="small"
                          className="inline-rename-btn"
                          aria-label="Cancel rename"
                          onClick={handleCancelInlineRename}
                          disabled={isRenamingChat}
                          sx={{
                            p: 0.25,
                            color: 'text.secondary',
                            '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
                          }}
                        >
                          <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                );
              }

              return (
                <ListItemButton
                  key={chat._id}
                  component={NavLink}
                  to={chatPath}
                  selected={isChatSelected}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (onMobileClose) onMobileClose();
                  }}
                  sx={{
                    mx: 1,
                    my: 0.25,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    px: 1.5,
                    pr: 4.5,
                    py: 0.5,
                    position: 'relative',
                    '&:hover': {
                      bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                      '& .chat-item-more-btn': {
                        opacity: 1,
                      },
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <ListItemIcon
                    sx={{
                      minWidth: 26,
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      color: isChatSelected ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
                    }}
                  >
                    <ChatBubbleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                  </ListItemIcon>
                  <ListItemText
                    onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setEditingChatId(chat._id);
                      setEditingTitle(chat.title || '');
                      editStartTimeRef.current = Date.now();
                    }}
                    primary={
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', minWidth: 0, gap: 0.5 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          noWrap
                          sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                            fontWeight: isChatSelected ? 600 : 400,
                            flexGrow: 1,
                            minWidth: 0,
                          }}
                        >
                          {chat.title || 'Untitled Chat'}
                        </Typography>
                        {chat.isPinned && (
                          <Tooltip title="Pinned" arrow placement="top">
                            <PushPinIcon
                              sx={{
                                fontSize: 13,
                                color: 'primary.main',
                                flexShrink: 0,
                                transform: 'rotate(45deg)',
                              }}
                            />
                          </Tooltip>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                    }
                  />
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    className="chat-item-more-btn"
                    aria-label="Chat options"
                    onClick={(e) => handleChatMenuOpen(e, chat)}
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: 4,
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      p: 0.25,
                      color: 'text.secondary',
                      bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                      opacity: isChatSelected ? 1 : 0,
                      transition: 'opacity 0.15s ease',
                      '&:hover': {
                        color: 'text.primary',
                        bgcolor: 'action.hover !important',
                      },
                    }}
                  >
                    <MoreVertIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                  </IconButton>
                </ListItemButton>
              );
            })}
            {hasNextPage && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', py: 1 }}>
                <Button
                  size="small"
                  variant="text"
                  disabled={isFetchingChats}
                  onClick={() => setPage((prev) => prev + 1)}
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    '&:hover': { color: 'text.primary', bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
                  }}
                >
                  {isFetchingChats ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                  ) : (
                    'Load older conversations'
                  )}
                </Button>
              </Box>
            )}
            {chats.length === 0 && (
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ px: 2, py: 1, color: 'text.disabled', display: 'block' }}
              >
                No recent chats
              </Typography>
            )}
          </List>
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Chat session 3-dots actions menu */}
      <Menu
        anchorEl={chatMenuAnchorEl}
        open={Boolean(chatMenuAnchorEl)}
        onClose={handleChatMenuClose}
        transitionDuration={0}
        disableRestoreFocus
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
        transformOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'right' }}
        slotProps={{
          root: {
            disableEnforceFocus: true,
          },
          paper: {
            sx: { minWidth: 150, boxShadow: 3 },
          },
        }}
      >
        <MenuItem onClick={handlePinClick} sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
          <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 28 }}>
            {activeMenuChat?.isPinned ? (
              <PushPinIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'primary.main' }} />
            ) : (
              <PushPinOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            )}
          </ListItemIcon>
          {activeMenuChat?.isPinned ? 'Unpin thread' : 'Pin thread'}
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={handleRenameClick} sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
          <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 28 }}>
            <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </ListItemIcon>
          Rename
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={handleDeleteClick} sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'error.main' }}>
          <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 28, color: 'error.main' }}>
            <DeleteOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
          </ListItemIcon>
          Delete
        </MenuItem>
      </Menu>

      {/* Delete chat confirmation modal */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={deleteConfirmOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteConfirmOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDelete}
        title="Delete Conversation"
        message={`Are you sure you want to delete "${activeMenuChat?.title || 'this conversation'}"? All messages and attachments in this thread will be permanently deleted.`}
        confirmText="Delete"
        cancelText="Cancel"
        confirmColor="error"
        loading={isDeletingChat}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiRecentChat.displayName = 'MuiRecentChat';

export default MuiRecentChat;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiSendButton
 * @description Decoupled circular action button for MUI X Chat composer.
 * Adheres strictly to the 7-state edge-case matrix while completely eliminating typing lag:
 * 1. Empty/whitespace: Disabled
 * 2. Non-empty text: Active Send mode (ArrowUpward)
 * 3. Generation in progress: Active Stop mode (Stop icon), wired to actions.stopStreaming()
 * 4. Submitting handshake: Handled by form submission
 * 5. IME composition: Protected by input composition handlers
 * 6. Multiline: Handled by InputBase / TextareaAutosize
 * 7. Offline/disabled: Disabled
 *
 * Performance Invariant: Subscribes to boolean selectors via useChatStore() + useStore(),
 * guaranteeing 0 re-renders while typing between character 1 and character 500.
 */

import React from 'react';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import ArrowUpwardIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowUpward';
import StopIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Stop';
import { useChatStatus, useChatActions, useChatStore } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';
import { useStore } from '@mui/x-internals/store';
import { usePendingUploadCount } from '../../utils/attachmentRegistry.js';

/**
 * MuiSendButton component.
 * @param {object} props - Component props.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled] - Optional external disabled override.
 * @returns {React.ReactElement}
 */
export const MuiSendButton = (props) => {
  const store = useChatStore();
  const status = useChatStatus();
  const actions = useChatActions();
  const pendingUploads = usePendingUploadCount();

  // Boolean selectors: strictly 0 re-renders while typing characters 2 through 500!
  const hasValue = useStore(store, (state) => Boolean(state.composerValue && state.composerValue.trim().length > 0));
  const hasAttachments = useStore(store, (state) => Boolean(state.composerAttachments && state.composerAttachments.length > 0));

  const isStreaming = Boolean(status?.isStreaming);
  const isUploading = pendingUploads > 0;
  const isDisabledExternally = Boolean(props.disabled);
  const canSend = (hasValue || hasAttachments) && !isStreaming && !isDisabledExternally && !isUploading;

  const handleSendTrigger = React.useCallback(
    (e) => {
      if (!canSend) {
        e.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      // Synchronously flush the composer textarea's current DOM text to the store
      // before native type="submit" form submission triggers composer.submit()
      const form = e.currentTarget.closest('form');
      const textarea = form?.querySelector('textarea');
      if (textarea && typeof store?.setComposerValue === 'function') {
        store.setComposerValue(textarea.value);
      }
    },
    [canSend, store]
  );

  // State 3: Active Streaming Generation (Stop Mode)
  if (isStreaming) {
    return (
      <Tooltip title="Stop generating" arrow disableFocusListener disableTouchListener>
        <IconButton
          type="button"
          aria-label="Stop generating"
          size="small"
          onPointerDown={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.blur();
          }}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.blur();
            if (typeof actions?.stopStreaming === 'function') {
              actions.stopStreaming();
            }
          }}
          sx={{
            width: 34,
            height: 34,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: 'error.main !important',
            backgroundColor: 'error.main !important',
            color: 'error.contrastText !important',
            transition: 'none !important',
            '&:hover': {
              bgcolor: 'error.dark !important',
              backgroundColor: 'error.dark !important',
              color: 'error.contrastText !important',
            },
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <StopIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
    );
  }

  // States 1 & 2: Idle Drafting (Send Mode)
  return (
    <Tooltip
      title={isUploading ? 'Uploading media...' : (canSend ? 'Send message' : '')}
      arrow
      disableHoverListener={!canSend && !isUploading}
      disableFocusListener
      disableTouchListener
    >
      <span>
        <IconButton
          type="submit"
          aria-label={isUploading ? 'Uploading media...' : 'Send message'}
          size="small"
          disabled={!canSend}
          onPointerDown={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.blur();
            handleSendTrigger(e);
          }}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.blur();
            handleSendTrigger(e);
          }}
          sx={{
            width: 34,
            height: 34,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: canSend ? 'primary.main !important' : 'action.disabledBackground !important',
            color: canSend ? 'primary.contrastText !important' : 'action.disabled !important',
            transition: 'none !important',
            cursor: canSend ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed',
            '&:hover': canSend
              ? {
                bgcolor: 'primary.dark !important',
              }
              : {},
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {isUploading ? (
            <CircularProgress size={16} thickness={5} sx={{ color: 'action.disabled' }} />
          ) : (
            <ArrowUpwardIcon sx={{ fontSize: 19 }} />
          )}
        </IconButton>
      </span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
};

MuiSendButton.displayName = 'MuiSendButton';

export default React.memo(MuiSendButton);

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiToolCallPart
 * @description Autonomous tool execution card rendered for each tool part during an agent turn.
 * Adheres strictly to the Task 8.11 specifications:
 * - Autonomous multi-step execution cards (steps 1..5) with zero approval modals.
 * - Live status indicators: spinner on input-streaming/input-available, green check on output-available,
 *   and error icon on output-error.
 * - Human-readable tool labels with dynamic operational summary badges.
 * - Collapsible JSON inspection drawer for parameters and database execution results.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Collapse from '@mui/material/Collapse';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import BuildOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BuildOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlined';
import ExpandMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore';
import TelegramIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Telegram';
import OpenInNewIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInNew';

/**
 * Human-friendly title dictionary for the 17 autonomous operations tools.
 */
const TOOL_DISPLAY_NAMES = {
  lookup_user_branches: 'Branch Directory Lookup',
  create_branch: 'Register Branch',
  update_branch: 'Update Branch',
  archive_branch: 'Archive Branch',
  restore_branch: 'Restore Branch',
  delete_branch_permanently: 'Permanent Delete Branch',
  create_report: 'Create Inspection Report',
  update_report: 'Update Inspection Report',
  update_branch_record_status: 'Update Record Status',
  archive_report: 'Archive Inspection Report',
  restore_report: 'Restore Inspection Report',
  delete_report_permanently: 'Permanent Delete Report',
  query_historical_reports: 'Historical Reports Query',
  query_branch_records: 'Branch Records Query',
  share_to_telegram: 'Telegram Alert Dispatch',
  save_user_directive: 'Save User Directives',
  save_supervisor_directive: 'Save User Directives',
  manage_google_drive: 'Google Drive Management',
  create_cloud_document: 'Cloud Document Authoring',
  generate_document_file: 'Document Generation',
};

/**
 * Derives a human-friendly summary text from the tool execution output.
 * @param {object|any} output
 * @param {string} [toolName='']
 * @returns {string} Summary string.
 */
const deriveOutputSummary = (output, toolName = '') => {
  if (!output) return 'Completed';
  const out = output?.data !== undefined ? output.data : output;
  if (Array.isArray(out)) {
    return `${out.length} record${out.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} found`;
  }
  if (typeof out === 'object') {
    if (toolName === 'create_cloud_document') {
      const typeLabel = out.type === 'sheet' || out.mimeType?.includes('spreadsheet') ? 'Google Sheet' : 'Google Doc';
      return `${typeLabel} created`;
    }
    if (toolName === 'generate_document_file') {
      const fmt = (out.format || 'doc').toUpperCase();
      const sizeStr = out.fileSizeFormatted ? ` (${out.fileSizeFormatted})` : '';
      return `${fmt} generated${sizeStr}`;
    }
    if (toolName === 'manage_google_drive') {
      if (out.action === 'create_folder') return `Folder '${out.name || 'Personal AI Agent'}' created`;
      if (out.action === 'search') return `${out.count || 0} file${out.count === 1 ? '' : 's'} found`;
      if (out.action === 'check_connection') return out.connected ? 'Drive connected' : 'Drive disconnected';
    }
    if (out.channel === 'telegram' || out.targetChannel) {
      const ch = out.targetChannel || out.channel;
      const modeStr = out.mode === 'image' ? 'Image Card' : 'Text';
      const statusStr = out.isStub ? 'Stub' : 'Live';
      return `${ch} • ${modeStr} • ${statusStr}`;
    }
    if (out.reportId) {
      return `Report #${String(out.reportId).slice(-6)} created`;
    }
    if (out.count !== undefined) {
      return `${out.count} item${out.count === 1 ? '' : 's'} found`;
    }
    if (out.branch?.name) {
      return `Branch: ${out.branch.name}`;
    }
    if (out.message && typeof out.message === 'string') {
      return out.message.slice(0, 60);
    }
    if (out.success) {
      return 'Execution successful';
    }
  }
  return 'Completed';
};

/**
 * Autonomous tool execution card.
 *
 * @component MuiToolCallPart
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {object} props.toolInvocation - Tool execution descriptor from MUI X Chat headless.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered tool execution card.
 */
export const MuiToolCallPart = ({ toolInvocation, stepNumber, totalSteps }) => {
  const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);

  if (!toolInvocation) return null;

  const { toolName = 'tool', state = 'output-available', input, output, errorText } = toolInvocation;
  const out = output?.data !== undefined ? output.data : output;

  const isExecuting = state === 'input-streaming' || state === 'input-available';
  const isError = state === 'output-error' || Boolean(errorText) || (out && out.success === false);
  const isSuccess = state === 'output-available' && !isError;

  const friendlyName = TOOL_DISPLAY_NAMES[toolName] || toolName.replace(/_/g, ' ');
  const displayName = stepNumber
    ? (totalSteps ? `Step ${stepNumber}/${totalSteps}: ${friendlyName}` : `Step ${stepNumber}: ${friendlyName}`)
    : friendlyName;
  const summaryText = isExecuting
    ? 'Executing in ACID session...'
    : isError
      ? (errorText || out?.error || (typeof out?.message === 'string' ? out.message.slice(0, 60) : 'Execution error'))
      : deriveOutputSummary(out, toolName);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: isError ? 'error.light' : 'divider',
        borderRadius: '10px',
        bgcolor: 'transparent',
        p: '6px 12px',
        mb: 1,
        transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease',
      }}
    >
      {/* Primary summary strip */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          gap: 1,
        }}
      >
        {/* Left: Icon, Tool Name & Status */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, minWidth: 0, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {toolName === 'share_to_telegram' ? (
            <TelegramIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2AABEE' }} />
          ) : (
            <BuildOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
          )}
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: 'text.primary',
              fontFamily: 'monospace, sans-serif',
            }}
          >
            {displayName}
          </Typography>

          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 0.5,
              px: 0.8,
              py: 0.2,
              borderRadius: '6px',
              bgcolor: isExecuting
                ? 'action.hover'
                : isError
                  ? 'error.light'
                  : 'action.hover',
            }}
          >
            {isExecuting && (
              <CircularProgress size={12} thickness={5} sx={{ color: 'primary.main' }} />
            )}
            {isSuccess && (
              <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'success.main' }} />
            )}
            {isError && (
              <ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'error.main' }} />
            )}

            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                color: isError ? 'error.main' : 'text.secondary',
                fontWeight: 500,
              }}
            >
              {summaryText}
            </Typography>

            {out?.deepLink && (
              <Box
                component="a"
                href={out.deepLink}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                sx={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 0.3,
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  color: '#2AABEE',
                  textDecoration: 'none',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  ml: 0.5,
                  '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                }}
              >
                View <OpenInNewIcon sx={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
              </Box>
            )}

            {out?.webViewLink && (
              <Box
                component="a"

                sx={{

                }}
              >
                Open <OpenInNewIcon sx={{ fontSize: 11 }} />

            )}

        </Box>

        {/* Right: Collapsible JSON details trigger */}
        <Box
          component="button"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowDetails((prev) => !prev)}
          aria-expanded={showDetails}
          aria-label="Inspect tool call parameters and result"
          sx={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 0.5,
            p: '2px 6px',
            bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
            backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
            border: 'none !important',
            boxShadow: 'none !important',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            color: 'text.secondary',
            fontSize: '0.75rem',
            userSelect: 'none',
            '&:hover': {
              color: 'text.primary',
            },
          }}
        >
          <span>{showDetails ? 'Hide' : 'Inspect'}</span>
          <ExpandMoreIcon
            sx={{
              fontSize: 16,
              transform: showDetails ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)',
              transition: 'transform 0.2s ease',
            }}
          />
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Expandable JSON details */}
      <Collapse in={showDetails} timeout="auto" unmountOnExit={false}>
        <Box
          sx={{
            mt: 1,
            pt: 1,
            borderTop: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 1,
          }}
        >
          {input !== undefined && (
            <Box>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary' }}
              >
                Arguments:
              </Typography>
              <Box
                component="pre"
                sx={{
                  m: 0,
                  p: 1,
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    theme.vars
                      ? theme.vars.palette.action.hover
                      : alpha(theme.palette.action.hover, 0.4),
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  color: 'text.primary',
                  overflowX: 'auto',
                  maxWidth: '100%',
                  maxHeight: 180,
                }}
              >
                {JSON.stringify(input, null, 2)}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          )}

          {output !== undefined && (
            <Box>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary' }}
              >
                Output:
              </Typography>
              <Box
                component="pre"
                sx={{
                  m: 0,
                  p: 1,
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    theme.vars
                      ? theme.vars.palette.action.hover
                      : alpha(theme.palette.action.hover, 0.4),
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  color: 'text.primary',
                  overflowX: 'auto',
                  maxWidth: '100%',
                  maxHeight: 220,
                }}
              >
                {JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          )}

          {errorText && (
            <Box>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'error.main' }}
              >
                Error:
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                sx={{
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  color: 'error.main',
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  p: 0.5,
                }}
              >
                {errorText}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Collapse>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiToolCallPart.propTypes = {

    output: PropTypes.any,
    errorText: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  stepNumber: PropTypes.number,

};

export default MuiToolCallPart;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiTtsPlayButton
 * @description Reusable Read Out Loud action button powered by native Addis AI TTS.
 * Displays speaker icon when idle, subtle circular progress while synthesizing,
 * and stop icon with brand color accent while playing.
 * Can be embedded anywhere in the UI (chat messages, operational reports, cards).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import VolumeUpOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VolumeUpOutlined';
import StopCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StopCircleOutlined';
import useAddisTts from '../../hooks/useAddisTts.js';

/**
 * Reusable Read Out Loud Icon Button.
 *
 * @component MuiTtsPlayButton
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} props.text - Text content to read out loud.
 * @param {string} [props.messageId] - Unique message turn identifier.
 * @param {string} [props.voiceId] - Optional voice override.
 * @param {string} [props.language] - Optional language override ('am', 'en', 'auto').
 * @param {number} [props.speed] - Optional playback speed override.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled] - Disabled state (e.g. while stream is in flight).
 * @param {string} [props.size='small'] - Button size.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Additional MUI styling overrides.
 * @param {string} [props.tooltipPlacement='top'] - Tooltip placement direction.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered action button.
 */
export const MuiTtsPlayButton = memo(({
  text,
  messageId,
  voiceId,
  language = 'auto',
  speed = 1.0,
  disabled = false,
  size = 'small',
  sx = {},
  tooltipPlacement = 'top',
}) => {
  const { isPlaying, isLoading, togglePlay } = useAddisTts({
    text,
    messageId,
    voiceId,
    language,
    speed,
  });

  if (!text || !text.trim()) {
    return null;
  }

  const tooltipTitle = isLoading
    ? 'Generating speech (Addis AI)...'
    : isPlaying
    ? 'Stop read out loud'
    : 'Read out loud';

  const ariaLabel = isLoading
    ? 'Generating speech audio'
    : isPlaying
    ? 'Stop read out loud'
    : 'Read out loud response';

  return (
    <Tooltip title={tooltipTitle} placement={tooltipPlacement} arrow>
      <span>
        <IconButton
          size={size}
          onClick={togglePlay}
          disabled={disabled || isLoading}
          aria-label={ariaLabel}
          sx={{
            p: 0.5,
            color: isPlaying ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
            bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
            backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
            boxShadow: 'none !important',
            border: 'none !important',
            transition: 'color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease',
            '&:hover': {
              color: isPlaying ? 'error.main' : 'primary.main',
              bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              transform: 'scale(1.08)',
            },
            '&:disabled': {
              color: 'text.disabled',
              bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
            },
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <CircularProgress size={15} color="inherit" thickness={4.5} />
          ) : isPlaying ? (
            <StopCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17, color: 'primary.main' }} />
          ) : (
            <VolumeUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
          )}
        </IconButton>
      </span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
});

MuiTtsPlayButton.displayName = 'MuiTtsPlayButton';

MuiTtsPlayButton.propTypes = {
  text: PropTypes.string,
  messageId: PropTypes.string,
  voiceId: PropTypes.string,
  language: PropTypes.string,
  speed: PropTypes.number,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium', 'large']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
  tooltipPlacement: PropTypes.string,
};

export default MuiTtsPlayButton;

/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiUserAttachmentShelf
 * @description Dual-mode attachment shelf atop the user message card.
 * In View Mode: Multi-item natural flex-wrap deck with zero horizontal and zero vertical scrollbars.
 * In Edit Mode: Single-line horizontal scroll shelf with hidden scrollbars, scroll chevrons, and individual (x) dismiss pills.
 */

import { useRef, useCallback, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import DescriptionIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Description';
import GraphicEqIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GraphicEq';
import ImageIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Image';
import ChevronLeftIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronLeft';
import ChevronRightIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronRight';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Resolves attachment URL to fully qualified HTTP/HTTPS or blob URL.
 * @param {string|null} url
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
const resolveAttachmentUrl = (url) => {
  if (!url) return null;
  if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://') || url.startsWith('blob:')) {
    return url;
  }
  const hostOrigin = API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/api\/v1\/?$/, '');
  const cleanPath = url.startsWith('/') ? url : `/${url}`;
  return `${hostOrigin}${cleanPath}`;
};

/**
 * Formats byte size into human-readable label.
 * @param {number} bytes
 * @returns {string} Formatted size (e.g. "8.5 KB", "2.1 MB").
 */
const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

/**
 * Determines file category from MIME type or file extension.
 * @param {object} item
 * @returns {'audio'|'image'|'doc'} File category.
 */
const getFileCategory = (item) => {
  const mime = (item.mimeType || item.type || '').toLowerCase();
  const name = (item.name || item.originalName || item.fileName || '').toLowerCase();

  if (
    mime.startsWith('audio/') ||
    mime.includes('webm') ||
    name.endsWith('.webm') ||
    name.endsWith('.wav') ||
    name.endsWith('.mp3') ||
    name.endsWith('.ogg') ||
    name.endsWith('.m4a')
  ) {
    return 'audio';
  }
  if (
    mime.startsWith('image/') ||
    name.endsWith('.png') ||
    name.endsWith('.jpg') ||
    name.endsWith('.jpeg') ||
    name.endsWith('.webp') ||
    name.endsWith('.gif') ||
    name.endsWith('.svg')
  ) {
    return 'image';
  }
  return 'doc';
};

/**
 * Extracts display extension badge.
 * @param {object} item
 * @returns {string} Badge text (e.g. "PDF", "WAV", "PNG").
 */
const getExtensionBadge = (item) => {
  const name = item.name || item.originalName || item.fileName || '';
  const ext = name.split('.').pop()?.toUpperCase();
  if (ext && ext.length <= 4) return ext;
  const cat = getFileCategory(item);
  if (cat === 'audio') return 'AUDIO';
  if (cat === 'image') return 'IMG';
  return 'DOC';
};

/**
 * Top-row attachment shelf component for User Message.
 *
 * @component MuiUserAttachmentShelf
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {Array<object>} props.attachments - List of attachment items.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isEditing=false] - Whether card is in Edit Mode.
 * @param {Function} [props.onRemoveAttachment] - Callback to remove individual attachment in Edit Mode.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered attachment shelf or null if empty.
 */
export const MuiUserAttachmentShelf = ({
  attachments = [],
  isEditing = false,
  onRemoveAttachment,
}) => {
  const scrollContainerRef = useRef(null);
  const [canScrollLeft, setCanScrollLeft] = useState(false);
  const [canScrollRight, setCanScrollRight] = useState(false);

  // Check scroll boundary state in Edit Mode
  const checkScrollBoundaries = useCallback(() => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el || !isEditing) {
      setCanScrollLeft(false);
      setCanScrollRight(false);
      return;
    }
    const { scrollLeft, scrollWidth, clientWidth } = el;
    setCanScrollLeft(scrollLeft > 4);
    setCanScrollRight(scrollLeft + clientWidth < scrollWidth - 4);
  }, [isEditing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    checkScrollBoundaries();
  }, [attachments, isEditing, checkScrollBoundaries]);

  const handleScroll = (direction) => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const offset = direction === 'left' ? -180 : 180;
    el.scrollBy({ left: offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  if (!Array.isArray(attachments) || attachments.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        mb: isEditing ? 1 : 0,
      }}
    >
      {/* Edit Mode: Left scroll chevron */}
      {isEditing && canScrollLeft && (
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          onClick={() => handleScroll('left')}
          aria-label="Scroll attachments left"
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: -8,
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            zIndex: 2,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            boxShadow: 'none',
            border: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            width: 24,
            height: 24,
            p: 0,
            '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
          }}
        >
          <ChevronLeftIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
        </IconButton>
      )}

      {/* Main attachment container: View Mode = flexWrap 'wrap' right-aligned; Edit Mode = nowrap overflowX 'auto' */}
      <Box
        ref={scrollContainerRef}
        onScroll={isEditing ? checkScrollBoundaries : undefined}
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'row',
          gap: 1,
          alignItems: 'center',
          ...(isEditing
            ? {
                flexWrap: 'nowrap',
                overflowX: 'auto',
                overflowY: 'hidden',
                scrollbarWidth: 'none',
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' },
                py: 0.5,
                px: 0.25,
              }
            : {
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                overflow: 'visible',
              }),
        }}
      >
        {attachments.map((item, index) => {
          const id = item.id || item._id || item.fileName || `att-${index}`;
          const name = item.name || item.originalName || item.fileName || 'Attachment';
          const size = item.size ? formatFileSize(item.size) : '';
          const category = getFileCategory(item);
          const badge = getExtensionBadge(item);

          return (
            <Paper
              key={id}
              variant="outlined"
              onClick={() => {
                if (!isEditing && (item.url || item.path)) {
                  const targetUrl = resolveAttachmentUrl(item.url || item.path);
                  if (targetUrl) {
                    window.open(targetUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
                  }
                }
              }}
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 1.25,
                py: 0.75,
                px: 1.25,
                borderRadius: '10px',
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                borderColor: 'divider',
                boxShadow: 'none',
                flexShrink: 0,
                maxWidth: isEditing ? 220 : 280,
                cursor: isEditing ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                transition: 'border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease',
                '&:hover': {
                  borderColor: isEditing ? 'divider' : 'text.secondary',
                  bgcolor: isEditing ? 'action.hover' : 'action.selected',
                },
              }}
            >
              {/* Category Icon */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  width: 32,
                  height: 32,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    alpha(
                      category === 'audio'
                        ? theme.palette.warning.main
                        : category === 'image'
                          ? theme.palette.info.main
                          : theme.palette.primary.main,
                      theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.22 : 0.12
                    ),
                  color:
                    category === 'audio'
                      ? 'warning.main'
                      : category === 'image'
                        ? 'info.main'
                        : 'primary.main',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                  position: 'relative',
                }}
              >
                {category === 'audio' ? (
                  <GraphicEqIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                ) : category === 'image' ? (
                  <ImageIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                ) : (
                  <DescriptionIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                )}

                {(item.isUploading || item.uploadProgress !== undefined) && (
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      top: 0,
                      left: 0,
                      width: '100%',
                      height: '100%',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      bgcolor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                    }}
                  >
                    <CircularProgress
                      size={18}
                      thickness={5}
                      variant={typeof item.uploadProgress === 'number' ? 'determinate' : 'indeterminate'}
                      value={typeof item.uploadProgress === 'number' ? item.uploadProgress : undefined}
                      sx={{ color: '#fff' }}
                    />
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>

              {/* Name & Badge metadata */}
              <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flexGrow: 1 }}>
                <Tooltip title={isEditing ? name : `Click to open ${name}`} enterDelay={400}>
                  <Typography
                    variant="body2"
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      lineHeight: 1.25,
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      color: 'text.primary',
                    }}
                  >
                    {name}
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.6875rem',
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    lineHeight: 1.1,
                    display: 'block',
                    mt: 0.25,
                  }}
                >
                  {badge} {size}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              {/* Edit Mode: (x) dismiss button */}
              {isEditing && (
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    if (typeof onRemoveAttachment === 'function') {
                      onRemoveAttachment(id);
                    }
                  }}
                  aria-label={`Remove attachment ${name}`}
                  sx={{
                    p: 0.25,
                    ml: 0.5,
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    '&:hover': {
                      color: 'error.main',
                      bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                </IconButton>
              )}
            </Paper>
          );
        })}
      </Box>

      {/* Edit Mode: Right scroll chevron */}
      {isEditing && canScrollRight && (
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          onClick={() => handleScroll('right')}
          aria-label="Scroll attachments right"
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            right: -8,
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            zIndex: 2,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            boxShadow: 'none',
            border: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            width: 24,
            height: 24,
            p: 0,
            '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
          }}
        >
          <ChevronRightIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
        </IconButton>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiUserAttachmentShelf.propTypes = {
  attachments: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      id: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
      _id: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
      name: PropTypes.string,
      fileName: PropTypes.string,
      originalName: PropTypes.string,
      size: PropTypes.number,
      mimeType: PropTypes.string,
      type: PropTypes.string,
      url: PropTypes.string,
    })
  ),
  isEditing: PropTypes.bool,
  onRemoveAttachment: PropTypes.func,
};

export default MuiUserAttachmentShelf;
