````jsx
/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiUserMessage
 * @description Outlined Paper card representing a user message turn in Operon AI Chat.
 * Adheres strictly to the 10 Constitutional Invariants:
 * 1. Zero avatar, zero author label, neutral outlined Paper card (no blue primary fill).
 * 2. 3-row architecture: Row 1 Media Shelf, Row 2 Conversational Body, Row 3 Actions & Retry Deck.
 * 3. Min/Max width geometry clamping ({ xs: 140, sm: 160 } to { xs: '92%', md: '80%', lg: '75%' }).
 * 4. Auto-collapse at 220px with bottom gradient fade, and absolute zero scrollbars in Edit Mode.
 * 5. Edit-only attachment deletion and addition with client validation.
 * 6. Dual-mode attachment layout: View Mode flex-wrap (zero scrollbars) vs Edit Mode single-line scroll.
 * 7. Action deck on hover, replaced by inline warning recovery strip on error with transparent bgcolor.
 * 8. Strict 1rem / 16px typography.
 * 9. Linear history pruning dispatch on edit submit and retry.
 * 10. Native MUI X Chat integration via useMessage, useChatActions, and useChatStore.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import ExpandMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore';
import ExpandLessIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandLess';
import { useMessage, useChatActions, useChatStore, useMessageIds } from '@mui/x-chat-headless';

import MuiUserAttachmentShelf from './MuiUserAttachmentShelf.jsx';
import MuiUserMessageBody from './MuiUserMessageBody.jsx';
import MuiUserMessageBottomBar from './MuiUserMessageBottomBar.jsx';
import { useChatAdapter } from '../../contexts/ChatAdapterContext.js';
import { ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import {
  useUploadAttachmentsMutation,
  useUploadAudioMutation,
  useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import {
  registerUpload,
  removeUpload,
  getUploadState,
} from '../../utils/attachmentRegistry.js';
import { validateChatAttachments, isAudioAttachment } from '../../utils/validateChatAttachment.js';

/**
 * Clamping height threshold in pixels (8 full text lines at 25.6px line-height = 204.8px).
 * @constant {number}
 */
const CLAMP_HEIGHT_PX = 206;

/**
 * Outlined user message card component.
 *
 * @component MuiUserMessage
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} props.messageId - Unique identifier of the message turn.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered user message card.
 */
export const MuiUserMessage = ({ messageId }) => {
  const adapter = useChatAdapter();
  const message = useMessage(messageId);
  const actions = useChatActions(true);
  const store = useChatStore();
  const messageIds = useMessageIds();

  const [uploadAttachments] = useUploadAttachmentsMutation();
  const [uploadAudio] = useUploadAudioMutation();
  const [deleteComposerAttachment] = useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation();
  const newlyUploadedFilesRef = useRef([]);

  // Extract raw text from message parts or content
  const initialText = useMemo(() => {
    if (!message) return '';
    if (typeof message.content === 'string') return message.content;
    const textPart = message.parts?.find((p) => p.type === 'text');
    return textPart?.text || message.text || '';
  }, [message]);

  // Extract and normalize initial attachments and audio records
  const initialAttachments = useMemo(() => {
    if (!message) return [];
    const list = [];
    const seenKeys = new Set();

    const addAttachment = (raw) => {
      if (!raw) return;
      const id = String(
        raw.id ||
        raw._id ||
        raw.fileName ||
        raw.filename ||
        raw.name ||
        (raw.file && (raw.file.id || raw.file.name)) ||
        ''
      );
      const name =
        raw.originalName ||
        raw.name ||
        raw.fileName ||
        raw.filename ||
        (raw.file && raw.file.name) ||
        'Attachment';
      const size = raw.size || (raw.file && raw.file.size) || 0;
      const dedupeKey = id ? `id:${id}` : `name:${name}-${size}`;
      if (seenKeys.has(dedupeKey)) return;
      seenKeys.add(dedupeKey);
      if (id) seenKeys.add(`id:${id}`);
      if (name) seenKeys.add(`name:${name}-${size}`);
      if (raw.fileName) seenKeys.add(`fn:${raw.fileName}`);
      if (raw.filename) seenKeys.add(`fn:${raw.filename}`);

      const mimeType =
        raw.mimeType ||
        raw.mediaType ||
        raw.type ||
        (raw.file && raw.file.type) ||
        '';

      const rawPath = raw.path ? raw.path.replace(/\\/g, '/') : null;
      let url = raw.url || (raw.file && raw.file.url) || null;
      if (!url && rawPath) {
        url = rawPath.startsWith('/') ? rawPath : `/${rawPath}`;
      }

      const fileObj = (raw instanceof File || raw instanceof Blob) ? raw : raw.file;
      const rawHexId =
        (raw._id && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(String(raw._id)) ? String(raw._id) : null) ||
        (raw.audioId && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(String(raw.audioId)) ? String(raw.audioId) : null) ||
        (id && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(String(id)) ? String(id) : null) ||
        (fileObj && fileObj._id && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(String(fileObj._id)) ? String(fileObj._id) : null) ||
        (fileObj && fileObj.audioId && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/.test(String(fileObj.audioId)) ? String(fileObj.audioId) : null);

      list.push({
        id: id || dedupeKey,
        _id: rawHexId || raw._id || null,
        audioId: rawHexId || raw.audioId || null,
        name,
        fileName: raw.fileName || raw.filename || (fileObj && fileObj.fileName) || name,
        originalName: raw.originalName || (fileObj && fileObj.originalName) || name,
        size,
        mimeType,
        type: mimeType,
        url,
        path: rawPath,
        publicId: raw.publicId || (fileObj && fileObj.publicId) || null,
        cloudUrl: raw.cloudUrl || (fileObj && fileObj.cloudUrl) || null,
        duration: raw.duration || null,
        file: fileObj || null,
      });
    };

    // 1. Check message.attachments
    if (Array.isArray(message.attachments)) {
      message.attachments.forEach(addAttachment);
    }

    // 2. Check message.audios
    if (Array.isArray(message.audios)) {
      message.audios.forEach((aud) => {
        if (aud) {
          addAttachment({
            ...aud,
            mimeType: aud.mimeType || 'audio/webm',
            name: aud.originalName || aud.fileName || 'Voice Recording',
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. Check message.parts for file or audio parts
    if (Array.isArray(message.parts)) {
      message.parts.forEach((p) => {
        if (p.type === 'file' || p.type === 'audio') {
          addAttachment({
            id: p.id || (p.file && p.file.id),
            _id: p._id || p.id || (p.file && p.file.id),
            name: p.filename || p.name || (p.file && p.file.name),
            originalName: p.originalName || p.filename || p.name || (p.file && p.file.name),
            fileName: p.filename || p.name || (p.file && p.file.name),
            size: p.size || (p.file && p.file.size),
            mimeType: p.mediaType || p.mimeType || (p.file && p.file.type) || (p.type === 'audio' ? 'audio/webm' : ''),
            url: p.url || (p.file && p.file.url),
            path: p.path,
            duration: p.duration,
            file: p.file || null,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [message]);

  // Local interaction states
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [hasOverflow, setHasOverflow] = useState(false);
  const draftTextRef = useRef(initialText);
  const hasDraftTextRef = useRef(Boolean(initialText && initialText.trim()));
  const [hasDraftText, setHasDraftText] = useState(Boolean(initialText && initialText.trim()));
  const [draftAttachments, setDraftAttachments] = useState(initialAttachments);

  // Snapshot ref for restoring state on cancel
  const snapshotRef = useRef({ text: initialText, attachments: initialAttachments });
  const [isModified, setIsModified] = useState(false);
  const contentRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const editContainerRef = useRef(null);

  // Measure content scrollHeight in View Mode to determine if auto-collapse clamping applies
  const measureHeight = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEditing && contentRef.current) {
      const scrollH = contentRef.current.scrollHeight;
      setHasOverflow(scrollH > CLAMP_HEIGHT_PX);
    }
  }, [isEditing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    measureHeight();
    window.addEventListener('resize', measureHeight);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', measureHeight);
  }, [measureHeight, initialText]);

  // 1. EDIT MODE LIFECYCLE HANDLERS
  const handleDraftTextChange = useCallback((val) => {
    draftTextRef.current = val;
    const hasNow = Boolean(val && val.trim().length > 0);
    if (hasNow !== hasDraftTextRef.current) {
      hasDraftTextRef.current = hasNow;
      setHasDraftText(hasNow);
    }
    const textChanged = (val ?? '').trim() !== (snapshotRef.current.text ?? '').trim();
    const attsChanged = draftAttachments.length !== snapshotRef.current.attachments.length;
    setIsModified(textChanged || attsChanged);
  }, [draftAttachments.length]);

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback(() => {
    newlyUploadedFilesRef.current = [];
    draftTextRef.current = initialText;
    hasDraftTextRef.current = Boolean(initialText && initialText.trim());
    setHasDraftText(Boolean(initialText && initialText.trim()));
    setDraftAttachments(initialAttachments);
    snapshotRef.current = {
      text: initialText,
      attachments: [...initialAttachments],
    };
    setIsModified(false);
    setIsExpanded(true);
    setIsEditing(true);
  }, [initialText, initialAttachments]);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    // Abort in-flight uploads and clean up newly uploaded assets from this edit session
    if (Array.isArray(newlyUploadedFilesRef.current) && newlyUploadedFilesRef.current.length > 0) {
      newlyUploadedFilesRef.current.forEach((item) => {
        if (item?.file) {
          const uploadStatus = removeUpload(item.file);
          if (!uploadStatus?.wasUploading && (uploadStatus?.publicId || item.publicId || item.fileName)) {
            void deleteComposerAttachment({
              publicId: uploadStatus?.publicId || item.publicId,
              fileName: uploadStatus?.fileName || item.fileName,
              mimeType: uploadStatus?.mimeType || item.mimeType,
            });
          }
        }
      });
      newlyUploadedFilesRef.current = [];
    }

    draftTextRef.current = snapshotRef.current.text;
    hasDraftTextRef.current = Boolean(snapshotRef.current.text && snapshotRef.current.text.trim());
    setHasDraftText(Boolean(snapshotRef.current.text && snapshotRef.current.text.trim()));
    setDraftAttachments(snapshotRef.current.attachments);
    setIsModified(false);
    setIsEditing(false);
  }, [deleteComposerAttachment]);

  // Click-outside listener on edit container to safely auto-collapse back to view mode on blur
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (editContainerRef.current && editContainerRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        return;
      }
      if (event.target && event.target.tagName === 'INPUT' && event.target.type === 'file') {
        return;
      }
      handleCancelEdit();
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isEditing, handleCancelEdit]);

  const handleToggleExpand = useCallback(() => {
    setIsExpanded((prev) => !prev);
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveAttachment = useCallback((idToRemove) => {
    setDraftAttachments((prev) => {
      const target = prev.find((att) => {
        const id = att.id || att._id || att.fileName || att.name;
        return (
          id === idToRemove ||
          att.id === idToRemove ||
          att._id === idToRemove ||
          att.fileName === idToRemove
        );
      });

      if (target?.file) {
        const uploadStatus = removeUpload(target.file);
        if (uploadStatus && !uploadStatus.wasUploading && (uploadStatus.publicId || target.publicId || target.fileName)) {
          void deleteComposerAttachment({
            publicId: uploadStatus.publicId || target.publicId,
            fileName: uploadStatus.fileName || target.fileName || target.name,
            mimeType: uploadStatus.mimeType || target.mimeType || target.file.type,
          });
        }
        newlyUploadedFilesRef.current = newlyUploadedFilesRef.current.filter((item) => item.file !== target.file);
      }

      const next = prev.filter((att) => {
        const id = att.id || att._id || att.fileName || att.name;
        return (
          id !== idToRemove &&
          att.id !== idToRemove &&
          att._id !== idToRemove &&
          att.fileName !== idToRemove
        );
      });

      const textChanged = (draftTextRef.current ?? '').trim() !== (snapshotRef.current.text ?? '').trim();
      const attsChanged = next.length !== snapshotRef.current.attachments.length;
      setIsModified(textChanged || attsChanged);
      return next;
    });
  }, [deleteComposerAttachment]);

  const handleAttachFiles = useCallback((newFiles) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(newFiles) || newFiles.length === 0) return;

    const currentFiles = draftAttachments.map((a) => a.file).filter(Boolean);
    const validation = validateChatAttachments(newFiles, currentFiles, { showToast: true });
    if (!validation.isValid || !Array.isArray(validation.validFiles) || validation.validFiles.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const validFiles = validation.validFiles;

    validFiles.forEach((file, idx) => {
      const isAudio = isAudioAttachment(file);
      const tempId = `draft-${Date.now()}-${idx}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;

      const initialItem = {
        id: tempId,
        name: file.name,
        fileName: file.name,
        originalName: file.name,
        size: file.size,
        mimeType: file.type || (isAudio ? 'audio/webm' : 'application/octet-stream'),
        type: isAudio ? 'audio' : (file.type?.startsWith('image/') ? 'image' : 'doc'),
        file,
        isUploading: true,
      };

      setDraftAttachments((prev) => [...prev, initialItem]);
      setIsModified(true);

      const formData = new FormData();
      let mutationPromise;
      if (isAudio) {
        formData.append('audios', file);
        mutationPromise = uploadAudio(formData);
      } else {
        formData.append('attachments', file);
        mutationPromise = uploadAttachments(formData);
      }

      const uploadPromise = mutationPromise
        .unwrap()
        .then((res) => {
          let itemData = null;
          if (isAudio) {
            const list = res?.data?.audios || res?.audios || [];
            itemData = list[0] ? { ...list[0], isAudio: true } : null;
          } else {
            const list = res?.data?.attachments || res?.attachments || [];
            itemData = list[0] ? { ...list[0], isAudio: false } : null;
          }

          if (itemData) {
            const record = {
              file,
              publicId: itemData.publicId,
              fileName: itemData.fileName || file.name,
              mimeType: itemData.mimeType || file.type,
              isAudio,
              _id: itemData._id || itemData.id,
            };
            newlyUploadedFilesRef.current.push(record);

            setDraftAttachments((prev) =>
              prev.map((att) => {
                if (att.id === tempId || att.file === file) {
                  return {
                    ...att,
                    ...itemData,
                    id: String(itemData._id || itemData.id || att.id),
                    _id: itemData._id || itemData.id,
                    url: itemData.url || att.url,
                    path: itemData.path || att.path,
                    cloudUrl: itemData.cloudUrl,
                    publicId: itemData.publicId,
                    isUploading: false,
                  };
                }
                return att;
              })
            );
          }
          return itemData;
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          setDraftAttachments((prev) =>
            prev.map((att) => {
              if (att.id === tempId || att.file === file) {
                return { ...att, isUploading: false, error: err };
              }
              return att;
            })
          );
          throw err;
        });

      const abortFn = () => {
        try {
          if (mutationPromise && typeof mutationPromise.abort === 'function') {
            mutationPromise.abort();
          }
        } catch {
          // Ignored on abort
        }
      };

      const onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup = (result) => {
        if (result) {
          const publicId = result.publicId;
          const fileName = result.fileName;
          const mimeType = result.mimeType || file.type;
          void deleteComposerAttachment({ publicId, fileName, mimeType });
        }
      };

      registerUpload(file, uploadPromise, abortFn, onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup);
    });
  }, [draftAttachments, uploadAudio, uploadAttachments, deleteComposerAttachment]);

  // 2. LINEAR PRUNING SUBMISSION HANDLER
  const handleSubmitEdit = useCallback(async () => {
    const isAnyUploading = draftAttachments.some(
      (att) => att.isUploading || (att.file && getUploadState(att.file).isUploading)
    );
    if (isAnyUploading) {
      toast.warning('Please wait for attachments to finish uploading.');
      return;
    }

    const textToSubmit = (inputRef.current?.value ?? draftTextRef.current ?? '').trim();
    if (!textToSubmit && draftAttachments.length === 0) return;

    // Validate cumulative batch size before submission
    const totalBatchSize = draftAttachments.reduce((sum, att) => sum + (Number(att.size) || 0), 0);
    if (totalBatchSize > ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_BATCH_SIZE_BYTES) {
      toast.error('Total attachment batch size cannot exceed 50MB. Please remove some attachments.');
      return;
    }

    // Mark uploads as committed so cancel cleanup won't purge them
    newlyUploadedFilesRef.current = [];

    // Resolve target turn index k in conversation
    const currentIds = Array.isArray(messageIds) ? messageIds : store.state.messageIds;
    const turnIndex = currentIds.indexOf(messageId);

    // Apply linear history pruning to client store: slice all messages > turnIndex
    if (turnIndex !== -1 && store && typeof store.update === 'function') {
      const slicedIds = currentIds.slice(0, turnIndex);
      const slicedById = {};
      slicedIds.forEach((id) => {
        if (store.state.messagesById[id]) {
          slicedById[id] = store.state.messagesById[id];
        }
      });
      store.update({
        messageIds: slicedIds,
        messagesById: slicedById,
      });
    }

    setIsEditing(false);

    // Build complete parts array containing both text and attachments
    const parts = [];
    if (textToSubmit) {
      parts.push({ type: 'text', text: textToSubmit });
    }
    draftAttachments.forEach((att) => {
      const actualFile = (att instanceof File || att instanceof Blob) ? att : att.file;
      const mime = (att.mimeType || att.type || (actualFile && actualFile.type) || '').toLowerCase();
      const name = (att.name || att.originalName || att.fileName || (actualFile && actualFile.name) || '').toLowerCase();
      const isAudio =
        mime.startsWith('audio/') ||
        mime.includes('webm') ||
        name.endsWith('.webm') ||
        name.endsWith('.wav') ||
        name.endsWith('.mp3') ||
        name.endsWith('.m4a') ||
        name.endsWith('.aac') ||
        name.endsWith('.ogg') ||
        name.endsWith('.mp4');

      parts.push({
        type: isAudio ? 'audio' : 'file',
        id: att.id || att._id,
        _id: att._id || att.id,
        audioId: att.audioId || (isAudio ? (att._id || att.id) : null),
        filename: att.originalName || att.name || att.fileName || (actualFile && actualFile.name),
        name: att.originalName || att.name || att.fileName || (actualFile && actualFile.name),
        originalName: att.originalName || att.name || att.fileName || (actualFile && actualFile.name),
        fileName: att.fileName || att.originalName || att.name || (actualFile && actualFile.name),
        mediaType: att.mimeType || att.type || (actualFile && actualFile.type),
        mimeType: att.mimeType || att.type || (actualFile && actualFile.type),
        size: att.size || (actualFile && actualFile.size),
        url: att.url,
        path: att.path,
        publicId: att.publicId,
        cloudUrl: att.cloudUrl,
        duration: att.duration,
        file: actualFile,
      });
    });

    // Dispatch edited turn through actions.sendMessage with editTurnIndex and isEdit metadata
    if (actions && typeof actions.sendMessage === 'function') {
      await actions.sendMessage({
        parts,
        attachments: draftAttachments,
        metadata: {
          isEdit: true,
          editTurnIndex: turnIndex >= 0 ? turnIndex : undefined,
          anchorUserMessageId: messageId,
        },
      });
    }
  }, [draftAttachments, messageId, messageIds, store, actions]);

  // 3. RETRY HANDLER FOR FAILED TURNS
  const handleRetry = useCallback(async () => {
    const currentIds = Array.isArray(messageIds) ? messageIds : store?.state?.messageIds || [];
    const turnIndex = currentIds.findIndex((id) => String(id) === String(messageId));
    const nextAssistantId = turnIndex >= 0 && turnIndex + 1 < currentIds.length ? currentIds[turnIndex + 1] : null;

    if (nextAssistantId && actions && typeof actions.regenerate === 'function') {
      try {
        await actions.regenerate(nextAssistantId);
        return;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[MuiUserMessage] actions.regenerate fallback to retry:', err);
      }
    }

    if (adapter && typeof adapter.retryTurn === 'function') {
      try {
        await adapter.retryTurn({
          conversationId: message?.conversationId || adapter.currentChatId,
          targetAssistantMessageId: nextAssistantId,
          anchorUserMessageId: messageId,
          store,
        });
        return;
      } catch (adapterErr) {
        console.warn('[MuiUserMessage] adapter.retryTurn fallback:', adapterErr);
      }
    }

    if (actions && typeof actions.retry === 'function') {
      await actions.retry(messageId);
    }
  }, [actions, adapter, message, messageId, messageIds, store]);

  if (!message) return null;

  const status = message.status || 'idle';
  const isAnyUploading = draftAttachments.some(
    (att) => att.isUploading || (att.file && getUploadState(att.file).isUploading)
  );
  const disabledSubmit = !isModified || isAnyUploading || (!hasDraftText && draftAttachments.length === 0);

  // 1. EDIT MODE: Unified single outlined editor card ("Keep the UI on edit mode as it is")
  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <Paper
        ref={editContainerRef}
        variant="outlined"
        className="MuiUserMessage-root"
        sx={{
          position: 'relative',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignSelf: 'flex-end',
          justifySelf: 'end',
          gridArea: 'content',
          ml: 'auto',
          width: '100%',
          minWidth: { xs: '90%', sm: 420 },
          maxWidth: { xs: '92%', sm: '85%', md: '80%', lg: '75%' },
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          color: 'text.primary',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: 'primary.main',
          borderRadius: '16px',
          p: 1.5,
          boxShadow: 'none',
        }}
      >
        {/* ROW 1: TOP MEDIA & ATTACHMENT SHELF (single-line horizontal scroll) */}
        <MuiUserAttachmentShelf
          attachments={draftAttachments}
          isEditing={true}
          onRemoveAttachment={handleRemoveAttachment}
        />

        {/* ROW 2: MIDDLE CONVERSATIONAL BODY (auto-expanding InputBase, 0 scrollbars) */}
        <MuiUserMessageBody
          text={initialText}
          isEditing={true}
          isExpanded={isExpanded}
          hasOverflow={hasOverflow}
          draftText={initialText}
          onDraftTextChange={handleDraftTextChange}
          contentRef={contentRef}
          inputRef={inputRef}
        />

        {/* ROW 3: BOTTOM ACTIONS (Attach on left, Cancel and Send on right) */}
        <MuiUserMessageBottomBar
          status={status}
          text={initialText}
          isEditing={true}
          onStartEdit={handleStartEdit}
          onCancelEdit={handleCancelEdit}
          onSubmitEdit={handleSubmitEdit}
          onRetry={handleRetry}
          onAttachFiles={handleAttachFiles}
          disabledSubmit={disabledSubmit}
          createdAt={message.createdAt}
          editedAt={message.editedAt}
        />
      </Paper>
    );
  }

  // 2. VIEW MODE: Decoupled topology (media_1791646169233.png)
  // Row 1 (Top outside): Standalone attachment pills flex-wrapped to the right
  // Row 2 (Middle): The ONLY outlined card (only text, with docked [⌵] chevron if clamped)
  // Row 3 (Bottom outside): Action buttons deck or inline error recovery strip
  const hasText = Boolean(initialText && initialText.trim());

  // Defensive Guard for Empty/Ghost User Turns (Case 1):
  // If a user turn contains neither text nor attachments, it possesses zero conversational payload
  // and must strictly emit null to prevent rendering orphan floating timestamps and action buttons.
  if (!hasText && initialAttachments.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Box
      className="MuiUserMessage-root"
      sx={{
        position: 'relative',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'flex-end',
        alignSelf: 'flex-end',
        justifySelf: 'end',
        gridArea: 'content',
        ml: 'auto',
        width: 'fit-content',
        minWidth: { xs: 140, sm: 160 },
        maxWidth: { xs: '92%', sm: '85%', md: '80%', lg: '75%' },
        gap: 0.75,
      }}
    >
      {/* ROW 1 (OUTSIDE CARD): STANDALONE ATTACHMENT PILLS */}
      <MuiUserAttachmentShelf
        attachments={initialAttachments}
        isEditing={false}
      />

      {/* ROW 2 (THE ONLY OUTLINED CARD): MESSAGE BODY */}
      {hasText && (
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            position: 'relative',
            width: 'fit-content',
            minWidth: { xs: 140, sm: 180 },
            maxWidth: '100%',
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            color: 'text.primary',
            border: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            borderRadius: '16px',
            p: 1.5,
            boxShadow: 'none',
            transition: 'border-color 150ms ease',
            '&:hover': {
              borderColor: 'text.secondary',
            },
          }}
        >
          <MuiUserMessageBody
            text={initialText}
            isEditing={false}
            isExpanded={isExpanded}
            hasOverflow={hasOverflow}
            contentRef={contentRef}
          />

          {hasOverflow && (
            <Tooltip title={isExpanded ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}>
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                onClick={handleToggleExpand}
                aria-label={isExpanded ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  right: 8,
                  bottom: 8,
                  width: 24,
                  height: 24,
                  minWidth: 24,
                  minHeight: 24,
                  p: 0,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  color: 'text.secondary',
                  bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.background.paper, 0.85),
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  boxShadow: 'none',
                  backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                  '&:hover': {
                    bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.action.hover, 0.9),
                    color: 'text.primary',
                  },
                }}
              >
                {isExpanded ? (
                  <ExpandLessIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                ) : (
                  <ExpandMoreIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                )}
              </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Paper>
      )}

      {/* ROW 3 (OUTSIDE CARD): BOTTOM ACTIONS & RETRY DECK */}
      <MuiUserMessageBottomBar
        status={status}
        text={initialText}
        isEditing={false}
        onStartEdit={handleStartEdit}
        onCancelEdit={handleCancelEdit}
        onSubmitEdit={handleSubmitEdit}
        onRetry={handleRetry}
        onAttachFiles={handleAttachFiles}
        disabledSubmit={disabledSubmit}
        createdAt={message.createdAt}
        editedAt={message.editedAt}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiUserMessage.propTypes = {
  messageId: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]).isRequired,
};

export default MuiUserMessage;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiUserMessageBody
 * @description Middle conversational row of the user message card.
 * In View Mode: Formatted typography (1rem / 16px, pre-wrap, line-height 1.6) with auto-collapse clamping (>220px) and bottom gradient fade.
 * In Edit Mode: Unconstrained auto-expanding InputBase drafting pad with absolute zero scrollbars.
 */

import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import InputBase from '@mui/material/InputBase';


/**
 * Middle-row conversational body for User Message.
 *
 * @component MuiUserMessageBody
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} props.text - Persisted message text.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isEditing=false] - Whether card is in Edit Mode.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isExpanded=false] - Whether long text is expanded.
 * @param {boolean} [props.hasOverflow=false] - Whether text height exceeds clamp threshold.
 * @param {string} [props.draftText=''] - Edit buffer text.
 * @param {Function} [props.onDraftTextChange] - Callback when edit buffer updates.
 * @param {import('react').RefObject} [props.contentRef] - Ref to measure content height.
 * @param {import('react').RefObject} [props.inputRef] - Ref to the editing InputBase DOM textarea.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered message body.
 */
export const MuiUserMessageBody = ({
  text = '',
  isEditing = false,
  isExpanded = false,
  hasOverflow = false,
  draftText = '',
  onDraftTextChange,
  contentRef,
  inputRef,
}) => {
  const localInputRef = useRef(null);
  const activeInputRef = inputRef || localInputRef;

  // Auto-focus and place caret at the end of text when entering Edit Mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEditing && activeInputRef.current) {
      const textarea = activeInputRef.current;
      textarea.value = draftText;
      textarea.focus();
      const len = textarea.value?.length || 0;
      textarea.setSelectionRange?.(len, len);
    }
  }, [isEditing, draftText, activeInputRef]);

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: '100%',
          minHeight: 48,
          py: 0.5,
        }}
      >
        <InputBase
          inputRef={activeInputRef}
          multiline
          minRows={2}
          maxRows={undefined}
          defaultValue={draftText}
          onChange={(e) => {
            if (typeof onDraftTextChange === 'function') {
              onDraftTextChange(e.target.value);
            }
          }}
          placeholder="Edit your message..."
          fullWidth
          sx={{
            fontSize: '1rem',
            lineHeight: 1.6,
            color: 'text.primary',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            scrollbarWidth: 'none',
            '& textarea': {
              overflow: 'hidden !important',
              scrollbarWidth: 'none !important',
              resize: 'none',
              lineHeight: 1.6,
              fontSize: '1rem',
              p: 0,
            },
            '& ::-webkit-scrollbar': {
              display: 'none',
            },
          }}
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // In View Mode, if there is no text content (e.g. attachment-only message), collapse completely
  if (!isEditing && (!text || !text.trim())) {
    return null;
  }

  const shouldClamp = hasOverflow && !isExpanded;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        overflow: 'visible',
      }}
    >
      <Typography
        ref={contentRef}
        variant="body1"
        component="div"
        sx={{
          fontSize: '1rem',
          lineHeight: 1.6,
          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
          wordBreak: 'break-word',
          color: 'text.primary',
          ...(shouldClamp
            ? {
                display: '-webkit-box',
                WebkitLineClamp: 8,
                WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                overflow: 'hidden',
              }
            : {
                display: 'block',
                overflow: 'visible',
              }),
        }}
      >
        {text}
      </Typography>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiUserMessageBody.propTypes = {
  text: PropTypes.string,
  isEditing: PropTypes.bool,
  isExpanded: PropTypes.bool,
  hasOverflow: PropTypes.bool,
  draftText: PropTypes.string,
  onDraftTextChange: PropTypes.func,
  contentRef: PropTypes.oneOfType([
    PropTypes.func,
    PropTypes.shape({ current: PropTypes.any }),
  ]),
  inputRef: PropTypes.oneOfType([
    PropTypes.func,
    PropTypes.shape({ current: PropTypes.any }),
  ]),
};

export default MuiUserMessageBody;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/chat/MuiUserMessageBottomBar
 * @description Bottom contextual row of the user message card.
 * In Normal View Mode: Elevated action pill on hover ([Copy], [Edit], and [Expand/Collapse] chevron).
 * In Error View Mode: Replaces normal hover action pill with an Inline Warning Recovery Strip
 *                     (zero bgcolor, warning.main text/icon, [Retry], and [Edit] buttons).
 * In Edit Mode: Full-width action bar with [Attach File] on left, [Cancel] and [Send/Submit] on right.
 */

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import ContentCopyIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContentCopy';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import AttachFileIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AttachFile';
import { ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS, AUDIO_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Formats timestamp for display.
 * @param {string|Date} dateStr
 * @param {boolean} isEdited
 * @returns {string} Formatted timestamp string (e.g. "14:32 (edited)").
 */
const formatTimestamp = (dateStr, isEdited) => {
  if (!dateStr) return isEdited ? '(edited)' : '';
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    const time = d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    return isEdited ? `${time} (edited)` : time;
  } catch {
    return isEdited ? '(edited)' : '';
  }
};

/**
 * Bottom action and retry deck for User Message.
 *
 * @component MuiUserMessageBottomBar
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {string} [props.status='idle'] - Turn status ('success'|'error'|'streaming'|'idle').
 * @param {string} [props.text=''] - Message text to copy.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isEditing=false] - Whether card is in Edit Mode.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isExpanded=false] - Whether long text is expanded.
 * @param {boolean} [props.hasOverflow=false] - Whether text height exceeds clamp threshold.
 * @param {Function} [props.onToggleExpand] - Toggle expand/collapse callback.
 * @param {Function} [props.onStartEdit] - Trigger edit mode callback.
 * @param {Function} [props.onCancelEdit] - Cancel edit mode callback.
 * @param {Function} [props.onSubmitEdit] - Submit edited turn callback.
 * @param {Function} [props.onRetry] - Retry failed turn callback.
 * @param {Function} [props.onAttachFiles] - Callback receiving newly selected files.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabledSubmit=false] - Whether submit button is disabled.
 * @param {string|Date} [props.createdAt] - Creation timestamp.
 * @param {string|Date} [props.editedAt] - Edit timestamp.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered bottom bar.
 */
export const MuiUserMessageBottomBar = ({
  status = 'idle',
  text = '',
  isEditing = false,
  onStartEdit,
  onCancelEdit,
  onSubmitEdit,
  onRetry,
  onAttachFiles,
  disabledSubmit = false,
  createdAt,
  editedAt,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copyTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(true);
      if (copyTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimeoutRef.current);
      copyTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopied(false);
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }
  };

  const handleFileInputChange = (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length > 0 && typeof onAttachFiles === 'function') {
      onAttachFiles(files);
    }
    // Reset file input value to allow re-attaching same file if deleted
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  // 1. EDIT MODE: Full-width action bar
  if (isEditing) {
    // Build accepted extensions list
    const acceptedExtensions = [
      ...ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS,
      ...AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS,
    ].join(',');

    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
          mt: 1,
          pt: 1,
          borderTop: 1,
          borderColor: 'divider',
        }}
      >
        {/* Left: Attach file trigger */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            multiple
            accept={acceptedExtensions}
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
            onChange={handleFileInputChange}
          />
          <Tooltip title="Attach files, audios, or images">
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              aria-label="Attach file to message"
              sx={{
                color: 'text.secondary',
                '&:hover': {
                  color: 'primary.main',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                },
              }}
            >
              <AttachFileIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>

        {/* Right: Cancel & Send action pills */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            onClick={onCancelEdit}
            sx={{
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.8125rem',
              color: 'text.secondary',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              px: 1.5,
              py: 0.25,
              minWidth: 64,
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              },
            }}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>

          <Tooltip
            title={
              disabledSubmit
                ? 'Enter text or attach a file/image to send, and wait for any active uploads to complete.'
                : 'Save and submit edit'
            }
            arrow
            placement="top"
          >
            <span>
              <Button
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                disabled={disabledSubmit}
                onClick={onSubmitEdit}
                sx={{
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  px: 1.75,
                  py: 0.25,
                  minWidth: 68,
                  boxShadow: 'none',
                  '&:hover': {
                    boxShadow: 'none',
                  },
                }}
              >
                Send
              </Button>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // 2. ERROR STATE VIEW MODE: Inline Warning Recovery Strip (Zero bgcolor, warning.main text)
  if (status === 'error') {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          width: '100%',
          mt: 0.75,
          pt: 0.5,
          bgcolor: 'transparent',
        }}
      >
        {/* Warning Indicator */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
          <WarningAmberIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'warning.main' }} />
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            sx={{
              color: 'warning.main',
              fontWeight: 500,
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            Failed to complete response
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {/* Direct Recovery Controls */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            startIcon={<ReplayIcon sx={{ fontSize: '15px !important' }} />}
            onClick={onRetry}
            sx={{
              color: 'warning.main',
              bgcolor: 'transparent',
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              fontWeight: 600,
              p: '2px 8px',
              minWidth: 0,
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              },
            }}
          >
            Retry
          </Button>

          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '15px !important' }} />}
            onClick={onStartEdit}
            sx={{
              color: 'warning.main',
              bgcolor: 'transparent',
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              fontWeight: 500,
              p: '2px 8px',
              minWidth: 0,
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              },
            }}
          >
            Edit
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  // 3. NORMAL VIEW MODE: Timestamp on left, Elevated Hover Action Pill on right
  const timeString = formatTimestamp(createdAt, Boolean(editedAt));

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'flex-end',
        gap: 0.75,
        width: '100%',
        mt: 0.5,
        minHeight: 26,
        opacity: { xs: 1, sm: 0 },
        transition: 'opacity 150ms ease',
        '.MuiUserMessage-root:hover &': {
          opacity: 1,
        },
      }}
    >
      {/* Timestamp / Edited indicator */}
      {timeString && (
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            color: 'text.disabled',
            fontSize: '0.6875rem',
            userSelect: 'none',
            mr: 0.5,
          }}
        >
          {timeString}
        </Typography>
      )}

      {/* Flat action deck (zero background color, transparent icons) */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 0.25,
          bgcolor: 'transparent',
        }}
      >
        {/* Copy button (rendered only when message text is non-empty) */}
        {Boolean(text && text.trim()) && (
          <Tooltip title={copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy prompt'}>
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              onClick={handleCopy}
              aria-label="Copy prompt text"
              sx={{
                p: 0.5,
                width: 26,
                height: 26,
                minWidth: 26,
                minHeight: 26,
                color: copied ? 'success.main' : 'text.secondary',
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                boxShadow: 'none !important',
                border: 'none !important',
                '&:hover': {
                  color: 'text.primary',
                  bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                },
                '&:active': {
                  bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                },
                '&:focus': {
                  bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
                },
              }}
            >
              {copied ? (
                <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />
              ) : (
                <ContentCopyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />
              )}
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        )}

        {/* Edit button */}
        <Tooltip title="Edit prompt">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={onStartEdit}
            aria-label="Edit prompt text"
            sx={{
              p: 0.5,
              width: 26,
              height: 26,
              minWidth: 26,
              minHeight: 26,
              color: 'text.secondary',
              bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              boxShadow: 'none !important',
              border: 'none !important',
              '&:hover': {
                color: 'text.primary',
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              },
              '&:active': {
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              },
              '&:focus': {
                bgcolor: 'transparent !important',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent !important',
              },
            }}
          >
            <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

MuiUserMessageBottomBar.propTypes = {
  status: PropTypes.string,
  text: PropTypes.string,
  isEditing: PropTypes.bool,
  onStartEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onCancelEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onSubmitEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onRetry: PropTypes.func,
  onAttachFiles: PropTypes.func,
  disabledSubmit: PropTypes.bool,
  createdAt: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
  editedAt: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
};

export default MuiUserMessageBottomBar;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/columns/auditHistoryColumns
 * @description Colocated column definitions for the Historical Inspections Ledger DataGrid.
 * Adheres strictly to the Universal Column Sizing Invariant (fluid flex with minWidth)
 * and displays actual schema statuses for activities and issues (zero fake stubs).
 */

import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import OpenInNewIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInNew';
import EventOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EventOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';

/**
 * Factory creating DataGrid column definitions for branch historical audit visits.
 *
 * @function getAuditHistoryColumns
 * @param {object} options - Options and handlers.
 * @param {string} options.branchId - Active branch identifier.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} options.onViewReport - View report dossier handler.
 * @returns {Array<object>} Column configurations.
 */
export const getAuditHistoryColumns = ({ branchId, onViewReport } = {}) => [
  {
    field: 'date',
    headerName: 'Inspection Date',
    flex: 1.0,
    minWidth: 130,
    valueGetter: (_value, row) => {
      if (!row?.date) return 'N/A';
      return new Date(row.date).toISOString().split('T')[0];
    },
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
        <EventOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'primary.main' }} />
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {params.value}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'ethiopianDate',
    headerName: 'Ethiopian Date',
    flex: 0.9,
    minWidth: 110,
    valueGetter: (_value, row) => row?.ethiopianDate || '—',
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Chip
        label={params.value}
        size="small"
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 500 }}
      />
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'shiftHours',
    headerName: 'Shift Hours',
    flex: 1.1,
    minWidth: 130,
    valueGetter: (_value, row) => {
      const visit = (row?.visits || []).find(
        (v) => String(v.branch?._id || v.branch) === String(branchId)
      ) || row?.visits?.[0];

      if (visit && visit.clockIn && visit.clockOut) {
        return `${visit.clockIn} - ${visit.clockOut}`;
      }
      if (row?.clockIn && row?.clockOut) {
        return `${row.clockIn} - ${row.clockOut}`;
      }
      return '08:30 - 17:00';
    },
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
        <AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
        <Typography variant="body2">{params.value}</Typography>
      </Box>
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'activities',
    headerName: 'Activities (By Real Status)',
    flex: 1.5,
    minWidth: 190,
    renderCell: (params) => {
      const activities = params.row?.activities || [];
      const completed = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'completed').length;
      const inProgress = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'in_progress').length;

      return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <Tooltip title="Completed Activities">
            <Chip
              label={`${completed} completed`}
              size="small"
              color="success"
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
            />
          </Tooltip>
          {inProgress > 0 && (
            <Tooltip title="In-Progress Activities">
              <Chip
                label={`${inProgress} in_progress`}
                size="small"
                color="info"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
              />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Box>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    field: 'issues',
    headerName: 'Issues (By Real Status)',
    flex: 1.5,
    minWidth: 190,
    renderCell: (params) => {
      const issues = params.row?.issues || [];
      const reported = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'reported').length;
      const inProgress = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'in_progress').length;
      const completed = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'completed').length;
      const noIssue = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'no_issue').length;

      return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {reported > 0 && (
            <Tooltip title="Reported Issues">
              <Chip
                label={`${reported} reported`}
                size="small"
                color="error"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
              />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          {inProgress > 0 && (
            <Tooltip title="In-Progress Issues">
              <Chip
                label={`${inProgress} in_prog`}
                size="small"
                color="warning"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
              />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          {completed > 0 && (
            <Tooltip title="Resolved Issues">
              <Chip
                label={`${completed} resolved`}
                size="small"
                color="success"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
              />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          {reported === 0 && inProgress === 0 && (
            <Chip
              label={noIssue > 0 ? 'no_issue' : '0 issues'}
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem', color: 'text.secondary' }}
            />
          )}
        </Box>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    field: 'actions',
    headerName: 'Dossier',
    flex: 0.9,
    minWidth: 120,
    sortable: false,
    filterable: false,
    renderCell: (params) => (
      onViewReport ? (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => onViewReport(params.row)}
          endIcon={<OpenInNewIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
          sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
        >
          View
        </Button>
      ) : null
    ),
  },
];

export default getAuditHistoryColumns;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/columns/branchColumns
 * @description Colocated column definitions for the Branch Directory DataGrid.
 * Strictly adheres to:
 * 1. Universal Column Sizing Invariant: Zero static widths, fluid flex with protective minWidth.
 * 2. Two-Phase Action Lifecycle: Active (View, Edit, Archive) vs Archived (View, Restore, Permanent Delete).
 * 3. Inline Loading State: Renders CircularProgress inline on row actions during background mutations.
 */

import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Link from '@mui/material/Link';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import { getCleanAliases } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Factory creating DataGrid column definitions for physical store branches.
 *
 * @function getBranchColumns
 * @param {object} handlers - Action triggers and loading state.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} handlers.onView - Navigation to branch details.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} handlers.onEdit - Open edit modal.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} handlers.onArchive - Open archive confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} handlers.onRestore - Open restore confirmation.
 * @param {(branch: object) => void} handlers.onDelete - Open permanent delete confirmation.
 * @param {object|null} [handlers.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [handlers.actionLoadingId=null] - Legacy fallback ID of mutating branch.
 * @returns {Array<object>} Array of DataGrid column configurations.
 */
export const getBranchColumns = ({
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
} = {}) => [
  {
    field: 'code',
    headerName: 'Code',
    flex: 0.8,
    minWidth: 110,
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Chip
        label={params.value || 'N/A'}
        size="small"
        variant="outlined"
        color="primary"
        sx={{ fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}
      />
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'name',
    headerName: 'Branch Name',
    flex: 1.6,
    minWidth: 200,
    renderCell: (params) => {
      const cleanAliases = getCleanAliases(params.row?.aliases, params.value);
      const visibleAliases = cleanAliases.slice(0, 2);
      const remainingCount = cleanAliases.length - visibleAliases.length;

      return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center', py: 0.5, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <Typography
            variant="body2"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary', lineHeight: 1.3, textOverflow: 'ellipsis', overflow: 'hidden' }}
          >
            {params.value}
          </Typography>
          {visibleAliases.length > 0 && (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.72rem', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
              >
                {visibleAliases.join(' • ')}
              </Typography>
              {remainingCount > 0 && (
                <Tooltip title={cleanAliases.slice(2).join(', ')} arrow>
                  <Typography
                    component="span"
                    variant="caption"
                    sx={{
                      color: 'primary.main',
                      fontSize: '0.70rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}
                  >
                    +{remainingCount}
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    field: 'subcity',
    headerName: 'Subcity',
    flex: 1.0,
    minWidth: 130,
    valueGetter: (_value, row) => row?.location?.subcity || 'Addis Ababa',
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
        <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary' }} />
        <Typography variant="body2">{params.value}</Typography>
      </Box>
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'managerName',
    headerName: 'Store Manager',
    flex: 1.2,
    minWidth: 160,
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
        {params.value || 'Unassigned'}
      </Typography>
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'contactPhone',
    headerName: 'Telephone',
    flex: 1.1,
    minWidth: 140,
    renderCell: (params) => (
      params.value ? (
        <Link
          href={`tel:${params.value}`}
          underline="hover"
          sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, color: 'primary.main', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
        >
          <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
          {params.value}
        </Link>
      ) : (
        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
          None
        </Typography>
      )
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'isArchived',
    headerName: 'Status',
    flex: 0.8,
    minWidth: 110,
    renderCell: (params) => (
      <MuiStatusChip status={params.value ? 'archived' : 'active'} />
    ),
  },
  {
    field: 'actions',
    headerName: 'Actions',
    flex: 1.1,
    minWidth: 160,
    sortable: false,
    filterable: false,
    renderCell: (params) => {
      const isArchived = Boolean(params.row?.isArchived);
      const rowId = params.row?._id;
      const activeLoading = actionLoading || (actionLoadingId ? { id: actionLoadingId } : null);
      const isRowBusy = Boolean(activeLoading && activeLoading.id === rowId);

      const isArchiveLoading = isRowBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'archive' || (!activeLoading?.action && !isArchived));
      const isRestoreLoading = isRowBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'restore' || (!activeLoading?.action && isArchived));
      const isDeleteLoading = isRowBusy && activeLoading?.action === 'delete';

      return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
          {/* Universal View Details Action */}
          {onView && (
            <Tooltip title="View Inspection Profile">
              <span>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => onView(params.row)}
                  disabled={isRowBusy}
                  aria-label="view branch details"
                >
                  <VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}

          {!isArchived ? (
            /* Active Branch Actions: Edit, Archive */
            <>
              {onEdit && (
                <Tooltip title="Edit Branch">
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      onClick={() => onEdit(params.row)}
                      disabled={isRowBusy}
                      aria-label="edit branch"
                    >
                      <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              {onArchive && (
                <Tooltip title="Archive Branch">
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      onClick={() => onArchive(params.row)}
                      disabled={isRowBusy}
                      aria-label="archive branch"
                    >
                      {isArchiveLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            /* Archived Branch Actions: Restore, Permanent Delete */
            <>
              {onRestore && (
                <Tooltip title="Restore Branch">
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="primary"
                      onClick={() => onRestore(params.row)}
                      disabled={isRowBusy}
                      aria-label="restore branch"
                    >
                      {isRestoreLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                      ) : (
                        <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              {onDelete && (
                <Tooltip title="Permanently Delete (Cascade)">
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="error"
                      onClick={() => onDelete(params.row)}
                      disabled={isRowBusy}
                      aria-label="permanently delete branch"
                    >
                      {isDeleteLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                      ) : (
                        <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      );
    },
  },
];

export default getBranchColumns;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/columns/reportColumns
 * @description Colocated column definitions for the Operational Reports Archive DataGrid.
 * Strictly adheres to:
 * 1. Fluid Proportional Column Law: 100% flex + minWidth floors (zero static widths).
 * 2. Real Schema Statuses: Zero synthetic open/clean stubs.
 * 3. Temporal SSOT: Primary Gregorian date paired with derived Ethiopian calendar (ዓ.ም).
 * 4. Action-Scoped Loading & Restore Icon: Scoped { id, action } spinner, RestoreOutlinedIcon for unarchiving.
 */

import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';
import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import MuiReportTelegramShareButton from '../reports/MuiReportTelegramShareButton.jsx';
import { toEthiopianDateString, computeShiftDuration } from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Factory creating DataGrid column definitions for operational reports.
 *
 * @function getReportColumns
 * @param {object} handlers - Action triggers and loading state.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} handlers.onView - Navigation to report dossier.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [handlers.onEdit] - Navigation to report editor.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [handlers.onArchive] - Trigger report archival.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [handlers.onRestore] - Trigger report restoration.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [handlers.onDelete] - Trigger report cascade deletion.
 * @param {object|null} [handlers.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [handlers.actionLoadingId=null] - Legacy fallback ID of mutating report.
 * @param {boolean} [handlers.isArchived=false] - Whether displaying archived reports dataset.
 * @returns {Array<object>} Array of DataGrid column configurations.
 */
export const getReportColumns = ({
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
  isArchived = false,
} = {}) => [
    {
      field: 'date',
      headerName: 'Date',
      flex: 1.2,
      minWidth: 150,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const row = params.row;
        const gregorian = row?.date ? new Date(row.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : '—';
        const ethiopian = row?.ethiopianDate || toEthiopianDateString(row?.date);
        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center', py: 0.5 }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
              {gregorian}
            </Typography>
            {ethiopian && (
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                {ethiopian}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      field: 'branches',
      headerName: 'Visited Branches',
      flex: 1.8,
      minWidth: 200,
      sortable: false,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const visits = params.row?.visits || [];
        if (visits.length === 0) {
          return <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>No visits recorded</Typography>;
        }
        const firstTwo = visits.slice(0, 2);
        const remaining = visits.length - 2;

        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, flexWrap: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {firstTwo.map((v, idx) => {
              const b = v.branch;
              const code = b?.code || 'BR';
              const name = b?.name || 'Branch';
              const clockInfo = v.clockIn && v.clockOut ? ` • ${v.clockIn} - ${v.clockOut}` : '';
              return (
                <Tooltip key={v._id || idx} title={`${name} (${code})${clockInfo}`} arrow>
                  <Chip
                    label={code}
                    size="small"
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="primary"
                    sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22 }}
                  />
                </Tooltip>
              );
            })}
            {remaining > 0 && (
              <Tooltip
                arrow
                title={visits
                  .slice(2)
                  .map((v) => `${v.branch?.name || 'Branch'} (${v.branch?.code || 'BR'})`)
                  .join(', ')}
              >
                <Chip
                  label={`+${remaining}`}
                  size="small"
                  sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: 20, bgcolor: 'action.hover', fontWeight: 600 }}
                />
              </Tooltip>
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      field: 'shiftHours',
      headerName: 'Shift Hours',
      flex: 1.1,
      minWidth: 130,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const { clockIn, clockOut } = params.row || {};
        if (!clockIn || !clockOut) {
          return <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>—</Typography>;
        }
        const duration = computeShiftDuration(clockIn, clockOut);
        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center', py: 0.5 }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
              {clockIn} - {clockOut}
            </Typography>
            {duration && (
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                {duration}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      field: 'activities',
      headerName: 'Activities',
      flex: 1.2,
      minWidth: 140,
      sortable: false,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const acts = params.row?.activities || [];
        if (acts.length === 0) {
          return <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>None</Typography>;
        }
        const completed = acts.filter((a) => a.status === 'completed').length;
        const inProgress = acts.filter((a) => a.status === 'in_progress').length;

        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {completed > 0 && (
              <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completed} done`} size="small" />
            )}
            {inProgress > 0 && (
              <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgress} prog`} size="small" />
            )}
            {completed === 0 && inProgress === 0 && (
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>{acts.length} logged</Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      field: 'issues',
      headerName: 'Issues & Findings',
      flex: 1.5,
      minWidth: 170,
      sortable: false,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const issues = params.row?.issues || [];
        const reported = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'reported').length;
        const inProgress = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'in_progress').length;
        const completed = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'completed').length;

        if (issues.length === 0) {
          return <MuiStatusChip status="no_issue" label="No Issues" size="small" />;
        }

        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {reported > 0 && <MuiStatusChip status="reported" label={`${reported} flagged`} size="small" />}
            {inProgress > 0 && <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgress} open`} size="small" />}
            {completed > 0 && <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completed} solved`} size="small" />}
            {reported === 0 && inProgress === 0 && completed === 0 && (
              <MuiStatusChip status="no_issue" label="No Issues" size="small" />
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      field: 'actions',
      headerName: 'Actions',
      flex: 1.2,
      minWidth: 165,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const row = params.row;
        const isMutating = actionLoading?.id === row?._id || actionLoadingId === row?._id;
        const isArchiveLoading = isMutating && (actionLoading?.action === 'archive' || (!actionLoading?.action && isMutating));
        const isRestoreLoading = isMutating && (actionLoading?.action === 'restore' || (!actionLoading?.action && isMutating));
        const isDeleteLoading = isMutating && (actionLoading?.action === 'delete' || (!actionLoading?.action && isMutating));

        return (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
            {/* View Details Action */}
            {onView && (
              <Tooltip title="View Report Dossier" arrow>
                <span>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    color="primary"
                    onClick={() => onView(row)}
                    disabled={isMutating}
                    aria-label="view report dossier"
                  >
                    <VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            )}

            {/* Active Report Actions: Share to Telegram, Edit & Archive */}
            {!isArchived ? (
              <>
                <MuiReportTelegramShareButton
                  report={row}
                  disabled={isMutating}
                  size="small"
                />
                {onEdit && (
                  <Tooltip title="Edit Report" arrow>
                    <span>
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        color="default"
                        onClick={() => onEdit(row)}
                        disabled={isMutating}
                        aria-label="edit report"
                      >
                        <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </span>
                  </Tooltip>
                )}
                {onArchive && (
                  <Tooltip title="Archive Report" arrow>
                    <span>
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        color="warning"
                        onClick={() => onArchive(row)}
                        disabled={isMutating}
                        aria-label="archive report"
                      >
                        {isArchiveLoading ? (
                          <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                        ) : (
                          <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                        )}
                      </IconButton>
                    </span>
                  </Tooltip>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              /* Archived Report Actions: Restore & Permanent Delete */
              <>
                {onRestore && (
                  <Tooltip title="Restore Report" arrow>
                    <span>
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        color="success"
                        onClick={() => onRestore(row)}
                        disabled={isMutating}
                        aria-label="restore report"
                      >
                        {isRestoreLoading ? (
                          <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                        ) : (
                          <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                        )}
                      </IconButton>
                    </span>
                  </Tooltip>
                )}
                {onDelete && (
                  <Tooltip title="Permanently Delete (Cascade)" arrow>
                    <span>
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        color="error"
                        onClick={() => onDelete(row)}
                        disabled={isMutating}
                        aria-label="permanently delete report"
                      >
                        {isDeleteLoading ? (
                          <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                        ) : (
                          <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                        )}
                      </IconButton>
                    </span>
                  </Tooltip>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </Box>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

export default getReportColumns;
````
