/**
 * @module components/common/GlobalErrorFallback
 * @description Global fallback screen rendered by react-error-boundary when an unhandled runtime error occurs.
 * Provides empathetic recovery guidance, boundary retry, full reload, and return to safety navigation.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Collapse from '@mui/material/Collapse';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import HomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Home';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import ExpandMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore';
import ExpandLessIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandLess';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlined';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Global fallback screen rendered by react-error-boundary when an unhandled runtime exception occurs.
 *
 * @component GlobalErrorFallback
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Error} [props.error] - Runtime error caught by boundary.
 * @param {() => void} [props.resetErrorBoundary] - Error boundary reset callback.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered fallback error presentation.
 */
export const GlobalErrorFallback = ({ error, resetErrorBoundary }) => {
  const [showTechnicalDetails, setShowTechnicalDetails] = useState(false);

  const handleRetry = () => {
    if (typeof resetErrorBoundary === 'function') {
      resetErrorBoundary();
    } else {
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const handleFullReload = () => {
    window.location.reload();
  };

  const handleNavigateHome = () => {
    window.location.href = '/';
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        minHeight: '100dvh',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 4 },
        bgcolor: 'background.default',
      }}
    >
      <Paper
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          maxWidth: 520,
          width: '100%',
          p: { xs: 3, sm: 5 },
          textAlign: 'center',
          border: '1px solid',
          borderColor: 'divider',
          borderRadius: 3,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 2,
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            width: 64,
            height: 64,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: 'error.light',
            color: 'error.main',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            mb: 1,
          }}
        >
          <ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36 }} />
        </Box>

        <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={700} color="text.primary">
          Something went wrong
        </Typography>

        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ maxWidth: 420, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          We encountered an unexpected problem while displaying this view.
          Please try again, or reload the page to continue your operational session.
        </Typography>

        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 1.5,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            width: '100%',
            mt: 1,
          }}
        >
          {resetErrorBoundary && (
            <MuiButton
              size="small"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              startIcon={<ReplayIcon />}
              onClick={handleRetry}
            >
              Try Again
            </MuiButton>
          )}

          <MuiButton
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            color="primary"
            startIcon={<RefreshIcon />}
            onClick={handleFullReload}
          >
            Reload Page
          </MuiButton>

          <MuiButton
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            startIcon={<HomeIcon />}
            onClick={handleNavigateHome}
          >
            Return to Home
          </MuiButton>
        </Box>

        {error?.message && (
          <Box sx={{ width: '100%', mt: 2 }}>
            <MuiButton
              size="small"
              variant="text"
              color="inherit"
              onClick={() => setShowTechnicalDetails((prev) => !prev)}
              endIcon={showTechnicalDetails ? <ExpandLessIcon /> : <ExpandMoreIcon />}
              sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', textTransform: 'none', color: 'text.secondary' }}
            >
              {showTechnicalDetails ? 'Hide Details' : 'View Technical Details'}
            </MuiButton>

            <Collapse in={showTechnicalDetails}>
              <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  mt: 1,
                  p: 2,
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  textAlign: 'left',
                  maxHeight: 180,
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  fontFamily="monospace"
                  color="text.secondary"
                  component="pre"
                  sx={{ m: 0, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-word', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
                >
                  {error.message}
                </Typography>
              </Paper>
            </Collapse>
          </Box>
        )}
      </Paper>
    </Box>
  );
};

GlobalErrorFallback.propTypes = {
  error: PropTypes.shape({
    message: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  resetErrorBoundary: PropTypes.func,
};

export default GlobalErrorFallback;

/**
 * @module components/dashboard/DashboardAuditTrendChart
 * @description Executive continuous 14-day audit volume trend line chart.
 * Visualizes daily supervisor inspection activity over the trailing two weeks.
 * Adheres strictly to MUI X Charts performance invariants:
 * - Module-level frozen constants for layout, axis styling, and item-level tooltips.
 * - Point-scale x-axis ensuring clean temporal line interpolation.
 * - Container measurement ensuring safe non-negative SVG viewport width.
 */

import { memo, useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import { LineChart } from '@mui/x-charts/LineChart';
import TimelineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TimelineOutlined';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

/**
 * Frozen chart layout constants.
 */
const CHART_MARGIN = Object.freeze({ top: 15, bottom: 35, left: 35, right: 15 });
const AXIS_TICK_STYLE = Object.freeze({ fontSize: 10, angle: 0 });
const MIN_CHART_WIDTH = 120;

const CHART_SLOT_PROPS = Object.freeze({
  tooltip: Object.freeze({
    trigger: 'item',
  }),
});

const CHART_AXIS_HIGHLIGHT = Object.freeze({
  x: 'none',
  y: 'none',
});

const DEFAULT_Y_AXIS = Object.freeze([
  {
    id: 'trend-y-axis',
    scaleType: 'linear',
    min: 0,
  },
]);

const TREND_SERIES = Object.freeze([
  {
    type: 'line',
    id: 'audit-volume-series',
    dataKey: 'count',
    label: 'Audits',
    color: '#059669',
    area: true,
    showMark: true,
    curve: 'monotoneX',
    valueFormatter: (val) => `${val ?? 0} report${val === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
  },
]);

/**
 * 14-day continuous audit volume trajectory chart component.
 *
 * @component DashboardAuditTrendChart
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.data=[]] - Trailing 14-day audit trend [{ date, label, count }].
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether query is loading.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered chart container.
 */
export const DashboardAuditTrendChart = memo(({ data = [], isLoading = false }) => {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    const measureWidth = () => {
      if (containerRef.current) {
        const clientWidth = containerRef.current.clientWidth;
        if (clientWidth > 0) {
          setContainerWidth(clientWidth);
        }
      }
    };

    measureWidth();

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const measured = Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width);
        if (measured > 0) {
          setContainerWidth(measured);
        }
      }
    });

    resizeObserver.observe(containerRef.current);
    return () => resizeObserver.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return [];
    return data.map((item) => ({
      label: item.label || item.date?.slice(5) || '',
      count: item.count || 0,
    }));
  }, [data]);

  const xAxis = useMemo(() => [
    {
      id: 'trend-timeline-axis',
      scaleType: 'point',
      dataKey: 'label',
      tickLabelStyle: AXIS_TICK_STYLE,
    },
  ], []);

  const hasData = chartData.length > 0;
  const chartHeight = containerWidth < 450 ? 250 : (containerWidth > 750 ? 300 : 280);

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2, md: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: '10px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        borderColor: 'divider',
        height: { xs: 'auto', md: '100%' },
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ mb: 1.5 }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
          <TimelineOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: '#059669' }} />
          <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
            14-Day Audit Volume Trend
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
          Continuous daily operational inspection activity
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Box
        ref={containerRef}
        sx={{
          width: '100%',
          height: chartHeight,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
      >
        {isLoading ? (
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={chartHeight} sx={{ borderRadius: '8px' }} />
        ) : !hasData ? (
          <MuiEmptyState
            title="No Activity Logged"
            subtitle="Inspection reports filed in the last 14 days will appear here."
            sx={{ py: 4 }}
          />
        ) : containerWidth >= MIN_CHART_WIDTH ? (
          <LineChart
            dataset={chartData}
            xAxis={xAxis}
            yAxis={DEFAULT_Y_AXIS}
            series={TREND_SERIES}
            width={containerWidth}
            height={chartHeight}
            margin={CHART_MARGIN}
            slotProps={CHART_SLOT_PROPS}
            axisHighlight={CHART_AXIS_HIGHLIGHT}
          />
        ) : (
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={chartHeight} sx={{ borderRadius: '8px' }} />
        )}
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
});

DashboardAuditTrendChart.displayName = 'DashboardAuditTrendChart';

DashboardAuditTrendChart.propTypes = {
  data: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      date: PropTypes.string,
      label: PropTypes.string,
      count: PropTypes.number,
    })
  ),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default DashboardAuditTrendChart;

import { memo, useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export const DashboardBranchVisitChart = memo(({ data = [], isLoading = false }) => {

    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    const measureWidth = () => {
      if (containerRef.current) {
        const clientWidth = containerRef.current.clientWidth;
        if (clientWidth > 0) {
          setContainerWidth(clientWidth);
        }
      }
    };

    measureWidth();

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const measured = Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width);
        if (measured > 0) {
          setContainerWidth(measured);
        }
      }
    });

    resizeObserver.observe(containerRef.current);

/**
 * @module components/dashboard/DashboardKpiDeck
 * @description Executive operational KPI metric cards row.
 * Displays 4 core metrics: Active Branches, Total Inspections, Audits This Week, and Open Issues.
 * Adheres to responsive multi-breakpoint layout:
 * - Desktop (md+: 1440px): 4 cards in single row.
 * - Tablet (sm: 600px - 899px): 2x2 grid.
 * - Mobile (xs: <600px, 375px): 4 stacked cards (100% fullwidth).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import StorefrontIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Storefront';
import AssessmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AssessmentOutlined';
import DateRangeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DateRange';
import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import MuiStatCard from '../reusable/MuiStatCard.jsx';

/**
 * Skeleton placeholder for individual KPI cards during metric query latency.
 */
const KpiCardSkeleton = () => (
  <Card
    variant="outlined"
    sx={{
      borderRadius: '10px',
      bgcolor: 'background.paper',
      borderColor: 'divider',
      height: '100%',
    }}
  >
    <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 }, '&:last-child': { pb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } } }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1.5 }}>
        <Skeleton variant="text" width="60%" height={16} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" width={36} height={36} sx={{ borderRadius: '8px' }} />
      </Box>
      <Skeleton variant="text" width="40%" height={38} sx={{ mb: 0.5 }} />
      <Skeleton variant="text" width="80%" height={14} />
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
);

/**
 * Executive KPI cards deck for supervisor operational intelligence.
 *
 * @component DashboardKpiDeck
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} [props.kpis={}] - Aggregated KPI metrics object.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether metrics query is loading.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered KPI deck.
 */
export const DashboardKpiDeck = memo(({ kpis = {}, isLoading = false }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 1.5, sm: 2 }}>
        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((idx) => (
          <Grid key={idx} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 6, lg: 3, xl: 3 }}>
            <KpiCardSkeleton />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>
    );
  }

  const activeBranches = kpis.activeBranches ?? 0;
  const totalReports = kpis.totalReports ?? 0;
  const auditsThisWeek = kpis.auditsThisWeek ?? 0;
  const openIssues = kpis.openIssues ?? 0;
  const totalVisits = kpis.totalVisits ?? 0;

  return (
    <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 1.5, sm: 2 }}>
      {/* 1. Active Branches */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 6, lg: 3, xl: 3 }}>
        <MuiStatCard
          title="Active Branches"
          value={activeBranches}
          subtitle="Operational Store Network"
          icon={<StorefrontIcon fontSize="small" />}
          accentColor="primary.main"
          onClick={() => navigate('/branches')}
          sx={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
        />
      </Grid>

      {/* 2. Total Inspections */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 6, lg: 3, xl: 3 }}>
        <MuiStatCard
          title="Total Inspections"
          value={totalReports}
          subtitle={`${totalVisits} Total Branch Visits`}
          icon={<AssessmentOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          accentColor="#0288d1"
          onClick={() => navigate('/reports')}
          sx={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
        />
      </Grid>

      {/* 3. Audits This Week */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 6, lg: 3, xl: 3 }}>
        <MuiStatCard
          title="Audits This Week"
          value={auditsThisWeek}
          subtitle="Trailing 7 Days Activity"
          icon={<DateRangeIcon fontSize="small" />}
          accentColor="#2e7d32"
          onClick={() => navigate('/reports')}
          sx={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
        />
      </Grid>

      {/* 4. Open Issues */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 6, lg: 3, xl: 3 }}>
        <MuiStatCard
          title="Open Issues"
          value={openIssues}
          subtitle={openIssues > 0 ? 'Requires Action' : 'All Clear'}
          icon={<WarningAmberIcon fontSize="small" />}
          accentColor={openIssues > 0 ? '#ed6c02' : '#757575'}
          onClick={() => navigate('/reports')}
          sx={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
        />
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  );
});

DashboardKpiDeck.displayName = 'DashboardKpiDeck';

DashboardKpiDeck.propTypes = {
  kpis: PropTypes.shape({
    activeBranches: PropTypes.number,
    totalReports: PropTypes.number,
    auditsThisWeek: PropTypes.number,
    openIssues: PropTypes.number,
    totalVisits: PropTypes.number,
  }),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default DashboardKpiDeck;

 * Features:
 * - Desktop & Tablet (sm+): High-density structured table with horizontal overflow protection.
 * - Mobile (xs, 375px): Stacked responsive card list with full-width primary navigation CTA.
 * - Bilingual date display (Gregorian ISO + Ethiopian calendar).
 * - Visited branch pills and issue status indicators.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { Link } from 'react-router';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import ArrowForwardIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward';
import OpenInNewIcon from '@mui/icons-material/OpenInNew';
import AssignmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AssignmentOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';
import MuiReportTelegramShareButton from '../reports/MuiReportTelegramShareButton.jsx';
import { toEthiopianDateString, computeShiftDuration } from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Skeleton rows for recent inspections table during query latency.
 */
const TableSkeleton = () => (
  <TableBody>
    {[0, 1, 2].map((idx) => (
      <TableRow key={idx}>
        <TableCell sx={{ width: '18%', minWidth: { sm: 110, md: 110, lg: 130 } }}><Skeleton variant="text" width={100} height={24} /></TableCell>
        <TableCell sx={{ width: '32%', minWidth: { sm: 150, md: 160, lg: 200 } }}><Skeleton variant="rounded" width={130} height={28} /></TableCell>
        <TableCell sx={{ width: '20%', minWidth: { sm: 120, md: 120, lg: 140 } }}><Skeleton variant="text" width={90} height={24} /></TableCell>
        <TableCell sx={{ width: '15%', minWidth: { sm: 100, md: 110, lg: 120 } }}><Skeleton variant="rounded" width={80} height={24} /></TableCell>
        <TableCell align="right" sx={{ width: '15%', minWidth: { sm: 120, md: 130, lg: 150 } }}><Skeleton variant="rounded" width={90} height={32} sx={{ ml: 'auto' }} /></TableCell>
      </TableRow>
    ))}
  </TableBody>
);

/**
 * Skeleton cards for mobile view.
 */
const MobileSkeleton = () => (
  <Stack spacing={1.5}>
    {[0, 1, 2].map((idx) => (
      <Card key={idx} variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: '10px' }}>
        <CardContent sx={{ p: 2 }}>
          <Skeleton variant="text" width="50%" height={24} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="80%" height={26} sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={36} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    ))}
  </Stack>
);

/**
 * Formats report date into Gregorian ISO and Ethiopian calendar string.
 *
 * @param {string|Date} dateVal - Input date value.
 * @param {string} [ethiopianVal] - Optional backend Ethiopian date string.
 * @returns {{ gregorian: string, ethiopian: string }}
 */
const formatDatePair = (dateVal, ethiopianVal) => {
  if (!dateVal) return { gregorian: '—', ethiopian: '—' };
  const d = new Date(dateVal);
  const gregorian = !isNaN(d.getTime()) ? d.toISOString().split('T')[0] : String(dateVal);
  const ethiopian = ethiopianVal || toEthiopianDateString(dateVal);
  return { gregorian, ethiopian };
};

/**
 * Counts open issues in a report document.
 *
 * @param {Array<object>} issues - Report issues list.
 * @returns {number} Count of open issues.
 */
const countOpenIssues = (issues = []) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(issues)) return 0;
  return issues.filter((iss) => iss.status === 'reported' || iss.status === 'in_progress').length;
};

/**
 * Recent operational inspections ledger component.
 *
 * @component DashboardRecentAuditsLedger
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.reports=[]] - List of recent 5 reports.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether query is loading.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered table or card list.
 */
export const DashboardRecentAuditsLedger = memo(({ reports = [], isLoading = false }) => {
  const hasReports = reports && reports.length > 0;

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2, md: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: '10px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        borderColor: 'divider',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Title and "View All Reports" Link */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
          gap: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5 },
          mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        }}
      >
        <Box>
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
            <AssignmentOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'primary.main' }} />
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1rem' } }}>
              Recent Operational Inspections
            </Typography>
          </Box>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
            Latest supervisor audit reports and store assessments
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <MuiButton
          variant="text"
          size="small"
          component={Link}
          to="/reports"
          endIcon={<ArrowForwardIcon fontSize="small" />}
          sx={{
            fontWeight: 700,
            fontSize: '0.82rem',
            alignSelf: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
            px: { xs: 0, sm: 1 },
          }}
        >
          View All Reports
        </MuiButton>
      </Box>

      {/* Content Rendering */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <>
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' } }}>
            <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: 'auto', width: '100%' }}>
              <Table sx={{ minWidth: { sm: 600, md: 630, lg: 750 }, width: '100%' }} size="medium">
                <TableSkeleton />
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </Box>
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'block', sm: 'none' } }}>
            <MobileSkeleton />
          </Box>
        </>
      ) : !hasReports ? (
        <MuiEmptyState
          title="No Recent Inspections Logged"
          subtitle="Start an inspection in Chat to record your store visits and generate operational dossiers."
          action={
            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              size="small"
              component={Link}
              to="/chat"
              sx={{ mt: 1 }}
            >
              Start Inspection
            </MuiButton>
          }
          sx={{ py: 4 }}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Desktop & Tablet Table (sm+) */}
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' } }}>
            <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: 'auto', width: '100%' }}>
              <Table sx={{ minWidth: { sm: 600, md: 630, lg: 750 }, width: '100%' }} size="medium">
                <TableHead>
                  <TableRow sx={{ '& th': { fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'text.secondary', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.04em', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' } }}>
                    <TableCell sx={{ width: '18%', minWidth: { sm: 110, md: 110, lg: 130 } }}>Date</TableCell>
                    <TableCell sx={{ width: '32%', minWidth: { sm: 150, md: 160, lg: 200 } }}>Visited Branches</TableCell>
                    <TableCell sx={{ width: '20%', minWidth: { sm: 120, md: 120, lg: 140 } }}>Shift Schedule</TableCell>
                    <TableCell sx={{ width: '15%', minWidth: { sm: 100, md: 110, lg: 120 } }}>Issues Status</TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ width: '15%', minWidth: { sm: 120, md: 130, lg: 150 } }}>Actions</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHead>
                <TableBody>
                  {reports.map((report) => {
                    const { gregorian, ethiopian } = formatDatePair(report.date, report.ethiopianDate);
                    const openIssues = countOpenIssues(report.issues);
                    const duration = computeShiftDuration(report.clockIn, report.clockOut);
                    const visits = report.visits || [];

                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={report._id}
                        hover
                        sx={{
                          '&:last-child td, &:last-child th': { border: 0 },
                          transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease',
                        }}
                      >
                        {/* 1. Date */}
                        <TableCell sx={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.88rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                            {gregorian}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                            {ethiopian}
                          </Typography>
                        </TableCell>

                        {/* 2. Visited Branches */}
                        <TableCell>
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
                            {visits.length === 0 ? (
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
                                None recorded
                              </Typography>
                            ) : (
                              visits.slice(0, 3).map((v, vIdx) => {
                                const b = v.branch;
                                const code = b?.code || (typeof b === 'string' ? b.slice(-4) : 'BR');
                                const name = b?.name || 'Branch';
                                return (
                                  <Chip
                                    key={v._id || vIdx}
                                    label={`${code} • ${name}`}
                                    size="small"
                                    variant="outlined"
                                    sx={{
                                      fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                      height: 24,
                                      fontWeight: 600,
                                      borderColor: 'divider',
                                      bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                    }}
                                  />
                                );
                              })
                            )}
                            {visits.length > 3 && (
                              <Chip
                                label={`+${visits.length - 3} more`}
                                size="small"
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 24, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
                              />
                            )}
                          </Box>
                        </TableCell>

                        {/* 3. Shift Schedule */}
                        <TableCell sx={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                            {report.clockIn && report.clockOut
                              ? `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut}`
                              : 'Schedule not set'}
                          </Typography>
                          {duration && (
                            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 600, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                              {duration}
                            </Typography>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>

                        {/* 4. Issues Status */}
                        <TableCell sx={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          {openIssues > 0 ? (
                            <Chip
                              icon={<WarningAmberIcon fontSize="small" />}
                              label={`${openIssues} Open Issue${openIssues === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
                              size="small"
                              color="warning"
                              variant="outlined"
                              sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.75rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <Chip
                              icon={<CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />}
                              label="All Clear"
                              size="small"
                              color="success"
                              variant="outlined"
                              sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.75rem', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}
                            />
                          )}
                        </TableCell>

                        {/* 5. Actions */}
                        <TableCell align="right" sx={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 1 }}>
                            <MuiReportTelegramShareButton report={report} size="small" />
                            <MuiButton
                              variant="outlined"
                              size="small"
                              component={Link}
                              to={`/reports/${report._id}/details`}
                              endIcon={<OpenInNewIcon fontSize="small" />}
                              sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', py: 0.5, px: { sm: 1, md: 1.25 }, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', minWidth: { sm: 'auto', lg: 120 } }}
                            >
                              View Dossier
                            </MuiButton>
                          </Box>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </Box>

          {/* Mobile Stacked Cards (xs: <600px, 375px) */}
          <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' } }}>
            {reports.map((report) => {
              const { gregorian, ethiopian } = formatDatePair(report.date, report.ethiopianDate);
              const openIssues = countOpenIssues(report.issues);
              const duration = computeShiftDuration(report.clockIn, report.clockOut);
              const visits = report.visits || [];

              return (
                <Card
                  key={report._id}
                  variant="outlined"
                  sx={{
                    borderRadius: '10px',
                    borderColor: 'divider',
                    bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                  }}
                >
                  <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 }, '&:last-child': { pb: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 } } }}>
                    {/* Date and Status Badge */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.92rem' }}>
                          {gregorian}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                          {ethiopian}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>

                      {openIssues > 0 ? (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<WarningAmberIcon fontSize="small" />}
                          label={`${openIssues} Open`}
                          size="small"
                          color="warning"
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22 }}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />}
                          label="Clean"
                          size="small"
                          color="success"
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22 }}
                        />
                      )}
                    </Box>

                    {/* Visited Branches Chips */}
                    {visits.length > 0 && (
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mb: 1.5 }}>
                        {visits.map((v, vIdx) => {
                          const b = v.branch;
                          const code = b?.code || (typeof b === 'string' ? b.slice(-4) : 'BR');
                          const name = b?.name || 'Branch';
                          return (
                            <Chip
                              key={v._id || vIdx}
                              label={`${code} • ${name}`}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                              sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22, fontWeight: 600 }}
                            />
                          );
                        })}
                      </Box>
                    )}

                    {/* Shift Duration */}
                    {(report.clockIn || report.clockOut) && (
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ display: 'block', color: 'text.secondary', mb: 1.5 }}>
                        Shift: {report.clockIn || '—'} - {report.clockOut || '—'}
                        {duration ? ` (${duration})` : ''}
                      </Typography>
                    )}

                    {/* Balanced Dual Action Deck: Share & View Dossier (50/50 Equal Width) */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 1 }}>
                      <MuiReportTelegramShareButton
                        report={report}
                        variant="button"
                        label="Share"
                        size="small"
                        sx={{
                          flex: 1,
                          height: 36,
                          borderRadius: '8px',
                          fontSize: '0.8rem',
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          borderColor: 'divider',
                          color: '#2AABEE',
                          bgcolor: (theme) => theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(42, 171, 238, 0.08)' : 'rgba(42, 171, 238, 0.06)',
                          '&:hover': {
                            borderColor: '#2AABEE',
                            bgcolor: (theme) => theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(42, 171, 238, 0.16)' : 'rgba(42, 171, 238, 0.12)',
                          },
                        }}
                      />
                      <MuiButton
                        variant="contained"
                        size="small"
                        component={Link}
                        to={`/reports/${report._id}/details`}
                        endIcon={<OpenInNewIcon fontSize="small" />}
                        sx={{
                          flex: 1,
                          height: 36,
                          fontSize: '0.8rem',
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          borderRadius: '8px',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}
                      >
                        View Dossier
                      </MuiButton>
                    </Box>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </Stack>
        </>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

DashboardRecentAuditsLedger.displayName = 'DashboardRecentAuditsLedger';

DashboardRecentAuditsLedger.propTypes = {
  reports: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      _id: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
      date: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.instanceOf(Date)]),
      ethiopianDate: PropTypes.string,
      clockIn: PropTypes.string,
      clockOut: PropTypes.string,
      visits: PropTypes.array,
      issues: PropTypes.array,
      activities: PropTypes.array,
    })
  ),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default DashboardRecentAuditsLedger;

import { memo } from 'react';

]);

/**

          <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mt: 0.5 }}>

                    {item.description}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </Box>
            </Grid>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Paper>
    </Box>
  );
});

export default LandingArchitectureShowcase;

/**
 * @module components/landing/LandingFeaturesDeck
 * @description Capability pillars deck showcasing Executive Partner, Conversational Canvas,
 * and Operational Oversight capabilities for the Personal AI Agent platform.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import PsychologyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PsychologyOutlined';
import MicNoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MicNoneOutlined';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';

const CAPABILITY_PILLARS = Object.freeze([
  {
    id: 'executive_partner',
    title: 'Executive Partner & Leadership',
    subtitle: 'Strategic Intelligence',
    description:
      'A multi-dimensional AI partner designed to support team leadership, strategic decision-making, task scheduling, and open-domain problem solving across all professional and personal endeavors.',
    icon: <PsychologyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />,
    accent: 'primary.main',
  },
  {
    id: 'conversational_canvas',
    title: 'Conversational Synthesis Canvas',
    subtitle: 'Voice & Multimodal Intelligence',
    description:
      'Narrate shift updates naturally with Addis AI Amharic speech-to-text acoustic chunking, watch real-time Gemini streaming reasoning, and attach photos and audio notes for instant analysis.',
    icon: <MicNoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />,
    accent: 'info.main',
  },
  {
    id: 'operational_suite',
    title: 'Operational Oversight Suite',
    subtitle: 'Enterprise Control & Delivery',
    description:
      'Full directory oversight across 14 operational branches, zero-approval autonomous operational tools, authoritative corporate Amharic reports, and 5 manual one-click delivery channels.',
    icon: <StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />,
    accent: 'success.main',
  },
]);

/**
 * 3-Column capability pillars presentation.
 *
 * @component LandingFeaturesDeck
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered Features Deck.
 */
export const LandingFeaturesDeck = memo(() => {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 8, md: 12 } }}>
      <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', mb: 5 }}>
        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'primary.main', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.08em' }}>
          Core Capabilities
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mt: 0.5 }}>
          Designed for Operational Excellence
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {CAPABILITY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }} key={pillar.id}>
            <Card
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{
                height: '100%',
                borderRadius: '12px',
                bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                borderColor: 'divider',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                transition: 'all 0.2s ease-in-out',
                '&:hover': {
                  borderColor: pillar.accent,
                  transform: 'translateY(-3px)',
                  boxShadow: (theme) => `0 8px 24px ${theme.palette.action.hover}`,
                },
              }}
            >
              <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3.5 }, flexGrow: 1 }}>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    p: 1.5,
                    borderRadius: '10px',
                    bgcolor: (theme) => `${theme.palette.primary.main}12`,
                    color: pillar.accent,
                    mb: 2.5,
                  }}
                >
                  {pillar.icon}
                </Box>

                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
                  {pillar.subtitle}
                </Typography>

                <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.2rem', mb: 1.5 }}>
                  {pillar.title}
                </Typography>

                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', lineHeight: 1.65 }}>
                  {pillar.description}
                </Typography>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
});

export default LandingFeaturesDeck;

/**
 * @module components/profile/CloudIntegrationsTab
 * @description Cloud Workspace & Google Drive Integration Management component.
 * Provides real-time Google Drive connection status, OAuth authorization handshake,
 * connected account scopes, dedicated root folder display, and secure disconnection controls.
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Switch from '@mui/material/Switch';
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CloudQueueIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloudQueue';
import CloudDoneIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CloudDone';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import FolderIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Folder';
import LinkOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LinkOff';
import AddLinkIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AddLink';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import {
  useGetGoogleDriveStatusQuery,
  useLazyGetGoogleDriveConnectUrlQuery,
  useDisconnectGoogleDriveMutation,
  useToggleGoogleDriveMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';

/**
 * Cloud Workspace & Google Drive Integration Management Tab.
 *
 * @component CloudIntegrationsTab
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Cloud Integrations view.
 */
export const CloudIntegrationsTab = () => {
  const [isConfirmOpen, setIsConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);

  const { data: driveStatus, isLoading: isStatusLoading, refetch } = useGetGoogleDriveStatusQuery();
  const [getConnectUrl] = useLazyGetGoogleDriveConnectUrlQuery();
  const [disconnectDrive, { isLoading: isDisconnecting }] = useDisconnectGoogleDriveMutation();
  const [toggleDrive, { isLoading: isToggling }] = useToggleGoogleDriveMutation();

  const statusPayload = driveStatus?.data || driveStatus;
  const isConnected = Boolean(statusPayload?.connected);
  const isEnabled = statusPayload?.enabled !== false;
  const accountEmail = statusPayload?.email || null;
  const rootFolder = 'Personal AI Agent';
  const connectedAt = statusPayload?.connectedAt
    ? new Date(statusPayload.connectedAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    })
    : null;

  const handleToggleEnabled = async (_event, checked) => {
    try {
      await toggleDrive({ enabled: checked }).unwrap();
      toast.success(`Google Drive integration ${checked ? 'enabled' : 'paused'}.`);
      refetch();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update Google Drive integration setting.');
    }
  };

  // Back-Forward Cache (bfcache) and Window Focus Listener to auto-reset in-flight state
  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePageShow = (event) => {
      if (event.persisted) {
        setIsConnecting(false);
      }
    };
    const handleWindowFocus = () => {
      // Auto-unlock button when user switches back to this tab
      setIsConnecting(false);
    };

    window.addEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);
    };
  }, []);

  // Listen for OAuth redirect parameters and refresh status
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const authStatus = params.get('google_auth');
    if (!authStatus) return;

    if (authStatus === 'success') {
      toast.success('Google Drive connected successfully!');
      refetch();
    } else if (authStatus === 'error') {
      const err = params.get('error') || 'Failed to authenticate with Google.';
      if (err.toLowerCase().includes('access_denied')) {
        toast.error('Google authorization denied (Error 403). While in testing mode, your Google account must be added to the developer\'s Google Cloud Console "Test users" list.');
      } else {
        toast.error(`Google connection failed: ${err}`);
      }
    }
    const newUrl = window.location.pathname + (params.get('tab') ? `?tab=${params.get('tab')}` : '');
    window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newUrl);
  }, [refetch]);

  /**
   * Initiates Google OAuth consent screen redirect.
   */
  const handleConnect = async () => {
    try {
      setIsConnecting(true);
      const res = await getConnectUrl().unwrap();
      const authUrl = res?.data?.authUrl || res?.data?.url || res?.authUrl || res?.url;
      if (authUrl) {
        window.location.href = authUrl;
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to generate Google authorization link.');
        setIsConnecting(false);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to initiate Google connection.');
      setIsConnecting(false);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Disconnects Google Drive integration.
   */
  const handleConfirmDisconnect = async () => {
    try {
      await disconnectDrive().unwrap();
      setIsConfirmOpen(false);
      toast.success('Google Drive disconnected successfully.');
      refetch();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to disconnect Google Drive.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 760, mx: 'auto', py: 2 }}>
      {/* Primary Integration Card */}
      <Card
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          borderRadius: '12px',
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: isConnected ? 'success.light' : 'divider',
          transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          boxShadow: 'none',
        }}
      >
        <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 } }}>
          {/* Header Strip */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: 1.5,
              mb: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    isConnected
                      ? theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                        ? 'rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.2)'
                        : 'rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.1)'
                      : theme.palette.action.hover,
                  color: isConnected ? 'success.main' : 'text.secondary',
                }}
              >
                {isConnected ? <CloudDoneIcon fontSize="medium" /> : <CloudQueueIcon fontSize="medium" />}
              </Box>
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                  Google Drive & Cloud Documents
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.775rem' }}>
                  Cloud workspace storage, native Google Docs, and Google Sheets authoring
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Box>

            {/* Status Chip */}
            {isStatusLoading ? (
              <CircularProgress size={18} thickness={5} />
            ) : (
              <Chip
                label={isConnected ? 'Connected' : 'Disconnected'}
                color={isConnected ? 'success' : 'default'}
                variant={isConnected ? 'filled' : 'outlined'}
                size="small"
                sx={{
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  height: 24,
                  px: 0.5,
                }}
              />
            )}
          </Box>

          <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} />

          {/* Body Content */}
          {isConnected ? (
            <Stack spacing={2}>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                Your Google Drive workspace is active. Your Personal AI Agent can autonomously author native Google
                Docs, Google Sheets, and organize operational documents directly inside your account.
              </Typography>

              {/* Integration Enable/Disable Toggle Card */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  p: 1.5,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.01)',
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: isEnabled ? 'success.main' : 'divider',
                  flexWrap: 'wrap',
                  gap: 1.5,
                }}
              >
                <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                    Workspace Agent Access
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
                    {isEnabled
                      ? 'Autonomous authoring of Google Docs, Sheets, and file management is active.'
                      : 'Google Drive integration is temporarily paused. The agent will not access your Drive.'}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
                <FormControlLabel
                  control={
                    <Switch
                      checked={isEnabled}
                      onChange={handleToggleEnabled}
                      disabled={isToggling}
                      color="success"
                      size="small"
                    />
                  }
                  label={
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      {isEnabled ? 'Active' : 'Paused'}
                    </Typography>
                  }
                  sx={{ m: 0 }}
                />
              </Box>

              {/* Connected Details Grid */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 2,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)',
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  minWidth: 0,
                }}
              >
                <Grid container spacing={2}>
                  {/* Account Email */}
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.25 }}>
                      Connected Account
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'success.main', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                      <Typography
                        variant="body2"
                        sx={{
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          fontSize: '0.85rem',
                          wordBreak: 'break-all',
                          minWidth: 0,
                        }}
                      >
                        {accountEmail || 'Authorized Account'}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>

                  {/* Root Workspace Folder */}
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.25 }}>
                      Default Workspace Folder
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <FolderIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'primary.main', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                      <Typography
                        variant="body2"
                        sx={{
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          fontSize: '0.85rem',
                          wordBreak: 'break-word',
                          minWidth: 0,
                        }}
                      >
                        {rootFolder}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>

                  {/* Scopes */}
                  <Grid size={12}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
                      Active OAuth Permissions
                    </Typography>
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexWrap: 'wrap',
                        gap: 1,
                        width: '100%',
                        minWidth: 0,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Chip
                        label="Google Drive Files (drive.file)"
                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: '0.7rem',
                          maxWidth: '100%',
                          height: 'auto',
                          py: 0.25,
                          '& .MuiChip-label': { whiteSpace: 'normal', wordBreak: 'break-word' },
                        }}
                      />
                      <Chip
                        label="Google Docs (documents)"
                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: '0.7rem',
                          maxWidth: '100%',
                          height: 'auto',
                          py: 0.25,
                          '& .MuiChip-label': { whiteSpace: 'normal', wordBreak: 'break-word' },
                        }}
                      />
                      <Chip
                        label="Google Sheets (spreadsheets)"
                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: '0.7rem',
                          maxWidth: '100%',
                          height: 'auto',
                          py: 0.25,
                          '& .MuiChip-label': { whiteSpace: 'normal', wordBreak: 'break-word' },
                        }}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </Grid>

                  {/* Connection Date */}
                  {connectedAt && (
                    <Grid size={12}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                        Connected on {connectedAt}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                  )}
                </Grid>
              </Box>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 1.5, pt: 1 }}>
                <MuiButton
                  variant="outlined"
                  color="error"
                  size="small"
                  startIcon={<LinkOffIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setIsConfirmOpen(true)}
                  disabled={isDisconnecting}
                >
                  Disconnect Google Drive
                </MuiButton>
              </Box>
            </Stack>
          ) : (
            <Stack spacing={2}>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                Connect your Google Drive account to empower your Personal AI Agent to save generated spreadsheets,
                business reports, project summaries, and resumes directly to your dedicated cloud workspace.
              </Typography>

              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 2,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: (theme) =>
                    theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)',
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                }}
              >
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.75, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  What you get when connected:
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={0.5}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                    <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: 'primary.main' }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                      Dedicated <strong>Personal AI Agent</strong> cloud root folder automatically provisioned.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                    <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: 'primary.main' }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                      Direct conversational authoring of collaborative Google Docs and Google Sheets.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                    <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: 'primary.main' }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.primary', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                      Automatic silent token refresh with zero interruptions during active streaming.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Stack>
              </Box>

              {/* Testing Mode Guidance Alert */}
              <Alert
                severity="info"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  '& .MuiAlert-message': { fontSize: '0.8125rem', lineHeight: 1.5 },
                }}
              >
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, display: 'block', mb: 0.5, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  Google Cloud Sensitive Scopes Notice (Development Testing Mode):
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                  Connecting Google Drive requests sensitive scopes (<code>drive.file</code>, <code>documents</code>, <code>spreadsheets</code>). While the OAuth application is in &quot;Testing&quot; mode, your Google account must be explicitly added to the developer&apos;s <strong>Google Cloud Console &gt; Test users</strong> list. If you see <em>Error 403: access_denied</em>, ensure your email address has been whitelisted.
                </Typography>
              </Alert>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1.5, pt: 1 }}>
                <MuiButton
                  variant="contained"
                  color="primary"
                  size="small"
                  startIcon={isConnecting ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <AddLinkIcon />}
                  onClick={handleConnect}
                  disabled={isConnecting}
                >
                  {isConnecting ? 'Connecting...' : 'Connect Google Drive'}
                </MuiButton>
                {isConnecting && (
                  <MuiButton
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="inherit"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={() => setIsConnecting(false)}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </MuiButton>
                )}
              </Box>
            </Stack>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Disconnect Confirmation Dialog */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsConfirmOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDisconnect}
        title="Disconnect Google Drive"
        message="Are you sure you want to disconnect Google Drive? Your Personal AI Agent will no longer be able to save documents or create spreadsheets directly in your cloud workspace."
        confirmText="Disconnect"
        confirmColor="error"
        loading={isDisconnecting}
      />
    </Box>
  );
};

export default CloudIntegrationsTab;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileAccountTab
 * @description Supervisor account profile management tab.
 * Enforces zero-lag typing with react-hook-form mode: 'onBlur' and zero watch calls.
 */

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import SaveIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Save';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import { useUpdateProfileMutation } from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import { EMAIL_REGEX } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Account Profile Tab for editing personal information.
 *
 * @component ProfileAccountTab
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.user - Current user object.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered account tab.
 */
export const ProfileAccountTab = ({ user }) => {
  const [updateProfile, { isLoading: isUpdatingProfile }] = useUpdateProfileMutation();

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors, isDirty },
  } = useForm({
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: user?.firstName || '',
      lastName: user?.lastName || '',
      email: user?.email || '',
      position: user?.position || 'Area Supervisor',
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values) => {
    try {
      await updateProfile(values).unwrap();
      toast.success('Profile updated successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update profile. Please try again.';
      toast.error(errorMsg);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        boxShadow: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 } }}>
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' }, fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
          Personal Identity & Contact Information
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }, mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
          Manage your personal identity details, corporate position, and communication email.
        </Typography>

        {/* Profile Information Form */}
        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
          <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 }}>
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="First Name"
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.firstName)}
                helperText={errors.firstName?.message || 'Required (2-50 characters)'}
                {...register('firstName', {
                  required: 'First name is required.',
                  minLength: { value: 2, message: 'Minimum 2 characters.' },
                  maxLength: { value: 50, message: 'Maximum 50 characters.' },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Last Name"
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.lastName)}
                helperText={errors.lastName?.message || 'Required (2-50 characters)'}
                {...register('lastName', {
                  required: 'Last name is required.',
                  minLength: { value: 2, message: 'Minimum 2 characters.' },
                  maxLength: { value: 50, message: 'Maximum 50 characters.' },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Corporate Email"
                type="email"
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.email)}
                helperText={errors.email?.message || 'Unique login and communication email'}
                {...register('email', {
                  required: 'Email address is required.',
                  pattern: {
                    value: EMAIL_REGEX,
                    message: 'Please provide a valid email address.',
                  },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Operational Position / Role"
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.position)}
                helperText={errors.position?.message || 'Professional title in executive reports'}
                {...register('position', {
                  required: 'Position title is required.',
                })}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              mt: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
            }}
          >
            <MuiButton
              type="submit"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isUpdatingProfile || !isDirty}
              startIcon={
                isUpdatingProfile ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                py: { xs: 0.85, sm: 0.75 },
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isUpdatingProfile ? 'Saving Changes...' : 'Save Profile Changes'}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

ProfileAccountTab.propTypes = {
  user: PropTypes.shape({
    firstName: PropTypes.string,
    lastName: PropTypes.string,
    email: PropTypes.string,
    position: PropTypes.string,
    avatar: PropTypes.string,
  }),
};

export default ProfileAccountTab;

  const counterRef = useRef(null);

      counterRef.current.textContent = `${e.target.value.length}`;

  const handleBlur = (e) => {

  return (
    <MuiTextField
      inputRef={inputRef}

/**
 * AI Agent & Inference Configuration Tab.
 *
 * @component ProfileAgentConfigTab
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.user - Active supervisor user object.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered agent config tab.
 */
export const ProfileAgentConfigTab = ({ user }) => {
  const [updateAgentConfig, { isLoading }] = useUpdateAgentConfigMutation();
  const [updateApiKeys, { isLoading: isSavingKeys }] = useUpdateUserApiKeysMutation();

  const initialConfig = user?.settings?.agentConfig || {};
  const initialStt = user?.settings?.sttEngine || AI_MODELS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE || 'addis_ai';
  const apiKeysConfig = user?.settings?.apiKeys || {};

  // Form State strictly defaulting to centralized constants
  const personaRef = useRef(
    initialConfig.persona || CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_PERSONA || ''
  );
  const handlePersonaChange = useCallback((val) => {
    personaRef.current = val;
  }, []);

  const [defaultModel, setDefaultModel] = useState(
    initialConfig.defaultModel || AI_MODELS.DEFAULT
  );
  const [thinkingBudget, setThinkingBudget] = useState(
    typeof initialConfig.defaultThinkingBudget === 'number'
      ? Math.min(initialConfig.defaultThinkingBudget, CHAT_CONSTANTS.MAX_THINKING_BUDGET || 8192)
      : CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET || 2048
  );
  const [defaultLanguage, setDefaultLanguage] = useState(
    initialConfig.defaultLanguage || CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE || 'auto'
  );
  const [sttEngine, setSttEngine] = useState(initialStt);

  const initialTts = user?.settings?.tts || {};
  const [amharicVoice, setAmharicVoice] = useState(
    initialTts.amharicVoice || TTS_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_AMHARIC_VOICE
  );
  const [englishVoice, setEnglishVoice] = useState(
    initialTts.englishVoice || TTS_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ENGLISH_VOICE
  );
  const [ttsSpeed, setTtsSpeed] = useState(
    typeof initialTts.speed === 'number' ? initialTts.speed : TTS_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_SPEED
  );
  const [autoPlayTts, setAutoPlayTts] = useState(Boolean(initialTts.autoPlay));

  // Dynamically fetch available voices directly from Addis AI catalog (zero hardcoding)
  const { data: voicesResponse, isLoading: isLoadingVoices } = useGetTtsVoicesQuery(undefined, {
    skip: !user,
  });
  const dynamicVoices = Array.isArray(voicesResponse?.data)
    ? voicesResponse.data
    : Array.isArray(voicesResponse)
    ? voicesResponse
    : [];

  const amharicVoiceOptions = dynamicVoices.filter((v) => v.language === 'am');
  const englishVoiceOptions = dynamicVoices.filter((v) => v.language !== 'am');

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    try {
      await updateAgentConfig({
        persona: (personaRef.current || '').trim(),
        defaultModel,
        defaultThinkingBudget: Number(thinkingBudget),
        defaultLanguage,
        sttEngine,
        tts: {
          amharicVoice,
          englishVoice,
          speed: Number(ttsSpeed),
          autoPlay: Boolean(autoPlayTts),
        },
      }).unwrap();

      toast.success('AI Agent configurations saved successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update agent configuration.';
      toast.error(errorMsg);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        boxShadow: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 } }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
          <SmartToyOutlinedIcon color="primary" />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' }, fontWeight: 600 }}>
            AI Agent & Inference Governance
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }, mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
          Configure foundation reasoning model, deliberation token budget, default language, and Speech-to-Text transcriber.
        </Typography>

        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
          <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2.5, sm: 3 }}>
            {/* 1. Persona Definition */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
                Autonomous Agent Persona & Behavioral Guidelines
              </Typography>
              <PersonaInputField
                initialValue={initialConfig.persona || CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_PERSONA || ''}
                onValueChange={handlePersonaChange}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* 2. Default Gemini Model (Aligned with MuiModelSelector) */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                <PsychologyIcon fontSize="small" color="primary" />
                Default Foundation Model (TTT)
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 1.5 }}>
                Select default multimodal foundation model across new chat sessions and autonomous tool runs.
              </Typography>

              <Grid container spacing={1.5}>
                {MODEL_REGISTRY.map((model) => {
                  const Icon = model.icon;
                  const isSelected = defaultModel === model.id;
                  return (
                    <Grid key={model.id} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
                      <Card
                        variant="outlined"

                            bgcolor: isSelected ? 'action.selected' : 'action.hover',

                        }}
                      >
                        <Box>
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 0.75 }}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                              <Icon sx={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', color: model.iconColor }} />
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: '0.85rem', sm: '0.9rem' } }}>
                                {model.name}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            {isSelected && <CheckCircleIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: '1.1rem' }} />}
                          </Box>
                          <Typography
                            variant="caption"
                            sx={{
                              color: 'text.secondary',
                              display: '-webkit-box',
                              WebkitLineClamp: 2,
                              WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                              overflow: 'hidden',
                              minHeight: 34,
                              lineHeight: 1.35,
                            }}
                          >
                            {model.description}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        <Chip

                          sx={{
                            height: 20,
                            fontSize: '0.68rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            width: 'fit-content',
                          }}
                        />
                      </Card>
                    </Grid>
                  );
                })}
              </Grid>
            </Grid>

            {/* 3. Reasoning Token Budget Card */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Card
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{

                    <Box sx={{ px: 0.5 }}>

                            color="primary"

                        label={

                            Auto-read out loud new agent responses
                          </Typography>
                        }
                      />
