            </Grid>

            {/* 7. Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) Inference & Speech Credentials */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <ApiCredentialsSection
                apiKeysConfig={apiKeysConfig}
                updateApiKeys={updateApiKeys}
                isSavingKeys={isSavingKeys}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',

            }}
          >
            <MuiButton
              type="submit"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isLoading}
              startIcon={
                isLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                py: { xs: 0.85, sm: 0.75 },
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Saving Configuration...' : 'Save Agent Configuration'}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

ProfileAgentConfigTab.propTypes = {
  user: PropTypes.shape({
    settings: PropTypes.shape({
      agentConfig: PropTypes.shape({
        persona: PropTypes.string,
        defaultModel: PropTypes.string,
        defaultThinkingBudget: PropTypes.number,
        defaultLanguage: PropTypes.string,
      }),
      sttEngine: PropTypes.string,
      tts: PropTypes.shape({
        amharicVoice: PropTypes.string,
        englishVoice: PropTypes.string,
        speed: PropTypes.number,
        autoPlay: PropTypes.bool,
      }),
    }),
  }),
};

export default ProfileAgentConfigTab;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileDangerZone
 * @description Profile Danger Zone card for cascading account preference reset.
 * Implements the strict three-phase action lifecycle (action -> confirm -> effect) using MuiConfirmDialog.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import RestartAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestartAlt';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiConfirmDialog from '../reusable/MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';
import {
  useUpdateAgentConfigMutation,
  useUpdateDirectivesMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import { CHAT_CONSTANTS, AI_MODELS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Danger Zone card component providing guarded account preference reset.
 *
 * @component ProfileDangerZone
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Danger Zone component.
 */
export const ProfileDangerZone = () => {
  const [isDialogOpen, setIsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [updateAgentConfig, { isLoading: isResettingConfig }] = useUpdateAgentConfigMutation();
  const [updateDirectives, { isLoading: isResettingDirectives }] = useUpdateDirectivesMutation();

  const isResetting = isResettingConfig || isResettingDirectives;

  const handleConfirmReset = async () => {
    try {
      // 1. Reset Directives to clean empty structures
      await updateDirectives({
        negativeVocabulary: [],
        phraseMappings: {},
        customInstructions: [],
      }).unwrap();

      // 2. Reset Agent Configuration to system defaults
      await updateAgentConfig({
        persona: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_PERSONA || '',
        defaultModel: AI_MODELS.DEFAULT,
        defaultThinkingBudget: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET || 2048,
        defaultLanguage: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE || 'auto',
        sttEngine: AI_MODELS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE || 'addis_ai',
        reportTemplates: {
          singleBranch: null,
          multiBranch: null,
        },
      }).unwrap();

      setIsDialogOpen(false);
      toast.success('Account directives and agent configurations reset to system defaults.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to reset account preferences.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Card
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          borderRadius: '12px',
          bgcolor: (theme) =>
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.05)' : 'rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.02)',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: 'error.main',
          boxShadow: 'none',
          mt: 3,
        }}
      >
        <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
                <WarningAmberIcon color="error" fontSize="small" />
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'error.main' }}>
                  Danger Zone: Reset Account Preferences
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
                Permanently purge all custom directives, negative vocabulary, phrase mappings, and report templates, reverting your Personal AI Agent configurations to factory defaults.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <MuiButton
              variant="outlined"
              color="error"
              size="small"
              disabled={isResetting}
              startIcon={
                isResetting ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <RestartAltIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              onClick={() => setIsDialogOpen(true)}
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isResetting ? 'Resetting...' : 'Reset Preferences'}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Confirmation Dialog following action -> confirm -> effect */}
      <MuiConfirmDialog
        open={isDialogOpen}
        title="Reset All AI Agent Preferences?"
        message="Are you sure you want to reset all custom directives, phrase mappings, and report templates? This action cannot be undone."
        confirmText="Yes, Reset Everything"
        cancelText="Cancel"
        confirmColor="error"
        onConfirm={handleConfirmReset}
        onCancel={() => setIsDialogOpen(false)}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default ProfileDangerZone;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileDirectivesTab
 * @description Supervisor Directives, Negative Vocabulary, Phrase Mappings, and Report Templates SSOT tab.
 * Enforces zero-lag typing, clear end-adornments, in-place rule editing, scrollable growing containers,
 * and strict sx alignment styling.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import DeleteOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import SaveIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Save';
import BlockIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Block';
import SpellcheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Spellcheck';
import RuleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Rule';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import {
  useUpdateDirectivesMutation,
  useUpdateAgentConfigMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import ProfileReportTemplatesSection from './ProfileReportTemplatesSection.jsx';

/**
 * Directives & Report Templates SSOT tab.
 *
 * @component ProfileDirectivesTab
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.user - Current supervisor user object.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered directives tab.
 */
export const ProfileDirectivesTab = ({ user }) => {
  const [updateDirectives, { isLoading: isUpdatingDirectives }] = useUpdateDirectivesMutation();
  const [updateAgentConfig, { isLoading: isUpdatingTemplates }] = useUpdateAgentConfigMutation();

  const initialDirectives = user?.settings?.directives || {};
  const initialTemplates = user?.settings?.reportTemplates || {};

  // Directives State
  const [negativeVocabulary, setNegativeVocabulary] = useState(
    Array.isArray(initialDirectives.negativeVocabulary) ? initialDirectives.negativeVocabulary : []
  );

  const [phraseMappings, setPhraseMappings] = useState(() => {
    const raw = initialDirectives.phraseMappings;
    if (!raw) return {};
    if (raw instanceof Map) return Object.fromEntries(raw);
    return typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
  });

  const [customInstructions, setCustomInstructions] = useState(
    Array.isArray(initialDirectives.customInstructions) ? initialDirectives.customInstructions : []
  );

  // In-Place Rule Edit State
  const [editingRuleIndex, setEditingRuleIndex] = useState(null);
  const editRuleInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Report Templates State (Isolated Uncontrolled Refs for Zero-Lag Typing)
  const [resetCounter, setResetCounter] = useState(0);
  const singleTemplateRef = useRef(initialTemplates.singleBranch || '');
  const multiTemplateRef = useRef(initialTemplates.multiBranch || '');

  const handleSingleChange = useCallback((val) => {
    singleTemplateRef.current = val;
  }, []);

  const handleMultiChange = useCallback((val) => {
    multiTemplateRef.current = val;
  }, []);

  // Uncontrolled Input Refs for Zero-Lag Typing
  const newWordInputRef = useRef(null);
  const mappingKeyInputRef = useRef(null);
  const mappingValInputRef = useRef(null);
  const newInstructionInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Direct DOM Refs for Clear Buttons (100% Zero-Lag: Zero React state updates while typing)
  const clearWordBtnRef = useRef(null);
  const clearMappingKeyBtnRef = useRef(null);
  const clearMappingValBtnRef = useRef(null);
  const clearInstructionBtnRef = useRef(null);

  // 1. Negative Vocabulary Handlers
  const handleAddNegativeWord = () => {
    const word = newWordInputRef.current?.value?.trim();
    if (!word) return;
    if (negativeVocabulary.includes(word)) {
      toast.warning(`'${word}' is already in negative vocabulary.`);
      return;
    }
    setNegativeVocabulary((prev) => [...prev, word]);
    if (newWordInputRef.current) {
      newWordInputRef.current.value = '';
      newWordInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearWordBtnRef.current) {
      clearWordBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleClearNegativeWord = () => {
    if (newWordInputRef.current) {
      newWordInputRef.current.value = '';
      newWordInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearWordBtnRef.current) {
      clearWordBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveNegativeWord = (targetWord) => {
    setNegativeVocabulary((prev) => prev.filter((w) => w !== targetWord));
  };

  // 2. Phrase Mappings Handlers
  const handleAddPhraseMapping = () => {
    const key = mappingKeyInputRef.current?.value?.trim();
    const val = mappingValInputRef.current?.value?.trim();
    if (!key || !val) {
      toast.error('Both shorthand key and corporate replacement are required.');
      return;
    }
    setPhraseMappings((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: val }));
    if (mappingKeyInputRef.current) mappingKeyInputRef.current.value = '';
    if (mappingValInputRef.current) mappingValInputRef.current.value = '';
    if (clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current) clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    if (clearMappingValBtnRef.current) clearMappingValBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
  };

  const handleClearMappingKey = () => {
    if (mappingKeyInputRef.current) {
      mappingKeyInputRef.current.value = '';
      mappingKeyInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current) {
      clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleClearMappingVal = () => {
    if (mappingValInputRef.current) {
      mappingValInputRef.current.value = '';
      mappingValInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearMappingValBtnRef.current) {
      clearMappingValBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleRemovePhraseMapping = (targetKey) => {
    setPhraseMappings((prev) => {
      const copy = { ...prev };
      delete copy[targetKey];
      return copy;
    });
  };

  // 3. Custom Instructions Handlers
  const handleAddInstruction = () => {
    const inst = newInstructionInputRef.current?.value?.trim();
    if (!inst) return;
    setCustomInstructions((prev) => [...prev, inst]);
    if (newInstructionInputRef.current) {
      newInstructionInputRef.current.value = '';
      newInstructionInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearInstructionBtnRef.current) {
      clearInstructionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleClearInstruction = () => {
    if (newInstructionInputRef.current) {
      newInstructionInputRef.current.value = '';
      newInstructionInputRef.current.focus();
    }
    if (clearInstructionBtnRef.current) {
      clearInstructionBtnRef.current.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveInstruction = (indexToRemove) => {
    if (editingRuleIndex === indexToRemove) {
      setEditingRuleIndex(null);
    }
    setCustomInstructions((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== indexToRemove));
  };

  const handleStartEditRule = (idx) => {
    setEditingRuleIndex(idx);
  };

  const handleSaveEditRule = (idx) => {
    const updated = editRuleInputRef.current?.value?.trim();
    if (!updated) {
      toast.error('Rule content cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }
    setCustomInstructions((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      next[idx] = updated;
      return next;
    });
    setEditingRuleIndex(null);
    toast.success('Rule updated.');
  };

  const handleCancelEditRule = () => {
    setEditingRuleIndex(null);
  };

  // 4. Template Reset
  const handleResetTemplates = useCallback(() => {
    singleTemplateRef.current = '';
    multiTemplateRef.current = '';
    setResetCounter((c) => c + 1);
    toast.info('Report templates reset to system defaults. Click Save to persist.');
  }, []);

  // 5. Submit All Changes
  const handleSaveAll = async () => {
    try {
      await updateDirectives({
        negativeVocabulary,
        phraseMappings,
        customInstructions,
      }).unwrap();

      await updateAgentConfig({
        reportTemplates: {
          singleBranch: (singleTemplateRef.current || '').trim() || null,
          multiBranch: (multiTemplateRef.current || '').trim() || null,
        },
      }).unwrap();

      toast.success('Supervisor directives and report templates saved successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to save directives and templates.';
      toast.error(errorMsg);
    }
  };

  const isSaving = isUpdatingDirectives || isUpdatingTemplates;

  // Zero-Lag Native Input Listeners: Pure DOM ref style toggling (0 React state updates while typing)
  const onWordInput = (e) => {
    if (clearWordBtnRef.current) {
      clearWordBtnRef.current.style.display = e.target.value ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
  };

  const onMappingKeyInput = (e) => {
    if (clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current) {
      clearMappingKeyBtnRef.current.style.display = e.target.value ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
  };

  const onMappingValInput = (e) => {
    if (clearMappingValBtnRef.current) {
      clearMappingValBtnRef.current.style.display = e.target.value ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
  };

  const onInstructionInput = (e) => {
    if (clearInstructionBtnRef.current) {
      clearInstructionBtnRef.current.style.display = e.target.value ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        boxShadow: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 } }}>
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' }, fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
          Supervisor Directives & Report Templates SSOT
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }, mb: { xs: 2, sm: 3 } }}>
          Configure negative vocabulary, phrase mappings, persistent rules, and corporate report templates strictly adhered to by your Personal AI Agent.
        </Typography>

        <Stack spacing={{ xs: 2.5, sm: 3.5 }}>
          {/* Section 1: Negative Vocabulary */}
          <Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
              <BlockIcon fontSize="small" color="error" />
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Negative Vocabulary (Forbidden Words)
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 1.5 }}>
              Terms strictly forbidden from appearing in generated inspection reports and conversational responses.
            </Typography>

            {/* Scrollable Container with Max Height */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 1,
                p: 1.5,
                borderRadius: '8px',
                bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                border: 1,
                borderColor: 'divider',
                maxHeight: 180,
                overflowY: 'auto',
                alignItems: 'center',
                mb: 1.5,
              }}
            >
              {negativeVocabulary.length === 0 ? (
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                  No forbidden words registered. Type a word below and click Add.
                </Typography>
              ) : (
                negativeVocabulary.map((word) => (
                  <Chip
                    key={word}
                    label={word}
                    size="small"
                    color="error"
                    variant="outlined"
                    onDelete={() => handleRemoveNegativeWord(word)}
                    sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}
                  />
                ))
              )}
            </Box>

            {/* Pixel-Perfect Aligned Input Row with Clear End-Adornment */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <MuiTextField
                inputRef={newWordInputRef}
                placeholder="Type forbidden word (e.g. ችግር, ስህተት)..."
                size="small"
                fullWidth
                helperText={null}
                onInput={onWordInput}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleAddNegativeWord();
                  }
                }}
                endAdornment={
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      ref={clearWordBtnRef}
                      size="small"
                      onClick={handleClearNegativeWord}
                      edge="end"
                      aria-label="Clear word input"
                      sx={{ display: 'none' }}
                    >
                      <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: '1rem' }} />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                }
              />
              <MuiButton
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                onClick={handleAddNegativeWord}
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                Add Word
              </MuiButton>
              <Tooltip title="Add Word">
                <IconButton
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={handleAddNegativeWord}
                  sx={{
                    display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                    border: 1,
                    borderColor: 'divider',

                  }}
                >
                  <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          <Divider />

          {/* Section 2: Phrase Mappings */}
          <Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>

                Phrase Mappings & Operational Shorthand Expansion
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 1.5 }}>
              Map informal shorthand or jargon into authoritative corporate terminology.
            </Typography>

            {/* Scrollable Mappings Table Container with Max Height */}
            {Object.keys(phraseMappings).length > 0 ? (
              <TableContainer
                component={Paper}

                  mb: 1.5,

              >

                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="right" sx={{ width: 60, bgcolor: 'action.hover' }} />

                  <TableBody>
                    {Object.entries(phraseMappings).map(([k, v]) => (
                      <TableRow key={k}>
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: '0.8125rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>{k}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>{v}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell align="right">
                          <Tooltip title="Remove Mapping">
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="error"
                              onClick={() => handleRemovePhraseMapping(k)}
                            >
                              <DeleteOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            ) : (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 1.5,
                  mb: 1.5,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                  No phrase mappings defined. Add one below (e.g. &quot;ማታ&quot; ➔ &quot;የማታ ፈረቃ&quot;).
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}

            {/* Pixel-Perfect Aligned Add Mapping Row with Clear Adornments */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                gap: 1,
                alignItems: { xs: 'stretch', sm: 'flex-start' },
              }}
            >
              <MuiTextField
                inputRef={mappingKeyInputRef}
                placeholder="Shorthand Key (e.g. ፖስ)"
                size="small"
                helperText={null}
                onInput={onMappingKeyInput}
                sx={{ flex: { sm: 1 }, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
                endAdornment={
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      ref={clearMappingKeyBtnRef}
                      size="small"
                      onClick={handleClearMappingKey}
                      edge="end"
                      aria-label="Clear key"
                      sx={{ display: 'none' }}
                    >
                      <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: '1rem' }} />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                }
              />
              <MuiTextField
                inputRef={mappingValInputRef}
                placeholder="Replacement (e.g. የሽያጭ ማሽን)"
                size="small"
                helperText={null}
                onInput={onMappingValInput}
                sx={{ flex: { sm: 1.5 }, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleAddPhraseMapping();
                  }
                }}
                endAdornment={
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      ref={clearMappingValBtnRef}
                      size="small"
                      onClick={handleClearMappingVal}
                      edge="end"
                      aria-label="Clear value"
                      sx={{ display: 'none' }}
                    >
                      <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: '1rem' }} />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                }
              />
              <MuiButton
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                onClick={handleAddPhraseMapping}
                sx={{
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                  width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },

              >
                Add Mapping
              </MuiButton>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          <Divider />

          {/* Section 3: Custom Instructions with Edit and Delete + Clear Adornment */}
          <Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
              <RuleIcon fontSize="small" color="primary" />
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Persistent Custom Rules & Guidelines
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 1.5 }}>
              Discrete rules dynamically observed across all chats and report generation pipelines.
            </Typography>

            {/* Scrollable Rules Container with Max Height */}
            {customInstructions.length > 0 ? (
              <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ mb: 1.5, maxHeight: 280, overflowY: 'auto', pr: 0.5 }}>
                {customInstructions.map((instruction, idx) => {
                  const isEditing = editingRuleIndex === idx;

                  if (isEditing) {
                    return (
                      <Box
                        key={idx}
                        sx={{
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 1,
                          p: 1,
                          borderRadius: '8px',
                          bgcolor: 'action.selected',
                          border: 1,
                          borderColor: 'primary.main',
                        }}
                      >
                        <MuiTextField
                          inputRef={editRuleInputRef}
                          defaultValue={instruction}
                          size="small"
                          fullWidth
                          autoFocus
                          helperText={null}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                              e.preventDefault();
                              handleSaveEditRule(idx);
                            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                              handleCancelEditRule();
                            }
                          }}
                        />
                        <Tooltip title="Save Edit">
                          <IconButton size="small" color="primary" onClick={() => handleSaveEditRule(idx)}>
                            <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Cancel">
                          <IconButton size="small" onClick={handleCancelEditRule}>
                            <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </Box>
                    );
                  }

                  return (
                    <Box
                      key={idx}
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        p: 1.25,
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                        border: 1,
                        borderColor: 'divider',
                        gap: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', flex: 1, wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>
                        • {instruction}
                      </Typography>
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        <Tooltip title="Edit Rule">
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="inherit"
                            onClick={() => handleStartEditRule(idx)}
                            sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}
                          >
                            <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Delete Rule">
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="error"
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveInstruction(idx)}
                          >
                            <DeleteOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </Box>
                    </Box>
                  );
                })}
              </Stack>
            ) : (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 1.5,
                  mb: 1.5,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  border: 1,
                  borderColor: 'divider',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                  No custom instructions registered.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}

            {/* Pixel-Perfect Aligned Add Rule Row with Clear End-Adornment */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <MuiTextField
                inputRef={newInstructionInputRef}
                placeholder="Type persistent rule (e.g. Always format dates in Ethiopian calendar)..."
                size="small"
                fullWidth
                helperText={null}
                onInput={onInstructionInput}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleAddInstruction();
                  }
                }}
                endAdornment={
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      ref={clearInstructionBtnRef}
                      size="small"
                      onClick={handleClearInstruction}
                      edge="end"
                      aria-label="Clear rule input"
                      sx={{ display: 'none' }}
                    >
                      <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: '1rem' }} />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                }
              />
              <MuiButton
                variant="outlined"
                color="primary"
                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                onClick={handleAddInstruction}
                sx={{
                  display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                Add Rule
              </MuiButton>
              <Tooltip title="Add Rule">
                <IconButton
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={handleAddInstruction}
                  sx={{
                    display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
                    border: 1,
                    borderColor: 'divider',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </Box>
          </Box>

          <Divider />

          {/* Section 4: Report Templates SSOT (Memoized Zero-Lag Subcomponent) */}
          <ProfileReportTemplatesSection
            initialSingle={initialTemplates.singleBranch || ''}
            initialMulti={initialTemplates.multiBranch || ''}
            onSingleChange={handleSingleChange}
            onMultiChange={handleMultiChange}
            onReset={handleResetTemplates}
            resetCounter={resetCounter}
          />

          {/* Save Action Deck */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              pt: 1,
            }}
          >
            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isSaving}
              onClick={handleSaveAll}
              startIcon={
                isSaving ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                py: { xs: 0.85, sm: 0.75 },
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isSaving ? 'Saving Directives...' : 'Save Directives & Templates'}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

ProfileDirectivesTab.propTypes = {
  user: PropTypes.shape({
    settings: PropTypes.shape({
      directives: PropTypes.shape({
        negativeVocabulary: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.string),
        phraseMappings: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.object, PropTypes.instanceOf(Map)]),
        customInstructions: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.string),
      }),
      reportTemplates: PropTypes.shape({
        singleBranch: PropTypes.string,
        multiBranch: PropTypes.string,
      }),
    }),
  }),
};

export default ProfileDirectivesTab;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileHeaderHero
 * @description Supervisor identity header hero displaying avatar, initials, full name, email,
 * active agent chip, and direct avatar photo management (upload/remove) with zero visual duplication.
 */

import { useRef } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Breadcrumbs from '@mui/material/Breadcrumbs';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Avatar from '@mui/material/Avatar';
import Badge from '@mui/material/Badge';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';
import SmartToyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SmartToyOutlined';
import PhotoCameraIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhotoCamera';
import DeleteOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import { ROUTES } from '../../utils/constants.js';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import {
  useUpdateAvatarMutation,
  useRemoveAvatarMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import { optimizeAvatarImage } from '../../utils/imageOptimizer.js';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../../utils/avatarUtils.js';

const MAX_AVATAR_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB

/**
 * Supervisor identity hero banner rendered at the top of the Profile canvas.
 * Houses the canonical profile photo with upload/remove actions.
 *
 * @component ProfileHeaderHero
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.user - Active supervisor user object.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered profile hero banner.
 */
export const ProfileHeaderHero = ({ user }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [updateAvatar, { isLoading: isUploadingAvatar }] = useUpdateAvatarMutation();
  const [removeAvatar, { isLoading: isRemovingAvatar }] = useRemoveAvatarMutation();

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (window.history.state && window.history.state.idx > 0) {
      navigate(-1);
    } else {
      navigate(ROUTES.DASHBOARD || '/dashboard');
    }
  };

  const isAvatarBusy = isUploadingAvatar || isRemovingAvatar;

  const initials = user
    ? `${user.firstName?.[0] ?? ''}${user.lastName?.[0] ?? ''}`.toUpperCase()
    : 'U';

  const fullName =
    user?.fullName ||
    `${user?.firstName ?? ''} ${user?.lastName ?? ''}`.trim() ||
    'Supervisor';

  const handleFileChange = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      toast.error('Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP).');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_AVATAR_SIZE_BYTES) {
      toast.error('Image size must be 5MB or less.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const optimizedBase64 = await optimizeAvatarImage(file);
      await updateAvatar({ avatar: optimizedBase64 }).unwrap();
      toast.success('Profile photo updated successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update avatar image.');
    } finally {
      // Reset input
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveAvatar = async () => {
    try {
      await removeAvatar().unwrap();
      toast.success('Profile photo removed.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || 'Failed to remove avatar.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
      {/* Top Navigation & Breadcrumbs Row */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          mb: 1.5,
        }}
      >
        {/* Universal Back Button (History-Aware) */}
        <MuiButton
          variant="text"
          color="inherit"
          size="small"
          onClick={handleBack}
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />}
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' },
            color: 'text.secondary',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          Back
        </MuiButton>

        {/* Mobile xs: 375px Iconified Back Button */}
        <Tooltip title="Back">
          <IconButton
            onClick={handleBack}
            size="small"
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' },
              color: 'text.secondary',
              border: 1,
              borderColor: 'divider',
              p: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>

        {/* Structured Breadcrumbs replacing orphaned caption */}
        <Breadcrumbs
          separator={<NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'text.disabled' }} />}
          aria-label="breadcrumb"
        >
          <Typography

          <Typography
            variant="caption"

              color: 'text.primary',

            Profile & Settings

      </Box>

      {/* User Identity Header Card */}
      <Card
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          borderRadius: '12px',
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: 'divider',
          boxShadow: 'none',
        }}
      >
        <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 } }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 },
            }}
          >
            {/* Hidden File Input for Avatar Upload */}
            <input
              type="file"

              accept="image/*"

            />

            {/* Single Interactive Avatar with Camera Upload Badge */}
            <Badge
              overlap="circular"
              anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
              badgeContent={
                <Tooltip title="Change profile photo">
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    disabled={isAvatarBusy}
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                    sx={{
                      width: { xs: 24, sm: 28 },
                      height: { xs: 24, sm: 28 },
                      bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                      border: 1,
                      borderColor: 'divider',
                      boxShadow: 1,
                      p: 0.5,
                      '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
                    }}
                  >
                    <PhotoCameraIcon sx={{ fontSize: { xs: 13, sm: 16 }, color: 'text.primary' }} />
                  </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
              }
            >
              <Box sx={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <Avatar
                  src={getAvatarUrl(user?.avatar) || undefined}
                  alt={fullName}
                  sx={{
                    width: { xs: 52, sm: 64 },
                    height: { xs: 52, sm: 64 },
                    fontSize: { xs: '1.15rem', sm: '1.45rem' },
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    bgcolor: 'primary.main',
                    border: 2,
                    borderColor: 'divider',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {initials}
                </Avatar>
                {isAvatarBusy && (
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      inset: 0,
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                    }}
                  >
                    <CircularProgress size={22} sx={{ color: '#fff' }} />
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>
            </Badge>

            {/* Identity Text and Chips */}
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1 }}>
                <Typography
                  variant="h6"
                  noWrap
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.2rem' },
                    lineHeight: 1.25,
                  }}
                >
                  {fullName}
                </Typography>

                {user?.avatar && (
                  <Tooltip title="Remove photo">
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="error"
                      disabled={isAvatarBusy}
                      onClick={handleRemoveAvatar}
                      sx={{ p: 0.5 }}
                    >
                      <DeleteOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: '1.1rem' }} />
                    </IconButton>
                  </Tooltip>
                )}
              </Box>

              <Typography
                variant="body2"
                noWrap
                sx={{
                  color: 'text.secondary',
                  fontSize: { xs: '0.75rem', sm: '0.8125rem' },
                  mb: 0.75,
                }}
              >
                {user?.email || 'user@example.com'}
              </Typography>

              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.75, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Chip
                  label={user?.position || 'Area Supervisor'}
                  size="small"
                  variant="outlined"
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.7rem',
                    height: 22,
                    fontWeight: 500,

                  icon={<SmartToyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem !important' }} />}
                  label="Personal AI Agent Active"
                  size="small"
                  color="primary"
                  variant="filled"
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.7rem',
                    height: 22,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                  }}
                />
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Box>
  );
};

ProfileHeaderHero.propTypes = {

};

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileReportTemplatesSection
 * @description Isolated and memoized corporate report templates editor.
 * Eliminates keystroke lag in ProfileDirectivesTab by decoupling template text editing
 * from the directives ledger, phrase mapping table, and vocabulary chip collections.
 */

import { memo, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';
import RestartAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestartAlt';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import { REPORT_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Memoized report templates configuration section.
 * Employs 100% uncontrolled inputs and native DOM counter refs to guarantee zero-lag typing.
 *
 * @component ProfileReportTemplatesSection
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {string} props.initialSingle - Initial single-branch template.
 * @param {string} props.initialMulti - Initial multi-branch template.
 * @param {Function} props.onSingleChange - Callback invoked on single template changes.
 * @param {Function} props.onMultiChange - Callback invoked on multi template changes.
 * @param {Function} props.onReset - Callback when user clicks Reset Defaults.
 * @param {number} [props.resetCounter] - External trigger to re-initialize fields.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element}
 */
export const ProfileReportTemplatesSection = memo(({
  initialSingle,
  initialMulti,
  onSingleChange,
  onMultiChange,
  onReset,
  resetCounter = 0,
}) => {
  const singleInputRef = useRef(null);
  const multiInputRef = useRef(null);
  const singleCountRef = useRef(null);
  const multiCountRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (singleInputRef.current) {
      singleInputRef.current.value = initialSingle || '';
    }
    if (singleCountRef.current) {
      singleCountRef.current.textContent = `${(initialSingle || '').length}`;
    }
  }, [initialSingle, resetCounter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (multiInputRef.current) {
      multiInputRef.current.value = initialMulti || '';
    }
    if (multiCountRef.current) {
      multiCountRef.current.textContent = `${(initialMulti || '').length}`;
    }
  }, [initialMulti, resetCounter]);

  const handleSingleInput = (e) => {
    if (singleCountRef.current) {
      singleCountRef.current.textContent = `${e.target.value.length}`;
    }
  };

  const handleSingleBlur = (e) => {
    onSingleChange(e.target.value);
  };

  const handleMultiInput = (e) => {
    if (multiCountRef.current) {
      multiCountRef.current.textContent = `${e.target.value.length}`;
    }
  };

  const handleMultiBlur = (e) => {
    onMultiChange(e.target.value);
  };

  return (
    <Box>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 0.5 }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <DescriptionOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" color="primary" />
          <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Corporate Report Templates (SSOT)
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <MuiButton
          variant="text"
          color="inherit"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<RestartAltIcon fontSize="small" />}
          onClick={onReset}
          sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}
        >
          Reset Defaults
        </MuiButton>
      </Box>
      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 2 }}>
        Authoritative Amharic report layouts applied when synthesizing inspection records (up to{' '}
        {REPORT_CONSTANTS.TEMPLATE_MAX_LENGTH.toLocaleString()} characters each). Leave blank to use system standard templates.
      </Typography>

      <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2, sm: 2.5 }}>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
            Single-Branch Inspection Template
          </Typography>
          <MuiTextField
            inputRef={singleInputRef}
            multiline
            rows={4}
            fullWidth
            defaultValue={initialSingle || ''}
            onInput={handleSingleInput}
            onBlur={handleSingleBlur}
            placeholder="Enter custom Single-Branch report header and section layout..."
            helperText={
              <Box component="span">
                <Box component="span" ref={singleCountRef}>
                  {(initialSingle || '').length}
                </Box>
                /{REPORT_CONSTANTS.TEMPLATE_MAX_LENGTH.toLocaleString()} characters
              </Box>
            }
            slotProps={{
              htmlInput: { maxLength: REPORT_CONSTANTS.TEMPLATE_MAX_LENGTH },
            }}
          />
        </Grid>

        <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
            Multi-Branch Consolidated Inspection Template
          </Typography>
          <MuiTextField
            inputRef={multiInputRef}
            multiline
            rows={4}
            fullWidth
            defaultValue={initialMulti || ''}
            onInput={handleMultiInput}
            onBlur={handleMultiBlur}
            placeholder="Enter custom Multi-Branch report header and branch-separated layout..."
            helperText={
              <Box component="span">
                <Box component="span" ref={multiCountRef}>
                  {(initialMulti || '').length}
                </Box>
                /{REPORT_CONSTANTS.TEMPLATE_MAX_LENGTH.toLocaleString()} characters
              </Box>
            }
            slotProps={{
              htmlInput: { maxLength: REPORT_CONSTANTS.TEMPLATE_MAX_LENGTH },
            }}
          />
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
});

ProfileReportTemplatesSection.displayName = 'ProfileReportTemplatesSection';

ProfileReportTemplatesSection.propTypes = {
  initialSingle: PropTypes.string,
  initialMulti: PropTypes.string,
  onSingleChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onMultiChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onReset: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  resetCounter: PropTypes.number,
};

export default ProfileReportTemplatesSection;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileSecurityTab
 * @description Account security and password management tab.
 * Enforces zero-lag typing with react-hook-form mode: 'onBlur' and zero watch calls.
 */

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import LockResetIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LockReset';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import { useUpdatePasswordMutation } from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';
import { PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Security Tab providing password update capabilities and complexity verification.
 * Supports dual-mode for Google SSO accounts creating their first password.
 *
 * @component ProfileSecurityTab
 * @param {Object} [props]
 * @param {Object} [props.user] - Optional user object override.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered security tab.
 */
export const ProfileSecurityTab = ({ user: propUser }) => {
  const authUser = useSelector((state) => state.auth.user);
  const user = propUser || authUser;
  const isPasswordSet = user?.isPasswordSet !== false;

  const [updatePassword, { isLoading }] = useUpdatePasswordMutation();

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    reset,
    formState: { errors, isDirty },
  } = useForm({
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      currentPassword: '',
      newPassword: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values) => {
    try {
      await updatePassword({
        currentPassword: isPasswordSet ? values.currentPassword : '',
        newPassword: values.newPassword,
        confirmNewPassword: values.confirmPassword,
      }).unwrap();

      reset();
      toast.success(
        isPasswordSet
          ? 'Account password updated successfully.'
          : 'Account password set successfully! You can now log in with email/password or Google.'
      );
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update password. Please check your current password.';
      toast.error(errorMsg);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        boxShadow: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 } }}>
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' }, fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
          Account Security & Password
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }, mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
          Ensure your Personal AI Agent account remains secure with a strong, complex password.
        </Typography>

        {!isPasswordSet && (
          <Alert
            severity="info"
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
              borderRadius: '8px',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              '& .MuiAlert-message': { fontSize: '0.8125rem', lineHeight: 1.5 },
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, display: 'block', mb: 0.5, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
              Google Sign-In Account (Dual-Mode Login):
            </Typography>
            Your account was created via Google Sign-In and does not have an email password yet. Set an application password below to enable logging in with both email/password and Google.
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
          <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Current Password (rendered only if existing password is set) */}
            {isPasswordSet && (
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                <MuiTextField
                  label="Current Password"
                  type="password"
                  isPassword
                  fullWidth
                  error={Boolean(errors.currentPassword)}
                  helperText={errors.currentPassword?.message || 'Enter your existing account password'}
                  {...register('currentPassword', {
                    required: isPasswordSet ? 'Current password is required.' : false,
                  })}
                />
              </Grid>
            )}

            {/* New Password */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="New Password"
                type="password"
                isPassword
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.newPassword)}
                helperText={errors.newPassword?.message || `Minimum ${PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH || 8} characters`}
                {...register('newPassword', {
                  required: 'New password is required.',
                  minLength: {
                    value: PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH || 8,
                    message: `Password must be at least ${PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH || 8} characters long.`,
                  },
                  validate: {
                    hasUpper: (v) => /[A-Z]/.test(v) || 'Must contain at least 1 uppercase letter.',
                    hasLower: (v) => /[a-z]/.test(v) || 'Must contain at least 1 lowercase letter.',
                    hasNumberOrSpecial: (v) =>
                      /[0-9!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/.test(v) || 'Must contain at least 1 number or special character.',
                  },
                })}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* Confirm Password */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
              <MuiTextField
                label="Confirm New Password"
                type="password"
                isPassword
                fullWidth
                error={Boolean(errors.confirmPassword)}
                helperText={errors.confirmPassword?.message || 'Re-enter your new password'}
                {...register('confirmPassword', {
                  required: 'Please confirm your new password.',
                  validate: (val, formValues) =>
                    val === formValues.newPassword || 'The passwords do not match.',
                })}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          {/* Password Complexity Policy Deck */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              mt: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
              p: 1.5,
              borderRadius: '8px',
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              border: 1,
              borderColor: 'divider',
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.75 }}>
              Password Complexity Guidelines:
            </Typography>
            <Stack spacing={0.5}>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', color: 'primary.main' }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  At least 8 characters long (up to 128 characters)
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', color: 'primary.main' }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  Includes at least one uppercase letter (A-Z) and one lowercase letter (a-z)
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', color: 'primary.main' }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                  Includes at least one numeric digit (0-9) or special character (!@#$%^&*)
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Stack>
          </Box>

          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              mt: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
            }}
          >
            <MuiButton
              type="submit"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isLoading || !isDirty}
              startIcon={
                isLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <LockResetIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                py: { xs: 0.85, sm: 0.75 },
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isLoading
                ? (isPasswordSet ? 'Updating Password...' : 'Setting Password...')
                : (isPasswordSet ? 'Update Account Password' : 'Set Account Password')}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default ProfileSecurityTab;

/**
 * @module components/profile/ProfileTelegramTab
 * @description Telegram Operational Channels, Bot Token, and Broadcast Preferences tab.
 * Enforces zero-lag typing with react-hook-form mode: 'onBlur' and zero watch calls.
 */

import { useForm, Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Switch from '@mui/material/Switch';
import RadioGroup from '@mui/material/RadioGroup';
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel';
import Radio from '@mui/material/Radio';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import SendIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Send';
import SaveIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Save';
import SignalCellularAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SignalCellularAlt';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import LinkOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LinkOff';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import {
  useVerifyTelegramBotTokenMutation,
  useConnectTelegramMutation,
  useDisconnectTelegramMutation,
  useToggleTelegramMutation,
} from '../../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTextField from '../reusable/MuiTextField.jsx';

/**
 * Telegram Channels and Broadcast Settings Tab.
 *
 * @component ProfileTelegramTab
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.user - Active supervisor user object.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered telegram tab.
 */
export const ProfileTelegramTab = ({ user }) => {
  const [verifyToken, { isLoading: isPinging }] = useVerifyTelegramBotTokenMutation();
  const [connectTelegram, { isLoading: isSaving }] = useConnectTelegramMutation();
  const [disconnectTelegram, { isLoading: isDisconnecting }] = useDisconnectTelegramMutation();
  const [toggleTelegram, { isLoading: isToggling }] = useToggleTelegramMutation();

  const initialTelegram = user?.integrations?.telegram || {};
  const isConnected = Boolean(initialTelegram.connected);
  const isEnabled = initialTelegram.enabled !== false;
  const botUsername = initialTelegram.botUsername || null;

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    getValues,
    reset,
  } = useForm({
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      botToken: initialTelegram.botToken || '',
      managementChatId: initialTelegram.managementChatId || '',
      maintenanceChatId: initialTelegram.maintenanceChatId || '',
      generalChatId: initialTelegram.generalChatId || '',
      defaultFormat: initialTelegram.defaultFormat || 'text',
    },
  });

  const handleTestPing = async () => {
    const rawToken = getValues('botToken');
    const token = typeof rawToken === 'string' ? rawToken.trim() : '';

    if (!token) {
      toast.warning('Please enter a Telegram Bot Token before testing.');
      return;
    }

    const tokenPattern = /^\d+:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$/;
    if (!tokenPattern.test(token)) {
      toast.error('Invalid Telegram Bot Token format. Tokens typically look like: 123456789:ABCDefgh-IJKLmnOPqrstUV');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await verifyToken({ botToken: token }).unwrap();
      if (res?.valid) {
        toast.success(`Telegram Bot verified: @${res.bot.username || 'bot'} (${res.bot.firstName || 'Bot'})`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Invalid Telegram Bot Token.');
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnect = async () => {
    try {
      await disconnectTelegram().unwrap();
      reset({
        botToken: '',
        managementChatId: '',
        maintenanceChatId: '',
        generalChatId: '',
        defaultFormat: 'text',
      });
      toast.success('Telegram integration disconnected successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to disconnect Telegram.');
    }
  };

  const handleToggle = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await toggleTelegram().unwrap();
      toast.success(`Telegram integration ${res?.data?.enabled ? 'enabled' : 'paused'}.`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to toggle Telegram.');
    }
  };

  const onSubmit = async (values) => {
    try {
      await connectTelegram({
        botToken: values.botToken?.trim() || undefined,
        managementChatId: values.managementChatId?.trim() || null,
        maintenanceChatId: values.maintenanceChatId?.trim() || null,
        generalChatId: values.generalChatId?.trim() || null,
        defaultFormat: values.defaultFormat || 'text',
      }).unwrap();

      toast.success('Telegram operational channels connected and saved successfully.');
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to update Telegram settings.';
      toast.error(errorMsg);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: '12px',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: isConnected ? 'primary.light' : 'divider',
        boxShadow: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 } }}>
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
            alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            gap: 1.5,
            mb: 1,
          }}
        >
          {/* Tier 1: Title and Bot Status Chip */}
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap', minWidth: 0, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}>
            <SendIcon color="primary" fontSize="small" sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' }, fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Telegram Operational Broadcast Channels
            </Typography>
            <Chip
              icon={isConnected ? <CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" /> : undefined}
              label={isConnected ? (botUsername ? `@${botUsername}` : 'Connected') : 'Not Connected'}
              color={isConnected ? (isEnabled ? 'success' : 'default') : 'default'}
              size="small"
              variant={isConnected ? 'filled' : 'outlined'}
              sx={{
                maxWidth: { xs: 150, sm: 220 },
                '& .MuiChip-label': { overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' },
              }}
            />
          </Box>

          {/* Tier 2: Controls cluster (Enabled toggle + Disconnect) */}
          {isConnected && (
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',

            >
              <FormControlLabel
                control={<Switch checked={isEnabled} onChange={handleToggle} disabled={isToggling} size="small" />}
                label={isEnabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Paused'}
                sx={{ m: 0 }}
              />

              {/* Desktop/Tablet Disconnect Button */}
              <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' } }}>
                <MuiButton
                  variant="outlined"

                  startIcon={isDisconnecting ? <CircularProgress size={12} color="inherit" /> : <LinkOffIcon fontSize="small" />}

                  sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
                >
                  Disconnect
                </MuiButton>
              </Box>

              {/* Mobile xs Iconified Disconnect Button with Tooltip */}
              <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' } }}>
                <Tooltip title="Disconnect Telegram" arrow>
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      color="error"

                      sx={{
                        border: 1,
                        borderColor: 'error.main',
                        borderRadius: 1,

                      }}
                    >
                      {isDisconnecting ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <LinkOffIcon fontSize="small" />}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.875rem' }, mb: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 } }}>
          Connect your Telegram Bot to instantly dispatch synthesized inspection dossiers, incident alerts, and executive briefings to operations channels.
        </Typography>

        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
          <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 1.5, sm: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Bot API Token */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
                Telegram Bot API Token
              </Typography>
              <MuiTextField
                type="password"
                isPassword
                fullWidth
                placeholder="e.g. 7123456789:AAHk1_example_token_abcdef12345"
                helperText="Generated via Telegram's @BotFather. Kept securely encrypted on the server."
                {...register('botToken')}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* Management Channel Chat ID */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
                Management Channel ID
              </Typography>
              <MuiTextField
                fullWidth
                placeholder="e.g. -1001234567890"
                helperText="Executive & area leadership channel"
                {...register('managementChatId')}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* Maintenance Channel Chat ID */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>

              </Typography>
              <MuiTextField
                fullWidth
                placeholder="e.g. -1002345678901"
                helperText="Equipment & facilities dispatch channel"
                {...register('maintenanceChatId')}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* General Channel Chat ID */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
