              </Typography>
              <MuiTextField
                fullWidth
                placeholder="e.g. -1003456789012"
                helperText="All-hands or branch operations chat"
                {...register('generalChatId')}
              />
            </Grid>

            {/* Telegram Channel Setup Guidance */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Alert
                severity="info"
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                  '& .MuiAlert-message': { fontSize: '0.8125rem', lineHeight: 1.5 },
                }}
              >
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, display: 'block', mb: 0.5, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  Important Telegram Channel Setup Requirements:
                </Typography>
                <Box component="ul" sx={{ m: 0, pl: 2 }}>
                  <li>
                    <strong>Administrator Rights:</strong> You must add your bot to the channel/group as an <em>Administrator</em> with <strong>&quot;Post Messages&quot;</strong> permission enabled. Otherwise, Telegram will reject broadcast attempts.
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    <strong>Channel Chat ID:</strong> Telegram channels and supergroups require the <code>-100</code> prefix (e.g. <code>-1001003982938439</code>) or a public username (e.g. <code>@my_channel</code>). You can find your Chat ID via <em>web.telegram.org</em> in the browser URL bar or by forwarding a message from the channel to <code>@userinfobot</code>.
                  </li>
                </Box>
              </Alert>
            </Grid>

            {/* Broadcast Format Selection */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
                Default Broadcast Format
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 1.5 }}>
                Choose how reports and executive summaries are formatted when posted to Telegram channels.
              </Typography>

              <Controller
                name="defaultFormat"
                control={control}
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <RadioGroup
                    {...field}
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                      gap: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2 },
                    }}
                  >
                    <Card
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        flex: 1,
                        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 1.5 },
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        borderColor: field.value === 'text' ? 'primary.main' : 'divider',
                        bgcolor: field.value === 'text' ? 'action.selected' : 'background.paper',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                      onClick={() => field.onChange('text')}
                    >
                      <FormControlLabel
                        value="text"
                        control={<Radio size="small" />}
                        label={
                          <Box>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                              Plain Text Markdown
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
                              Formatted Markdown with bold headers and plain-text bullets. Maximum readability on mobile devices.
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        }
                        sx={{ m: 0, width: '100%', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}
                      />
                    </Card>

                    <Card
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        flex: 1,
                        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 1.5 },
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        borderColor: field.value === 'image' ? 'primary.main' : 'divider',
                        bgcolor: field.value === 'image' ? 'action.selected' : 'background.paper',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                      onClick={() => field.onChange('image')}
                    >
                      <FormControlLabel
                        value="image"
                        control={<Radio size="small" />}
                        label={
                          <Box>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                              High-Resolution 2K Image Card
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
                              Rendered 2048px corporate graphic card with branded header, status pills, and Amharic typography.
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        }
                        sx={{ m: 0, width: '100%', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}
                      />
                    </Card>
                  </RadioGroup>
                )}
              />
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          {/* Action Buttons Deck */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column-reverse', sm: 'row' },
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 2,
              mt: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3.5 },
            }}
          >
            {/* Ping Bot Button */}
            <MuiButton
              variant="outlined"
              color="inherit"
              disabled={isPinging}
              onClick={handleTestPing}
              startIcon={
                isPinging ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <SignalCellularAltIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                color: 'text.secondary',
              }}
            >
              {isPinging ? 'Pinging Bot...' : 'Test Bot Token'}
            </MuiButton>

            {/* Save Settings Button */}
            <MuiButton
              type="submit"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isSaving}
              startIcon={
                isSaving ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveIcon fontSize="small" />
              }
              sx={{
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                py: { xs: 1, sm: 0.75 },
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              {isSaving ? 'Connecting...' : (isConnected ? 'Update Telegram Settings' : 'Connect Telegram')}
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

ProfileTelegramTab.propTypes = {
  user: PropTypes.shape({
    settings: PropTypes.shape({
      telegram: PropTypes.shape({

        managementChatId: PropTypes.string,
        maintenanceChatId: PropTypes.string,
        generalChatId: PropTypes.string,
        defaultFormat: PropTypes.string,
      }),
    }),
  }),
};

export default ProfileTelegramTab;

/**
 * @module components/reports/MuiReportTelegramShareButton
 * @description Self-contained, reusable Telegram report sharing component.
 * Features:
 * - Direct popover action deck matching enterprise chat & report delivery specs.
 * - Format selector: Semantic Text (HTML) vs High-Fidelity Image Card.
 * - Multi-channel selection: Management, Maintenance & Facilities, and General Operations.
 * - Telegram integration health check with direct navigation to Profile configuration.
 * - Fully decoupled from chat routes; executes against Report SSOT (/api/v1/reports/:id/share/telegram).
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Popover from '@mui/material/Popover';
import MenuList from '@mui/material/MenuList';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import TelegramIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Telegram';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import { useShareReportToTelegramMutation } from '../../redux/features/reportSlice.js';

/**
 * Reusable Telegram report broadcast button.
 *
 * @component MuiReportTelegramShareButton
 * @param {object} props
 * @param {object|string} props.report - Operational report object or report ID.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'|'large'} [props.size='small'] - IconButton size.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether button is disabled.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Additional MUI styling overrides.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Telegram share button and modal popover.
 */
export const MuiReportTelegramShareButton = memo(({
  report,
  size = 'small',
  disabled = false,
  variant = 'icon',
  label = 'Share',
  buttonVariant = 'outlined',
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const user = useSelector((state) => state.auth.user);
  const telegram = user?.integrations?.telegram || {};
  const isTelegramConnected = Boolean(telegram.connected);
  const isTelegramEnabled = telegram.enabled !== false;

  const [shareReportToTelegram] = useShareReportToTelegramMutation();
  const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState(null);
  const [userSelectedFormat, setUserSelectedFormat] = useState(null);
  const telegramFormat = userSelectedFormat || telegram.defaultFormat || 'text';
  const [sharingChannel, setSharingChannel] = useState(null);

  const reportId = typeof report === 'string' ? report : (report?._id || report?.id);

  const telegramChannels = [
    {
      id: 'management',
      label: 'Management (Default)',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.managementChatId),
    },
    {
      id: 'maintenance',
      label: 'Maintenance & Facilities',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.maintenanceChatId),
    },
    {
      id: 'general',
      label: 'General Operations',
      configured: Boolean(telegram.generalChatId),
    },
  ];

  const handleOpen = useCallback((e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setAnchorEl(e.currentTarget);
  }, []);

  const handleClose = useCallback((e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    setAnchorEl(null);
  }, []);

  const handleShareToChannel = useCallback(async (channel, e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    if (!reportId || sharingChannel) return;

    setSharingChannel(channel);
    try {
      const res = await shareReportToTelegram({
        reportId,
        targetChannel: channel,
        asImage: telegramFormat === 'image',
      }).unwrap();

      const modeLabel = telegramFormat === 'image' ? 'Image Card' : 'Text';
      toast.success(res?.message || `Dispatched report to Telegram: ${channel} [${modeLabel}]`);
      setAnchorEl(null);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Telegram report dispatch failed');
    } finally {
      setSharingChannel(null);
    }
  }, [reportId, sharingChannel, shareReportToTelegram, telegramFormat]);

  const isPopoverOpen = Boolean(anchorEl);

  return (
    <>
      {variant === 'button' ? (
        <Button
          variant={buttonVariant}
          size={size}
          onClick={handleOpen}
          disabled={disabled || !reportId}
          startIcon={<TelegramIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: '#2AABEE' }} />}
          aria-label="share report to telegram"
          sx={{
            textTransform: 'none',
            fontWeight: 700,
            fontSize: '0.8rem',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            color: '#2AABEE',
            borderColor: 'divider',
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          {label}
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <Tooltip title="Share to Telegram" arrow>
          <span>
            <IconButton
              size={size}
              onClick={handleOpen}
              disabled={disabled || !reportId}
              aria-label="share report to telegram"
              sx={{
                color: isPopoverOpen ? '#2AABEE' : 'text.secondary',
                transition: 'color 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease',
                '&:hover': {
                  color: '#2AABEE',
                  transform: 'scale(1.08)',
                },
                ...sx,
              }}
            >
              <TelegramIcon fontSize={size === 'small' ? 'small' : 'medium'} />
            </IconButton>
          </span>
        </Tooltip>
      )}

      <Popover
        open={isPopoverOpen}
        anchorEl={anchorEl}
        onClose={handleClose}
        disableEnforceFocus={true}
        disableRestoreFocus={true}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'center' }}
        transformOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'center' }}
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            sx: {
              p: 1.5,
              width: 270,
              borderRadius: 2,
              boxShadow: 4,
              border: 1,
              borderColor: 'divider',
              backgroundImage: 'none',
              mt: 0.5,
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 1.2 }}>
          <TelegramIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2AABEE' }} />
          <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8125rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Share Report to Telegram
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {!isTelegramConnected || !isTelegramEnabled ? (
          <Box sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: '0.8125rem', color: 'text.secondary', mb: 1.5 }}>
              {!isTelegramConnected
                ? 'Telegram bot integration is not connected.'
                : 'Telegram integration is currently paused.'}
            </Typography>
            <Button
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              fullWidth
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleClose();
                navigate('/profile?tab=telegram');
              }}
              sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', textTransform: 'none' }}
            >
              Configure Telegram
            </Button>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ToggleButtonGroup
              value={telegramFormat}
              exclusive
              onChange={(_e, val) => val && setUserSelectedFormat(val)}
              size="small"
              fullWidth
              sx={{ mb: 1 }}
            >
              <ToggleButton value="text" sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', py: 0.3, textTransform: 'none' }}>
                Text (HTML)
              </ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton value="image" sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', py: 0.3, textTransform: 'none' }}>
                Image Card
              </ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>

            <Divider sx={{ my: 0.8 }} />

            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block', mb: 0.5 }}>
              Select Broadcast Channel:
            </Typography>

            <MenuList disablePadding>
              {telegramChannels.map((item) => {
                const isDisabled = !item.configured || Boolean(sharingChannel);
                const menuItem = (
                  <MenuItem
                    key={item.id}
                    onClick={(e) => item.configured && handleShareToChannel(item.id, e)}
                    disabled={isDisabled}
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                      borderRadius: 1,
                      py: 0.6,
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      opacity: item.configured ? 1 : 0.6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>{item.label}</span>
                    {sharingChannel === item.id ? (
                      <CircularProgress size={12} sx={{ ml: 1, color: '#2AABEE' }} />
                    ) : !item.configured ? (
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: 'text.disabled' }}>
                        Not set
                      </Typography>
                    ) : null}
                  </MenuItem>
                );

                if (!item.configured) {
                  return (
                    <Tooltip key={item.id} title="Chat ID not configured in Profile > Telegram" arrow placement="left">
                      <span>{menuItem}</span>
                    </Tooltip>
                  );
                }

                return menuItem;
              })}
            </MenuList>
          </>
        )}
      </Popover>
    </>
  );
});

MuiReportTelegramShareButton.displayName = 'MuiReportTelegramShareButton';

MuiReportTelegramShareButton.propTypes = {
  report: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.object, PropTypes.string]).isRequired,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium', 'large']),
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  variant: PropTypes.oneOf(['icon', 'button']),
  label: PropTypes.string,
  buttonVariant: PropTypes.oneOf(['outlined', 'contained', 'text']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiReportTelegramShareButton;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportActivitiesCard
 * @description Structured subdocument panel displaying operational activities and checklist items.
 * Features:
 * - Clean English title strictly formatted as "Activities (N)"
 * - Deprecated props purged in favor of modern MUI slotProps
 * - MaxHeight scroll bounds with custom theme scrollbars for collection scalability
 * - Item-level editing capability with zero-lag uncontrolled text input
 * - Responsive 2-tier stacked layout on mobile xs (vw < 600px) preventing text compression
 * - Reduced horizontal padding on mobile xs preserving viewport width
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import Select from '@mui/material/Select';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import FormControl from '@mui/material/FormControl';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';

import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import AssignmentTurnedInOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AssignmentTurnedInOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';

import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import { REPORT_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

const ACTIVITY_STATUS_LABELS = {
  completed: 'Completed',
  in_progress: 'In Progress',
};

/**
 * Operational activities checklist panel.
 *
 * @component ReportActivitiesCard
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.activities=[]] - Array of activity subdocuments.
 * @param {(updatedActivities: Array<object>) => void} [props.onUpdateActivities] - Item-level edit callback.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered activities card.
 */
export const ReportActivitiesCard = memo(({ activities = [], onUpdateActivities }) => {
  const completedCount = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'completed').length;
  const inProgressCount = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'in_progress').length;

  // Uncontrolled input ref for zero-lag editing (0 React re-renders on keystroke)
  const editInputRef = useRef(null);
  const addInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [editingIndex, setEditingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ACTIVITY_STATUS);
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [addStatus, setAddStatus] = useState(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ACTIVITY_STATUS);
  const [savingIndex, setSavingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [deletingIndex, setDeletingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [isAddSaving, setIsAddSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback((idx, item) => {
    setEditingIndex(idx);
    const validStatus = REPORT_CONSTANTS.ACTIVITY_STATUSES.includes(item?.status)
      ? item.status
      : REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ACTIVITY_STATUS;
    setEditStatus(validStatus);
  }, []);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditingIndex(null);
    setEditStatus(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ACTIVITY_STATUS);
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateActivities) return;
      const updated = activities.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
      try {
        setDeletingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateActivities(updated);
        if (editingIndex === idx) {
          setEditingIndex(null);
        } else if (editingIndex > idx) {
          setEditingIndex(editingIndex - 1);
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep state if update fails
      } finally {
        setDeletingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [activities, onUpdateActivities, editingIndex]
  );

  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateActivities) {
        setEditingIndex(null);
        return;
      }
      const newText = editInputRef.current ? editInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
      if (!newText) return;

      const updated = activities.map((item, i) =>
        i === idx ? { ...item, text: newText, status: editStatus } : item
      );
      try {
        setSavingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateActivities(updated);
        setEditingIndex(null);
      } catch {
        // Keep in edit mode so edits are preserved if update fails
      } finally {
        setSavingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [activities, editStatus, onUpdateActivities]
  );

  const handleSaveAdd = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onUpdateActivities) {
      setIsAdding(false);
      return;
    }
    const newText = addInputRef.current ? addInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
    if (!newText) return;

    try {
      setIsAddSaving(true);
      await onUpdateActivities([...activities, { text: newText, status: addStatus }]);
      setIsAdding(false);
      setAddStatus('completed');
    } catch {
      // Keep adding form open so input is preserved
    } finally {
      setIsAddSaving(false);
    }
  }, [activities, addStatus, onUpdateActivities]);

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2, md: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        height: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Counter Badges & Add Button */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          pb: 1.5,
          mb: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <AssignmentTurnedInOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
            Activities ({activities.length})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
          {completedCount > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completedCount} done`} size="small" />
          )}
          {inProgressCount > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgressCount} prog`} size="small" />
          )}
          {onUpdateActivities && (
            <Tooltip title="Add Activity">
              <span>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdding((prev) => !prev)}
                  disabled={isAddSaving}
                  aria-label="Add Activity"
                  sx={{ border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`, p: 0.5 }}
                >
                  <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Inline Add Activity Form */}
      {isAdding && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            p: 1.5,
            mb: 1.5,
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.primary.main}`,
            bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 1.25,
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            inputRef={addInputRef}
            size="small"
            multiline
            minRows={2}
            maxRows={4}
            placeholder="Describe new operational activity..."
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            disabled={isAddSaving}
            slotProps={{
              input: {
                sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem' },
              },
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) handleSaveAdd();
              if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isAddSaving) setIsAdding(false);
            }}
          />
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <FormControl size="small">
              <Select
                value={addStatus}
                onChange={(e) => setAddStatus(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                sx={{ height: 32, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
              >
                {REPORT_CONSTANTS.ACTIVITY_STATUSES.map((statusKey) => (
                  <MenuItem key={statusKey} value={statusKey}>
                    {ACTIVITY_STATUS_LABELS[statusKey] || statusKey}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>

            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                color="inherit"
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}
              >
                Cancel
              </MuiButton>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                startIcon={isAddSaving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : null}
                onClick={handleSaveAdd}
              >
                Add
              </MuiButton>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* List of Activities with Scroll Bounds */}
      {activities.length === 0 ? (
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic', py: 2 }}>
          No operational activities recorded for this inspection.
        </Typography>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            maxHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            overflowY: 'auto',
            pr: 0.5,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: '6px' },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.2),
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.4),
            },
          }}
        >
          <List disablePadding sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
            {activities.map((item, idx) => {
              const isEditing = editingIndex === idx;

              if (isEditing) {
                return (
                  <ListItem
                    key={item._id || idx}
                    disableGutters
                    sx={{
                      py: 1.5,
                      borderBottom:
                        idx < activities.length - 1
                          ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                          : 'none',
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      alignItems: 'stretch',
                      gap: 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    {/* Zero-lag Uncontrolled Input (0 React re-renders on keystroke) */}
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      minRows={2}
                      maxRows={4}
                      inputRef={editInputRef}
                      defaultValue={item.text}
                      disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                      placeholder="Activity description"
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem' },
                        },
                      }}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) handleSaveEdit(idx);
                        if (e.key === 'Escape' && savingIndex !== idx && deletingIndex !== idx) handleCancelEdit();
                      }}
                    />
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        gap: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Select
                        size="small"
                        value={editStatus}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}
                        disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                        MenuProps={{
                          disableEnforceFocus: true,
                          disableRestoreFocus: true,
                        }}
                        sx={{ height: 32, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
                      >
                        {REPORT_CONSTANTS.ACTIVITY_STATUSES.map((statusKey) => (
                          <MenuItem key={statusKey} value={statusKey}>
                            {ACTIVITY_STATUS_LABELS[statusKey] || statusKey}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                        <Tooltip title="Delete Activity">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="error"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                              aria-label="Delete activity"
                            >
                              {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                              ) : (
                                <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Save change">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)}
                              aria-label="Save activity"
                            >
                              {savingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                              ) : (
                                <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Cancel">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="inherit"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                              aria-label="Cancel editing"
                            >
                              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </Box>
                    </Box>
                  </ListItem>
                );
              }

              return (
                <ListItem
                  key={item._id || idx}
                  disableGutters
                  sx={{
                    py: 1.25,
                    borderBottom:
                      idx < activities.length - 1
                        ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                        : 'none',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                    alignItems: { xs: 'stretch', sm: 'flex-start' },
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.5 },
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Tier 1 on xs (Left block on sm): Icon + Full-width text with optical baseline alignment */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1, flex: 1, width: '100%', minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <CheckCircleOutlineIcon
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: 18,
                        color: item.status === 'completed' ? 'success.main' : 'warning.main',
                        mt: '3px',
                        flexShrink: 0,
                      }}
                    />
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      sx={{
                        m: 0,
                        p: 0,
                        lineHeight: 1.5,
                        fontWeight: 500,
                        color: 'text.primary',
                        wordBreak: 'break-word',
                        flex: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.text}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Tier 2 on xs (Right block on sm): Status Chip + Edit button grouped right */}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                      gap: 1,
                      flexShrink: 0,
                      width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                      pl: 0,
                    }}
                  >
                    <MuiStatusChip
                      status={item.status || REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ACTIVITY_STATUS}
                      size="small"
                      label={ACTIVITY_STATUS_LABELS[item.status] || undefined}
                    />
                    {onUpdateActivities && (
                      <>
                        <Tooltip title="Edit Activity">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx, item)}
                              sx={{
                                p: 0.5,
                                color: 'text.secondary',
                                '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
                              }}
                              aria-label="Edit activity"
                            >
                              <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Delete Activity">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                              sx={{
                                p: 0.5,
                                color: 'text.secondary',
                                '&:hover': { color: 'error.main' },
                              }}
                              aria-label="Delete activity"
                            >
                              {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                              ) : (
                                <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </ListItem>
              );
            })}
          </List>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportActivitiesCard.displayName = 'ReportActivitiesCard';

ReportActivitiesCard.propTypes = {
  activities: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      _id: PropTypes.string,
      text: PropTypes.string,
      status: PropTypes.string,
    })
  ),
  onUpdateActivities: PropTypes.func,
};

export default ReportActivitiesCard;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportAmharicDossier
 * @description Synthesized Corporate Amharic Dossier Canvas (Row 4 of Report Detail).
 * Features:
 * - Authoritative Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Amharic text presentation
 * - Ge'ez typography ('Noto Sans Ethiopic', 'Nyala', sans-serif) with 1.8 line-height
 * - Pre-line whitespace preservation
 * - Top-right 1-click clipboard copy shortcut.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import ContentCopyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContentCopyOutlined';
import TranslateOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TranslateOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Authoritative Amharic report transcription canvas.
 *
 * @component ReportAmharicDossier
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} [props.transcription=''] - Authoritative Amharic operational text.
 * @param {(newTranscription: string) => Promise<any>} [props.onUpdateTranscription] - Optional update handler for in-place editing.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Amharic dossier canvas.
 */
export const ReportAmharicDossier = memo(({ transcription = '', onUpdateTranscription }) => {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const editInputRef = useRef(null);
  const charCountRef = useRef(null);

  const handleCopy = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!transcription) return;

    try {
      if (navigator?.clipboard?.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(transcription);
        toast.success('Amharic text copied to clipboard!');
      } else {
        toast.error('Clipboard access not supported in this browser.');
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to copy text.');
    }
  }, [transcription]);

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setIsEditing(true);
  }, []);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setIsEditing(false);
  }, []);

  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onUpdateTranscription) {
      setIsEditing(false);
      return;
    }
    const newText = editInputRef.current ? editInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
    if (!newText) {
      toast.error('Dossier transcription text cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSaving(true);
      await onUpdateTranscription(newText);
      setIsEditing(false);
    } catch {
      // Keep edit state open on error so edits are not lost
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }, [onUpdateTranscription]);

  const handleInput = useCallback((e) => {
    if (charCountRef.current) {
      charCountRef.current.textContent = `${e.target.value.length} / 50000 chars`;
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 2,
      }}
    >
      {/* Dossier Header */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          pb: 1.5,
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <TranslateOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
            Authoritative Amharic Dossier
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          {/* In-place Edit Button (only rendered when onUpdateTranscription is provided) */}
          {Boolean(onUpdateTranscription) && !isEditing && (
            <Tooltip title="Edit Amharic transcription" arrow>
              <span>
                <MuiButton
                  size="small"
                  variant="outlined"
                  color="primary"
                  startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
                  onClick={handleStartEdit}
                  sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' }, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}
                >
                  Edit Text
                </MuiButton>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={handleStartEdit}
                  aria-label="Edit Amharic text"
                  sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' }, border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}` }}
                >
                  <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}

          {/* Copy Text Button */}
          {transcription && !isEditing && (
            <Tooltip title="Copy Amharic text to clipboard" arrow>
              <span>
                <MuiButton
                  size="small"
                  variant="outlined"
                  color="inherit"
                  startIcon={<ContentCopyOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
                  onClick={handleCopy}
                  sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'inline-flex' }, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}
                >
                  Copy Text
                </MuiButton>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={handleCopy}
                  aria-label="Copy Amharic text"
                  sx={{ display: { xs: 'inline-flex', sm: 'none' }, border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}` }}
                >
                  <ContentCopyOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Amharic Text Body: Edit Mode vs View Mode */}
      {isEditing ? (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5, p: { xs: 0.5, sm: 1 } }}>
          <TextField
            inputRef={editInputRef}
            defaultValue={transcription}
            multiline
            minRows={5}
            maxRows={14}
            fullWidth
            onInput={handleInput}
            aria-label="Amharic dossier transcription text editor"
            placeholder="የዕለቱ የስራ ክንውን ሪፖርት ጽሑፍ..."
            slotProps={{
              input: {
                sx: {
                  fontFamily: "'Noto Sans Ethiopic', 'Nyala', sans-serif",
                  fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' },
                  lineHeight: 1.8,
                  bgcolor: (t) => (t.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.02)'),
                },
              },
            }}
          />

          {/* Edit Toolbar: Character Counter & Action Buttons */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: 1.5,
              pt: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            <Typography
              ref={charCountRef}
              variant="caption"
              sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 500 }}
            >
              {transcription.length} / 50000 chars
            </Typography>

            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                variant="outlined"
                color="inherit"
                startIcon={<CloseIcon fontSize="small" />}
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                disabled={isSaving}
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                Cancel
              </MuiButton>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                startIcon={isSaving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />}
                onClick={handleSaveEdit}
                disabled={isSaving}
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Text'}
              </MuiButton>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      ) : transcription ? (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 } }}>
          <Typography
            component="div"
            sx={{
              fontFamily: "'Noto Sans Ethiopic', 'Nyala', sans-serif",
              fontSize: { xs: '0.95rem', sm: '1.05rem' },
              lineHeight: 1.8,
              color: 'text.primary',
              whiteSpace: 'pre-line',
              wordBreak: 'break-word',
            }}
          >
            {transcription}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Box sx={{ py: 3, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            No Amharic transcription text recorded for this report.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportAmharicDossier.displayName = 'ReportAmharicDossier';

ReportAmharicDossier.propTypes = {
  transcription: PropTypes.string,
  onUpdateTranscription: PropTypes.func,
};

export default ReportAmharicDossier;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportAudioPlayerDeck
 * @description Evidentiary Voice Notes & Audio Player Deck (Row 6 of Report Detail).
 * Renders audio recordings attached to the operational report:
 * - Original file name, MIME type format badge, file size in MB
 * - Audio duration and HTML5 audio playback controls
 * - Speech-to-text transcript preview snippet.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import MicNoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MicNoneOutlined';
import GraphicEqOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GraphicEqOutlined';

/**
 * Audio voice notes evidentiary player deck.
 *
 * @component ReportAudioPlayerDeck
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.audios=[]] - Array of Audio document records.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered audio deck.
 */
export const ReportAudioPlayerDeck = memo(({ audios = [] }) => {
  const formatDuration = (seconds) => {
    if (!seconds || Number.isNaN(Number(seconds))) return '—';
    const totalSec = Math.round(Number(seconds));
    const m = Math.floor(totalSec / 60);
    const s = totalSec % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes || Number.isNaN(Number(bytes))) return '';
    const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024);
    return `${mb.toFixed(2)} MB`;
  };

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      className="report-audio-deck"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
        <MicNoneOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
          Evidentiary Voice Notes ({audios.length})
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      {/* Audio Items Grid with Scroll Bounds */}
      {audios.length === 0 ? (
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic', py: 1 }}>
          No audio voice notes recorded or attached to this inspection report.
        </Typography>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            maxHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            overflowY: 'auto',
            pr: 0.5,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: '6px' },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.2),
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.4),
            },
          }}
        >
          <Grid container spacing={2}>
            {audios.map((audio, idx) => {
              const fileName = audio.originalName || audio.fileName || `Voice Note #${idx + 1}`;
              const mimeType = audio.mimeType || 'audio/webm';
              const durationStr = formatDuration(audio.duration);
              const sizeStr = formatFileSize(audio.size);
              const audioSrc =
                audio.url ||
                (audio.fileName ? `/uploads/audios/${audio.fileName}` : '') ||
                (audio.path ? `/${audio.path.replace(/\\/g, '/')}` : '');

              return (
                <Grid key={audio._id || idx} size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      p: 2,
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      border: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
                      bgcolor: 'action.hover',
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      gap: 1.5,
                    }}
                  >
                  {/* File Metadata Row */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                      <GraphicEqOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 20, flexShrink: 0 }} />
                      <Typography
                        variant="subtitle2"
                        sx={{
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}
                      >
                        {fileName}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      <Chip
                        label={mimeType.replace('audio/', '').toUpperCase()}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', height: 20, fontWeight: 700 }}
                      />
                      {durationStr !== '—' && (
                        <Chip
                          label={durationStr}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                          sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', height: 20, fontWeight: 600 }}
                        />
                      )}
                      {sizeStr && (
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                          {sizeStr}
                        </Typography>
                      )}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>

                  {/* HTML5 Native Audio Player */}
                  {audioSrc && (
                    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                      <audio
                        controls
                        src={audioSrc}
                        style={{
                          width: '100%',
                          height: 36,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                          outline: 'none',
                        }}
                      >
                        Your browser does not support audio playback.
                      </audio>
                    </Box>
                  )}

                  {/* Transcript Snippet */}
                  {audio.transcription && (
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        p: 1,
                        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                        borderRadius: 1,
                        border: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', mb: 0.25 }}>
                        STT Transcript:
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography
                        variant="caption"
                        sx={{
                          color: 'text.primary',
                          fontFamily: "'Noto Sans Ethiopic', 'Nyala', sans-serif",
                          lineHeight: 1.5,
                          display: '-webkit-box',
                          WebkitLineClamp: 2,
                          WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                        }}
                      >
                        {audio.transcription}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  )}
                </Box>
              </Grid>
            );
          })}
        </Grid>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportAudioPlayerDeck.displayName = 'ReportAudioPlayerDeck';

ReportAudioPlayerDeck.propTypes = {
  audios: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
};

export default ReportAudioPlayerDeck;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportCard
 * @description Operational inspection report card component for mobile (< 600px) and list views.
 * Features:
 * - Gregorian date paired with Ethiopian calendar (ዓ.ም) badge
 * - Shift duration and clockIn - clockOut timeframe
 * - Visited branch code badges with tooltips
 * - Activities & issues operational findings summary chips
 * - Amharic transcription snippet with Ethiopic font styling
 * - Action-scoped inline loading spinners and semantic RestoreOutlinedIcon.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import CardActions from '@mui/material/CardActions';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import StoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StoreOutlined';
import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import MuiReportTelegramShareButton from './MuiReportTelegramShareButton.jsx';
import { toEthiopianDateString, computeShiftDuration } from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Report card representation for list view and mobile screens.
 *
 * @component ReportCard
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {object} props.report - Report document data.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation to report dossier.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onEdit] - Navigation to report editor.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onArchive] - Trigger report archival.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onRestore] - Trigger report restoration.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onDelete] - Trigger report cascade deletion.
 * @param {object|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - Legacy fallback ID of mutating report.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered report card.
 */
export const ReportCard = memo(({
  report,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
}) => {
  const isArchived = Boolean(report?.isArchived);
  const activeLoading = actionLoading || (actionLoadingId ? { id: actionLoadingId } : null);
  const isCardBusy = Boolean(activeLoading && activeLoading.id === report?._id);

  const isArchiveLoading = isCardBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'archive' || (!activeLoading?.action && !isArchived));
  const isRestoreLoading = isCardBusy && (activeLoading?.action === 'restore' || (!activeLoading?.action && isArchived));
  const isDeleteLoading = isCardBusy && activeLoading?.action === 'delete';

  const gregorianDate = report?.date ? new Date(report.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : '—';
  const ethiopianDate = report?.ethiopianDate || toEthiopianDateString(report?.date);
  const shiftDuration = computeShiftDuration(report?.clockIn, report?.clockOut);

  const visits = report?.visits || [];
  const activities = report?.activities || [];
  const issues = report?.issues || [];

  const completedActivities = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'completed').length;
  const inProgressActivities = activities.filter((a) => a.status === 'in_progress').length;

  const reportedIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'reported').length;
  const inProgressIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'in_progress').length;
  const completedIssues = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'completed').length;

  const transcriptionSnippet = report?.transcription
    ? report.transcription.length > 130
      ? `${report.transcription.slice(0, 130)}...`
      : report.transcription
    : null;

  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        borderRadius: 2,
        height: '100%',
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease',
        '&:hover': {
          borderColor: 'primary.main',
          boxShadow: (theme) => `0 4px 12px ${theme.palette.action.hover}`,
        },
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
        {/* Top Header: Inspection Date & Shift Duration */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'flex-start',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            gap: 1,
            mb: 1.25,
          }}
        >
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.2, color: 'text.primary' }}>
              {gregorianDate}
            </Typography>
            {ethiopianDate && (
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                {ethiopianDate}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>

          {report?.clockIn && report?.clockOut && (
            <Chip
              icon={<AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '14px !important' }} />}
              label={shiftDuration ? `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut} (${shiftDuration})` : `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut}`}
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 24, fontWeight: 500 }}
            />
          )}
        </Box>

        {/* Visited Branches Badges */}
        <Box sx={{ mb: 1.5 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, mb: 0.5 }}>
            <StoreOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> Visited Branches ({visits.length})
          </Typography>
          {visits.length > 0 ? (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
              {visits.map((v, idx) => (
                <Tooltip
                  key={v._id || idx}
                  title={`${v.branch?.name || 'Branch'} (${v.branch?.code || 'BR'}) • ${v.clockIn || '—'} to ${v.clockOut || '—'}`}
                  arrow
                >
                  <Chip
                    label={v.branch?.code || 'BR'}
                    size="small"
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="primary"
                    sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22, fontWeight: 600 }}
                  />
                </Tooltip>
              ))}
            </Box>
          ) : (
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled' }}>
              No branches recorded
            </Typography>
          )}
        </Box>

        {/* Findings Summary (Activities & Issues) */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5, mb: 1.5 }}>
          {completedActivities > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completedActivities} done`} size="small" />
          )}
          {inProgressActivities > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgressActivities} prog`} size="small" />
          )}
          {reportedIssues > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="reported" label={`${reportedIssues} flagged`} size="small" />
          )}
          {inProgressIssues > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgressIssues} open`} size="small" />
          )}
          {completedIssues > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completedIssues} solved`} size="small" />
          )}
          {issues.length === 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="no_issue" label="No Issues" size="small" />
          )}
        </Box>

        {/* Amharic Dossier Snippet */}
        {transcriptionSnippet && (
          <Box
            sx={{
              p: 1,
              bgcolor: 'action.hover',
              borderRadius: 1,
              fontFamily: "'Noto Sans Ethiopic', 'Nyala', sans-serif",
            }}
          >
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{
                color: 'text.secondary',
                lineHeight: 1.5,
                display: '-webkit-box',
                WebkitLineClamp: 3,
                WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
              }}
            >
              {transcriptionSnippet}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      {/* Card Actions Bottom Deck */}
      <CardActions
        sx={{
          px: 2,
          py: 1.25,
          borderTop: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="outlined"
          color="primary"
          startIcon={<VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          onClick={() => onView(report)}
          disabled={isCardBusy}
          sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}
        >
          View Dossier
        </Button>

        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
          {!isArchived ? (
            <>
              <MuiReportTelegramShareButton
                report={report}
                disabled={isCardBusy}
                size="small"
              />
              {onEdit && (
                <Tooltip title="Edit Report" arrow>
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      onClick={() => onEdit(report)}
                      disabled={isCardBusy}
                      aria-label="edit report"
                    >
                      <EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              {onArchive && (
                <Tooltip title="Archive Report" arrow>
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="warning"
                      onClick={() => onArchive(report)}
                      disabled={isCardBusy}
                      aria-label="archive report"
                    >
                      {isArchiveLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              {onRestore && (
                <Tooltip title="Restore Report" arrow>
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="success"
                      onClick={() => onRestore(report)}
                      disabled={isCardBusy}
                      aria-label="restore report"
                    >
                      {isRestoreLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              {onDelete && (
                <Tooltip title="Permanently Delete (Cascade)" arrow>
                  <span>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      color="error"
                      onClick={() => onDelete(report)}
                      disabled={isCardBusy}
                      aria-label="permanently delete report"
                    >
                      {isDeleteLoading ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )}
                    </IconButton>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </CardActions>
    </Card>
  );
});

ReportCard.displayName = 'ReportCard';

ReportCard.propTypes = {
  report: PropTypes.object.isRequired,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
};

export default ReportCard;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportCardGrid
 * @description Responsive card grid layout for operational reports.
 * Used on mobile viewports (< 600px) or when List view mode is selected on tablet/desktop.
 * Uses Material-UI Grid container and embeds conditional MuiPagination (only if totalPages > 1).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';
import ReportCard from './ReportCard.jsx';
import MuiPagination from '../reusable/MuiPagination.jsx';
import MuiEmptyState from '../reusable/MuiEmptyState.jsx';

/**
 * Grid of report cards with responsive columns and conditional pagination.
 *
 * @component ReportCardGrid
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.reports=[]] - Report documents.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Whether data is loading.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation to report details.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onEdit] - Open edit page.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onArchive] - Open archive confirmation.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onRestore] - Open restore confirmation.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onDelete] - Open permanent delete confirmation.
 * @param {object|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - ID of report undergoing mutation.
 * @param {number} [props.page=1] - Active page number (1-based).
 * @param {number} [props.totalPages=1] - Total calculated pages.
 * @param {(page: number) => void} [props.onPageChange] - Page change handler.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyTitle='No inspection reports found'] - Custom empty title.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyDescription='There are no operational reports matching your current filter.'] - Custom empty subtitle.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.emptyAction] - Action button element for empty state.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered report card grid.
 */
export const ReportCardGrid = memo(({
  reports = [],
  isLoading = false,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
  page = 1,
  totalPages = 1,
  onPageChange,
  emptyTitle = 'No inspection reports found',
  emptyDescription = 'There are no operational reports matching your current filter.',
  emptyAction,
}) => {
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
          <Grid key={i} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
            <Skeleton
              variant="rounded"
              height={260}
              sx={{ borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: 'action.hover' }}
            />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>
    );
  }

  if (reports.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ py: 4 }}>
        <MuiEmptyState
          icon={<DescriptionOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
          title={emptyTitle}
          subtitle={emptyDescription}
          action={emptyAction}
        />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {reports.map((report) => (
          <Grid key={report._id || report.id} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
            <ReportCard
              report={report}
              onView={onView}
              onEdit={onEdit}
              onArchive={onArchive}
              onRestore={onRestore}
              onDelete={onDelete}
              actionLoading={actionLoading}
              actionLoadingId={actionLoadingId}
            />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>

      {totalPages > 1 && onPageChange && (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', mt: 3, mb: 1 }}>
          <MuiPagination
            page={page}
            count={totalPages}
            onChange={onPageChange}
          />
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
});

ReportCardGrid.displayName = 'ReportCardGrid';

ReportCardGrid.propTypes = {
  reports: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
  page: PropTypes.number,
  totalPages: PropTypes.number,
  onPageChange: PropTypes.func,
  emptyTitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptyDescription: PropTypes.string,
  emptyAction: PropTypes.node,
};

export default ReportCardGrid;
