/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportCommentsCard
 * @description Structured subdocument panel displaying supervisory observations and recommendations.
 * Features:
 * - Clean English title strictly formatted as "Observations (N)"
 * - Deprecated props purged in favor of modern MUI slotProps
 * - MaxHeight scroll bounds with custom theme scrollbars for collection scalability
 * - Item-level editing and creation capability with zero-lag uncontrolled multiline text input
 * - In-situ item deletion with item-scoped inline error circular spinner
 * - Strict schema purity: guaranteed never to transmit 'status' property, preventing HTTP 422
 * - Reduced horizontal padding on mobile xs preserving viewport width
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';

import CommentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CommentOutlined';
import FormatQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FormatQuoteOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Strips all prohibited fields (especially 'status') from comment subdocuments.
 * Express-validator in reportValidation.js explicitly throws HTTP 422 if comments.*.status !== undefined.
 *
 * @param {Array<object>} list - Array of comment objects.
 * @returns {Array<{ text: string, _id?: string }>} Sanitized comment array.
 */
const sanitizeComments = (list) =>
  (list || []).map((c) => ({
    text: (c.text || '').trim(),
    ...(c._id ? { _id: c._id } : {}),
  }));

/**
 * Supervisory comments and observations card.
 *
 * @component ReportCommentsCard
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.comments=[]] - Array of comment subdocuments.
 * @param {(updatedComments: Array<object>) => Promise<any>} [props.onUpdateComments] - Item-level mutation callback.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered comments card.
 */
export const ReportCommentsCard = memo(({ comments = [], onUpdateComments }) => {
  // Uncontrolled input ref for zero-lag editing (0 React re-renders on keystroke)
  const editInputRef = useRef(null);
  const addInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [editingIndex, setEditingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [savingIndex, setSavingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [deletingIndex, setDeletingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [isAddSaving, setIsAddSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback((idx) => {
    setEditingIndex(idx);
  }, []);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditingIndex(null);
  }, []);

  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateComments) {
        setEditingIndex(null);
        return;
      }
      const newText = editInputRef.current ? editInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
      if (!newText) return;

      const updated = sanitizeComments(
        comments.map((item, i) => (i === idx ? { ...item, text: newText } : item))
      );
      try {
        setSavingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateComments(updated);
        setEditingIndex(null);
      } catch {
        // Keep in edit mode so edits are preserved if update fails
      } finally {
        setSavingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [comments, onUpdateComments]
  );

  const handleSaveAdd = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onUpdateComments) {
      setIsAdding(false);
      return;
    }
    const newText = addInputRef.current ? addInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
    if (!newText) return;

    const updated = sanitizeComments([...comments, { text: newText }]);
    try {
      setIsAddSaving(true);
      await onUpdateComments(updated);
      setIsAdding(false);
    } catch {
      // Keep adding form open so input is preserved
    } finally {
      setIsAddSaving(false);
    }
  }, [comments, onUpdateComments]);

  const handleDelete = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateComments) return;
      const updated = sanitizeComments(comments.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
      try {
        setDeletingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateComments(updated);
        if (editingIndex === idx) {
          setEditingIndex(null);
        } else if (editingIndex > idx) {
          setEditingIndex(editingIndex - 1);
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep state if update fails
      } finally {
        setDeletingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [comments, onUpdateComments, editingIndex]
  );

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2, md: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        height: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Counter Badges & Add Button */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          pb: 1.5,
          mb: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <CommentOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
            Observations ({comments.length})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        {onUpdateComments && (
          <Tooltip title="Add Observation">
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isAdding || isAddSaving}
              onClick={() => setIsAdding((prev) => !prev)}
              aria-label="Add Observation"
              sx={{ border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`, p: 0.5 }}
            >
              <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Inline Add Observation Form */}
      {isAdding && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            p: 1.5,
            mb: 1.5,
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            border: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.primary.main}`,
            bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 1.25,
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            inputRef={addInputRef}
            size="small"
            multiline
            minRows={2}
            maxRows={4}
            placeholder="Record general supervisory directive or operational observation..."
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            disabled={isAddSaving}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) handleSaveAdd();
              if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isAddSaving) setIsAdding(false);
            }}
          />
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 1 }}>
            <MuiButton
              size="small"
              color="inherit"
              disabled={isAddSaving}
              onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </MuiButton>
            <MuiButton
              size="small"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              disabled={isAddSaving}
              startIcon={isAddSaving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : null}
              onClick={handleSaveAdd}
            >
              Add
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* List of Comments with Scroll Bounds */}
      {comments.length === 0 ? (
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic', py: 2 }}>
          No supervisory observations or directives recorded.
        </Typography>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            maxHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            overflowY: 'auto',
            pr: 0.5,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: '6px' },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.2),
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.4),
            },
          }}
        >
          <List disablePadding sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
            {comments.map((item, idx) => {
              const isEditing = editingIndex === idx;

              if (isEditing) {
                return (
                  <ListItem
                    key={item._id || idx}
                    disableGutters
                    sx={{
                      py: 1.5,
                      borderBottom:
                        idx < comments.length - 1
                          ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                          : 'none',
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      alignItems: 'stretch',
                      gap: 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    {/* Zero-lag Uncontrolled Input (0 React re-renders on keystroke) */}
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      minRows={2}
                      maxRows={4}
                      inputRef={editInputRef}
                      defaultValue={item.text}
                      disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                      placeholder="Observation text"
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem' },
                        },
                      }}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
                          handleSaveEdit(idx);
                        }
                        if (e.key === 'Escape' && savingIndex !== idx && deletingIndex !== idx) {
                          handleCancelEdit();
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                        gap: 0.5,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Tooltip title="Delete Observation">
                        <span>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="error"
                            disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                            aria-label="Delete observation"
                          >
                            {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                              <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                            ) : (
                              <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                            )}
                          </IconButton>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                      <Tooltip title="Save change">
                        <span>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="primary"
                            disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                            onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)}
                            aria-label="Save observation"
                          >
                            {savingIndex === idx ? (
                              <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                            ) : (
                              <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                            )}
                          </IconButton>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                      <Tooltip title="Cancel">
                        <span>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="inherit"
                            disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                            onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                            aria-label="Cancel editing"
                          >
                            <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </Box>
                  </ListItem>
                );
              }

              return (
                <ListItem
                  key={item._id || idx}
                  disableGutters
                  sx={{
                    py: 1.25,
                    borderBottom:
                      idx < comments.length - 1
                        ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                        : 'none',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'flex-start',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: 1.5,
                  }}
                >
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <FormatQuoteOutlinedIcon
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: 20,
                        color: 'primary.main',
                        mt: '3px',
                        flexShrink: 0,
                        transform: 'rotate(180deg)',
                      }}
                    />
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      sx={{
                        m: 0,
                        p: 0,
                        lineHeight: 1.5,
                        color: 'text.primary',
                        fontStyle: 'italic',
                        wordBreak: 'break-word',
                        flex: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.text}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>

                  {onUpdateComments && (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                      <Tooltip title="Edit Observation">
                        <span>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                            onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx)}
                            sx={{
                              p: 0.5,
                              color: 'text.secondary',
                              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
                            }}
                            aria-label="Edit observation"
                          >
                            <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                          </IconButton>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                      <Tooltip title="Delete Observation">
                        <span>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                            sx={{
                              p: 0.5,
                              color: 'text.secondary',
                              '&:hover': { color: 'error.main' },
                            }}
                            aria-label="Delete observation"
                          >
                            {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                              <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                            ) : (
                              <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                            )}
                          </IconButton>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </Box>
                  )}
                </ListItem>
              );
            })}
          </List>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportCommentsCard.displayName = 'ReportCommentsCard';

ReportCommentsCard.propTypes = {
  comments: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      _id: PropTypes.string,
      text: PropTypes.string,
    })
  ),
  onUpdateComments: PropTypes.func,
};

export default ReportCommentsCard;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportControlStrip
 * @description Standardized domain-specific control strip for the Operational Reports Directory.
 * Composes reusable MuiDataGridToolbar with Branch filter and Ethiopian Date Picker actions.
 * Enforces:
 * 1. Desktop (md+: >= 900px): Clean single/dual-row layout with wide flex search input.
 * 2. Tablet (sm: 600px - 899px): Predictable 2-row layout with 50/50 domain filters, zero collapsible accordions.
 * 3. Mobile (xs: < 600px): 100% fullwidth stacked inputs (Search, Branch, Ethiopian Date with zero right void, Fullwidth Tabs).
 * 4. Zero-lag uncontrolled search with explicit triggers via MuiSearchInput.
 */

import { useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import Select from '@mui/material/Select';
import FormControl from '@mui/material/FormControl';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme, alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';

import StoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StoreOutlined';
import EventOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EventOutlined';

import MuiDataGridToolbar from '../reusable/MuiDataGridToolbar.jsx';
import MuiDatePicker from '../reusable/MuiDatePicker.jsx';

/**
 * Control strip for filtering and switching views on the reports directory.
 *
 * @component ReportControlStrip
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} props.searchQuery - Active search query value.
 * @param {(query: string) => void} props.onSearchChange - Search update callback.
 * @param {string} [props.branchFilter=''] - Currently selected branch ID filter.
 * @param {(branchId: string) => void} props.onBranchChange - Branch filter change callback.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.branches=[]] - Array of branch objects for dropdown options.
 * @param {string} [props.dateFilter=''] - Currently selected date filter (YYYY-MM-DD).
 * @param {(date: string) => void} props.onDateChange - Date filter change callback.
 * @param {'active'|'archived'} props.statusFilter - Active status filter tab.
 * @param {(status: 'active'|'archived') => void} props.onStatusFilterChange - Status tab change callback.
 * @param {'table'|'cards'|'grid'|'list'} props.viewMode - Current view mode.
 * @param {(mode: string) => void} props.onViewModeChange - View mode change callback.
 * @param {number} [props.activeCount=0] - Number of active reports.
 * @param {number} [props.archivedCount=0] - Number of archived reports.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether controls are disabled.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered control strip element.
 */
export const ReportControlStrip = memo(({
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  branchFilter = '',
  onBranchChange,
  branches = [],
  dateFilter = '',
  onDateChange,
  statusFilter = 'active',
  onStatusFilterChange,
  viewMode = 'table',
  onViewModeChange,
  activeCount = 0,
  archivedCount = 0,
  disabled = false,
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm')); // vw < 600px

  // Compute if any secondary filters are active
  const hasActiveFilters = Boolean(
    (branchFilter && branchFilter !== '') ||
    (dateFilter && dateFilter !== '') ||
    statusFilter === 'archived'
  );

  // 1-Click Reset Filters Action
  const handleResetFilters = useCallback(() => {
    if (branchFilter) onBranchChange('');
    if (dateFilter) onDateChange('');
    if (statusFilter !== 'active') onStatusFilterChange('active');
  }, [branchFilter, dateFilter, statusFilter, onBranchChange, onDateChange, onStatusFilterChange]);

  // Branch selector element
  const branchSelector = (
    <FormControl
      size="small"
      sx={{
        width: { xs: '100%', sm: 180, md: 190 },
        flex: { sm: 1, md: 'none' },
        flexShrink: 0,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        borderRadius: 1.5,
      }}
    >
      <Select
        value={branchFilter}
        onChange={(e) => onBranchChange(e.target.value)}
        displayEmpty
        disabled={disabled}
        MenuProps={{
          disableEnforceFocus: true,
          disableRestoreFocus: true,
        }}
        sx={{
          borderRadius: 1.5,
          fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.85rem' },
          '& .MuiSelect-select': { py: 0.8 },
        }}
        startAdornment={
          <InputAdornment position="start" sx={{ ml: 0.5 }}>
            <StoreOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: 18 }} />
          </InputAdornment>
        }
      >
        <MenuItem value="">
          <em>All Branches</em>
        </MenuItem>
        {branches.map((b) => (
          <MenuItem key={b._id} value={b._id} sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
            {b.name} ({b.code})
          </MenuItem>
        ))}
      </Select>
    </FormControl>
  );

  // Date filter element using standard MuiDatePicker with fullWidth
  const datePicker = (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: { xs: '100%', sm: 170, md: 180 },
        flex: { sm: 1, md: 'none' },
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      <MuiDatePicker
        value={dateFilter}
        onChange={(val) => onDateChange(val ? val.gregorian : '')}
        disabled={disabled}
        allowClear={true}
        fullWidth
        placeholder="Eth Date"
        startAdornment={
          <EventOutlinedIcon
            sx={{
              fontSize: 18,
              color: dateFilter ? 'primary.main' : 'text.secondary',
            }}
          />
        }
        sx={{
          height: 38,
          borderRadius: 1.5,
          fontSize: { xs: '0.8125rem', sm: '0.825rem' },
          fontWeight: dateFilter ? 700 : 500,
          bgcolor: dateFilter ? (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.08) : 'background.paper',
          borderColor: dateFilter ? 'primary.main' : 'divider',
          color: dateFilter ? 'primary.main' : 'text.primary',
          '&:hover': {
            borderColor: 'primary.main',
            bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.12),
          },
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );

  return (
    <MuiDataGridToolbar
      onSearch={onSearchChange}
      searchPlaceholder={isMobile ? 'Search reports...' : 'Search reports, findings, branches...'}
      searchValue={searchQuery}
      activeTab={statusFilter}
      onTabChange={onStatusFilterChange}
      activeCount={activeCount}
      archivedCount={archivedCount}
      viewMode={viewMode}
      onViewModeChange={onViewModeChange}
      hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
      onResetFilters={handleResetFilters}
      disabled={disabled}
      customActions={
        <>
          {branchSelector}
          {datePicker}
        </>
      }
    />
  );
});

ReportControlStrip.displayName = 'ReportControlStrip';

ReportControlStrip.propTypes = {
  searchQuery: PropTypes.string,
  onSearchChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  branchFilter: PropTypes.string,
  onBranchChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  branches: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  dateFilter: PropTypes.string,
  onDateChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  statusFilter: PropTypes.oneOf(['active', 'archived']).isRequired,
  onStatusFilterChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  viewMode: PropTypes.oneOf(['table', 'cards', 'grid', 'list']).isRequired,
  onViewModeChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  activeCount: PropTypes.number,
  archivedCount: PropTypes.number,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default ReportControlStrip;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportDangerZone
 * @description Danger Zone panel for operational report management (Row 7 of Report Detail).
 * Features:
 * - Active: Soft-archive action with 30-day retention explanation
 * - Archived: Restore action OR Permanent Cascade Deletion (purging report, audios, disk files)
 * - Immediate modal closing and inline loading state.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import WarningAmberOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteForeverOutlined';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Report danger zone actions panel.
 *
 * @component ReportDangerZone
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isArchived=false] - Whether report is currently archived.
 * @param {() => void} props.onArchive - Archive trigger.
 * @param {() => void} props.onRestore - Restore trigger.
 * @param {() => void} props.onDelete - Permanent delete trigger.
 * @param {object|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Action loading state { id, action }.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered danger zone.
 */
export const ReportDangerZone = memo(({
  isArchived = false,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
}) => {
  const isArchiveLoading = actionLoading?.action === 'archive';
  const isRestoreLoading = actionLoading?.action === 'restore';
  const isDeleteLoading = actionLoading?.action === 'delete';

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      className="report-danger-zone"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        borderColor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.error.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.3 : 0.2),
        bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.error.main, theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 0.08 : 0.04),
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 2,
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
        <WarningAmberOutlinedIcon color="error" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'error.main', fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
          Danger Zone
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      {/* Action Rows */}
      {!isArchived ? (
        /* Active Report: Soft-Archive */
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
            alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            gap: 2,
            pt: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary' }}>
              Archive This Inspection Report
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
              Archiving hides this report from active listings. All data and audio files are preserved and can be restored at any time within 30 days.
            </Typography>
          </Box>

          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="warning"
            startIcon={isArchiveLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <ArchiveOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={onArchive}
            disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
            sx={{ flexShrink: 0, fontWeight: 600, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
          >
            Archive Report
          </MuiButton>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        /* Archived Report: Restore OR Permanent Cascade Delete */
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, pt: 1 }}>
          {/* Restore Option */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 2,
              pb: 2,
              borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
            }}
          >
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'success.main' }}>
                Restore Operational Report
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                Restores this report back into the active operational directory and dashboard aggregates.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="success"
              startIcon={isRestoreLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <RestoreOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={onRestore}
              disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
              sx={{ flexShrink: 0, fontWeight: 600, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
            >
              Restore Report
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>

          {/* Cascade Delete Option */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'error.main' }}>
                Permanent Cascade Deletion
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                Permanently purges this report from MongoDB and completely unlinks all associated voice audio recordings from disk. This action is irreversible.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="error"
              startIcon={isDeleteLoading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <DeleteForeverOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={onDelete}
              disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
              sx={{ flexShrink: 0, fontWeight: 600, width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
            >
              Delete Permanently
            </MuiButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportDangerZone.displayName = 'ReportDangerZone';

ReportDangerZone.propTypes = {
  isArchived: PropTypes.bool,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
};

export default ReportDangerZone;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportDataGrid
 * @description Operational inspection reports DataGrid view component.
 * Rendered on sm+ viewports. Wraps reusable MuiDataGrid with colocated report columns,
 * fluid proportional flex widths, and inline loading action buttons.
 */

import { useMemo, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';
import MuiDataGrid from '../reusable/MuiDataGrid.jsx';
import { getReportColumns } from '../columns/reportColumns.jsx';

/**
 * DataGrid table component for operational reports archive.
 *
 * @component ReportDataGrid
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.reports=[]] - Array of report documents.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isLoading=false] - Data fetching state.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} props.onView - Navigation handler to report dossier.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onEdit] - Edit page trigger handler.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onArchive] - Archive confirmation trigger.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onRestore] - Restore confirmation trigger.
 * @param {(report: object) => void} [props.onDelete] - Permanent cascade delete trigger.
 * @param {object|null} [props.actionLoading=null] - Action-scoped loading state { id, action }.
 * @param {string|null} [props.actionLoadingId=null] - Legacy fallback ID of mutating report.
 * @param {boolean} [props.isArchived=false] - Whether displaying archived reports dataset.
 * @param {number} [props.rowCount] - Total server count of reports.
 * @param {object} [props.paginationModel] - Controlled pagination model ({ page, pageSize }).
 * @param {Function} [props.onPaginationModelChange] - Pagination change handler.
 * @param {'server'|'client'} [props.paginationMode='server'] - Pagination computation mode.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyTitle='No inspection reports found'] - Custom empty state title.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyDescription='There are no operational reports matching your current filter.'] - Custom empty subtitle.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.emptyAction] - Action button element for empty state.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered Report DataGrid element.
 */
export const ReportDataGrid = memo(({
  reports = [],
  isLoading = false,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  onDelete,
  actionLoading = null,
  actionLoadingId = null,
  isArchived = false,
  rowCount,
  paginationModel,
  onPaginationModelChange,
  paginationMode = 'server',
  emptyTitle = 'No inspection reports found',
  emptyDescription = 'There are no operational reports matching your current filter.',
  emptyAction,
}) => {
  // Construct memoized column definitions with handlers and action state
  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      getReportColumns({
        onView,
        onEdit,
        onArchive,
        onRestore,
        onDelete,
        actionLoading,
        actionLoadingId,
        isArchived,
      }),
    [onView, onEdit, onArchive, onRestore, onDelete, actionLoading, actionLoadingId, isArchived]
  );

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 0, flexGrow: 1 }}>
      <MuiDataGrid
        rows={reports}
        columns={columns}
        loading={isLoading}
        rowCount={rowCount}
        paginationModel={paginationModel}
        onPaginationModelChange={onPaginationModelChange}
        paginationMode={paginationMode}
        getRowId={(row) => row?._id || row?.id}
        emptyIcon={<DescriptionOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: 'text.secondary' }} />}
        emptyTitle={emptyTitle}
        emptySubtitle={emptyDescription}
        emptyAction={emptyAction}
        autoHeight
        showToolbar={false}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

ReportDataGrid.displayName = 'ReportDataGrid';

ReportDataGrid.propTypes = {
  reports: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  isLoading: PropTypes.bool,
  onView: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onEdit: PropTypes.func,
  onArchive: PropTypes.func,
  onRestore: PropTypes.func,
  onDelete: PropTypes.func,
  actionLoading: PropTypes.shape({
    id: PropTypes.string,
    action: PropTypes.string,
  }),
  actionLoadingId: PropTypes.string,
  isArchived: PropTypes.bool,
  rowCount: PropTypes.number,
  paginationModel: PropTypes.shape({
    page: PropTypes.number,
    pageSize: PropTypes.number,
  }),
  onPaginationModelChange: PropTypes.func,
  paginationMode: PropTypes.oneOf(['server', 'client']),
  emptyTitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptyDescription: PropTypes.string,
  emptyAction: PropTypes.node,
};

export default ReportDataGrid;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportHero
 * @description Executive Dossier Header & Profile Banner for Report Inspection Detail (Row 2).
 * Implements the approved 2-Tier Executive Dossier Architecture (Sections 10.9 & 10.10):
 * - Tier 1: Dossier Identity (Supervisor Avatar, "Inspection Dossier" title, vertical author profile with semantic theme icons & ellipsis protection) paired with Action Deck (Edit, Archive, Restore) on sm+.
 * - Divider: Subtle theme separation between Identity and Operational Chronology.
 * - Tier 2: Dedicated full-width metadata ribbon (Active/Archived status chip, unified dual-calendar Ethiopian + Gregorian date badge, shift hours & duration badge, visits count badge).
 * - Mobile xs: Clean vertical rhythm with full-width metadata ribbon and 50/50 touch-friendly action buttons.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Avatar from '@mui/material/Avatar';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import StorefrontOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StorefrontOutlined';
import PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined';
import WorkOutlineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkOutlineOutlined';
import MailOutlineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MailOutlineOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import ArchiveOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArchiveOutlined';
import RestoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestoreOutlined';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiReportTelegramShareButton from './MuiReportTelegramShareButton.jsx';
import { toEthiopianDateString, computeShiftDuration } from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';
import { getAvatarUrl } from '../../utils/avatarUtils.js';

export const ReportHero = memo(({
  report,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onRestore,
  actionLoading = null,
}) => {
  if (!report) return null;

  const isArchived = Boolean(report.isArchived);
  const isMutating = actionLoading?.id === report._id;
  const isArchiveLoading = isMutating && actionLoading?.action === 'archive';
  const isRestoreLoading = isMutating && actionLoading?.action === 'restore';

  const gregorianDate = report.date ? new Date(report.date).toISOString().split('T')[0] : '—';
  const ethiopianDate = report.ethiopianDate || toEthiopianDateString(report.date);
  const shiftDuration = computeShiftDuration(report.clockIn, report.clockOut);
  const visitsCount = report.visits?.length || 0;

  // Unified dual-calendar date display (100% English UI Chrome)
  const dualDateDisplay = ethiopianDate
    ? `${ethiopianDate} (${gregorianDate})`
    : gregorianDate;

  // Multi-tier supervisor name and identity resolution (Zero artificial strings)
  const author = report.supervisor || report.user || {};
  const authorName = (() => {
    if (author.fullName && author.fullName.trim() !== '' && !author.fullName.includes('undefined')) {
      return author.fullName.trim();
    }
    const combined = [author.firstName, author.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();
    if (combined && !combined.includes('undefined')) return combined;
    if (author.username) return author.username;
    if (author.email) return author.email.split('@')[0];
    return '';
  })();

  const authorPosition = author.position || author.role || '';
  const authorEmail = author.email || '';
  const authorAvatar = author.avatar || '';

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.75, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2.5,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        width: '100%',
      }}
    >
      {/* TIER 1: Dossier Identity & Header Action Deck */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'flex-start',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          gap: 2,
        }}
      >
        {/* Left: Supervisor Avatar, Dossier Title & Vertical Linear Attribute Stack */}
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 }, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
          <Avatar
            src={getAvatarUrl(authorAvatar) || undefined}
            alt={authorName}
            sx={{
              width: { xs: 46, sm: 54 },
              height: { xs: 46, sm: 54 },
              bgcolor: 'primary.main',
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: { xs: '1.1rem', sm: '1.3rem' },
              flexShrink: 0,
              alignSelf: 'flex-start',
            }}
          >
            {authorName ? authorName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'S'}
          </Avatar>

          <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.5 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="h5"
              sx={{
                fontWeight: 700,
                lineHeight: 1.25,
                color: 'text.primary',
                fontSize: { xs: '1.15rem', sm: '1.35rem' },
                minWidth: 0,
                overflow: 'hidden',
                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              }}
            >
              Inspection Dossier
            </Typography>

            {/* Row 2: Supervisor Full Name */}
            {authorName && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <Tooltip title={authorName} arrow placement="top">
                  <Typography
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      color: 'text.primary',
                      minWidth: 0,
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    }}
                  >
                    {authorName}
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
              </Box>
            )}

            {/* Row 3: Position / Role */}
            {authorPosition && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <WorkOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <Tooltip title={authorPosition} arrow placement="top">
                  <Typography
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                      fontWeight: 500,
                      color: 'text.secondary',
                      minWidth: 0,
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    }}
                  >
                    {authorPosition}
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
              </Box>
            )}

            {/* Row 4: Email */}
            {authorEmail && (
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <MailOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'text.secondary', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <Tooltip title={authorEmail} arrow placement="top">
                  <Typography
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                      fontWeight: 500,
                      color: 'text.secondary',
                      minWidth: 0,
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    }}
                  >
                    {authorEmail}
                  </Typography>
                </Tooltip>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Right: Quick Action Deck (Inline on sm+, hidden on xs) */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'flex' },
            alignItems: 'center',
            alignSelf: 'flex-start',
            gap: 1.25,
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {/* Active: Share to Telegram */}
          {!isArchived && (
            <MuiReportTelegramShareButton
              report={report}
              disabled={isMutating}
              size="medium"
            />
          )}

          {/* Active: Edit Button */}
          {!isArchived && onEdit && (
            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              size="small"
              startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              onClick={onEdit}
              disabled={isMutating}
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
            >
              Edit Report
            </MuiButton>
          )}

          {/* Active: Archive Button */}
          {!isArchived && onArchive && (
            <MuiButton
              variant="outlined"
              color="warning"
              size="small"
              startIcon={isArchiveLoading ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              onClick={onArchive}
              disabled={isMutating}
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
            >
              Archive
            </MuiButton>
          )}

          {/* Archived: Restore Button */}
          {isArchived && onRestore && (
            <MuiButton
              variant="contained"
              color="success"
              size="small"
              startIcon={isRestoreLoading ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              onClick={onRestore}
              disabled={isMutating}
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
            >
              Restore
            </MuiButton>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Structural Divider */}
      <Divider sx={{ my: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 } }} />

      {/* TIER 2: Dedicated Full-Width Operational Metadata Strip */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 1,
          width: '100%',
        }}
      >
        {/* 1. Status Badge */}
        <Chip
          label={isArchived ? 'Archived Report' : 'Active Report'}
          color={isArchived ? 'default' : 'success'}
          variant="outlined"
          size="small"
          sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.75rem', height: 26 }}
        />

        {/* 2. Unified Dual-Calendar Date Badge */}
        <Chip
          icon={<CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '15px !important' }} />}
          label={dualDateDisplay}
          size="small"
          color="primary"
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.75rem', height: 26 }}
        />

        {/* 3. Shift Hours & Duration Badge */}
        {report.clockIn && report.clockOut && (
          <Chip
            icon={<AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '15px !important' }} />}
            label={shiftDuration ? `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut} (${shiftDuration})` : `${report.clockIn} - ${report.clockOut}`}
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '0.75rem', height: 26 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* 4. Inspection Scope Badge (Visits Count) */}
        {visitsCount > 0 && (
          <Chip
            icon={<StorefrontOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '15px !important' }} />}
            label={`${visitsCount} ${visitsCount === 1 ? 'Branch Visit' : 'Branch Visits'}`}
            size="small"
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '0.75rem', height: 26 }}
          />
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Mobile Action Deck (xs only: 50/50 touch-friendly buttons) */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' },
          gap: 1,
          mt: 1.5,
          pt: 1.5,
          borderTop: (t) => `1px dashed ${t.palette.divider}`,
        }}
      >
        {!isArchived && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
            <MuiReportTelegramShareButton
              report={report}
              disabled={isMutating}
              size="medium"
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {!isArchived && onEdit && (
          <MuiButton
            variant="contained"
            color="primary"
            size="small"
            fullWidth
            startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
            onClick={onEdit}
            disabled={isMutating}
            sx={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8rem', py: 0.75 }}
          >
            Edit Report
          </MuiButton>
        )}

        {!isArchived && onArchive && (
          <MuiButton
            variant="outlined"
            color="warning"
            size="small"
            fullWidth
            startIcon={isArchiveLoading ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <ArchiveOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
            onClick={onArchive}
            disabled={isMutating}
            sx={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8rem', py: 0.75 }}
          >
            Archive
          </MuiButton>
        )}

        {isArchived && onRestore && (
          <MuiButton
            variant="contained"
            color="success"
            size="small"
            fullWidth
            startIcon={isRestoreLoading ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <RestoreOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
            onClick={onRestore}
            disabled={isMutating}
            sx={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8rem', py: 0.75 }}
          >
            Restore
          </MuiButton>
        )}
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportHero.displayName = 'ReportHero';

ReportHero.propTypes = {

export default ReportHero;

/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportIssuesCard
 * @description Structured subdocument panel displaying operational issues & bottlenecks.
 * Features:
 * - Clean English title strictly formatted as "Issues (N)"
 * - Deprecated props purged in favor of modern MUI slotProps
 * - MaxHeight scroll bounds with custom theme scrollbars for collection scalability
 * - Item-level editing capability with zero-lag uncontrolled text input
 * - Responsive 2-tier stacked layout on mobile xs (vw < 600px) preventing text compression
 * - Reduced horizontal padding on mobile xs preserving viewport width
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import Select from '@mui/material/Select';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import FormControl from '@mui/material/FormControl';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';

import WarningAmberIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmber';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';

import MuiStatusChip from '../reusable/MuiStatusChip.jsx';
import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import { REPORT_CONSTANTS } from '../../utils/constants.js';

const ISSUE_STATUS_LABELS = {
  reported: 'Reported',
  in_progress: 'In Progress',
  completed: 'Completed',
  no_issue: 'No Issue',
};

/**
 * Operational issues and findings panel.
 *
 * @component ReportIssuesCard
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.issues=[]] - Array of issue subdocuments.
 * @param {(updatedIssues: Array<object>) => void} [props.onUpdateIssues] - Item-level edit callback.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered issues card.
 */
export const ReportIssuesCard = memo(({ issues = [], onUpdateIssues }) => {
  const reportedCount = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'reported').length;
  const inProgressCount = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'in_progress').length;
  const completedCount = issues.filter((i) => i.status === 'completed').length;

  // Uncontrolled input ref for zero-lag editing (0 React re-renders on keystroke)
  const editInputRef = useRef(null);
  const addInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [editingIndex, setEditingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ISSUE_STATUS);
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [addStatus, setAddStatus] = useState(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ISSUE_STATUS);
  const [savingIndex, setSavingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [deletingIndex, setDeletingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [isAddSaving, setIsAddSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback((idx, item) => {
    setEditingIndex(idx);
    const validStatus = REPORT_CONSTANTS.ISSUE_STATUSES.includes(item?.status)
      ? item.status
      : REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ISSUE_STATUS;
    setEditStatus(validStatus);
  }, []);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditingIndex(null);
    setEditStatus(REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ISSUE_STATUS);
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateIssues) return;
      const updated = issues.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
      try {
        setDeletingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateIssues(updated);
        if (editingIndex === idx) {
          setEditingIndex(null);
        } else if (editingIndex > idx) {
          setEditingIndex(editingIndex - 1);
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep state if update fails
      } finally {
        setDeletingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [issues, onUpdateIssues, editingIndex]
  );

  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(
    async (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateIssues) {
        setEditingIndex(null);
        return;
      }
      const newText = editInputRef.current ? editInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
      if (!newText) return;

      const updated = issues.map((item, i) =>
        i === idx ? { ...item, text: newText, status: editStatus } : item
      );
      try {
        setSavingIndex(idx);
        await onUpdateIssues(updated);
        setEditingIndex(null);
      } catch {
        // Keep in edit mode so edits are preserved if update fails
      } finally {
        setSavingIndex(null);
      }
    },
    [issues, editStatus, onUpdateIssues]
  );

  const handleSaveAdd = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onUpdateIssues) {
      setIsAdding(false);
      return;
    }
    const newText = addInputRef.current ? addInputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
    if (!newText) return;

    try {
      setIsAddSaving(true);
      await onUpdateIssues([...issues, { text: newText, status: addStatus }]);
      setIsAdding(false);
      setAddStatus('reported');
    } catch {
      // Keep adding form open so input is preserved
    } finally {
      setIsAddSaving(false);
    }
  }, [issues, addStatus, onUpdateIssues]);

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 2, md: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        height: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Counter Badges & Add Button */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          borderBottom: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
          pb: 1.5,
          mb: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <WarningAmberIcon color={reportedCount > 0 ? 'error' : 'primary'} sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
            Issues ({issues.length})
          </Typography>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {reportedCount > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="reported" label={`${reportedCount} flagged`} size="small" />
          )}
          {inProgressCount > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="in_progress" label={`${inProgressCount} open`} size="small" />
          )}
          {completedCount > 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="completed" label={`${completedCount} solved`} size="small" />
          )}
          {issues.length === 0 && (
            <MuiStatusChip status="no_issue" label="All Clean" size="small" />
          )}
          {onUpdateIssues && (
            <Tooltip title="Add Issue">
              <span>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  color="primary"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdding((prev) => !prev)}
                  disabled={isAddSaving}
                  aria-label="Add Issue"
                  sx={{ border: (t) => `1px solid ${t.palette.divider}`, p: 0.5 }}
                >
                  <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Inline Add Issue Form */}
      {isAdding && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            p: 1.5,
            mb: 1.5,
            borderRadius: 1.5,
            border: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.primary.main}`,
            bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 1.25,
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            inputRef={addInputRef}
            size="small"
            multiline
            minRows={2}
            maxRows={4}
            placeholder="Describe operational bottleneck or issue..."
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            disabled={isAddSaving}
            slotProps={{
              input: {
                sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem' },
              },
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) handleSaveAdd();
              if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isAddSaving) setIsAdding(false);
            }}
          />
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <FormControl size="small">
              <Select
                value={addStatus}
                onChange={(e) => setAddStatus(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                sx={{ height: 32, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
              >
                {REPORT_CONSTANTS.ISSUE_STATUSES.map((statusKey) => (
                  <MenuItem key={statusKey} value={statusKey}>
                    {ISSUE_STATUS_LABELS[statusKey] || statusKey}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>

            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                color="inherit"
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}
              >
                Cancel
              </MuiButton>
              <MuiButton
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                disabled={isAddSaving}
                startIcon={isAddSaving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : null}
                onClick={handleSaveAdd}
              >
                Add
              </MuiButton>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* List of Issues with Scroll Bounds */}
      {issues.length === 0 ? (
        <Box sx={{ py: 2, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <CheckCircleOutlineIcon color="success" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
            No operational issues or bottlenecks flagged during this inspection audit.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            maxHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            overflowY: 'auto',
            pr: 0.5,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: '6px' },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.2),
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.4),
            },
          }}
        >
          <List disablePadding sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
            {issues.map((item, idx) => {
              const isEditing = editingIndex === idx;

              if (isEditing) {
                return (
                  <ListItem
                    key={item._id || idx}
                    disableGutters
                    sx={{
                      py: 1.5,
                      borderBottom:
                        idx < issues.length - 1
                          ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                          : 'none',
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      alignItems: 'stretch',
                      gap: 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    {/* Zero-lag Uncontrolled Input (0 React re-renders on keystroke) */}
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      minRows={2}
                      maxRows={4}
                      inputRef={editInputRef}
                      defaultValue={item.text}
                      disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                      placeholder="Issue description"
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem' },
                        },
                      }}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) handleSaveEdit(idx);
                        if (e.key === 'Escape' && savingIndex !== idx && deletingIndex !== idx) handleCancelEdit();
                      }}
                    />
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        gap: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Select
                        size="small"
                        value={editStatus}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}
                        disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                        MenuProps={{
                          disableEnforceFocus: true,
                          disableRestoreFocus: true,
                        }}
                        sx={{ height: 32, fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
                      >
                        {REPORT_CONSTANTS.ISSUE_STATUSES.map((statusKey) => (
                          <MenuItem key={statusKey} value={statusKey}>
                            {ISSUE_STATUS_LABELS[statusKey] || statusKey}
                          </MenuItem>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                        <Tooltip title="Delete Issue">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="error"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                              aria-label="Delete issue"
                            >
                              {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                              ) : (
                                <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Save change">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)}
                              aria-label="Save issue"
                            >
                              {savingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="primary" />
                              ) : (
                                <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Cancel">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="inherit"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                              aria-label="Cancel editing"
                            >
                              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </Box>
                    </Box>
                  </ListItem>
                );
              }

              return (
                <ListItem
                  key={item._id || idx}
                  disableGutters
                  sx={{
                    py: 1.25,
                    borderBottom:
                      idx < issues.length - 1
                        ? (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`
                        : 'none',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                    alignItems: { xs: 'stretch', sm: 'flex-start' },
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    gap: { xs: 0.75, sm: 1.5 },
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Tier 1 on xs (Left block on sm): Icon + Full-width text with optical baseline alignment */}
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1, flex: 1, width: '100%', minWidth: 0 }}>
                    {item.status === 'completed' || item.status === 'no_issue' ? (
                      <CheckCircleOutlineIcon
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: 18,
                          color: 'success.main',
                          mt: '3px',
                          flexShrink: 0,
                        }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <WarningAmberIcon
                        sx={{
                          fontSize: 18,
                          color: item.status === 'reported' ? 'error.main' : 'warning.main',
                          mt: '3px',
                          flexShrink: 0,
                        }}
                      />
                    )}
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      sx={{
                        m: 0,
                        p: 0,
                        lineHeight: 1.5,
                        fontWeight: 500,
                        color:
                          item.status === 'reported'
                            ? 'error.main'
                            : item.status === 'in_progress'
                              ? 'warning.main'
                              : 'text.primary',
                        wordBreak: 'break-word',
                        flex: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.text}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Tier 2 on xs (Right block on sm): Status Chip + Edit button grouped right */}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                      gap: 1,
                      flexShrink: 0,
                      width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                      pl: 0,
                    }}
                  >
                    <MuiStatusChip
                      status={item.status || REPORT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_ISSUE_STATUS}
                      size="small"
                      label={ISSUE_STATUS_LABELS[item.status] || undefined}
                    />
                    {onUpdateIssues && (
                      <>
                        <Tooltip title="Edit Issue">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx, item)}
                              sx={{
                                p: 0.5,
                                color: 'text.secondary',
                                '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
                              }}
                              aria-label="Edit issue"
                            >
                              <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title="Delete Issue">
                          <span>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              disabled={savingIndex === idx || deletingIndex === idx}
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(idx)}
                              sx={{
                                p: 0.5,
                                color: 'text.secondary',
                                '&:hover': { color: 'error.main' },
                              }}
                              aria-label="Delete issue"
                            >
                              {deletingIndex === idx ? (
                                <CircularProgress size={16} color="error" />
                              ) : (
                                <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                              )}
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </ListItem>
              );
            })}
          </List>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportIssuesCard.displayName = 'ReportIssuesCard';

ReportIssuesCard.propTypes = {
  issues: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      _id: PropTypes.string,
      text: PropTypes.string,
      status: PropTypes.string,
    })
  ),
  onUpdateIssues: PropTypes.func,
};

export default ReportIssuesCard;
