/**
 * @module components/reports/ReportVisitsLedger
 * @description Structured subdocument ledger displaying branch visit intervals.
 * Features:
 * - Clean English title strictly formatted as "Branch Visits Ledger (N)"
 * - MaxHeight scroll bounds with custom theme scrollbars for collection scalability
 * - Item-level editing capability enabling in-place modification of clockIn and clockOut times
 * - Responsive table on sm+ and ergonomic stacked cards on xs viewports.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Link from '@mui/material/Link';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';

import StoreOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StoreOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';

import MuiButton from '../reusable/MuiButton.jsx';
import MuiTimePicker from '../reusable/MuiTimePicker.jsx';
import { computeShiftDuration } from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Branch visits ledger subdocument table.
 *
 * @component ReportVisitsLedger
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} [props.visits=[]] - Array of visit subdocuments.
 * @param {(updatedVisits: Array<object>) => void} [props.onUpdateVisits] - Item-level edit callback.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered visits ledger.
 */
export const ReportVisitsLedger = memo(({ visits = [], onUpdateVisits }) => {
  const [editingIndex, setEditingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [editClockIn, setEditClockIn] = useState('');
  const [editClockOut, setEditClockOut] = useState('');

  const handleStartEdit = useCallback((idx, item) => {
    setEditingIndex(idx);
    setEditClockIn(item.clockIn || '08:00');
    setEditClockOut(item.clockOut || '17:00');
  }, []);

  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditingIndex(null);
    setEditClockIn('');
    setEditClockOut('');
  }, []);

  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(
    (idx) => {
      if (!onUpdateVisits) {
        setEditingIndex(null);
        return;
      }
      const updated = visits.map((item, i) =>
        i === idx ? { ...item, clockIn: editClockIn.trim(), clockOut: editClockOut.trim() } : item
      );
      onUpdateVisits(updated);
      setEditingIndex(null);
    },
    [visits, editClockIn, editClockOut, onUpdateVisits]
  );

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 2 }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
          <StoreOutlinedIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: { xs: '1rem', sm: '1.15rem' } }}>
            Branch Visits Ledger ({visits.length})
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {visits.length === 0 ? (
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontStyle: 'italic', py: 1 }}>
          No branch visits recorded for this inspection.
        </Typography>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            maxHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            overflowY: 'auto',
            pr: 0.5,
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { width: '6px' },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.2),
              borderRadius: '3px',
            },
            '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover': {
              bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.text.secondary, 0.4),
            },
          }}
        >
          {/* sm+ Table View */}
          <TableContainer
            sx={{
              display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' },
              overflowX: 'auto',
              '& table': { minWidth: { sm: 540, md: '100%' } },
            }}
          >
            <Table size="small">
              <TableHead>
                <TableRow sx={{ '& th': { fontWeight: 700, color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.78rem' } }}>
                  <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 100 }}>Branch</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 100 }}>Manager</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 80 }}>Arrival</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 80 }}>Departure</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="right" sx={{ minWidth: 70 }}>Duration</TableCell>
                  {onUpdateVisits && <TableCell align="right" sx={{ width: 60 }}>Actions</TableCell>}
                </TableRow>
              </TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {visits.map((v, idx) => {
                  const b = v.branch || {};
                  const isEditing = editingIndex === idx;
                  const duration = computeShiftDuration(v.clockIn, v.clockOut);

                  if (isEditing) {
                    return (
                      <TableRow key={v._id || idx} sx={{ bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04) }}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {b.name || 'Branch'}
                          </Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                            {b.managerName || '—'}
                          </Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <MuiTimePicker
                            size="small"
                            value={editClockIn}
                            onChange={(val) => setEditClockIn(val ? val.value : '')}
                            placeholder="HH:mm"
                            sx={{ minWidth: 105, height: 32 }}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <MuiTimePicker
                            size="small"
                            value={editClockOut}
                            onChange={(val) => setEditClockOut(val ? val.value : '')}
                            placeholder="HH:mm"
                            sx={{ minWidth: 105, height: 32 }}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell align="right">
                          <Chip
                            label={computeShiftDuration(editClockIn, editClockOut) || '—'}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 20, fontWeight: 600 }}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell align="right">
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 0.5 }}>
                            <Tooltip title="Save visit times">
                              <IconButton size="small" color="primary" onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)}>
                                <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                              </IconButton>
                            </Tooltip>
                            <Tooltip title="Cancel">
                              <IconButton size="small" color="inherit" onClick={handleCancelEdit}>
                                <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                              </IconButton>
                            </Tooltip>
                          </Box>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  }

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={v._id || idx} hover>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                          <Chip
                            label={b.code || 'BR'}
                            size="small"
                            variant="outlined"
                            color="primary"
                            sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 22 }}
                          />
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {b.name || 'Branch'}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
                            {b.managerName || '—'}
                          </Typography>
                          {b.managerPhone && (
                            <Link
                              href={`tel:${b.managerPhone}`}
                              underline="hover"
                              sx={{
                                color: 'primary.main',
                                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                display: 'inline-flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 0.5,
                              }}
                            >
                              <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />
                              {b.managerPhone}
                            </Link>
                          )}
                        </Box>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{v.clockIn || '—'}</Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{v.clockOut || '—'}</Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="right">
                        {duration ? (
                          <Chip
                            label={duration}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 20, fontWeight: 600 }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          '—'
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      {onUpdateVisits && (
                        <TableCell align="right">
                          <Tooltip title="Edit visit times">
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx, v)}
                              sx={{ p: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary', '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' } }}
                            >
                              <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        </TableCell>
                      )}
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </TableContainer>

          {/* xs Mobile Card View */}
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' }, flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
            {visits.map((v, idx) => {
              const b = v.branch || {};
              const isEditing = editingIndex === idx;
              const duration = computeShiftDuration(v.clockIn, v.clockOut);

              if (isEditing) {
                return (
                  <Box
                    key={v._id || idx}
                    sx={{
                      p: 1.5,
                      borderRadius: 1.5,
                      border: (theme) => `1px solid ${theme.palette.primary.main}`,
                      bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
                      display: 'flex',
                      flexDirection: 'column',
                      gap: 1.25,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      Edit {b.name || 'Branch'} Times
                    </Typography>
                    {/* Row 1: Fullwidth Arrival */}
                    <MuiTimePicker
                      size="small"
                      label="Arrival Time"
                      value={editClockIn}
                      onChange={(val) => setEditClockIn(val ? val.value : '')}
                      placeholder="HH:mm"
                      sx={{ width: '100%' }}
                    />
                    {/* Row 2: Fullwidth Departure */}
                    <MuiTimePicker
                      size="small"
                      label="Departure Time"
                      value={editClockOut}
                      onChange={(val) => setEditClockOut(val ? val.value : '')}
                      placeholder="HH:mm"
                      sx={{ width: '100%' }}
                    />
                    {/* Row 3: Actions Right-Aligned */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 1, mt: 0.5 }}>
                      <MuiButton size="small" color="inherit" onClick={handleCancelEdit} sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                        Cancel
                      </MuiButton>
                      <MuiButton size="small" variant="contained" color="primary" onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)} sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                        Save
                      </MuiButton>
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                );
              }

              return (
                <Box
                  key={v._id || idx}
                  sx={{
                    p: 1.5,
                    borderRadius: 1.5,

                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"

                        sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.72rem', height: 20 }}
                      />
                      <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {b.name || 'Branch'}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                      {duration && (
                        <Chip label={duration} size="small" sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', height: 20, fontWeight: 600 }} />
                      )}
                      {onUpdateVisits && (
                        <IconButton
                          size="small"
                          onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx, v)}
                          sx={{ p: 0.5, color: 'text.secondary' }}
                        >
                          <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                      )}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>

                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
                      Hours: {v.clockIn || '—'} to {v.clockOut || '—'}
                    </Typography>
                    {b.managerPhone && (
                      <Link
                        href={`tel:${b.managerPhone}`}
                        underline="hover"
                        sx={{
                          color: 'primary.main',
                          fontSize: '0.75rem',
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 0.5,
                        }}
                      >
                        <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />
                        {b.managerName || 'Call Manager'}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              );
            })}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
});

ReportVisitsLedger.displayName = 'ReportVisitsLedger';

ReportVisitsLedger.propTypes = {
  visits: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.object),
  onUpdateVisits: PropTypes.func,
};

export default ReportVisitsLedger;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/ErrorBoundary
 * @description Standard React error boundary displaying user-friendly recovery interface on crash.
 */
import { Component } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import MuiButton from './MuiButton.jsx';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutline';

/**
 * React Error Boundary capturing unhandled runtime render exceptions in child trees.
 *
 * @component ErrorBoundary
 */
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
      console.error('[ErrorBoundary caught error]:', error, errorInfo);
    }
  }

  handleReload = () => {
    window.location.reload();
  };

  handleReset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      return (
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            minHeight: '100dvh',
            p: 3,
            backgroundColor: 'background.default',
          }}
        >
          <Paper
            elevation={2}
            sx={{
              p: 4,
              maxWidth: 480,
              width: '100%',
              textAlign: 'center',
              borderRadius: 3,
            }}
          >
            <ErrorOutlineIcon color="error" sx={{ fontSize: 64, mb: 2 }} />
            <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={600} gutterBottom>
              Something Went Wrong
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
              An unexpected error occurred in the application. Please try reloading the page.
            </Typography>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <MuiButton size="small" variant="contained" color="primary" onClick={this.handleReload}>
                Reload Page
              </MuiButton>
              <MuiButton size="small" variant="outlined" color="inherit" onClick={this.handleReset}>
                Try Again
              </MuiButton>
            </Box>
          </Paper>
        </Box>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/LoadingSpinner
 * @description Standardized loading indicator accepting message, height, and size.
 */

import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**
 * Size mapping presets for CircularProgress pixel dimensions.
 * @constant
 * @type {Record<'small'|'medium'|'large', number>}
 */
const SIZE_MAP = {
  small: 24,
  medium: 36,
  large: 48,
};

/**
 * Centered loading spinner with optional message and customizable geometry.
 *
 * @component LoadingSpinner
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} [props.message='Loading...'] - Explanatory message displayed below spinner.
 * @param {string|number} [props.height='100%'] - Minimum height of container box.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'|'large'|number} [props.size='medium'] - Spinner diameter preset or pixel size.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered spinner container.
 */
export const LoadingSpinner = ({
  message = 'Loading...',
  height = '100%',
  size = 'medium',
}) => {
  const pixelSize = typeof size === 'number' ? size : SIZE_MAP[size] || 36;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        minHeight: height,
        width: '100%',
        p: 3,
        gap: 2,
      }}
    >
      <CircularProgress size={pixelSize} thickness={4} color="primary" disableShrink />
      {message && (
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" fontWeight={500}>
          {message}
        </Typography>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

LoadingSpinner.propTypes = {
  message: PropTypes.string,
  height: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
  size: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
};

export default LoadingSpinner;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiActionMenu
 * @description Standardized 3-dots action menu with built-in action -> confirm -> effect lifecycle
 * integration using MuiConfirmDialog. Strictly 100% English UI chrome.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Menu from '@mui/material/Menu';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import ListItemIcon from '@mui/material/ListItemIcon';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import MoreVertIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MoreVert';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import MuiConfirmDialog from './MuiConfirmDialog.jsx';

/**
 * Standardized 3-dots actions menu component.
 * Executes the Three-Phase Action Lifecycle (action -> confirm -> effect):
 * If an item provides confirmation metadata, an explicit MuiConfirmDialog is opened
 * prior to dispatching the action effect.
 *
 * @component MuiActionMenu
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Array<object>} props.items - Array of action menu items.
 * @param {string} props.items[].id - Unique action identifier.
 * @param {string} props.items[].label - English action label.
 * @param {import('react').ReactElement} [props.items[].icon] - Action leading icon.
 * @param {Function} props.items[].onClick - Action execution callback.
 * @param {boolean} [props.items[].isDestructive=false] - Whether action is destructive (renders red).
 * @param {string} [props.items[].confirmTitle] - Title for confirmation dialog if confirmation required.
 * @param {string} [props.items[].confirmDescription] - Detailed explanation of action consequences.
 * @param {string} [props.items[].confirmMatchText] - Optional text required to type for confirmation.
 * @param {boolean} [props.items[].disabled=false] - Disabled state flag.
 * @param {string} [props.tooltip='Actions'] - Tooltip for the 3-dots trigger button.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'} [props.size='small'] - Button size.
 * @param {object} [props.sx={}] - Style overrides.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered Action Menu with integrated Confirmation Dialog.
 */
export const MuiActionMenu = memo(({
  items = [],
  tooltip = 'Actions',
  size = 'small',
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState(null);
  const [activeConfirmItem, setActiveConfirmItem] = useState(null);
  const [isEffectLoading, setIsEffectLoading] = useState(false);

  const isOpen = Boolean(anchorEl);

  const handleOpen = useCallback((event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    setAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
  }, []);

  const handleClose = useCallback((event) => {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();
    setAnchorEl(null);
  }, []);

  const handleItemClick = useCallback(
    (item) => (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      handleClose();

      // If action requires confirmation, open confirmation dialog first
      if (item.confirmTitle) {
        setActiveConfirmItem(item);
      } else if (typeof item.onClick === 'function') {
        item.onClick();
      }
    },
    [handleClose]
  );

  const handleConfirmClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEffectLoading) {
      setActiveConfirmItem(null);
    }
  }, [isEffectLoading]);

  const handleConfirmEffect = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!activeConfirmItem || typeof activeConfirmItem.onClick !== 'function') {
      setActiveConfirmItem(null);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsEffectLoading(true);
      await activeConfirmItem.onClick();
    } finally {
      setIsEffectLoading(false);
      setActiveConfirmItem(null);
    }
  }, [activeConfirmItem]);

  return (
    <>
      <Tooltip title={tooltip}>
        <IconButton
          size={size}
          aria-label={tooltip}
          aria-haspopup="true"
          aria-expanded={isOpen ? 'true' : undefined}
          onClick={handleOpen}
          sx={{
            color: 'text.secondary',
            '&:hover': { color: 'text.primary', bgcolor: 'action.hover' },
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          <MoreVertIcon fontSize={size} />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>

      <Menu
        anchorEl={anchorEl}
        open={isOpen}
        onClose={handleClose}
        disableEnforceFocus={true}
        disableRestoreFocus={true}
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            elevation: 3,
            sx: {
              borderRadius: '8px',
              minWidth: 160,
              border: 1,
              borderColor: 'divider',
              boxShadow: (theme) => `0 4px 16px ${theme.palette.action.hover}`,
            },
          },
        }}
        transformOrigin={{ horizontal: 'right', vertical: 'top' }}
        anchorOrigin={{ horizontal: 'right', vertical: 'bottom' }}
      >
        {items.map((item) => (
          <MenuItem
            key={item.id}
            onClick={handleItemClick(item)}
            disabled={item.disabled}
            sx={{
              py: 1,
              px: 1.5,
              fontSize: '0.875rem',
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: item.isDestructive ? 'error.main' : 'text.primary',
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: item.isDestructive ? 'error.lighter' : 'action.hover',
              },
            }}
          >
            {item.icon && (
              <ListItemIcon
                sx={{
                  color: item.isDestructive ? 'error.main' : 'text.secondary',
                  minWidth: 32,
                }}
              >
                {item.icon}
              </ListItemIcon>
            )}
            <ListItemText primary={item.label} />
          </MenuItem>
        ))}
      </Menu>

      {/* Confirmation Dialog for destructive or sensitive action items */}
      {activeConfirmItem && (
        <MuiConfirmDialog
          open={Boolean(activeConfirmItem)}
          onClose={handleConfirmClose}
          onConfirm={handleConfirmEffect}
          title={activeConfirmItem.confirmTitle}
          description={activeConfirmItem.confirmDescription}
          confirmText={activeConfirmItem.label}
          isDestructive={Boolean(activeConfirmItem.isDestructive)}
          isLoading={isEffectLoading}
          matchConfirmationText={activeConfirmItem.confirmMatchText}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
});

MuiActionMenu.propTypes = {
  items: PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
      id: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
      label: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
      icon: PropTypes.element,
      onClick: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
      isDestructive: PropTypes.bool,
      confirmTitle: PropTypes.string,
      confirmDescription: PropTypes.string,
      confirmMatchText: PropTypes.string,
      disabled: PropTypes.bool,
    })
  ).isRequired,
  tooltip: PropTypes.string,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiActionMenu;

        <Chip
          label="Ctrl K"

          sx={{

            fontWeight: 700,
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',

            flexShrink: 0,

  ) : null;

  return (
    <AppBar
      position="static"
      elevation={0}
      sx={{
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',

        disableGutters
        sx={{
          px: { xs: 1.5, sm: 3 },
          minHeight: APPBAR_MIN_HEIGHT,
          gap: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5 },
        }}
      >
        {leading}
        <Box sx={{ flexGrow: isPublic ? 1 : { xs: 0, md: 1 } }} />
        {searchAction}
        {actions}
      </Toolbar>
    </AppBar>
  );
};

MuiAppbar.propTypes = {

  leading: PropTypes.node,
  actions: PropTypes.node,
  onOpenSearch: PropTypes.func,
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiAppbar;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiConfirmDialog
 * @description Generic, reusable confirmation dialog modal adhering strictly to modern MUI
 * slotProps (zero deprecated props) and the Universal Arrow Functions Law.
 */

import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogTitle from '@mui/material/DialogTitle';
import DialogContent from '@mui/material/DialogContent';
import DialogContentText from '@mui/material/DialogContentText';
import DialogActions from '@mui/material/DialogActions';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import MuiButton from './MuiButton.jsx';

/**
 * Universal confirmation modal component.
 *
 * @component MuiConfirmDialog
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} props.open - Modal visibility state.
 * @param {() => void} props.onClose - Modal dismissal handler.
 * @param {() => void} props.onConfirm - Action confirmation handler.
 * @param {string} [props.title='Confirm Action'] - Dialog header title.
 * @param {string} [props.message='Are you sure you want to proceed?'] - Descriptive body notice.
 * @param {string} [props.confirmText='Confirm'] - Confirmation action label.
 * @param {string} [props.cancelText='Cancel'] - Rejection / dismissal action label.
 * @param {'error'|'primary'|'secondary'|'warning'} [props.confirmColor='error'] - Primary action intent color.
 * @param {boolean} [props.loading=false] - Whether operation is currently executing.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered confirmation dialog element.
 */
export const MuiConfirmDialog = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  title = 'Confirm Action',
  message = 'Are you sure you want to proceed?',
  confirmText = 'Confirm',
  cancelText = 'Cancel',
  confirmColor = 'error',
  loading = false,
  disablePortal = false,
}) => {
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={loading ? undefined : onClose}
      disablePortal={disablePortal}
      disableEnforceFocus={true}
      disableRestoreFocus={true}
      aria-labelledby="confirm-dialog-title"
      aria-describedby="confirm-dialog-description"
      slotProps={{
        paper: {
          sx: {
            borderRadius: 2,
            p: 1,
            backgroundImage: "none",
            minWidth: { xs: 280, sm: 360 },
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      <DialogTitle id="confirm-dialog-title" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, pb: 1 }}>
        {title}
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent sx={{ py: 1 }}>
        <DialogContentText id="confirm-dialog-description" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
          {message}
        </DialogContentText>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions sx={{ px: 2, pb: 1.5, gap: 1 }}>
        <MuiButton
          variant="outlined"
          color="inherit"
          onClick={onClose}
          disabled={loading}
        >
          {cancelText}
        </MuiButton>
        <MuiButton
          variant="contained"
          color={confirmColor}
          onClick={onConfirm}
          disabled={loading}
          startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : null}
        >
          {confirmText}
        </MuiButton>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

MuiConfirmDialog.propTypes = {
  open: PropTypes.bool.isRequired,
  onClose: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  onConfirm: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  title: PropTypes.string,
  message: PropTypes.string,
  confirmText: PropTypes.string,
  cancelText: PropTypes.string,
  confirmColor: PropTypes.oneOf(['error', 'primary', 'secondary', 'warning']),
  loading: PropTypes.bool,
  disablePortal: PropTypes.bool,
};

export default MuiConfirmDialog;

 * @description Enterprise-grade, reusable Material-UI DataGrid wrapper.

/**

 * @param {Array<object>} props.columns - Column definitions adhering to flex + minWidth invariant.
 * @param {boolean} [props.loading=false] - Whether data is actively fetching.
 * @param {number} [props.rowCount] - Total count of rows for server pagination.
 * @param {object} [props.paginationModel] - Controlled pagination model ({ page, pageSize }).
 * @param {Function} [props.onPaginationModelChange] - Pagination change handler.
 * @param {'server'|'client'} [props.paginationMode='client'] - Pagination computation mode.
 * @param {Array<number>} [props.pageSizeOptions=[5, 10, 25, 50]] - Page size selector options.
 * @param {boolean} [props.autoHeight=true] - Whether grid grows to fit row height.
 * @param {Function} [props.getRowId] - Custom row ID selector (defaults to row._id || row.id).
 * @param {boolean} [props.showToolbar=false] - Whether to render DataGrid toolbar.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.emptyIcon] - Custom icon for empty state overlay.
 * @param {string} [props.emptyTitle='No records found'] - Header for empty state overlay.
 * @param {string} [props.emptySubtitle='There are no records matching your current criteria.'] - Subtitle for empty state.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.emptyAction] - Action button element for empty state.
 * @param {object} [props.slots] - Granular slot overrides.
 * @param {object} [props.slotProps] - Granular slotProps overrides.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Styling overrides for outer container.
 * @param {object} [props.gridSx] - Styling overrides for DataGrid element.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered DataGrid component.
 */
export const MuiDataGrid = memo(({
  rows = [],
  columns = [],
  loading = false,
  rowCount,
  paginationModel,
  onPaginationModelChange,
  paginationMode = 'client',
  pageSizeOptions = DATA_GRID_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  autoHeight = true,
  getRowId,
  showToolbar = false,
  emptyIcon,
  emptyTitle = 'No records found',
  emptySubtitle = 'There are no records matching your current criteria.',
  emptyAction,
  slots = {},
  slotProps = {},
  sx = {},
  gridSx = {},
  ...restProps
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();

  // Memoized custom empty state overlay
  const NoRowsOverlayComponent = useCallback(
    () => (
      <CustomNoRowsOverlay
        icon={emptyIcon}
        title={emptyTitle}
        subtitle={emptySubtitle}
        action={emptyAction}
      />
    ),
    [emptyIcon, emptyTitle, emptySubtitle, emptyAction]
  );

  // Fallback row id resolver
  const defaultGetRowId = useMemo(
    () => getRowId || ((row) => row._id || row.id),
    [getRowId]
  );

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' },
        width: '100%',
        ...sx,
      }}
    >
      <DataGrid
        rows={rows}
        columns={columns}
        loading={loading}
        rowCount={rowCount}
        paginationModel={paginationModel}
        onPaginationModelChange={onPaginationModelChange}
        paginationMode={paginationMode}
        pageSizeOptions={pageSizeOptions}
        initialState={{
          pagination: {
            paginationModel: { pageSize: 10, page: 0 },
          },
          ...restProps.initialState,
        }}
        autoHeight={autoHeight}
        getRowId={defaultGetRowId}
        disableRowSelectionOnClick
        showToolbar={showToolbar}
        slots={{
          loadingOverlay: CustomLoadingOverlay,
          noRowsOverlay: NoRowsOverlayComponent,
          ...slots,
        }}
        slotProps={{
          toolbar: {
            showQuickFilter: true,
            quickFilterProps: { debounceMs: 400 },
            sx: { p: 1.5, gap: 1 },
          },
          ...slotProps,
        }}
        sx={{
          border: 1,
          borderColor: 'divider',
          borderRadius: 2.5,
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
          '& .MuiDataGrid-columnHeaders': {
            bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.text.primary, 0.03),
            borderBottom: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
          },
          '& .MuiDataGrid-columnHeaderTitle': {
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            color: 'text.primary',
          },
          '& .MuiDataGrid-cell': {
            borderColor: 'divider',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
          },
          '& .MuiDataGrid-row:hover': {
            bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
          },
          '& .MuiDataGrid-toolbarContainer': {
            p: 1.5,
            borderBottom: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            gap: 1,
          },
          ...gridSx,
        }}
        {...restProps}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiDataGrid.displayName = 'MuiDataGrid';

MuiDataGrid.propTypes = {
  rows: PropTypes.array.isRequired,
  columns: PropTypes.array.isRequired,
  loading: PropTypes.bool,
  rowCount: PropTypes.number,
  paginationModel: PropTypes.object,
  onPaginationModelChange: PropTypes.func,
  paginationMode: PropTypes.oneOf(['client', 'server']),
  pageSizeOptions: PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.number),
  autoHeight: PropTypes.bool,
  getRowId: PropTypes.func,
  showToolbar: PropTypes.bool,
  emptyIcon: PropTypes.node,
  emptyTitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptySubtitle: PropTypes.string,
  emptyAction: PropTypes.node,
  slots: PropTypes.object,
  slotProps: PropTypes.object,
  sx: PropTypes.object,
  gridSx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiDataGrid;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiDataGridToolbar
 * @description Standardized custom Material-UI DataGrid toolbar integrating zero-lag search,
 * domain-specific custom action filters, active/archived status tabs, add record action,
 * and view mode switcher. Responsive with mandatory xs: 375px fullwidth ergonomics.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Tabs from '@mui/material/Tabs';
import Tab from '@mui/material/Tab';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import ViewModuleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewModule';
import ViewListIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewList';
import RestartAltIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RestartAlt';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import MuiSearchInput from './MuiSearchInput.jsx';

/**
 * Standardized custom DataGrid toolbar component.
 *
 * @component MuiDataGridToolbar
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Function} [props.onSearch] - Search callback invoked on Enter / Search click / Clear.
 * @param {string} [props.searchPlaceholder='Search records...'] - Search field placeholder.
 * @param {string} [props.searchValue=''] - Controlled / initial search query value.
 * @param {Function} [props.onAdd] - Optional add new record callback.
 * @param {string} [props.addLabel='Add New'] - Text label for add button.
 * @param {'active'|'archived'} [props.activeTab] - Active status tab value.
 * @param {Function} [props.onTabChange] - Tab change callback.
 * @param {number} [props.activeCount] - Number of active records.
 * @param {number} [props.archivedCount] - Number of archived records.
 * @param {'table'|'cards'|'grid'|'list'} [props.viewMode] - Current view mode.
 * @param {Function} [props.onViewModeChange] - View mode toggle callback.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.customActions] - Custom filter / action elements.
 * @param {boolean} [props.hasActiveFilters=false] - Whether secondary filters are currently applied.
 * @param {Function} [props.onResetFilters] - 1-click filter reset callback.
 * @param {string} [props.resetFiltersLabel='Reset Filters'] - Text label for reset button.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether controls are disabled during loading.
 * @param {object} [props.sx={}] - Container sx overrides.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered Custom DataGrid Toolbar.
 */
export const MuiDataGridToolbar = memo(({
  onSearch,
  searchPlaceholder = 'Search records...',
  searchValue = '',
  onAdd,
  addLabel = 'Add New',
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  activeCount,
  archivedCount,
  viewMode,
  onViewModeChange,
  customActions,
  hasActiveFilters = false,
  onResetFilters,
  resetFiltersLabel = 'Reset Filters',
  disabled = false,
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm')); // xs: < 600px

  const isTableView = viewMode === 'table' || viewMode === 'grid';
  const isCardView = viewMode === 'cards' || viewMode === 'list';

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: { xs: 1.25, sm: 1.5 },
        p: { xs: 1.25, sm: 1.5 },
        bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        border: 1,
        borderColor: 'divider',
        borderRadius: 2,
        boxShadow: (t) =>
          t.palette.mode === 'dark'
            ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)'
            : '0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)',
        ...sx,
      }}
    >
      {/* Top Controls Row: Search Input + Action Elements (customActions, viewSwitcher, onAdd) */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexWrap: { xs: 'wrap', md: 'nowrap' },
          gap: { xs: 1.25, sm: 1.5 },
          width: '100%',
        }}
      >
        {/* Zero-Lag Search Field: full width on mobile/tablet, flex: 1 on desktop */}
        {onSearch && (
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: { xs: '100%', md: 'auto' },
              flex: { md: 1 },
              minWidth: { md: 240, lg: 320 },
            }}
          >
            <MuiSearchInput
              onSearch={onSearch}
              placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
              initialValue={searchValue}
              size="small"
              fullWidth
              disabled={disabled}
            />
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Action Controls Deck */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: { xs: 'stretch', sm: 'flex-end' },
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
            gap: 1.25,
            width: { xs: '100%', md: 'auto' },
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {/* Custom Domain Actions (Branch Filter, Date Picker) */}
          {customActions && (
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 1.25,
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                flex: { sm: 1, md: 'none' },
              }}
            >
              {customActions}
            </Box>
          )}

          {/* View Mode Switcher (Visible on Tablet and Desktop, strictly hidden on mobile xs) */}
          {onViewModeChange && viewMode && (
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'flex' },
                alignItems: 'center',
                border: 1,
                borderColor: 'divider',
                borderRadius: 1.5,
                p: 0.25,
                bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                flexShrink: 0,
                height: 38,
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
              }}
            >
              <Tooltip title="DataGrid Table View">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label="Table View"
                  onClick={() => onViewModeChange('table')}
                  color={isTableView ? 'primary' : 'default'}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  sx={{
                    p: 0.75,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    bgcolor: isTableView ? 'action.selected' : 'transparent',
                  }}
                >
                  <ViewListIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip title="Card Grid View">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label="Card Grid View"
                  onClick={() => onViewModeChange('cards')}
                  color={isCardView ? 'primary' : 'default'}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  sx={{
                    p: 0.75,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    bgcolor: isCardView ? 'action.selected' : 'transparent',
                  }}
                >
                  <ViewModuleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </Box>
          )}

          {/* Add Record Action Button */}
          {onAdd && (
            <>
              {/* Tablet & Desktop: Outlined/Contained Button */}
              <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' } }}>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  size="small"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={onAdd}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    borderRadius: 1.5,
                    px: 2,
                    height: 38,
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  }}
                >
                  {addLabel}
                </Button>
              </Box>
              {/* Mobile: 100% full width button */}
              <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'block', sm: 'none' }, width: '100%' }}>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  size="small"
                  fullWidth
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={onAdd}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    borderRadius: 1.5,
                    height: 38,
                  }}
                >
                  {addLabel}
                </Button>
              </Box>
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Mobile xs Reset Filters Row: Sits cleanly above fullwidth tabs */}
      {hasActiveFilters && onResetFilters && (
        <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' }, justifyContent: 'flex-end', width: '100%' }}>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            color="inherit"
            onClick={onResetFilters}
            disabled={disabled}
            startIcon={<RestartAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
            sx={{
              textTransform: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              color: 'text.secondary',
              '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
            }}
          >
            {resetFiltersLabel}
          </Button>
        </Box>
      )}

      {/* Bottom Row: Active vs Archived Tabs + Reset Filters (Tablet & Desktop) */}
      {onTabChange && activeTab !== undefined && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            borderTop: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            pt: 1,
            width: '100%',
          }}
        >
          <Tabs
            value={activeTab}
            onChange={(_e, val) => onTabChange(val)}
            variant={isMobile ? 'fullWidth' : 'standard'}
            sx={{
              minHeight: 36,
              width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
              '& .MuiTab-root': {
                minHeight: 36,
                py: 0.5,
                px: { xs: 1.5, sm: 2 },
                fontWeight: 600,
                fontSize: { xs: '0.8rem', sm: '0.85rem' },
                textTransform: 'none',
              },
            }}
          >
            <Tab
              value="active"
              label={activeCount !== undefined ? `Active (${activeCount})` : 'Active'}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
            <Tab
              value="archived"
              label={archivedCount !== undefined ? `Archived (${archivedCount})` : 'Archived'}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
          </Tabs>

          {/* Reset Filters on Tablet & Desktop */}
          {hasActiveFilters && onResetFilters && (
            <Box sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', sm: 'block' } }}>
              <Button
                size="small"
                variant="text"
                color="inherit"
                onClick={onResetFilters}
                disabled={disabled}
                startIcon={<RestartAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                sx={{
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  color: 'text.secondary',
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
                }}
              >
                {resetFiltersLabel}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiDataGridToolbar.displayName = 'MuiDataGridToolbar';

MuiDataGridToolbar.propTypes = {
  onSearch: PropTypes.func,
  searchPlaceholder: PropTypes.string,
  searchValue: PropTypes.string,
  onAdd: PropTypes.func,
  addLabel: PropTypes.string,
  activeTab: PropTypes.oneOf(['active', 'archived']),
  onTabChange: PropTypes.func,

  archivedCount: PropTypes.number,
  viewMode: PropTypes.oneOf(['table', 'cards', 'grid', 'list']),
  onViewModeChange: PropTypes.func,

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiDatePicker
 * @description Universal, production-grade Material-UI date picker wrapping official
 * MUI X DatePicker (@mui/x-date-pickers/DatePicker) with AdapterEthiopianDayjs scoped locally
 * under <LocalizationProvider> for 100% collision immunity.
 * Renders a native Button (no TextField) with right-docked Clear button, and inherits 100% of styling from AppTheme.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import { LocalizationProvider } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/LocalizationProvider';
import { DatePicker } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/DatePicker';

import { AdapterEthiopianDayjs } from '../../utils/AdapterEthiopianDayjs.js';
import {
  toEthiopianDate,
  formatEthiopianFullDate,
  parseEthiopianDate,
  ethiopianToGregorianDate,
} from '../../utils/ethiopianCalendar.js';

/**
 * Universal MuiDatePicker component wrapping official MUI X DatePicker.
 *
 * @component MuiDatePicker
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string|Date|object} [props.value] - Date value (Gregorian 'YYYY-MM-DD', Ethiopian 'DD-MM-YY', or Dayjs/Date).
 * @param {Function} props.onChange - Selection callback receiving { gregorian, ethiopianDate, ethiopian, target: { name, value } }.
 * @param {string} [props.name='date'] - Form field name attribute.
 * @param {string} [props.label='Date'] - Input label.
 * @param {string} [props.placeholder='Select Date'] - Placeholder text.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether picker is disabled.
 * @param {Function} [props.renderButton] - Custom trigger renderer.
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [props.startAdornment] - Custom leading adornment.
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [props.endAdornment] - Custom trailing adornment.
 * @param {boolean} [props.allowClear=true] - Whether clear button is enabled.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'} [props.size='small'] - Input size.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Styling overrides.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered date picker element.
 */
export const MuiDatePicker = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  name = 'date',
  label = 'Date',
  placeholder = 'Select Date',
  disabled = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  renderButton,
  startAdornment,
  endAdornment,
  allowClear = true,
  size = 'small',
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const anchorRef = useRef(null);

  // Unpack raw value safely (supporting primitive strings, Dayjs/Date, and { value, gregorian, target } objects)
  const rawDateValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!value) return null;
    if (typeof value === 'object' && !dayjs.isDayjs(value) && !(value instanceof Date)) {
      return value.gregorian ?? value.value ?? value.target?.value ?? null;
    }
    return value;
  }, [value]);

  // Parse incoming value into a valid dayjs instance
  const dayjsValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rawDateValue) return null;
    if (dayjs.isDayjs(rawDateValue)) return rawDateValue.isValid() ? rawDateValue : null;
    if (rawDateValue instanceof Date) {
      const d = dayjs(rawDateValue);
      return d.isValid() ? d : null;
    }
    if (typeof rawDateValue === 'string') {
      const trimmed = rawDateValue.trim();
      if (!trimmed) return null;

      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(trimmed)) {
        const d = dayjs(trimmed.slice(0, 10));
        if (d.isValid()) return d;
      }

      const ethParsed = parseEthiopianDate(trimmed);
      if (ethParsed) {
        const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(ethParsed.year, ethParsed.month, ethParsed.day);
        if (greg?.isoDate) {
          const d = dayjs(greg.isoDate);
          if (d.isValid()) return d;
        }
      }

      const fallback = dayjs(trimmed);
      return fallback.isValid() ? fallback : null;
    }
    return null;
  }, [rawDateValue]);

  const selectedEth = useMemo(() => {
    if (!dayjsValue || !dayjsValue.isValid()) return null;
    return toEthiopianDate(dayjsValue);
  }, [dayjsValue]);

  const ethiopianData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedEth) {
      return {
        ethiopian: null,
        formatted: '',
        ethiopianDate: '',
      };
    }
    const dd = String(selectedEth.day).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(selectedEth.month).padStart(2, '0');
    const yy = String(selectedEth.year).slice(-2);
    return {
      ethiopian: selectedEth,
      formatted: formatEthiopianFullDate(selectedEth),
      ethiopianDate: `${dd}-${mm}-${yy}`,
    };
  }, [selectedEth]);

  const handlePickerChange = useCallback(
    (newDate) => {
      if (!onChange) return;
      const d = dayjs.isDayjs(newDate) ? newDate : (newDate ? dayjs(newDate) : null);
      if (d && d.isValid()) {
        const gregStr = d.format('YYYY-MM-DD');
        const eth = toEthiopianDate(d);
        const dd = String(eth.day).padStart(2, '0');
        const mm = String(eth.month).padStart(2, '0');
        const yy = String(eth.year).slice(-2);
        const ethStr = `${dd}-${mm}-${yy}`;
        onChange({
          gregorian: gregStr,
          ethiopianDate: ethStr,
          ethiopian: eth,
          value: gregStr,
          target: { name, value: gregStr },
        });
      } else {
        onChange({
          gregorian: '',
          ethiopianDate: '',
          ethiopian: null,
          value: '',
          target: { name, value: '' },
        });
      }
    },
    [name, onChange]
  );

  const handleClear = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      if (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
      if (onChange) {
        onChange({
          gregorian: '',
          ethiopianDate: '',
          ethiopian: null,
          target: { name, value: '' },
        });
      }
    },
    [name, onChange]
  );

  const HiddenField = useCallback(
    () => <div tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'none' }} />,
    []
  );

  return (
    <LocalizationProvider dateAdapter={AdapterEthiopianDayjs}>
      {/* Visual Button Trigger (No TextField) */}
      {renderButton ? (
        <Box
          ref={anchorRef}
          sx={{
            display: fullWidth ? 'flex' : 'inline-flex',
            width: fullWidth ? '100%' : 'auto',
          }}
        >
          {renderButton({
            value: dayjsValue,
            formatted: ethiopianData.formatted,
            ethiopianDate: ethiopianData.ethiopianDate,
            onClick: () => setOpen(true),
            onClear: handleClear,
            disabled,
          })}
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          ref={anchorRef}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          disabled={disabled}
          size={size}
          fullWidth={fullWidth}
          startIcon={startAdornment || <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          sx={{
            width: fullWidth ? '100%' : 'auto',
            display: 'inline-flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            textAlign: 'left',
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          <Box component="span" sx={{ flexGrow: 1, mr: 1, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {ethiopianData.ethiopianDate || placeholder || label}
          </Box>

          {allowClear && selectedEth && !disabled ? (
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              component="span"
              onClick={handleClear}
              sx={{
                p: 0.25,
                ml: 'auto',
                bgcolor: 'transparent',
                color: 'text.secondary',
                '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'transparent', color: 'text.primary' },
              }}
              aria-label="Clear date selection"
            >
              <ClearIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          ) : (
            endAdornment
          )}
        </Button>
      )}

      {/* Official MUI X DatePicker wrapped in Scoped Adapter */}
      <DatePicker
        open={open}
        onOpen={() => setOpen(true)}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        value={dayjsValue}
        onChange={handlePickerChange}
        onAccept={handlePickerChange}
        disabled={disabled}
        dayOfWeekFormatter={(date) => {
          const day = typeof date?.day === 'function' ? date.day() : 0;
          const names = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];
          return names[day] || '';
        }}
        slots={{
          field: HiddenField,
        }}
        slotProps={{
          popper: {
            anchorEl: () => anchorRef.current,
          },
        }}
      />
    </LocalizationProvider>
  );
};

MuiDatePicker.propTypes = {
  value: PropTypes.oneOfType([
    PropTypes.string,
    PropTypes.instanceOf(Date),
    PropTypes.object,
  ]),
  onChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  name: PropTypes.string,
  label: PropTypes.string,
  placeholder: PropTypes.string,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  fullWidth: PropTypes.bool,
  renderButton: PropTypes.func,
  startAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  endAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  allowClear: PropTypes.bool,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiDatePicker;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiDialog
 * @description Enterprise-grade, accessible Material-UI Dialog modal wrapper.
 * Strictly eliminates the browser warning:
 * "Blocked aria-hidden on an element because its descendant that has focus was not hidden"
 * by enforcing disableEnforceFocus={true} and disableRestoreFocus={true}.
 * Automatically provides responsive fullScreen on mobile viewports (< 600px).
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogTitle from '@mui/material/DialogTitle';
import DialogContent from '@mui/material/DialogContent';
import DialogActions from '@mui/material/DialogActions';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';

/**
 * Accessible, responsive modal dialog wrapper.
 *
 * @component MuiDialog
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} props.open - Modal visibility state.
 * @param {() => void} props.onClose - Modal dismissal callback.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} props.title - Modal title header.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} props.children - Modal body content.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.actions] - Optional dialog actions button deck.
 * @param {'xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'|false} [props.maxWidth='sm'] - Maximum dialog width breakpoint.
 * @param {boolean} [props.fullWidth=true] - Whether dialog spans up to maxWidth.
 * @param {boolean} [props.fullScreenOnMobile=true] - Whether to adapt to fullscreen on xs (< 600px).
 * @param {boolean} [props.disablePortal=false] - Whether to render inline rather than via portal.
 * @param {object} [props.slotProps={}] - Granular slotProps overrides for dialog elements.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered modal dialog.
 */
export const MuiDialog = memo(({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  actions,
  maxWidth = 'sm',
  fullWidth = true,
  fullScreenOnMobile = true,
  disablePortal = false,
  slotProps = {},
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));
  const isFullScreen = fullScreenOnMobile && isMobile;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      fullScreen={isFullScreen}
      maxWidth={maxWidth}
      fullWidth={fullWidth}
      disablePortal={disablePortal}
      disableEnforceFocus={true}
      disableRestoreFocus={true}
      aria-labelledby="mui-dialog-title"
      slotProps={{
        paper: {
          sx: {
            borderRadius: isFullScreen ? 0 : 2.5,
            p: 0,
            backgroundImage: 'none',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            ...(slotProps.paper?.sx || {}),
          },
          ...slotProps.paper,
        },
        backdrop: slotProps.backdrop,
      }}
    >
      {title && (
        <DialogTitle
          id="mui-dialog-title"
          sx={{
            m: 0,
            px: { xs: 2, sm: 3 },
            py: 2,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            borderBottom: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
          }}
        >
          {typeof title === 'string' ? (
            <Typography variant="h6" component="div" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: '1.05rem', sm: '1.25rem' } }}>
              {title}
            </Typography>
          ) : (
            title
          )}
          {onClose && (
            <IconButton
              aria-label="close"
              onClick={onClose}
              size="small"
              sx={{
                color: 'text.secondary',
                '&:hover': { color: 'text.primary' },
              }}
            >
              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          )}
        </DialogTitle>
      )}

      <DialogContent
        dividers
        sx={{
          p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 },
          ...(slotProps.content?.sx || {}),
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </DialogContent>

      {actions && (
        <DialogActions
          sx={{
            px: { xs: 2, sm: 3 },
            py: 2,
            gap: 1.5,
            borderTop: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            bgcolor: (theme) => theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.01)',
            ...(slotProps.actions?.sx || {}),
          }}
        >
          {actions}
        </DialogActions>
      )}
    </Dialog>
  );
});

MuiDialog.displayName = 'MuiDialog';

MuiDialog.propTypes = {
  open: PropTypes.bool.isRequired,
  onClose: PropTypes.func,
  title: PropTypes.node,
  children: PropTypes.node,
  actions: PropTypes.node,
  maxWidth: PropTypes.oneOf(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', false]),
  fullWidth: PropTypes.bool,
  fullScreenOnMobile: PropTypes.bool,
  disablePortal: PropTypes.bool,
  slotProps: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiDialog;

import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**
 * Standardized visual empty state component conforming to Section 10.8 & Section 14.4.
 * Renders an elevated/outlined container with a centered icon badge, primary headline,
 * descriptive context text, and an optional call-to-action control.
 *
 * @component MuiEmptyState
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.icon] - MUI icon element displayed in the circular badge.
 * @param {string|import('react').ReactNode} props.title - Primary title or headline text.
 * @param {string|import('react').ReactNode} [props.description] - Explanatory message for empty or pending state.
 * @param {string|import('react').ReactNode} [props.subtitle] - Alias for description message.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.action] - Optional call-to-action button or interactive element.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Optional Material-UI sx styling overrides.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered empty state presentation.
 */
export const MuiEmptyState = ({ icon, title, description, subtitle, action, sx = {} }) => {
  const messageText = description || subtitle;

  return (
    <Paper
      elevation={0}
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        textAlign: 'center',

            justifyContent: 'center',
            width: 72,
            height: 72,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            bgcolor: (theme) => alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.08),

          }}

          {icon}

      {title && (

      {messageText && (
        <Typography
          variant="body2"
          color="text.secondary"
          sx={{ maxWidth: 460, mb: action ? 3 : 0, lineHeight: 1.6 }}
        >
          {messageText}
        </Typography>
      )}

      {action && <Box sx={{ mt: messageText ? 0 : 2 }}>{action}</Box>}
    </Paper>
  );
};

MuiEmptyState.propTypes = {

  title: PropTypes.node.isRequired,

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiPagination
 * @description Universal, accessible pagination component adhering strictly to
 * the conditional render invariant: returns null if totalPages <= 1.
 */

import { memo } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Pagination from '@mui/material/Pagination';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';

/**
 * Standardized pagination bar for card lists, tables, and audit logs.
 * Strictly returns null if totalPages <= 1.
 *
 * @component MuiPagination
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {number} props.page - Current 1-based active page.
 * @param {number} props.totalPages - Total number of available pages.
 * @param {(event: React.ChangeEvent<unknown>, value: number) => void} props.onChange - Page change handler.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'|'large'} [props.size] - Size variant (defaults to responsive).
 * @param {'primary'|'secondary'|'standard'} [props.color='primary'] - Pagination color intent.
 * @param {'rounded'|'circular'} [props.shape='rounded'] - Pagination item border radius shape.
 * @param {boolean} [props.showFirstButton=true] - Display fast-forward jump to first page.
 * @param {boolean} [props.showLastButton=true] - Display fast-forward jump to last page.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether pagination controls are disabled.
 * @param {object} [props.sx={}] - Container style overrides.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element|null} Rendered pagination or null if totalPages <= 1.
 */
export const MuiPagination = memo(({
  page,
  totalPages,
  onChange,
  size,
  color = 'primary',
  shape = 'rounded',
  showFirstButton = true,
  showLastButton = true,
  disabled = false,
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));

  // Strict Invariant: Do NOT render pagination when only 1 page exists or total is zero/undefined
  if (!totalPages || totalPages <= 1) {
    return null;
  }

  const effectiveSize = size || (isMobile ? 'small' : 'medium');

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        mt: 3,
        mb: 1.5,
        width: '100%',
        ...sx,
      }}
    >
      <Pagination
        count={totalPages}
        page={page || 1}
        onChange={onChange}
        color={color}
        shape={shape}
        size={effectiveSize}
        showFirstButton={showFirstButton}
        showLastButton={showLastButton}
        disabled={disabled}
        siblingCount={isMobile ? 0 : 1}
        boundaryCount={isMobile ? 1 : 1}
        sx={{
          '& .MuiPaginationItem-root': {
            fontWeight: 500,
          },
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );
});

MuiPagination.displayName = 'MuiPagination';

MuiPagination.propTypes = {
  page: PropTypes.number.isRequired,
  totalPages: PropTypes.number.isRequired,
  onChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium', 'large']),
  color: PropTypes.oneOf(['primary', 'secondary', 'standard']),
  shape: PropTypes.oneOf(['rounded', 'circular']),
  showFirstButton: PropTypes.bool,
  showLastButton: PropTypes.bool,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiPagination;

/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiSearchInput
 * @description Zero-lag explicit-trigger search input component strictly adhering to
 * the Zero-Lag Uncontrolled & Explicit-Trigger Law (Invariant 43).
 * Strictly zero debounces and zero react-hook-form watch.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, memo, useEffect } from 'react';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**
 * High-performance, zero-lag search input component.
 * Uses an uncontrolled DOM input reference to handle typing at native hardware speed
 * without triggering React state reconciliations or parent re-renders on keystroke.
 * Dispatches searches exclusively on explicit user triggers:
 *   1. Pressing the Enter key
 *   2. Clicking the Search icon button
 *   3. Clicking the Clear icon button
 *
 * @component MuiSearchInput
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {Function} props.onSearch - Callback invoked with the search query string upon explicit trigger.
 * @param {string} [props.placeholder='Search...'] - Placeholder text.
 * @param {string} [props.initialValue=''] - Initial query value if resuming state.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'} [props.size='small'] - Input size variant.
 * @param {boolean} [props.fullWidth=true] - Whether input fills container width.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Disabled state flag.
 * @param {boolean} [props.autoFocus=false] - Autofocus flag upon mount.
 * @param {boolean} [props.searchOnBlur=false] - Optional trigger on input blur.
 * @param {object} [props.sx={}] - Style overrides.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered search input component.
 */
export const MuiSearchInput = memo(({
  onSearch,
  placeholder = 'Search...',
  initialValue = '',
  size = 'small',
  fullWidth = true,
  disabled = false,
  autoFocus = false,
  searchOnBlur = false,
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const [hasContent, setHasContent] = useState(Boolean(initialValue));

  // Sync initialValue if provided or updated externally
  useEffect(() => {
    if (inputRef.current && initialValue !== undefined) {
      inputRef.current.value = initialValue;
      setHasContent(Boolean(initialValue));
    }
  }, [initialValue]);

  // Handle explicit search dispatch
  const handleTriggerSearch = useCallback(() => {
    const query = inputRef.current ? inputRef.current.value.trim() : '';
    if (onSearch) {
      onSearch(query);
    }
  }, [onSearch]);

  // Keydown handler: triggers search on Enter key
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleTriggerSearch();
      }
    },
    [handleTriggerSearch]
  );

  // Native input change: updates internal hasContent state purely for clear button visibility
  const handleNativeInput = useCallback(() => {
    const currentVal = inputRef.current ? inputRef.current.value : '';
    const nowHasContent = Boolean(currentVal);
    setHasContent((prev) => (prev !== nowHasContent ? nowHasContent : prev));
  }, []);

  // Clear handler: resets input value and dispatches empty search
  const handleClear = useCallback(() => {
    if (inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.value = '';
      inputRef.current.focus();
    }
    setHasContent(false);
    if (onSearch) {
      onSearch('');
    }
  }, [onSearch]);

  // Optional blur trigger
  const handleBlur = useCallback(() => {
    if (searchOnBlur) {
      handleTriggerSearch();
    }
  }, [searchOnBlur, handleTriggerSearch]);

  return (
    <TextField
      inputRef={inputRef}
      defaultValue={initialValue}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      size={size}
      fullWidth={fullWidth}
      disabled={disabled}
      autoFocus={autoFocus}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      onInput={handleNativeInput}
      onBlur={handleBlur}
      slotProps={{
        input: {
          startAdornment: (
            <InputAdornment position="start">
              <SearchIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }} />
            </InputAdornment>
          ),
          endAdornment: (
            <InputAdornment position="end" sx={{ gap: 0.5 }}>
              {hasContent && (
                <Tooltip title="Clear search">
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    aria-label="Clear search query"
                    onClick={handleClear}
                    edge="end"
                    sx={{ p: 0.5 }}
                  >
                    <ClearIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              <Tooltip title="Search (Enter)">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label="Execute search"
                  onClick={handleTriggerSearch}
                  edge="end"
                  color="primary"
                  sx={{ p: 0.5 }}
                >
                  <SearchIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </InputAdornment>
          ),
        },
      }}
      sx={{
        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
          borderRadius: '8px',
          bgcolor: 'background.paper',
        },
        ...sx,
      }}
    />
  );
});

MuiSearchInput.propTypes = {
  onSearch: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  placeholder: PropTypes.string,
  initialValue: PropTypes.string,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium']),
  fullWidth: PropTypes.bool,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  autoFocus: PropTypes.bool,
  searchOnBlur: PropTypes.bool,
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiSearchInput;

import { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';

import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**
 * Status configuration lookup mapping raw domain status keys to semantic representations.

 */
const STATUS_CONFIGS = Object.freeze({

    color: 'success',

  },

  },

  },
  reported: {
    label: 'Issue Flagged',
    color: 'error',
    icon: <WarningAmberIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  no_issue: {
    label: 'No Issues',
    color: 'success',
    icon: <CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  clean: {
    label: 'Clean Audit',
    color: 'success',
    icon: <CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  connected: {
    label: 'Connected',
    color: 'success',
    icon: <CloudDoneOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  disconnected: {
    label: 'Disconnected',
    color: 'default',
    icon: <CloudOffOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  enabled: {
    label: 'Enabled',
    color: 'primary',
    icon: <CheckCircleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
  disabled: {
    label: 'Disabled',
    color: 'default',
    icon: <RadioButtonUncheckedIcon fontSize="small" />,
  },
});

const DEFAULT_CONFIG = Object.freeze({
  label: 'Unknown',
  color: 'default',
  icon: <RadioButtonUncheckedIcon fontSize="small" />,
});

/**
 * Reusable semantic status chip component.
 *
 * @component MuiStatusChip
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} props.status - Raw domain status key.
 * @param {string} [props.label] - Optional explicit label override.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'} [props.size='small'] - Chip size variant.
 * @param {'outlined'|'filled'} [props.variant='outlined'] - Chip visual variant.
 * @param {import('react').ReactElement} [props.icon] - Optional explicit icon override.
 * @param {object} [props.sx={}] - Style overrides.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered Status Chip.
 */
export const MuiStatusChip = memo(({
  status,
  label,
  size = 'small',
  variant = 'outlined',
  icon,
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const normalizedKey = typeof status === 'string' ? status.toLowerCase() : '';
  const config = STATUS_CONFIGS[normalizedKey] || DEFAULT_CONFIG;

  const resolvedLabel = useMemo(
    () => label || config.label,
    [label, config.label]
  );

  const resolvedIcon = useMemo(
    () => (icon !== undefined ? icon : config.icon),
    [icon, config.icon]
  );

  return (
    <Chip
      size={size}
      variant={variant}
      color={config.color}
      icon={resolvedIcon}
      label={resolvedLabel}
      sx={{
        fontWeight: 600,
        fontSize: size === 'small' ? '0.75rem' : '0.85rem',
        borderRadius: '6px',
        height: size === 'small' ? 24 : 32,
        ...sx,
      }}
    />
  );
});

MuiStatusChip.propTypes = {
  status: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
  label: PropTypes.string,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium']),
  variant: PropTypes.oneOf(['outlined', 'filled']),
  icon: PropTypes.element,
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiStatusChip;
