````jsx
/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiTextField
 * @description Standardized Material-UI TextField wrapper supporting start/end adornments and password toggle.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, forwardRef, memo } from 'react';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Visibility from '@mui/icons-material/Visibility';
import VisibilityOff from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOff';
import Clear from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

/**
 * Standard text field wrapper reserving helperText space to prevent form layout jitter.
 * Includes built-in password visibility toggle and forwardRef integration for react-hook-form.
 * Wrapped with memo and optimized inputRef to ensure zero typing latency.
 *
 * @component MuiTextField
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string} [props.type='text'] - Input type ('text', 'password', 'email', etc.).
 * @param {boolean} [props.isPassword] - Explicit password toggle flag (or inferred if type='password').
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.startAdornment] - Leading adornment or icon.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.startIcon] - Alias for leading icon.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.endAdornment] - Trailing adornment or icon.
 * @param {import('react').ReactNode} [props.endIcon] - Alias for trailing icon.
 * @param {Function} [props.onClear] - Clear input callback.
 * @param {object} [props.slotProps] - Custom slot props merged with internal input slot.
 * @param {string} [props.helperText] - Helper or validation error message text.
 * @param {boolean} [props.error] - Error state boolean.
 * @param {string} [props.size='small'] - Input size variant.
 * @param {boolean} [props.fullWidth=true] - Full width boolean flag.
 * @param {string} [props.variant='outlined'] - TextField variant.
 * @param {import('react').Ref<HTMLInputElement>} [props.inputRef] - Explicit input ref.
 * @param {import('react').Ref<HTMLInputElement>} ref - Forwarded reference to the native input element.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered Material-UI TextField element.
 */
export const MuiTextField = memo(
  forwardRef((props, ref) => {
    const {
      type = 'text',
      isPassword: explicitIsPassword = false,
      startAdornment,
      startIcon,
      endAdornment,
      endIcon,
      onClear,
      slotProps = {},
      helperText,
      inputRef: customInputRef,
      error = false,
      size = 'small',
      fullWidth = true,
      variant = 'outlined',
      ...rest
    } = props;

    const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
    const togglePassword = useCallback(() => setShowPassword((v) => !v), []);

    const isPassword = explicitIsPassword || type === 'password';
    const resolvedType = isPassword ? (showPassword ? 'text' : 'password') : type;

    // Resolve ref directly to the native input element for react-hook-form
    const effectiveInputRef = customInputRef || ref || rest.ref;

    // Resolve start adornment: check startAdornment, startIcon, or slotProps.input?.startAdornment
    const rawStart = startAdornment ?? startIcon ?? slotProps.input?.startAdornment;
    const resolvedStartAdornment = useMemo(() => {
      if (!rawStart) return undefined;
      if (rawStart.type === InputAdornment) return rawStart;
      return <InputAdornment position="start">{rawStart}</InputAdornment>;
    }, [rawStart]);

    // Resolve end adornment: password eye toggle > custom clear > endAdornment/endIcon
    const rawEnd = endAdornment ?? endIcon ?? slotProps.input?.endAdornment;
    const resolvedEndAdornment = useMemo(() => {
      if (isPassword) {
        return (
          <InputAdornment position="end">
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              onClick={togglePassword}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              edge="end"
            >
              {showPassword ? <VisibilityOff fontSize="small" /> : <Visibility fontSize="small" />}
            </IconButton>
          </InputAdornment>
        );
      }
      if (onClear && rest.value) {
        return (
          <InputAdornment position="end">
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              onClick={onClear}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              edge="end"
              aria-label="Clear input"
            >
              <Clear fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </InputAdornment>
        );
      }
      if (!rawEnd) return undefined;
      if (rawEnd.type === InputAdornment) return rawEnd;
      return <InputAdornment position="end">{rawEnd}</InputAdornment>;
    }, [isPassword, showPassword, togglePassword, onClear, rest.value, rawEnd]);

    // Resolve helper text: suppress helperText space if explicitly null, false, or empty string
    const resolvedHelperText =
      helperText === null || helperText === false || helperText === ''
        ? undefined
        : (helperText ?? ' ');

    return (
      <TextField
        inputRef={effectiveInputRef}
        type={resolvedType}
        error={error}
        helperText={resolvedHelperText}
        size={size}
        fullWidth={fullWidth}
        variant={variant}
        slotProps={{
          ...slotProps,
          input: {
            ...slotProps.input,
            startAdornment: resolvedStartAdornment,
            endAdornment: resolvedEndAdornment,
          },
          ...(resolvedHelperText !== undefined
            ? {
                formHelperText: {
                  ...slotProps.formHelperText,
                  sx: error
                    ? { color: 'error.main', ...slotProps.formHelperText?.sx }
                    : slotProps.formHelperText?.sx,
                },
              }
            : {}),
        }}
        {...rest}
      />
    );
  })
);

MuiTextField.displayName = 'MuiTextField';

MuiTextField.propTypes = {
  type: PropTypes.string,
  isPassword: PropTypes.bool,
  startAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  startIcon: PropTypes.node,
  endAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  endIcon: PropTypes.node,
  onClear: PropTypes.func,
  slotProps: PropTypes.object,
  helperText: PropTypes.node,
  error: PropTypes.bool,
  size: PropTypes.string,
  fullWidth: PropTypes.bool,
  variant: PropTypes.string,
  inputRef: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.func, PropTypes.object]),
};

export default MuiTextField;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/reusable/MuiTimePicker
 * @description Universal, production-grade Material-UI 24-hour time picker wrapping official
 * MUI X TimePicker (@mui/x-date-pickers/TimePicker).
 * Renders a native Button (no TextField) with right-docked Clear button, and inherits 100% of styling from AppTheme.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import { TimePicker } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/TimePicker';
import { renderTimeViewClock } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/timeViewRenderers';

/**
 * Universal 24-Hour MuiTimePicker component wrapping official MUI X TimePicker.
 *
 * @component MuiTimePicker
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {string|Date|object} [props.value=''] - Time string in "HH:mm" 24-hour format or Dayjs/Date.
 * @param {Function} props.onChange - Time change callback receiving { value, hours, minutes, target: { name, value } }.
 * @param {string} [props.name='time'] - Form field name attribute.
 * @param {string} [props.label='Time'] - Input label.
 * @param {string} [props.placeholder='HH:mm'] - Placeholder text.
 * @param {boolean} [props.disabled=false] - Whether picker is disabled.
 * @param {Function} [props.renderButton] - Custom trigger renderer.
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [props.startAdornment] - Custom leading adornment.
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [props.endAdornment] - Custom trailing adornment.
 * @param {boolean} [props.allowClear=true] - Whether clear button is enabled.
 * @param {'small'|'medium'} [props.size='small'] - Input size.
 * @param {object} [props.sx] - Styling overrides.
 * @returns {import('react').JSX.Element} Rendered time picker element.
 */
export const MuiTimePicker = ({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  name = 'time',
  label = 'Time',
  placeholder = 'HH:mm',
  disabled = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  renderButton,
  startAdornment,
  endAdornment,
  allowClear = true,
  size = 'small',
  sx = {},
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const anchorRef = useRef(null);

  // Unpack raw time string safely (supporting primitive strings, Dayjs/Date, and { value, target } objects)
  const rawTimeStr = useMemo(() => {
    if (!value) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.trim();
    if (typeof value === 'object') {
      if (dayjs.isDayjs(value) && value.isValid()) return value.format('HH:mm');
      if (value instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) {
        const h = String(value.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
        const m = String(value.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${h}:${m}`;
      }
      if (typeof value.value === 'string') return value.value.trim();
      if (typeof value.target?.value === 'string') return value.target.value.trim();
    }
    return '';
  }, [value]);

  // Parse incoming value ("HH:mm") into a valid dayjs instance
  const dayjsValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rawTimeStr) return null;

    const match = rawTimeStr.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
    if (match) {
      const hours = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      const minutes = parseInt(match[2], 10);
      if (hours >= 0 && hours <= 23 && minutes >= 0 && minutes <= 59) {
        return dayjs().hour(hours).minute(minutes).second(0).millisecond(0);
      }
    }

    const d = dayjs(rawTimeStr);
    return d.isValid() ? d : null;
  }, [rawTimeStr]);

  const formattedTime = useMemo(() => {
    if (!dayjsValue || !dayjsValue.isValid()) return '';
    return dayjsValue.format('HH:mm');
  }, [dayjsValue]);

  const handlePickerChange = useCallback(
    (newTime) => {
      if (!onChange) return;
      const d = dayjs.isDayjs(newTime) ? newTime : (newTime ? dayjs(newTime) : null);
      if (d && d.isValid()) {
        const timeStr = d.format('HH:mm');
        const hStr = d.format('HH');
        const mStr = d.format('mm');
        onChange({
          value: timeStr,
          hours: hStr,
          minutes: mStr,
          target: { name, value: timeStr },
        });
      } else {
        onChange({
          value: '',
          hours: '',
          minutes: '',
          target: { name, value: '' },
        });
      }
    },
    [name, onChange]
  );

  const handleClear = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      if (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
      if (onChange) {
        onChange({
          value: '',
          hours: '',
          minutes: '',
          target: { name, value: '' },
        });
      }
    },
    [name, onChange]
  );

  const HiddenField = useCallback(
    () => <div tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'none' }} />,
    []
  );

  return (
    <>
      {/* Visual Button Trigger (No TextField) */}
      {renderButton ? (
        <Box ref={anchorRef} sx={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}>
          {renderButton({
            value: dayjsValue,
            formatted: formattedTime,
            onClick: () => setOpen(true),
            onClear: handleClear,
            disabled,
          })}
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          ref={anchorRef}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          disabled={disabled}
          size={size}
          fullWidth={fullWidth}
          startIcon={startAdornment || <AccessTimeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          sx={{
            width: fullWidth ? '100%' : 'auto',
            display: 'inline-flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            textAlign: 'left',
            ...sx,
          }}
        >
          <Box component="span" sx={{ flexGrow: 1, mr: 1, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {formattedTime || placeholder || label}
          </Box>

          {allowClear && dayjsValue && !disabled ? (
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              component="span"
              onClick={handleClear}
              sx={{
                p: 0.25,
                ml: 'auto',
                bgcolor: 'transparent',
                color: 'text.secondary',
                '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'transparent', color: 'text.primary' },
              }}
              aria-label="Clear time selection"
            >
              <ClearIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          ) : (
            endAdornment
          )}
        </Button>
      )}

      {/* Official MUI X TimePicker */}
      <TimePicker
        open={open}
        onOpen={() => setOpen(true)}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        value={dayjsValue}
        onChange={handlePickerChange}
        onAccept={handlePickerChange}
        disabled={disabled}
        ampm={false}
        views={['hours', 'minutes']}
        viewRenderers={{
          hours: renderTimeViewClock,
          minutes: renderTimeViewClock,
        }}
        slots={{
          field: HiddenField,
        }}
        slotProps={{
          popper: {
            anchorEl: () => anchorRef.current,
          },
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
};

MuiTimePicker.propTypes = {
  value: PropTypes.oneOfType([
    PropTypes.string,
    PropTypes.instanceOf(Date),
    PropTypes.object,
  ]),
  onChange: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
  name: PropTypes.string,
  label: PropTypes.string,
  placeholder: PropTypes.string,
  disabled: PropTypes.bool,
  fullWidth: PropTypes.bool,
  renderButton: PropTypes.func,
  startAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  endAdornment: PropTypes.node,
  allowClear: PropTypes.bool,
  size: PropTypes.oneOf(['small', 'medium']),
  sx: PropTypes.object,
};

export default MuiTimePicker;
````

````jsx
/**
 * @module components/search/GlobalSearchModal
 * @description Decoupled Command-Palette Global Search modal mounted from MuiAppbar.
 * Implements Invariant 43 (Zero-Lag Uncontrolled & Explicit-Trigger Law) and Invariant 45.
 * Strictly zero debounces and zero react-hook-form watch.
 */

import { useState, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogContent from '@mui/material/DialogContent';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemIcon from '@mui/material/ListItemIcon';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import StorefrontIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Storefront';
import DescriptionIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Description';
import ChatBubbleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChatBubbleOutlined';
import ArrowForwardIosIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForwardIos';
import SearchOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SearchOff';
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';

import MuiSearchInput from '../reusable/MuiSearchInput.jsx';
import { useGetChatsQuery } from '../../redux/features/chatSlice.js';
import { apiSlice } from '../../redux/app/apiSlice.js';

// Lazy injected endpoints for branches and reports to avoid circular dependencies
const searchApi = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    searchBranches: builder.query({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: '/branches',
        params,
      }),
      providesTags: ['Branch'],
    }),
    searchReports: builder.query({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: '/reports',
        params,
      }),
      providesTags: ['Report'],
    }),
  }),
  overrideExisting: false,
});

const { useSearchBranchesQuery, useSearchReportsQuery } = searchApi;

/**
 * Command-palette style global search modal.
 * Completely decoupled from AppShell render tree.
 *
 * @component GlobalSearchModal
 * @param {object} props - Component properties.
 * @param {boolean} props.open - Modal visibility boolean.
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Modal dismissal callback.
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Rendered command-palette dialog.
 */
export const GlobalSearchModal = memo(({ open, onClose }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [activeQuery, setActiveQuery] = useState('');

  // Fetch categorized records based on explicit query
  const shouldQuery = Boolean(activeQuery && activeQuery.length >= 1);

  const { data: branchesData, isFetching: isBranchesFetching } = useSearchBranchesQuery(
    { search: activeQuery, limit: 5 },
    { skip: !shouldQuery || !open }
  );

  const { data: reportsData, isFetching: isReportsFetching } = useSearchReportsQuery(
    { search: activeQuery, limit: 5 },
    { skip: !shouldQuery || !open }
  );

  const { data: chatsData, isFetching: isChatsFetching } = useGetChatsQuery(
    { search: activeQuery, limit: 5 },
    { skip: !shouldQuery || !open }
  );

  const handleSearch = useCallback((query) => {
    setActiveQuery(query.trim());
  }, []);

  const handleSelectBranch = useCallback(
    (branchId) => () => {
      onClose();
      navigate(`/branches/${branchId}/details`);
    },
    [navigate, onClose]
  );

  const handleSelectReport = useCallback(
    (reportId) => () => {
      onClose();
      navigate(`/reports/${reportId}/details`);
    },
    [navigate, onClose]
  );

  const handleSelectChat = useCallback(
    (chatId) => () => {
      onClose();
      navigate(`/chat/${chatId}`);
    },
    [navigate, onClose]
  );

  const branches = branchesData?.branches || branchesData?.data?.branches || [];
  const reports = reportsData?.reports || reportsData?.docs || reportsData?.data?.reports || reportsData?.data?.docs || [];
  const chats = chatsData?.chats || chatsData?.data?.chats || [];

  const isSearching = isBranchesFetching || isReportsFetching || isChatsFetching;
  const hasResults = branches.length > 0 || reports.length > 0 || chats.length > 0;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      disableEnforceFocus={true}
      disableRestoreFocus={true}
      maxWidth="sm"
      fullWidth
      slotProps={{
        paper: {
          sx: {
            borderRadius: '12px',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            bgcolor: 'background.paper',
            backgroundImage: 'none',
            border: 1,
            borderColor: 'divider',
            maxHeight: '80vh',
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent sx={{ p: 2 }}>
        {/* Isolated Zero-Lag Search Input */}
        <MuiSearchInput
          autoFocus
          placeholder="Search branches, reports, chats... (Press Enter)"
          initialValue={activeQuery}
          onSearch={handleSearch}
          fullWidth
          sx={{ mb: 2 }}
        />

        {/* Results Container */}
        {isSearching && (
          <Box sx={{ py: 4, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
            <CircularProgress size={28} thickness={4} />
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
              Searching branches, reports, and chats...
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}

        {!isSearching && shouldQuery && !hasResults && (
          <Box sx={{ py: 4, textAlign: 'center', px: 2 }}>
            <SearchOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: 'text.disabled', mb: 1 }} />
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary', mb: 0.5 }}>
              No matches found for &quot;{activeQuery}&quot;
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', maxWidth: 360, display: 'block', mx: 'auto' }}>
              Try searching with English or Amharic (e.g. Bole, መድኃኒዓለም, Sarbet), branch codes (e.g. BOLE-01), or operational keywords.
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}

        {!isSearching && !shouldQuery && (
          <Box sx={{ py: 3, textAlign: 'center', px: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', display: 'block' }}>
              Type an operational branch name, report date, or keyword and press <strong>Enter</strong> or click <strong>[🔍]</strong>
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'text.disabled', display: 'block', mt: 0.5 }}>
              Supports English and Amharic queries (e.g. Bole, መድኃኒዓለም)
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}

        {!isSearching && hasResults && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            {/* Branch Network Matches */}
            {branches.length > 0 && (
              <Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: '0.05em',
                    px: 1,
                    display: 'block',
                    mb: 0.5,
                  }}
                >
                  Branch Network ({branches.length})
                </Typography>
                <List disablePadding>
                  {branches.map((b) => (
                    <ListItemButton
                      key={b._id}
                      onClick={handleSelectBranch(b._id)}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: '8px', py: 1, mb: 0.5 }}
                    >
                      <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 36, color: 'primary.main' }}>
                        <StorefrontIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </ListItemIcon>
                      <ListItemText
                        primary={
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                              {b.name}
                            </Typography>
                            <Chip label={b.code} size="small" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: '0.7rem' }} />
                          </Box>
                        }
                        secondary={b.location?.subcity || b.managerName || 'Addis Ababa'}
                      />
                      <ArrowForwardIosIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'text.disabled' }} />
                    </ListItemButton>
                  ))}
                </List>
              </Box>
            )}

            {branches.length > 0 && (reports.length > 0 || chats.length > 0) && <Divider />}

            {/* Operational Reports Matches */}
            {reports.length > 0 && (
              <Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: '0.05em',
                    px: 1,
                    display: 'block',
                    mb: 0.5,
                  }}
                >
                  Operational Reports ({reports.length})
                </Typography>
                <List disablePadding>
                  {reports.map((r) => (
                    <ListItemButton
                      key={r._id}
                      onClick={handleSelectReport(r._id)}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: '8px', py: 1, mb: 0.5 }}
                    >
                      <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 36, color: 'success.main' }}>
                        <DescriptionIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </ListItemIcon>
                      <ListItemText
                        primary={
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {r.date ? new Date(r.date).toLocaleDateString() : 'Operational Audit'}
                            {r.ethiopianDate ? ` (${r.ethiopianDate})` : ''}
                          </Typography>
                        }
                        secondary={`${r.visits?.length || 0} branches visited • ${r.activities?.length || 0} activities`}
                      />
                      <ArrowForwardIosIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'text.disabled' }} />
                    </ListItemButton>
                  ))}
                </List>
              </Box>
            )}

            {reports.length > 0 && chats.length > 0 && <Divider />}

            {/* Chat History Matches */}
            {chats.length > 0 && (
              <Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    color: 'text.secondary',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: '0.05em',
                    px: 1,
                    display: 'block',
                    mb: 0.5,
                  }}
                >
                  Chat Conversations ({chats.length})
                </Typography>
                <List disablePadding>
                  {chats.map((c) => (
                    <ListItemButton
                      key={c._id}
                      onClick={handleSelectChat(c._id)}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: '8px', py: 1, mb: 0.5 }}
                    >
                      <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 36, color: 'info.main' }}>
                        <ChatBubbleOutlineIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </ListItemIcon>
                      <ListItemText
                        primary={
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {c.title || 'Untitled Inspection'}
                          </Typography>
                        }
                        secondary={c.updatedAt ? new Date(c.updatedAt).toLocaleString() : ''}
                      />
                      <ArrowForwardIosIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'text.disabled' }} />
                    </ListItemButton>
                  ))}
                </List>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
});

GlobalSearchModal.propTypes = {
  open: PropTypes.bool.isRequired,
  onClose: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
};

export default GlobalSearchModal;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module hooks/useAddisLiveStt
 * @description Decoupled, reusable React hook for real-time live Speech-to-Text (STT) powered by Addis AI Scribe.
 * Captures microphone audio via modern W3C AudioWorklet, resamples/converts to 16 kHz Mono Signed 16-bit PCM (PCM16 Little Endian),
 * and streams frames over a secure WebSocket using single-use session tickets.
 *
 * Agnostic of chat, reports, or domain models - usable in composer, search modals, forms, and notes.
 * Completely free of deprecated ScriptProcessorNode interfaces.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useCreateScribeSessionMutation } from '../redux/features/sttSlice.js';

/**
 * AudioWorkletProcessor inline source code.
 * Runs on a dedicated background audio rendering thread.
 * Buffers 4096 samples (~85ms at 48kHz) and transfers to main thread for PCM16 encoding.
 * Computes RMS audio level for real-time acoustic visualizer bars.
 */
const WORKLET_PROCESSOR_CODE = `
class PcmCaptureProcessor extends AudioWorkletProcessor {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.bufferSize = 4096;
    this.buffer = new Float32Array(this.bufferSize);
    this.index = 0;
  }

  process(inputs) {
    const input = inputs[0];
    if (input && input.length > 0 && input[0]) {
      const channel = input[0];
      const len = channel.length;
      let sumSquares = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        const sample = channel[i];
        sumSquares += sample * sample;
        this.buffer[this.index++] = sample;

        if (this.index >= this.bufferSize) {
          const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSquares / len);
          this.port.postMessage({
            buffer: this.buffer.slice(0, this.bufferSize),
            rms: rms,
          });
          this.index = 0;
          sumSquares = 0;
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}
registerProcessor('pcm-capture-processor', PcmCaptureProcessor);
`;

/**
 * Resamples Float32 audio buffer and converts to Int16 PCM Little-Endian ArrayBuffer.
 *
 * @param {Float32Array} float32Array - Raw browser audio samples in [-1.0, 1.0].
 * @param {number} inputSampleRate - AudioContext input sample rate (e.g. 44100 or 48000).
 * @param {number} [targetSampleRate=16000] - Scribe expected sample rate (16000).
 * @returns {ArrayBuffer} Raw PCM16 little-endian byte buffer.
 */
function float32ToPcm16(float32Array, inputSampleRate, targetSampleRate = 16000) {
  let resampled = float32Array;
  if (inputSampleRate !== targetSampleRate) {
    const ratio = inputSampleRate / targetSampleRate;
    const newLength = Math.round(float32Array.length / ratio);
    resampled = new Float32Array(newLength);
    for (let i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {
      const idx = Math.floor(i * ratio);
      resampled[i] = float32Array[idx] || 0;
    }
  }

  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(resampled.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(buffer);
  for (let i = 0; i < resampled.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, resampled[i]));
    view.setInt16(i * 2, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
  }
  return buffer;
}

/**
 * Formats duration in seconds to MM:SS string.
 *
 * @param {number} totalSeconds
 * @returns {string} Formatted time string.
 */
function formatDuration(totalSeconds) {
  const mins = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
  const secs = totalSeconds % 60;
  return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Custom hook for Addis AI Scribe live speech recognition.
 *
 * @param {object} [options={}]
 * @param {Function} [options.onTranscript] - Callback ({ partial, final, text, isFinal }) => void.
 * @param {Function} [options.onError] - Error callback (err) => void.
 * @param {string} [options.language='am'] - Audio language ('am' for Amharic).
 * @returns {object} Controller API.
 */
export function useAddisLiveStt({ onTranscript, onError, language = 'am' } = {}) {
  const [isListening, setIsListening] = useState(false);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioLevel, setAudioLevel] = useState(0);

  const [createScribeSession] = useCreateScribeSessionMutation();

  const socketRef = useRef(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);
  const processorRef = useRef(null);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const isListeningRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    isListeningRef.current = isListening;
  }, [isListening]);

  const teardownAudio = useCallback(() => {
    isListeningRef.current = false;
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (processorRef.current) {
      try {
        if (processorRef.current.port) {
          processorRef.current.port.onmessage = null;
        }
        processorRef.current.disconnect();
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      processorRef.current = null;
    }

    if (streamRef.current) {
      try {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      streamRef.current = null;
    }

    if (audioContextRef.current) {
      try {
        audioContextRef.current.close();
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      audioContextRef.current = null;
    }

    if (socketRef.current) {
      try {
        if (socketRef.current.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
          socketRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'session.end' }));
          socketRef.current.close(1000, 'Client stopped listening');
        } else if (socketRef.current.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING) {
          socketRef.current.close();
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      socketRef.current = null;
    }

    setIsListening(false);
    setIsConnecting(false);
    setDuration(0);
    setAudioLevel(0);
  }, []);

  const stopListening = useCallback(() => {
    teardownAudio();
  }, [teardownAudio]);

  const cancelListening = useCallback(() => {
    teardownAudio();
  }, [teardownAudio]);

  const startListening = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isListeningRef.current) return;

    setError(null);
    setIsConnecting(true);

    try {
      // 1. Check browser media support & request microphone stream
      if (!navigator?.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error('Microphone audio capture is not supported in this browser.');
      }

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: {
          channelCount: 1,
          echoCancellation: true,
          noiseSuppression: true,
          autoGainControl: true,
        },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;

      // 2. Request single-use Scribe session ticket from backend
      const sessionRes = await createScribeSession({ language: language || 'am' }).unwrap();
      const sessionData = sessionRes?.data || sessionRes;

      const ticket = sessionData?.ticket || sessionData?.token;
      const websocketUrl = sessionData?.websocketUrl || sessionData?.websocket_url;

      if (!ticket || !websocketUrl) {
        throw new Error('Invalid Scribe session data received from server.');
      }

      // 3. Connect to live Addis AI WebSocket
      const socket = new WebSocket(websocketUrl);
      socketRef.current = socket;
      socket.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';

      socket.onopen = async () => {
        // Authenticate as the very first frame
        socket.send(
          JSON.stringify({
            type: 'session.authenticate',
            token: ticket,
            ticket: ticket,
          })
        );

        setIsConnecting(false);
        setIsListening(true);

        // Start duration counter
        const startTime = Date.now();
        timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
          setDuration(Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000));
        }, 500);

        // 4. Initialize Web Audio API pipeline with modern AudioWorkletNode
        try {
          const AudioContextClass =
            window.AudioContext ||
            (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window['webkitAudioContext'] : null);
          if (!AudioContextClass) {
            throw new Error('Web Audio API is not supported in this browser.');
          }

          const audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
          audioContextRef.current = audioCtx;

          if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
            await audioCtx.resume();
          }

          const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);

          if (audioCtx.audioWorklet) {
            const blob = new Blob([WORKLET_PROCESSOR_CODE], {
              type: 'application/javascript',
            });
            const workletUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            try {
              await audioCtx.audioWorklet.addModule(workletUrl);
            } finally {
              URL.revokeObjectURL(workletUrl);
            }

            const workletNode = new AudioWorkletNode(audioCtx, 'pcm-capture-processor', {
              numberOfInputs: 1,
              numberOfOutputs: 1,
              outputChannelCount: [1],
            });
            processorRef.current = workletNode;

            workletNode.port.onmessage = (e) => {
              if (socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;
              const { buffer, rms } = e.data || {};
              if (rms !== undefined) {
                setAudioLevel(Math.min(1, rms * 5));
              }
              if (buffer) {
                const pcmBuffer = float32ToPcm16(buffer, audioCtx.sampleRate, 16000);
                socket.send(pcmBuffer);
              }
            };

            const muteGain = audioCtx.createGain();
            muteGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime);

            source.connect(workletNode);
            workletNode.connect(muteGain);
            muteGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
          } else {
            // Defensive legacy fallback only if audioWorklet is unavailable
            const scriptProc = audioCtx['createScriptProcessor']?.(4096, 1, 1);
            if (scriptProc) {
              processorRef.current = scriptProc;
              scriptProc['onaudioprocess'] = (e) => {
                if (socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;
                const inputChannel = e['inputBuffer']?.getChannelData(0);
                if (inputChannel) {
                  const pcmBuffer = float32ToPcm16(inputChannel, audioCtx.sampleRate, 16000);
                  socket.send(pcmBuffer);
                }
              };
              source.connect(scriptProc);
              scriptProc.connect(audioCtx.destination);
            }
          }
        } catch (audioErr) {
          console.error('[useAddisLiveStt] AudioContext pipeline failure:', audioErr);
          teardownAudio();
          setError(audioErr.message);
          onError?.(audioErr);
        }
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const msg = typeof event.data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(event.data) : null;
          if (!msg) return;

          // Event type 1: Partial transcript frame
          if (
            msg.type === 'transcript.partial' ||
            msg.type === 'transcript.partial_text' ||
            msg.partial ||
            msg.is_final === false
          ) {
            const partialText =
              msg.text || msg.transcript || msg.partial || msg.partial_text || '';
            if (partialText) {
              onTranscript?.({
                partial: partialText,
                final: '',
                text: partialText,
                isFinal: false,
              });
            }
          }
          // Event type 2: Completed/final transcript frame
          else if (
            msg.type === 'transcript.completed' ||
            msg.type === 'transcript.final' ||
            msg.is_final === true ||
            msg.final
          ) {
            const finalText = msg.text || msg.transcript || msg.final || '';
            if (finalText) {
              onTranscript?.({
                partial: '',
                final: finalText,
                text: finalText,
                isFinal: true,
              });
            }
          }
          // Event type 3: Generic text message
          else if (msg.text) {
            onTranscript?.({
              partial: '',
              final: msg.text,
              text: msg.text,
              isFinal: true,
            });
          }
        } catch (parseErr) {
          console.warn('[useAddisLiveStt] Failed to parse WebSocket frame:', parseErr);
        }
      };

      socket.onerror = () => {
        const errMsg = 'Addis AI Scribe WebSocket error encountered.';
        setError(errMsg);
        onError?.(new Error(errMsg));
        teardownAudio();
      };

      socket.onclose = () => {
        teardownAudio();
      };
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Could not start live speech recognition.';
      setError(msg);
      onError?.(err);
      teardownAudio();
    }
  }, [createScribeSession, language, onError, onTranscript, teardownAudio]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      teardownAudio();
    };
  }, [teardownAudio]);

  return {
    isListening,
    isConnecting,
    error,
    duration,
    formattedDuration: formatDuration(duration),
    audioLevel,
    startListening,
    stopListening,
    cancelListening,
  };
}

export default useAddisLiveStt;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module hooks/useAddisTts
 * @description Reusable React hook for Addis AI native text-to-speech synthesis and playback.
 * Connects the UI to the backend synthesis proxy and the singleton HTML5 audio player.
 * Features in-memory caching to prevent redundant API calls on repeated clicks.
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useId } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { addisAudioPlayer } from '../utils/addisAudioPlayer.js';
import { useSynthesizeSpeechMutation } from '../redux/features/chatSlice.js';

/**
 * Shared in-memory cache for synthesized speech clips.
 * Keyed by text hash/prefix + voice + language.
 */
const audioClipCache = new Map();

/**
 * Computes a lightweight cache key for speech requests.
 *
 * @param {string} text - Speech text.
 * @param {string} [voiceId] - Voice identifier.
 * @param {string} [language] - Language identifier.
 * @returns {string} Cache key.
 */
const getSpeechCacheKey = (text, voiceId = 'default', language = 'auto') => {
  const normalizedText = String(text || '').trim();
  return `${voiceId}:${language}:${normalizedText.length}:${normalizedText.slice(0, 64)}`;
};

/**
 * Hook managing speech generation, single-stream playback, and loading states.
 *
 * @param {object} options - Hook options.
 * @param {string} options.text - Text content to read out loud.
 * @param {string} [options.messageId] - Unique message or turn identifier.
 * @param {string} [options.voiceId] - Custom voice override.
 * @param {string} [options.language] - Custom language override ('am', 'en', 'auto').
 * @param {number} [options.speed=1.0] - Playback speed multiplier.
 * @returns {object} { isPlaying, isLoading, error, togglePlay, stop }
 */
export const useAddisTts = ({
  text,
  messageId,
  voiceId,
  language = 'auto',
  speed = 1.0,
}) => {
  const fallbackId = useId();
  const effectiveId = messageId || fallbackId;

  const [synthesizeSpeech] = useSynthesizeSpeechMutation();
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(() => addisAudioPlayer.isKeyPlaying(effectiveId));
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Synchronize playback state with the singleton audio player
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = addisAudioPlayer.subscribe((event) => {
      if (event.key === effectiveId) {
        if (event.type === 'play') {
          setIsPlaying(true);
        } else if (event.type === 'pause' || event.type === 'stop' || event.type === 'ended' || event.type === 'error') {
          setIsPlaying(false);
        }
      } else {
        // If another audio begins playing, this one is no longer active
        setIsPlaying(false);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [effectiveId]);

  // Clean stop action
  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (addisAudioPlayer.isKeyPlaying(effectiveId)) {
      addisAudioPlayer.stop();
    }
    setIsPlaying(false);
    setIsLoading(false);
  }, [effectiveId]);

  // Toggle play / stop
  const togglePlay = useCallback(async () => {
    // If currently playing, stop immediately
    if (isPlaying) {
      stop();
      return;
    }

    if (!text || !text.trim()) {
      toast.info('No readable text to speak.');
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    const cacheKey = getSpeechCacheKey(text, voiceId, language);
    const cached = audioClipCache.get(cacheKey);

    // 1. Play from in-memory cache if previously generated
    if (cached?.audioUrl || cached?.audio) {
      try {
        const audioSrc = cached.audioUrl || cached.audio;
        await addisAudioPlayer.play(effectiveId, audioSrc, { speed });
        return;
      } catch {
        // If cached URL expired or failed, proceed to re-generate
        audioClipCache.delete(cacheKey);
      }
    }

    // 2. Synthesize audio via backend proxy
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await synthesizeSpeech({
        text,
        voiceId: voiceId || undefined,
        language: language || undefined,
      }).unwrap();

      const data = response?.data || response;
      const audioSrc = data?.audioUrl || data?.audio;

      if (!audioSrc) {
        throw new Error('No audio stream returned from Addis AI.');
      }

      // Store in memory cache
      audioClipCache.set(cacheKey, {
        audioUrl: data.audioUrl,
        audio: data.audio,
        durationSeconds: data.durationSeconds,
      });

      // Begin playback through singleton
      await addisAudioPlayer.play(effectiveId, audioSrc, { speed });
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg =
        err?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to synthesize speech via Addis AI.';
      setError(errorMsg);
      toast.error(errorMsg);
      setIsPlaying(false);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isPlaying, text, voiceId, language, effectiveId, speed, stop, synthesizeSpeech]);

  return {
    isPlaying,
    isLoading,
    error,
    togglePlay,
    stop,
  };
};

export default useAddisTts;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module hooks/useAudioRecorder
 * @description Custom React hook managing the browser MediaRecorder lifecycle,
 * Web Audio API AnalyserNode frequency analysis, recording duration timer (10m cap),
 * and in-memory Blob caching for zero-loss transcription retries.
 */

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { AUDIO_CONSTANTS } from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Formats a duration in seconds into 'mm:ss' display format.
 *
 * @function formatDuration
 * @param {number} seconds - Total elapsed seconds.
 * @returns {string} Formatted duration string (e.g., '00:14').
 */
export const formatDuration = (seconds) => {
  if (!seconds || seconds <= 0) return '00:00';
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
  return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

/**
 * Selects the optimal supported audio MIME type for the client browser.
 *
 * @function getSupportedAudioMimeType
 * @returns {string} Supported MIME type string or empty string for browser default.
 */
export const getSupportedAudioMimeType = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
    return 'audio/webm';
  }

  const preferredCandidates = [
    'audio/webm;codecs=opus',
    'audio/webm',
    'audio/ogg;codecs=opus',
    'audio/mp4',
  ];

  for (const candidate of preferredCandidates) {
    if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(candidate)) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }

  return '';
};

/**
 * Custom React hook for live audio dictation recording.
 *
 * @function useAudioRecorder
 * @param {object} [options={}] - Hook options.
 * @param {number} [options.maxDurationSeconds=AUDIO_CONSTANTS.MAX_DURATION_SECONDS] - Maximum recording duration.
 * @param {number} [options.fftSize=64] - AnalyserNode FFT size for waveform frequency data.
 * @returns {{
 *   isRecording: boolean,
 *   isPaused: boolean,
 *   duration: number,
 *   formattedDuration: string,
 *   audioBlob: Blob|null,
 *   cachedAudioBlob: Blob|null,
 *   audioUrl: string|null,
 *   audioLevel: number,
 *   error: string|null,
 *   startRecording: () => Promise<boolean>,
 *   stopRecording: () => Promise<Blob|null>,
 *   pauseRecording: () => void,
 *   resumeRecording: () => void,
 *   cancelRecording: () => void,
 *   resetRecorder: () => void,
 *   clearCachedBlob: () => void,
 *   getFrequencyData: () => Uint8Array,
 * }} Audio recording state and controls.
 */
export const useAudioRecorder = (options = {}) => {
  const maxDurationSeconds =
    options.maxDurationSeconds || AUDIO_CONSTANTS.MAX_DURATION_SECONDS || 600;
  const fftSize = options.fftSize || 64;

  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  const [audioBlob, setAudioBlob] = useState(null);
  const [cachedAudioBlob, setCachedAudioBlob] = useState(null);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState(null);
  const [audioLevel, setAudioLevel] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Core audio references
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef(null);
  const mediaStreamRef = useRef(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef(null);
  const sourceNodeRef = useRef(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef([]);
  const timerIntervalRef = useRef(null);
  const animFrameRef = useRef(null);
  const isCancelledRef = useRef(false);
  const resolveStopPromiseRef = useRef(null);

  /**
   * Safely stops and cleans up audio hardware stream tracks.
   */
  const cleanupMediaTracks = useCallback(() => {
    if (mediaStreamRef.current) {
      mediaStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => {
        try {
          track.stop();
        } catch {
          // Ignore track termination errors
        }
      });
      mediaStreamRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  /**
   * Safely cleans up Web Audio API nodes and context.
   */
  const cleanupAudioContext = useCallback(() => {
    if (animFrameRef.current) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
      animFrameRef.current = null;
    }

    if (sourceNodeRef.current) {
      try {
        sourceNodeRef.current.disconnect();
      } catch {
        // Node already disconnected
      }
      sourceNodeRef.current = null;
    }

    if (analyserRef.current) {
      try {
        analyserRef.current.disconnect();
      } catch {
        // Node already disconnected
      }
      analyserRef.current = null;
    }

    if (audioContextRef.current) {
      try {
        if (audioContextRef.current.state !== 'closed') {
          audioContextRef.current.close();
        }
      } catch {
        // Context already closed
      }
      audioContextRef.current = null;
    }

    setAudioLevel(0);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Clears active duration tracking timer.
   */
  const clearTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerIntervalRef.current);
      timerIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  /**
   * Cancels active recording without producing a Blob.
   */
  const cancelRecording = useCallback(() => {
    isCancelledRef.current = true;
    clearTimer();
    cleanupAudioContext();

    if (
      mediaRecorderRef.current &&
      mediaRecorderRef.current.state !== 'inactive'
    ) {
      try {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      } catch {
        // Ignore recorder stop error
      }
    }

    cleanupMediaTracks();
    chunksRef.current = [];
    setIsRecording(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setDuration(0);
    setError(null);

    if (resolveStopPromiseRef.current) {
      resolveStopPromiseRef.current(null);
      resolveStopPromiseRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [clearTimer, cleanupAudioContext, cleanupMediaTracks]);

  /**
   * Stops recording and resolves with completed audio Blob.
   */
  const stopRecording = useCallback(() => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      isCancelledRef.current = false;
      clearTimer();
      cleanupAudioContext();

      if (
        !mediaRecorderRef.current ||
        mediaRecorderRef.current.state === 'inactive'
      ) {
        setIsRecording(false);
        setIsPaused(false);
        cleanupMediaTracks();
        resolve(cachedAudioBlob || audioBlob || null);
        return;
      }

      resolveStopPromiseRef.current = resolve;

      try {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      } catch {
        cleanupMediaTracks();
        setIsRecording(false);
        setIsPaused(false);
        resolve(null);
      }
    });
  }, [clearTimer, cleanupAudioContext, cleanupMediaTracks, cachedAudioBlob, audioBlob]);

  /**
   * Begins microphone stream acquisition and starts audio recording.
   */
  const startRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      const err = 'Audio recording is not supported in this browser environment.';
      setError(err);
      toast.error(err);
      return false;
    }

    // Reset previous recording states
    isCancelledRef.current = false;
    chunksRef.current = [];
    setError(null);
    setDuration(0);
    setAudioLevel(0);

    let stream;
    try {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: {
          echoCancellation: true,
          noiseSuppression: true,
          autoGainControl: true,
        },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      let friendlyError = 'Failed to access microphone. Please try again.';
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError' || err.name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
        friendlyError = 'Microphone permission required.';
      } else if (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
        friendlyError = 'No microphone found on this device.';
      }
      setError(friendlyError);
      toast.error(friendlyError);
      return false;
    }

    mediaStreamRef.current = stream;

    // 1. Initialize Web Audio API AnalyserNode for live visual waveform
    try {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        audioContextRef.current = audioCtx;

        const analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = fftSize;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        analyserRef.current = analyser;

        const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
        sourceNodeRef.current = source;
        source.connect(analyser);

        const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);

        const tickAudioLevel = () => {
          if (!analyserRef.current) return;
          analyserRef.current.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

          // Calculate average energy level (0.0 to 1.0)
          let sum = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i += 1) {
            sum += dataArray[i];
          }
          const avg = sum / (dataArray.length || 1);
          setAudioLevel(Math.min(1, avg / 128));

          animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tickAudioLevel);
        };

        animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tickAudioLevel);
      }
    } catch {
      // AnalyserNode is optional: voice recording continues even if AudioContext fails
    }

    // 2. Instantiate MediaRecorder with optimal MIME format
    const mimeType = getSupportedAudioMimeType();
    let recorder;
    try {
      recorder = mimeType ? new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType }) : new MediaRecorder(stream);
    } catch {
      // Fallback without mimeType option
      try {
        recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      } catch {
        cleanupMediaTracks();
        cleanupAudioContext();
        const err = 'Failed to initialize audio recorder.';
        setError(err);
        toast.error(err);
        return false;
      }
    }

    mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;

    recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
      if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
        chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
      }
    };

    recorder.onstop = () => {
      cleanupMediaTracks();
      cleanupAudioContext();
      setIsRecording(false);
      setIsPaused(false);

      if (isCancelledRef.current) {
        chunksRef.current = [];
        if (resolveStopPromiseRef.current) {
          resolveStopPromiseRef.current(null);
          resolveStopPromiseRef.current = null;
        }
        return;
      }

      const resolvedType = recorder.mimeType || mimeType || 'audio/webm';
      const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: resolvedType });
      chunksRef.current = [];

      // Retain in-memory cache for zero-loss retry
      setAudioBlob(blob);
      setCachedAudioBlob(blob);

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.URL) {
        if (audioUrl) {
          window.URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
        }
        const newUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setAudioUrl(newUrl);
      }

      if (resolveStopPromiseRef.current) {
        resolveStopPromiseRef.current(blob);
        resolveStopPromiseRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    recorder.start(250); // Collect slice every 250ms
    setIsRecording(true);
    setIsPaused(false);

    // 3. Start recording duration timer with 10-minute cap
    timerIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setDuration((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        if (next >= maxDurationSeconds) {
          toast.info(`Maximum recording limit of ${Math.round(maxDurationSeconds / 60)} minutes reached.`);
          stopRecording();
          return maxDurationSeconds;
        }
        return next;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return true;
  }, [
    fftSize,
    maxDurationSeconds,
    audioUrl,
    cleanupMediaTracks,
    cleanupAudioContext,
    stopRecording,
  ]);

  /**
   * Pauses active audio recording.
   */
  const pauseRecording = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      mediaRecorderRef.current &&
      mediaRecorderRef.current.state === 'recording'
    ) {
      try {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.pause();
        clearTimer();
        setIsPaused(true);
      } catch {
        // Ignore pause errors
      }
    }
  }, [clearTimer]);

  /**
   * Resumes paused audio recording.
   */
  const resumeRecording = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      mediaRecorderRef.current &&
      mediaRecorderRef.current.state === 'paused'
    ) {
      try {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.resume();
        setIsPaused(false);

        timerIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
          setDuration((prev) => {
            const next = prev + 1;
            if (next >= maxDurationSeconds) {
              toast.info(`Maximum recording limit of ${Math.round(maxDurationSeconds / 60)} minutes reached.`);
              stopRecording();
              return maxDurationSeconds;
            }
            return next;
          });
        }, 1000);
      } catch {
        // Ignore resume errors
      }
    }
  }, [maxDurationSeconds, stopRecording]);

  /**
   * Resets all recorder states and revokes object URL.
   */
  const resetRecorder = useCallback(() => {
    cancelRecording();
    setAudioBlob(null);
    setCachedAudioBlob(null);
    if (audioUrl && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.URL) {
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
    }
    setAudioUrl(null);
  }, [cancelRecording, audioUrl]);

  /**
   * Clears only cached audio blobs.
   */
  const clearCachedBlob = useCallback(() => {
    setAudioBlob(null);
    setCachedAudioBlob(null);
    if (audioUrl && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.URL) {
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
    }
    setAudioUrl(null);
  }, [audioUrl]);

  /**
   * Returns byte frequency data array for visual bar rendering.
   */
  const getFrequencyData = useCallback(() => {
    if (!analyserRef.current) {
      return new Uint8Array(fftSize / 2);
    }
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyserRef.current.frequencyBinCount);
    analyserRef.current.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    return dataArray;
  }, [fftSize]);

  // Cleanup on hook unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      clearTimer();
      cleanupAudioContext();
      cleanupMediaTracks();
      if (audioUrl && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.URL) {
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [clearTimer, cleanupAudioContext, cleanupMediaTracks, audioUrl]);

  return {
    isRecording,
    isPaused,
    duration,
    formattedDuration: formatDuration(duration),
    audioBlob,
    cachedAudioBlob,
    audioUrl,
    audioLevel,
    error,
    startRecording,
    stopRecording,
    pauseRecording,
    resumeRecording,
    cancelRecording,
    resetRecorder,
    clearCachedBlob,
    getFrequencyData,
  };
};

export default useAudioRecorder;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module hooks/useLogout
 * @description Hook providing logout handler to terminate backend session and clear client state.
 */

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useLogoutMutation, logout } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import { ROUTES } from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Custom React hook providing a memoized supervisor logout action handler.
 * Dispatches server-side session revocation, clears client Redux state,
 * and navigates to the login screen.
 *
 * @function useLogout
 * @returns {() => Promise<void>} Asynchronous logout trigger handler.
 */
export const useLogout = () => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [logoutMutation] = useLogoutMutation();

  return useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await logoutMutation().unwrap();
    } catch {
      // Ignore network errors during logout
    } finally {
      dispatch(logout());
      navigate(ROUTES.LOGIN, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [dispatch, navigate, logoutMutation]);
};

export default useLogout;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module redux/app/apiSlice
 * @description Central RTK Query Base API with concurrency-safe silent token refresh on 401,
 * credentials inclusion, multipart upload safety, tag definitions including Dashboard,
 * and centralized response and error envelope normalization.
 */

import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

/**
 * Normalizes API query and mutation responses and error envelopes so consumer
 * slices and components receive clean data without redundant nesting (e.g., data.data.<...>).
 * Also maps technical errors to empathetic, user-friendly messages.
 *
 * @function normalizeResult
 * @param {import('@reduxjs/toolkit/query').QueryReturnValue} result - Raw RTK Query return object.
 * @returns {import('@reduxjs/toolkit/query').QueryReturnValue} Normalized query return object.
 */
export const normalizeResult = (result) => {
  if (!result) return result;

  // 1. Normalize Successful Responses
  if (result.data !== undefined && result.data !== null && typeof result.data === 'object') {
    // If backend wrapped payload in standard { success, message, data } envelope
    if ('data' in result.data && result.data.data !== undefined) {
      result.data = result.data.data;
    }
  }

  // 2. Normalize Error Envelopes
  if (result.error) {
    const errorData = result.error.data;
    let message = 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.';
    let errors = null;

    if (result.error.status === 'FETCH_ERROR') {
      message = 'Unable to connect to the server. Please check your internet connection.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 401) {
      message = 'Please log in again to continue.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 403) {
      message = 'You do not have permission to access this resource.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 404) {
      message = 'The requested resource was not found.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 409) {
      message = 'A resource with this information already exists.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 422) {
      message = 'Please check the entered information and correct any validation issues.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 429) {
      message = 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.';
    } else if (result.error.status === 500) {
      message = 'A server error occurred. Our team has been notified. Please try again later.';
    }

    if (typeof errorData === 'string') {
      message = errorData;
    } else if (errorData && typeof errorData === 'object') {
      if (errorData.message) {
        message = errorData.message;
      }
      if (errorData.errors || errorData.details) {
        errors = errorData.errors || errorData.details;
      }
    }

    // Attach normalized properties directly to error
    result.error = {
      ...result.error,
      message,
      errors,
      data: {
        ...(typeof errorData === 'object' && errorData !== null ? errorData : {}),
        message,
        errors,
      },
    };
  }

  return result;
};

/**
 * Base HTTP fetch query configuration with credentials inclusion and JSON headers.
 * Safely preserves multipart form boundaries for audio and image uploads.
 * @constant
 */
const baseQuery = fetchBaseQuery({
  baseUrl: (import.meta.env && import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL) || 'http://localhost:4000/api/v1',
  credentials: 'include',
  prepareHeaders: (headers) => {
    // Standard JSON acceptance header
    headers.set('Accept', 'application/json');
    // Note: Do NOT explicitly set 'Content-Type' here. fetchBaseQuery automatically sets
    // 'application/json' for objects and leaves it unset for FormData so the browser
    // injects the correct multipart/form-data boundary for audio and image uploads.
    return headers;
  },
});

import { refreshSession } from './authClient.js';

/**
 * Custom base query wrapper intercepting 401 UNAUTHENTICATED errors to refresh session cookies.
 * Strictly attempts token refresh only for logged-in users with active session state.
 * Uses a shared singleton concurrency lock so parallel queries and chat adapters share a single refresh request.
 * Dispatches session logout when refresh token rotation fails.
 *
 * @function baseQueryWithReauth
 * @param {string|object} args - Query arguments or URL string.
 * @param {import('@reduxjs/toolkit/query').BaseQueryApi} api - Base query API context and dispatcher.
 * @param {object} extraOptions - Additional query execution options.
 * @returns {Promise<import('@reduxjs/toolkit/query').QueryReturnValue>} Query execution result.
 */
const baseQueryWithReauth = async (args, api, extraOptions) => {
  let result = await baseQuery(args, api, extraOptions);

  if (result.error && result.error.status === 401) {
    const url = typeof args === 'string' ? args : args.url;
    // Never attempt token refresh for public authentication endpoints
    if (
      url.includes('/auth/refresh') ||
      url.includes('/auth/login') ||
      url.includes('/auth/register')
    ) {
      return normalizeResult(result);
    }

    // Refresh token is strictly for currently logged-in users with active session state
    const state = api.getState();
    const isAuthenticated = state?.auth?.isAuthenticated;
    const user = state?.auth?.user;

    if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
      return normalizeResult(result);
    }

    // Delegate to shared singleton refresh mutex
    const refreshResult = await refreshSession({
      dispatch: api.dispatch,
      getState: api.getState,
    });

    if (refreshResult.ok) {
      // Re-run original query with refreshed session credentials
      result = await baseQuery(args, api, extraOptions);
    } else if (refreshResult.status === 401) {
      api.dispatch(apiSlice.util.resetApiState());
    }
  }

  return normalizeResult(result);
};

/**
 * Central RTK Query API slice definition.
 * Serves as the single root entry point for code-split injected feature endpoints.
 *
 * @constant
 * @type {import('@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react').Api}
 */
export const apiSlice = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'api',
  baseQuery: baseQueryWithReauth,
  tagTypes: ['User', 'Branch', 'Chat', 'Report', 'Dashboard'],
  endpoints: () => ({}),
});

export default apiSlice;
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module redux/app/authClient
 * @description Central singleton authentication client and re-authorization mutex.
 * Serializes all concurrent /auth/refresh operations across RTK Query (apiSlice),
 * MuiChatAdapter (streaming & pre-flight uploads), and external fetch engines.
 * Prevents refresh token rotation race conditions and false session invalidations.
 */

import { API_BASE_URL } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Global singleton promise representing an active in-flight /auth/refresh request.
 * Shared across all client modules to guarantee exactly one refresh request in flight.
 * @type {Promise<{ ok: boolean, user?: object, status?: number }> | null}
 */
let activeRefreshPromise = null;

/**
 * Triggers a centralized, mutex-protected token refresh request against /auth/refresh.
 * If a refresh is already in flight, joins the existing promise.
 *
 * @function refreshSession
 * @param {object} options
 * @param {Function} [options.dispatch] - Redux store dispatch function.
 * @param {Function} [options.getState] - Redux store getState function.
 * @param {string} [options.baseUrl] - Base API URL (defaults to API_BASE_URL).
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, user?: object, status?: number }>}
 */
export const refreshSession = async ({ dispatch, baseUrl = API_BASE_URL } = {}) => {
  // If an active refresh promise is already pending, join it immediately
  if (activeRefreshPromise) {
    return activeRefreshPromise;
  }

  activeRefreshPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/refresh`, {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Accept: 'application/json',
        },
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const user = data?.data?.user || data?.user;
        if (user && dispatch) {
          dispatch({ type: 'auth/setCredentials', payload: { user } });
        }
        return { ok: true, user, status: res.status };
      }

      // If refresh token was genuinely expired / invalid (401)
      if (res.status === 401) {
        if (dispatch) {
          dispatch({ type: 'auth/logout' });
        }
        return { ok: false, status: 401 };
      }

      return { ok: false, status: res.status };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ok: false, error: err, status: 0 };
    } finally {
      // Clear mutex on next tick so all microtasks spawned from this turn share the result
      Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        activeRefreshPromise = null;
      });
    }
  })();

  return activeRefreshPromise;
};

/**
 * Executes an arbitrary asynchronous fetch/request operation under automatic re-authentication protection.
 * If the operation yields a 401 UNAUTHENTICATED response, intercepts the failure,
 * acquires the singleton refresh mutex to rotate tokens, and retries the original request once.
 *
 * @function executeWithReauth
 * @param {Function} requestFn - Function returning a fetch Response or result with a `status` property.
 * @param {object} options - Options containing dispatch, getState, and optional baseUrl.
 * @returns {Promise<Response|object>} The final response after transparent re-auth if applicable.
 */
export const executeWithReauth = async (requestFn, { dispatch, getState, baseUrl = API_BASE_URL } = {}) => {
  let response = await requestFn();

  if (response && response.status === 401) {
    const refreshResult = await refreshSession({ dispatch, getState, baseUrl });
    if (refreshResult.ok) {
      // Re-run original request with freshly rotated session cookies
      response = await requestFn();
    }
  }

  return response;
};

export default {
  refreshSession,
  executeWithReauth,
};
````

````javascript
/**
 * @module redux/app/store
 * @description Central Redux Toolkit store configuration with redux-persist and RTK Query apiSlice.
 */

import { configureStore, combineReducers } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import {
  persistStore,
  persistReducer,
  FLUSH,
  REHYDRATE,
  PAUSE,
  PERSIST,
  PURGE,
  REGISTER,
} from 'redux-persist';

import authReducer from '../features/authSlice.js';
import chatReducer from '../features/chatSlice.js';
import { apiSlice } from './apiSlice.js';

/**
 * Standard asynchronous storage engine for redux-persist, directly interfacing
 * with window.localStorage to guarantee zero ESM/CommonJS bundler mismatch errors.
 *
 * @constant
 * @type {{ getItem: (key: string) => Promise<string|null>, setItem: (key: string, value: string) => Promise<void>, removeItem: (key: string) => Promise<void> }}
 */
const persistStorage = {
  getItem: (key) => {
    try {
      return Promise.resolve(
        typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage
          ? window.localStorage.getItem(key)
          : null
      );
    } catch (err) {
      return Promise.reject(err);
    }
  },
  setItem: (key, value) => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    } catch (err) {
      return Promise.reject(err);
    }
  },
  removeItem: (key) => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    } catch (err) {
      return Promise.reject(err);
    }
  },
};

/**
 * Persistence configuration for the authentication slice.
 * @constant
 * @type {import('redux-persist').PersistConfig}
 */
const authPersistConfig = {
  key: 'auth',
  storage: persistStorage,
  whitelist: ['user', 'isAuthenticated'],
};

/**
 * Root reducer combining persisted authentication state and RTK Query API slice reducer.
 * @constant
 * @type {import('@reduxjs/toolkit').Reducer}
 */
const rootReducer = combineReducers({
  auth: persistReducer(authPersistConfig, authReducer),
  chat: chatReducer,
  [apiSlice.reducerPath]: apiSlice.reducer,
});

/**
 * Configured central Redux Toolkit store with redux-persist serializable middleware checks.
 * @constant
 * @type {import('@reduxjs/toolkit').EnhancedStore}
 */
export const store = configureStore({
  reducer: rootReducer,
  middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) =>
    getDefaultMiddleware({
      serializableCheck: {
        ignoredActions: [FLUSH, REHYDRATE, PAUSE, PERSIST, PURGE, REGISTER],
      },
    }).concat(apiSlice.middleware),
  devTools: Boolean(typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env?.DEV),
});

/**
 * Redux persistor instance handling client session rehydration.
 * @constant
 * @type {import('redux-persist').Persistor}
 */
export const persistor = persistStore(store);

export default store;

````

````javascript
/**
 * @module redux/features/authSlice
 * @description Redux Toolkit slice and injected RTK Query endpoints managing
 * supervisor session authentication state and auth lifecycle operations.
 */

import { createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { apiSlice } from '../app/apiSlice.js';

/**
 * Initial authentication state.
 * @constant
 * @type {{ user: object|null, isAuthenticated: boolean, isLoading: boolean }}
 */
const initialState = {
  user: null,
  isAuthenticated: false,
  isLoading: false,
};

/**
 * Authentication slice managing user session state and profile updates.
 * @constant
 */
export const authSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'auth',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setCredentials: (state, action) => {
      const user = action.payload?.user || action.payload;
      state.user = user;
      state.isAuthenticated = Boolean(user);
      state.isLoading = false;
    },
    logout: (state) => {
      state.user = null;
      state.isAuthenticated = false;
      state.isLoading = false;
    },
    setLoading: (state, action) => {
      state.isLoading = action.payload;
    },
    updateUserProfile: (state, action) => {
      const updatedFields = action.payload?.user || action.payload;
      if (updatedFields) {
        state.user = state.user
          ? { ...state.user, ...updatedFields }
          : updatedFields;
      }
    },
  },
});

/**
 * Authentication synchronous action creators.
 */
export const {
  setCredentials,
  logout,
  setLoading,
  updateUserProfile,
} = authSlice.actions;

/**
 * Selects the authenticated user profile object from Redux state.
 *
 * @function selectCurrentUser
 * @param {object} state - Root Redux state tree.
 * @returns {object|null} Authenticated user profile or null.
 */
export const selectCurrentUser = (state) => state.auth.user;

/**
 * Selects the authenticated user profile object from Redux state (alias).
 *
 * @function selectAuthUser
 * @param {object} state - Root Redux state tree.
 * @returns {object|null} Authenticated user profile or null.
 */
export const selectAuthUser = (state) => state.auth.user;

/**
 * Selects the session authentication boolean flag from Redux state.
 *
 * @function selectIsAuthenticated
 * @param {object} state - Root Redux state tree.
 * @returns {boolean} True if supervisor is currently authenticated.
 */
export const selectIsAuthenticated = (state) => state.auth.isAuthenticated;

/**
 * Selects the session loading boolean flag from Redux state.
 *
 * @function selectAuthLoading
 * @param {object} state - Root Redux state tree.
 * @returns {boolean} True if initial session hydration is pending.
 */
export const selectAuthLoading = (state) => state.auth.isLoading;

/**
 * Selects the current categorical authentication status string.
 *
 * @function selectAuthStatus
 * @param {object} state - Root Redux state tree.
 * @returns {'LOADING'|'AUTHENTICATED'|'UNAUTHENTICATED'} Active session status.
 */
export const selectAuthStatus = (state) => {
  if (state.auth.isLoading) return 'LOADING';
  return state.auth.isAuthenticated ? 'AUTHENTICATED' : 'UNAUTHENTICATED';
};

/**
 * Authentication API endpoints injected into the core RTK Query slice.
 * @constant
 */
export const authApiSlice = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    register: builder.mutation({
      query: (credentials) => ({
        url: '/auth/register',
        method: 'POST',
        body: credentials,
      }),
    }),
    login: builder.mutation({
      query: (credentials) => ({
        url: '/auth/login',
        method: 'POST',
        body: credentials,
      }),
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          // Normalized by apiSlice: data.user is directly accessible
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(setCredentials({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          // Handled by caller UI
        }
      },
    }),
    logout: builder.mutation({
      query: () => ({
        url: '/auth/logout',
        method: 'POST',
      }),
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          await queryFulfilled;
        } finally {
          dispatch(logout());
          dispatch(apiSlice.util.resetApiState());
        }
      },
    }),
    refreshToken: builder.mutation({
      query: () => ({
        url: '/auth/refresh',
        method: 'POST',
      }),
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(setCredentials({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          dispatch(logout());
        }
      },
    }),
  }),
  overrideExisting: false,
});

/**
 * RTK Query mutation hooks for supervisor authentication lifecycle.
 */
export const {
  useRegisterMutation,
  useLoginMutation,
  useLogoutMutation,
  useRefreshTokenMutation,
} = authApiSlice;

export default authSlice.reducer;
````
