/**
 * @module redux/features/branchSlice
 * @description Injected RTK Query endpoints for physical store branch management, bilingual search,
 * branch report metrics aggregation, soft archival, restoration, and permanent cascade deletion.
 * Scoped strictly to authenticated supervisor under tag 'Branch'.
 */

import { apiSlice } from '../app/apiSlice.js';

/**
 * Branch management and analytics API endpoints injected into the core RTK Query slice.
 * @constant
 */
export const branchSlice = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    /**
     * Retrieve paginated list of operational branches with optional bilingual search and archival filter.
     */
    getBranches: builder.query({
      query: (params = {}) => {
        const { page = 1, limit = 10, search = '', archived, isArchived } = params;
        const isArchivedVal = archived !== undefined ? archived : isArchived;
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();

        if (page) searchParams.append('page', String(page));
        if (limit) searchParams.append('limit', String(limit));
        if (search && search.trim()) searchParams.append('search', search.trim());
        if (isArchivedVal !== undefined) searchParams.append('archived', String(isArchivedVal));

        const queryString = searchParams.toString();
        return `/branches${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`;
      },
      providesTags: (result) =>
        result?.branches
          ? [
              ...result.branches.map(({ _id }) => ({ type: 'Branch', id: _id })),
              { type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' },
            ]
          : [{ type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),

    /**
     * Retrieve details of a single branch by ObjectId or operational uppercase code.
     */
    getBranchById: builder.query({
      query: (branchId) => `/branches/${branchId}`,
      providesTags: (_result, _error, branchId) => [{ type: 'Branch', id: branchId }],
    }),

    /**
     * Retrieve analytics metrics and report aggregations for a single branch.
     */
    getBranchMetrics: builder.query({
      query: (branchId) => `/branches/${branchId}/metrics`,
      providesTags: (_result, _error, branchId) => [{ type: 'Branch', id: `${branchId}-metrics` }],
    }),

    /**
     * Create a new operational store branch location.
     */
    createBranch: builder.mutation({
      query: (branchData) => ({
        url: '/branches',
        method: 'POST',
        body: branchData,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: [{ type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' }, 'Dashboard'],
    }),

    /**
     * Update operational store branch attributes.
     */
    updateBranch: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ branchId, ...updates }) => ({
        url: `/branches/${branchId}`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: updates,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, { branchId }) => [
        { type: 'Branch', id: branchId },
        { type: 'Branch', id: `${branchId}-metrics` },
        { type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Soft-archive an active branch location.
     */
    archiveBranch: builder.mutation({
      query: (branchId) => ({
        url: `/branches/${branchId}/archive`,
        method: 'PATCH',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, branchId) => [
        { type: 'Branch', id: branchId },
        { type: 'Branch', id: `${branchId}-metrics` },
        { type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Restore a soft-archived branch location.
     */
    restoreBranch: builder.mutation({
      query: (branchId) => ({
        url: `/branches/${branchId}/restore`,
        method: 'PATCH',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, branchId) => [
        { type: 'Branch', id: branchId },
        { type: 'Branch', id: `${branchId}-metrics` },
        { type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Permanently cascade-delete an archived branch and all associated inspection reports/audios.
     */
    deleteBranchPermanently: builder.mutation({
      query: (branchId) => ({
        url: `/branches/${branchId}/delete`,
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, branchId) => [
        { type: 'Branch', id: branchId },
        { type: 'Branch', id: `${branchId}-metrics` },
        { type: 'Branch', id: 'LIST' },
        'Report',
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetBranchesQuery,
  useGetBranchByIdQuery,
  useGetBranchMetricsQuery,
  useCreateBranchMutation,
  useUpdateBranchMutation,
  useArchiveBranchMutation,
  useRestoreBranchMutation,
  useDeleteBranchPermanentlyMutation,
  useDeleteBranchPermanentlyMutation: useDeleteBranchMutation,
} = branchSlice;

export default branchSlice;

/**
 * @module redux/features/chatSlice
 * @description Redux Toolkit slice and injected RTK Query endpoints managing
 * conversational AI chat sessions, SSE streaming telemetry, thread drawer state,
 * model inference preferences, and media upload mutations.
 */

import { createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { apiSlice } from '../app/apiSlice.js';
import { AI_MODELS, CHAT_CONSTANTS, CHAT_PAGINATION } from '../../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Initial UI state for conversational canvas.
 * @constant
 * @type {{
 *   activeChatId: string|null,
 *   isDrawerOpen: boolean,
 *   activeModel: string,
 *   thinkingBudget: number,
 *   language: string,
 *   sttEngine: string,
 *   isStreaming: boolean,
 *   streamingStatus: 'idle'|'reasoning'|'answering'|'error',
 * }}
 */
const initialState = {
  activeChatId: null,
  isDrawerOpen: false,
  activeModel: AI_MODELS.DEFAULT,
  thinkingBudget: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET,
  language: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
  sttEngine: CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE,
  isStreaming: false,
  streamingStatus: 'idle',
  pipelineStatus: '',
};

/**
 * Synchronous UI state slice for conversational AI chat experience.
 * @constant
 */
export const chatSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'chat',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    /**
     * Sets currently active chat session identifier.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: string|null }} action - Action payload.
     */
    setActiveChatId: (state, action) => {
      state.activeChatId = action.payload || null;
    },

    /**
     * Toggles or explicitly sets history drawer visibility.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload?: boolean }} action - Optional explicit boolean.
     */
    toggleDrawer: (state, action) => {
      state.isDrawerOpen =
        typeof action.payload === 'boolean' ? action.payload : !state.isDrawerOpen;
    },

    /**
     * Sets history drawer visibility explicitly.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: boolean }} action - Action payload.
     */
    setDrawerOpen: (state, action) => {
      state.isDrawerOpen = Boolean(action.payload);
    },

    /**
     * Sets selected Gemini model identifier.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: string }} action - Selected model string.
     */
    setActiveModel: (state, action) => {
      if (action.payload) {
        state.activeModel = action.payload;
      }
    },

    /**
     * Updates thinking budget clamped between system bounds.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: number }} action - Thinking budget in tokens.
     */
    setThinkingBudget: (state, action) => {
      const budget = Number(action.payload);
      if (!Number.isNaN(budget)) {
        state.thinkingBudget = Math.max(
          CHAT_CONSTANTS.MIN_THINKING_BUDGET,
          Math.min(budget, CHAT_CONSTANTS.MAX_THINKING_BUDGET)
        );
      }
    },

    /**
     * Sets synthesis language preference ('am'|'en'|'auto').
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: string }} action - Language code.
     */
    setLanguage: (state, action) => {
      if (action.payload) {
        state.language = action.payload;
      }
    },

    /**
     * Sets speech-to-text transcription engine ('addis_ai'|'gemini-2.5-flash').
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: string }} action - Engine name.
     */
    setSttEngine: (state, action) => {
      if (action.payload) {
        state.sttEngine = action.payload;
      }
    },

    /**
     * Updates active streaming flag. Resets status to idle when streaming terminates.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: boolean }} action - Streaming flag.
     */
    setIsStreaming: (state, action) => {
      state.isStreaming = Boolean(action.payload);
      if (!state.isStreaming && state.streamingStatus !== 'idle') {
        state.streamingStatus = 'idle';
      }
    },

    /**
     * Sets granular streaming phase.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: 'idle'|'reasoning'|'answering'|'error' }} action - Stream phase.
     */
    setStreamingStatus: (state, action) => {
      state.streamingStatus = action.payload || 'idle';
    },

    /**
     * Sets real-time dynamic pipeline status string for multi-modal ingestion and tool execution.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     * @param {{ payload: string }} action - Pipeline status string.
     */
    setPipelineStatus: (state, action) => {
      state.pipelineStatus = action.payload || '';
    },

    /**
     * Resets canvas UI state to pristine defaults.
     * @param {object} state - Current slice state.
     */
    resetChatUiState: (state) => {
      state.activeChatId = null;
      state.isStreaming = false;
      state.streamingStatus = 'idle';
      state.pipelineStatus = '';
    },
  },
});

export const {
  setActiveChatId,
  toggleDrawer,
  setDrawerOpen,
  setActiveModel,
  setThinkingBudget,
  setLanguage,
  setSttEngine,
  setIsStreaming,
  setStreamingStatus,
  setPipelineStatus,
  resetChatUiState,
} = chatSlice.actions;

// Synchronous Selectors
export const selectActiveChatId = (state) => state.chat?.activeChatId ?? null;
export const selectIsDrawerOpen = (state) => state.chat?.isDrawerOpen ?? false;
export const selectActiveModel = (state) => state.chat?.activeModel ?? AI_MODELS.DEFAULT;
export const selectThinkingBudget = (state) =>
  state.chat?.thinkingBudget ?? CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET;
export const selectLanguage = (state) =>
  state.chat?.language ?? CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
export const selectSttEngine = (state) =>
  state.chat?.sttEngine ?? CHAT_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_STT_ENGINE;
export const selectIsStreaming = (state) => state.chat?.isStreaming ?? false;
export const selectStreamingStatus = (state) => state.chat?.streamingStatus ?? 'idle';
export const selectPipelineStatus = (state) => state.chat?.pipelineStatus ?? '';

/**
 * Chat API endpoints injected into central RTK Query apiSlice.
 * Scoped to tag 'Chat' with fine-grained query invalidation.
 * @constant
 */
export const chatApi = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    /**
     * Retrieves paginated chat sessions list.
     */
    getChats: builder.query({
      query: (params = {}) => {
        const {
          page = 1,
          limit = CHAT_PAGINATION.RECENT_CHATS_PAGE_SIZE,
          search = '',
          pinned,
          archived,
        } = params;
        const queryParams = { page, limit };
        if (search && typeof search === 'string' && search.trim()) {
          queryParams.search = search.trim();
        }
        if (pinned !== undefined) {
          queryParams.pinned = pinned;
        }
        if (archived !== undefined) {
          queryParams.archived = archived;
        }
        return {
          url: '/chat',
          params: queryParams,
        };
      },
      serializeQueryArgs: ({ endpointName, queryArgs }) => {
        const search = queryArgs?.search ? queryArgs.search.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const archived = queryArgs?.archived ?? false;
        const pinned = queryArgs?.pinned ?? false;
        return `${endpointName}-${search}-${archived}-${pinned}`;
      },
      merge: (currentCache, newItems, { arg }) => {
        if (!arg || !arg.page || arg.page === 1) {
          return newItems;
        }
        const existingIds = new Set((currentCache?.chats || []).map((c) => String(c._id)));
        const incomingDocs = newItems?.chats || [];
        const uniqueDocs = incomingDocs.filter((c) => !existingIds.has(String(c._id)));
        if (!currentCache.chats) {
          currentCache.chats = [];
        }
        currentCache.chats.push(...uniqueDocs);
        currentCache.pagination = newItems?.pagination || currentCache.pagination;
      },
      forceRefetch({ currentArg, previousArg }) {
        return (
          currentArg?.page !== previousArg?.page ||
          currentArg?.search !== previousArg?.search ||
          currentArg?.limit !== previousArg?.limit
        );
      },
      keepUnusedDataFor: 86400,
      providesTags: (result) =>
        result?.chats
          ? [
              ...result.chats.map(({ _id }) => ({ type: 'Chat', id: _id })),
              { type: 'Chat', id: 'LIST' },
            ]
          : [{ type: 'Chat', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),

    /**
     * Retrieves full chat session with message history.
     */
    getChatById: builder.query({
      query: ({ chatId, limit = CHAT_PAGINATION.MESSAGES_PAGE_SIZE, before }) => ({
        url: `/chat/${chatId}`,
        params: {
          limit,
          ...(before !== undefined && before !== null ? { before } : {}),
        },
      }),
      providesTags: (_result, _error, { chatId }) => [{ type: 'Chat', id: chatId }],
    }),

    /**
     * Dedicated transcription mutation for audio blobs.
     */
    transcribeAudio: builder.mutation({
      query: (formData) => ({
        url: '/chat/transcribe-audio',
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Uploads audio recordings for chat grounding.
     */
    uploadAudio: builder.mutation({
      query: (formData) => ({
        url: '/chat/upload-audio',
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Uploads document and image attachments for chat grounding.
     */
    uploadAttachments: builder.mutation({
      query: (formData) => ({
        url: '/chat/upload-attachments',
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Toggles pinned status for a chat session.
     */
    pinChat: builder.mutation({
      query: (chatId) => ({
        url: `/chat/${chatId}/pin`,
        method: 'PATCH',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: [{ type: 'Chat', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),

    /**
     * Renames chat session title.
     */
    renameChat: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ chatId, title }) => ({
        url: `/chat/${chatId}/title`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: { title },
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, { chatId }) => [
        { type: 'Chat', id: chatId },
        { type: 'Chat', id: 'LIST' },
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Updates chat model parameters (model, thinkingBudget, language, persona).
     */
    updateChatConfig: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ chatId, ...config }) => ({
        url: `/chat/${chatId}/config`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: config,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, { chatId }) => [{ type: 'Chat', id: chatId }],
    }),

    /**
     * Permanently deletes a chat session and its turn history.
     */
    deleteChat: builder.mutation({
      query: (chatId) => ({
        url: `/chat/${chatId}`,
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: [{ type: 'Chat', id: 'LIST' }],
    }),

    /**
     * Dismisses staged attachment from composer shelf and purges from Cloud CDN.
     */
    deleteComposerAttachment: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ publicId, mimeType, fileName }) => ({
        url: '/chat/attachment',
        method: 'DELETE',
        params: { publicId, mimeType, fileName },
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Dispatches operational broadcast to Telegram channel (text or image card).
     */
    shareTelegram: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ text, targetChannel, asImage }) => ({
        url: '/chat/share-telegram',
        method: 'POST',
        body: { text, targetChannel, asImage },
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Synthesizes speech from text using native Addis AI (Addis Voices 2).
     */
    synthesizeSpeech: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ text, voiceId, language, clientRequestId }) => ({
        url: '/chat/tts',
        method: 'POST',
        body: { text, voiceId, language, clientRequestId },
      }),
    }),

    /**
     * Fetches dynamic Addis AI voices catalog.
     */
    getTtsVoices: builder.query({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: '/chat/tts/voices',
        params,
      }),
      keepUnusedDataFor: 86400, // 24 hours
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetChatsQuery,
  useGetChatByIdQuery,
  useTranscribeAudioMutation,
  useUploadAudioMutation,
  useUploadAttachmentsMutation,
  usePinChatMutation,
  useRenameChatMutation,
  useUpdateChatConfigMutation,
  useDeleteChatMutation,
  useDeleteComposerAttachmentMutation,
  useShareTelegramMutation,
  useSynthesizeSpeechMutation,
  useGetTtsVoicesQuery,
} = chatApi;

export default chatSlice.reducer;

/**
 * @module redux/features/reportSlice
 * @description Injected RTK Query endpoints for supervisor operational reports,
 * branch audit histories, status filtering, and corporate multi-channel exports.
 * Scoped strictly to authenticated supervisor under tag 'Report'.
 */

import { apiSlice } from '../app/apiSlice.js';

/**
 * Report management and inspection history API endpoints injected into apiSlice.
 * @constant
 */
export const reportSlice = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    /**
     * Retrieve paginated operational reports with optional branch, date, search, and archival filters.
     */
    getReports: builder.query({
      query: (params = {}) => {
        const { page = 1, limit = 10, search = '', branch, date, archived, isArchived } = params;
        const isArchivedVal = archived !== undefined ? archived : isArchived;
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();

        if (page) searchParams.append('page', String(page));
        if (limit) searchParams.append('limit', String(limit));
        if (search && search.trim()) searchParams.append('search', search.trim());
        if (branch) searchParams.append('branch', String(branch));
        if (date) searchParams.append('date', String(date));
        if (isArchivedVal !== undefined) searchParams.append('archived', String(isArchivedVal));

        const queryString = searchParams.toString();
        return `/reports${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`;
      },
      providesTags: (result) => {
        const list = result?.reports || result?.docs || [];
        return list.length
          ? [
              ...list.map(({ _id }) => ({ type: 'Report', id: _id })),
              { type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' },
            ]
          : [{ type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' }];
      },
    }),

    /**
     * Retrieve a single operational report by its ObjectId.
     */
    getReportById: builder.query({
      query: (reportId) => `/reports/${reportId}`,
      providesTags: (_result, _error, reportId) => [{ type: 'Report', id: reportId }],
    }),

    /**
     * Update an operational report document.
     */
    updateReport: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ reportId, ...updates }) => ({
        url: `/reports/${reportId}`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: updates.data ? updates.data : updates,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, { reportId }) => [
        { type: 'Report', id: reportId },
        { type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Soft-archive an operational report.
     */
    archiveReport: builder.mutation({
      query: (reportId) => ({
        url: `/reports/${reportId}/archive`,
        method: 'PATCH',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, reportId) => [
        { type: 'Report', id: reportId },
        { type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Restore an archived operational report.
     */
    restoreReport: builder.mutation({
      query: (reportId) => ({
        url: `/reports/${reportId}/restore`,
        method: 'PATCH',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, reportId) => [
        { type: 'Report', id: reportId },
        { type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Permanently delete an operational report.
     */
    deleteReport: builder.mutation({
      query: (reportId) => ({
        url: `/reports/${reportId}/delete`,
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (_result, _error, reportId) => [
        { type: 'Report', id: reportId },
        { type: 'Report', id: 'LIST' },
        'Dashboard',
      ],
    }),

    /**
     * Broadcasts an operational report's authoritative Amharic transcription to Telegram.
     */
    shareReportToTelegram: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ reportId, targetChannel = 'management', asImage = false }) => ({
        url: `/reports/${reportId}/share/telegram`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { targetChannel, asImage },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetReportsQuery,
  useGetReportByIdQuery,
  useUpdateReportMutation,
  useArchiveReportMutation,
  useRestoreReportMutation,
  useDeleteReportMutation,
  useShareReportToTelegramMutation,
} = reportSlice;

export default reportSlice;

/**
 * @module redux/features/userSlice
 * @description Injected RTK Query endpoints for supervisor profile, dedicated avatar routes, and password changes.
 * Adheres to standard slice naming convention (<name>Slice.js).
 */

import { apiSlice } from '../app/apiSlice.js';
import { setCredentials, logout, updateUserProfile } from './authSlice.js';

/**
 * User and profile API endpoints injected into the core RTK Query slice.
 * @constant
 */
export const userSlice = apiSlice.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getProfile: builder.query({
      query: () => '/users/profile',
      providesTags: ['User'],
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          // Normalized by apiSlice: data.user is directly accessible
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(setCredentials({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          // If session profile retrieval fails (e.g. 401 expired cookie), purge state cleanly
          dispatch(logout());
        }
      },
    }),
    updateProfile: builder.mutation({
      query: (profileData) => ({
        url: '/users/profile',
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: profileData,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['User'],
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(updateUserProfile({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          // Handled by caller UI
        }
      },
    }),
    updateAvatar: builder.mutation({
      query: (avatarData) => ({
        url: '/users/avatar',
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: avatarData,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['User'],
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(updateUserProfile({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          // Handled by caller UI
        }
      },
    }),
    removeAvatar: builder.mutation({
      query: () => ({
        url: '/users/avatar',
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['User'],
      async onQueryStarted(_arg, { dispatch, queryFulfilled }) {
        try {
          const { data } = await queryFulfilled;
          const user = data?.user || data?.data?.user;
          if (user) {
            dispatch(updateUserProfile({ user }));
          }
        } catch {
          // Handled by caller UI
        }
      },
    }),
    updatePassword: builder.mutation({
      query: (passwordData) => ({

    updateAgentConfig: builder.mutation({

                integrations: {

                    ...(currentUser.integrations?.telegram || {}),
                    ...(resData.telegram || {}),

              };
              dispatch(updateUserProfile({ user: updatedUser }));
            }

        } catch {

    getUserAgentConfig: builder.query({

    updateDirectives: builder.mutation({

          if (directives) {

/**
 * @module routes/ProtectedRoute
 * @description Route guard ensuring only authenticated supervisors can access protected views.
 * Defensively verifies session cookies against the server before redirecting to login.
 */

import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { selectIsAuthenticated, selectAuthLoading } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import { useGetProfileQuery } from '../redux/features/userSlice.js';
import LoadingSpinner from '../components/reusable/LoadingSpinner.jsx';
import { ROUTES } from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Route guard component restricting child route access to authenticated supervisors.
 * Defensively checks server-side HttpOnly cookie session if client memory has not yet hydrated
 * (e.g. cold boot following Google SSO), preventing unwanted bounces to the login screen.
 *
 * @component ProtectedRoute
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Protected route outlet, verification spinner, or navigation redirect.
 */
export const ProtectedRoute = () => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated);
  const isLoading = useSelector(selectAuthLoading);

  // If Redux has not yet authenticated the user (e.g. following Google SSO redirect,
  // cold boot, or localStorage purge), verify whether an active cookie session exists on the server.
  const { isFetching } = useGetProfileQuery(undefined, {
    skip: isAuthenticated,
    refetchOnMountOrArgChange: false,
  });

  // Display smooth verification spinner while session is being verified with the backend
  if (isLoading || (!isAuthenticated && isFetching)) {
    return <LoadingSpinner message="Verifying session..." height="100dvh" size="large" />;
  }

  // If user is definitively unauthenticated (or profile retrieval failed with 401), redirect to login
  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTES.LOGIN} replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedRoute;

````

/**
 * @module routes/PublicRoute
 * @description Route guard redirecting authenticated supervisors away from public auth pages.
 * Displays smooth hydration spinner while verifying session, strictly preventing flicker of public views.
 */

import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { selectIsAuthenticated, selectAuthLoading } from '../redux/features/authSlice.js';
import LoadingSpinner from '../components/reusable/LoadingSpinner.jsx';
import { ROUTES } from '../utils/constants.js';

/**
 * Route guard component redirecting authenticated supervisors away from public auth pages.
 * Ensures signed-in users cannot access landing, login, or registration screens.
 * Displays a full-screen loader while session check is in-flight to prevent UI flicker.
 *
 * @component PublicRoute
 * @returns {JSX.Element} Public route outlet, hydration spinner, or dashboard redirect.
 */
export const PublicRoute = () => {
  const isAuthenticated = useSelector(selectIsAuthenticated);
  const isLoading = useSelector(selectAuthLoading);

  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingSpinner message="Checking session..." height="100dvh" size="large" />;
  }

  if (isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTES.DASHBOARD} replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default PublicRoute;

/**
 * @module utils/AdapterEthiopianDayjs
 * @description Localized Material-UI DatePicker adapter subclassing AdapterDayjs for authentic
 * 13-month Ethiopian calendar calculations in 100% English UI Chrome.
 * Scoped locally to MuiDatePicker to guarantee 100% collision immunity across the platform.
 */

import { AdapterDayjs } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/AdapterDayjs';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import {
  toEthiopianDate,
  ethiopianToGregorianDate,
  getDaysInEthiopianMonth,
  ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS,
  ETHIOPIAN_DAYS_OF_WEEK,
} from './ethiopianCalendar.js';

export class AdapterEthiopianDayjs extends AdapterDayjs {
  getYear = (value) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return null;
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    return eth ? eth.year : null;
  };

  getMonth = (value) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return null;
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    return eth ? eth.month - 1 : null; // 0-indexed: 0..12
  };

  getDate = (value) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return null;
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    return eth ? eth.day : null;
  };

  getDaysInMonth = (value) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return 30;
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    return eth ? getDaysInEthiopianMonth(eth.year, eth.month) : 30;
  };

  startOfMonth = (value) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.startOf('month');
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, eth.month, 1);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  endOfMonth = (value) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.endOf('month');
    const lastDay = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(eth.year, eth.month);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, eth.month, lastDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  startOfYear = (value) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.startOf('year');
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, 1, 1);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  endOfYear = (value) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.endOf('year');
    const lastDay = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(eth.year, 13);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, 13, lastDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  addMonths = (value, count) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.add(count, 'month');
    let totalMonths = eth.year * 13 + (eth.month - 1) + count;
    let newYear = Math.floor(totalMonths / 13);
    let newMonth = (totalMonths % 13) + 1;
    let maxDays = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(newYear, newMonth);
    let newDay = Math.min(eth.day, maxDays);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(newYear, newMonth, newDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  addYears = (value, count) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value.add(count, 'year');
    let newYear = eth.year + count;
    let maxDays = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(newYear, eth.month);
    let newDay = Math.min(eth.day, maxDays);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(newYear, eth.month, newDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  setYear = (value, year) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value;
    const maxDays = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(year, eth.month);
    const newDay = Math.min(eth.day, maxDays);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(year, eth.month, newDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  setMonth = (value, monthIndex) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value;
    const newMonth = monthIndex + 1;
    const maxDays = getDaysInEthiopianMonth(eth.year, newMonth);
    const newDay = Math.min(eth.day, maxDays);
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, newMonth, newDay);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  setDate = (value, day) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return value;
    const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(eth.year, eth.month, day);
    return dayjs(greg.isoDate);
  };

  isSameMonth = (value, comparing) => {
    if (!value || !comparing) return false;
    const ethA = toEthiopianDate(value);
    const ethB = toEthiopianDate(comparing);
    if (!ethA || !ethB) return false;
    return ethA.year === ethB.year && ethA.month === ethB.month;
  };

  isSameYear = (value, comparing) => {
    if (!value || !comparing) return false;
    const ethA = toEthiopianDate(value);
    const ethB = toEthiopianDate(comparing);
    if (!ethA || !ethB) return false;
    return ethA.year === ethB.year;
  };

  isSameDay = (value, comparing) => {
    if (!value || !comparing) return false;
    const ethA = toEthiopianDate(value);
    const ethB = toEthiopianDate(comparing);
    if (!ethA || !ethB) return false;
    return ethA.year === ethB.year && ethA.month === ethB.month && ethA.day === ethB.day;
  };

  getMonthArray = (value) => {
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    const year = eth ? eth.year : this.getYear(value);
    const months = [];
    for (let m = 1; m <= 13; m++) {
      const greg = ethiopianToGregorianDate(year, m, 1);
      months.push(dayjs(greg.isoDate));
    }
    return months;
  };

  format = (value, formatKey) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return '';
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return '';
    const monthObj = ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS[eth.month - 1] || { name: `Month ${eth.month}` };
    const monthName = monthObj.name;
    const monthShort = monthName.slice(0, 3);
    const day = eth.day;
    const dd = String(day).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(eth.month).padStart(2, '0');
    const yy = String(eth.year).slice(-2);
    const year = eth.year;
    const dayOfWeek = value.day();
    const dayObj = ETHIOPIAN_DAYS_OF_WEEK[dayOfWeek] || { short: 'Sun', name: 'Sunday' };

    switch (formatKey) {
      case 'year':
        return String(year);
      case 'month':
        return monthName;
      case 'monthShort':
        return monthShort;
      case 'dayOfMonth':
        return String(day);
      case 'fullDate':
        return `${monthName} ${day}, ${year}`;
      case 'keyboardDate':
        return `${dd}-${mm}-${yy}`;
      case 'shortDate':
        return `${monthShort} ${day}`;
      case 'normalDate':
        return `${day} ${monthName}`;
      case 'weekday':
        return dayObj.name;
      case 'weekdayShort':
        return dayObj.short;
      default:
        return this.formatByString(value, this.formats[formatKey] || 'YYYY-MM-DD');
    }
  };

  formatByString = (value, formatString) => {
    if (!value || !value.isValid()) return '';
    const eth = toEthiopianDate(value);
    if (!eth) return '';
    const monthObj = ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS[eth.month - 1] || { name: `Month ${eth.month}` };
    const monthName = monthObj.name;
    const monthShort = monthName.slice(0, 3);
    const day = eth.day;
    const dd = String(day).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(eth.month).padStart(2, '0');
    const yy = String(eth.year).slice(-2);
    const year = eth.year;
    const dayOfWeek = value.day();
    const dayObj = ETHIOPIAN_DAYS_OF_WEEK[dayOfWeek] || { short: 'Sun', name: 'Sunday' };

    return formatString
      .replace(/YYYY/g, String(year))
      .replace(/YY/g, yy)
      .replace(/MMMM/g, monthName)
      .replace(/MMM/g, monthShort)
      .replace(/MM/g, mm)
      .replace(/DD/g, dd)
      .replace(/D/g, String(day))
      .replace(/dddd/g, dayObj.name)
      .replace(/ddd/g, dayObj.short)
      .replace(/dd/g, dayObj.short.slice(0, 2))
      .replace(/\bd\b/g, String(dayOfWeek));
  };
}

export default AdapterEthiopianDayjs;

````

/**
 * @module utils/addisAudioPlayer
 * @description Centralized singleton audio player for Addis AI speech playback.
 * Enforces the Single Active Stream Invariant: guarantees that only one audio clip
 * can play at any given moment across the entire application. Starting playback
 * on any message immediately halts and resets any previously active stream.
 */

class AddisAudioPlayer {
  constructor() {
    this.audio = typeof Audio !== 'undefined' ? new Audio() : null;
    this.currentKey = null;
    this.currentSrc = null;
    this.isPlaying = false;
    this.listeners = new Set();

    if (this.audio) {
      this.audio.addEventListener('play', () => {
        this.isPlaying = true;
        this._notify({ type: 'play', key: this.currentKey, src: this.currentSrc });
      });

      this.audio.addEventListener('pause', () => {
        this.isPlaying = false;
        this._notify({ type: 'pause', key: this.currentKey });
      });

      this.audio.addEventListener('ended', () => {
        this.isPlaying = false;
        const endedKey = this.currentKey;
        this.currentKey = null;
        this.currentSrc = null;
        this._notify({ type: 'ended', key: endedKey });
      });

      this.audio.addEventListener('error', (e) => {
        this.isPlaying = false;
        const errKey = this.currentKey;
        this.currentKey = null;
        this.currentSrc = null;
        this._notify({ type: 'error', key: errKey, error: e });
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Begins playback of a specific audio source under a given unique key.
   * If any other stream is active, it is immediately stopped and unloaded.
   *
   * @param {string} key - Unique key identifying the message or element (e.g. messageId).
   * @param {string} src - Audio source URL (signed CDN URL or Base64 data URI).
   * @param {object} [options={}] - Optional playback configurations (speed/playbackRate).
   * @returns {Promise<void>}
   */
  async play(key, src, options = {}) {
    if (!this.audio) return;

    // Halt previous track if running
    if (this.isPlaying || this.currentKey) {
      this.stop();
    }

    this.currentKey = key;
    this.currentSrc = src;
    this.audio.src = src;

    if (options.speed && typeof options.speed === 'number') {
      this.audio.playbackRate = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0, options.speed));
    } else {
      this.audio.playbackRate = 1.0;
    }

    try {
      await this.audio.play();
    } catch (err) {
      this.isPlaying = false;
      this.currentKey = null;
      this.currentSrc = null;
      this._notify({ type: 'error', key, error: err });
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Completely stops audio playback and resets the player state to idle.
   */
  stop() {
    if (!this.audio) return;

    try {
      this.audio.pause();
      this.audio.currentTime = 0;
      this.audio.removeAttribute('src');
      this.audio.load();
    } catch {
      // Ignore unload errors
    }

    const prevKey = this.currentKey;
    this.isPlaying = false;
    this.currentKey = null;
    this.currentSrc = null;
    this._notify({ type: 'stop', key: prevKey });
  }

  /**
   * Dynamically adjusts playback rate of the current active audio stream.
   *
   * @param {number} speed - Playback speed multiplier (e.g., 0.75 to 1.5).
   */
  setSpeed(speed) {
    if (!this.audio || typeof speed !== 'number') return;
    this.audio.playbackRate = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0, speed));
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether a specific key is currently actively playing.
   *
   * @param {string} key - Unique identifier to test.
   * @returns {boolean} True if this key is playing.
   */
  isKeyPlaying(key) {
    return Boolean(this.isPlaying && this.currentKey === key);
  }

  /**
   * Returns the key of whatever is currently active, or null if idle.
   *
   * @returns {string|null} Active audio key.
   */
  getCurrentKey() {
    return this.currentKey;
  }

  /**
   * Registers a listener callback for player state changes.
   *
   * @param {Function} listener - Callback (event) => void.
   * @returns {Function} Unsubscribe function to clean up on component unmount.
   */
  subscribe(listener) {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Internal broadcaster for registered listeners.
   *
   * @private
   * @param {object} event - Event descriptor.
   */
  _notify(event) {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(event);
      } catch {
        // Prevent faulty listener from crashing other listeners
      }
    }
  }
}

export const addisAudioPlayer = new AddisAudioPlayer();
export default addisAudioPlayer;

/**
 * @module utils/attachmentRegistry
 * @description Centralized in-memory registry tracking eager background uploads for composer attachments.
 * Completely decoupled from React render loops to uphold hardware 60/120fps zero-lag typing.
 */

import { useSyncExternalStore, useCallback } from 'react';

const registry = new Map();
const listeners = new Set();

/**
 * Registers an in-flight background upload for a File object.
 *
 * @param {File} file - Native File object.
 * @param {Promise<object>} uploadPromise - Active upload request promise.
 * @param {(() => void)} [abortFn] - Optional abort callback to terminate HTTP upload on cancel.
 * @param {((result: object) => void)} [onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup] - Optional cleanup callback if upload resolves after cancellation.
 */
export const registerUpload = (file, uploadPromise, abortFn, onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup) => {
  if (!file) return;
  const entry = {
    isUploading: true,
    result: null,
    error: null,
    abortFn: typeof abortFn === 'function' ? abortFn : null,
    wasCancelled: false,
    onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup: typeof onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup === 'function' ? onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup : null,
  };
  registry.set(file, entry);
  notify();

  uploadPromise
    .then((result) => {
      if (entry.wasCancelled) {
        if (entry.onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup) {
          try {
            entry.onResolvedAfterCancelCleanup(result);
          } catch {
            // Ignored on cleanup
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      entry.isUploading = false;
      entry.result = result;
      entry.error = null;
      notify();
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      if (entry.wasCancelled) return;
      entry.isUploading = false;
      entry.result = null;
      entry.error = error;
      notify();
    });
};

/**
 * Retrieves the current upload state for a File object.
 *
 * @param {File} file
 * @returns {{ isUploading: boolean, result: object|null, error: any }}
 */
export const getUploadState = (file) => {
  if (!file) return { isUploading: false, result: null, error: null };
  const entry = registry.get(file);
  return entry
    ? { isUploading: entry.isUploading, result: entry.result, error: entry.error }
    : { isUploading: false, result: null, error: null };
};

/**
 * Removes an attachment from the registry, immediately aborts any in-flight request,
 * and returns its upload result (e.g. for Cloudinary cleanup).
 *
 * @param {File} file
 * @returns {object|null} The resolved upload result metadata with wasUploading flag.
 */
export const removeUpload = (file) => {
  if (!file) return null;
  const entry = registry.get(file);
  if (!entry) return null;

  const wasUploading = Boolean(entry.isUploading);
  entry.wasCancelled = true;

  if (wasUploading && typeof entry.abortFn === 'function') {
    try {
      entry.abortFn();
    } catch {
      // Ignored on abort
    }
  }

  registry.delete(file);
  notify();

  const result = entry.result || null;
  return {
    ...result,
    wasUploading,
    result,
  };
};

/**
 * Returns the count of files currently uploading in the background.
 *
 * @returns {number}
 */
export const getPendingUploadCount = () => {
  let count = 0;
  for (const entry of registry.values()) {
    if (entry.isUploading) count += 1;
  }
  return count;
};

/**
 * Subscribes a listener to pending upload count changes.
 *
 * @param {(count: number) => void} callback
 * @returns {() => void} Unsubscribe function.
 */
export const subscribeUploadState = (callback) => {
  listeners.add(callback);
  return () => listeners.delete(callback);
};

const notify = () => {
  const count = getPendingUploadCount();
  listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(count);
    } catch {
      // Ignore listener error
    }
  });
};

/**
 * React hook returning the active number of background uploads.
 * Re-renders only on upload start and upload completion.
 *
 * @returns {number}
 */
export const usePendingUploadCount = () => {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeUploadState, getPendingUploadCount);
};

/**
 * React hook returning the reactive upload state for a specific file.
 *
 * @param {File} file
 * @returns {{ isUploading: boolean, result: object|null, error: any }}
 */
export const useUploadState = (file) => {
  const getSnapshot = useCallback(() => getUploadState(file), [file]);
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeUploadState, getSnapshot);
};

export default {
  registerUpload,
  getUploadState,
  removeUpload,
  getPendingUploadCount,
  subscribeUploadState,
  usePendingUploadCount,
  useUploadState,
};

/**
 * @module utils/avatarUtils
 * @description Centralized supervisor and user avatar URL resolution utility.
 * Guarantees proper URL resolution across Cloudinary CDN, local disk static uploads (/uploads/avatars),
 * Base64 data URLs, and blob/object URLs regardless of hosting domain or Vite proxy.
 */

import { API_BASE_URL } from './constants.js';

/**
 * Resolves an avatar string to a fully-qualified, browser-renderable image URL.
 *
 * @param {string|null|undefined} avatar - Raw avatar field from user profile.
 * @returns {string|null} Resolved absolute URL, CDN URL, or data URL; null if invalid/empty.
 */
export const getAvatarUrl = (avatar) => {
  if (!avatar || typeof avatar !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = avatar.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  // 1. Direct web URLs, base64 data URIs, or temporary client object blobs
  if (
    trimmed.startsWith('http://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('https://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('data:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('blob:')
  ) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  // 2. Local uploads relative path resolution (e.g. /uploads/avatars/avatar-xxx.png)
  const cleanPath = trimmed.startsWith('/') ? trimmed : `/${trimmed}`;
  const serverOrigin = (
    (typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL) ||
    API_BASE_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000/api/v1'
  ).replace(/\/api\/v1\/?$/, '');

  return `${serverOrigin}${cleanPath}`;
};

export default {
  getAvatarUrl,
};

/**
 * Normalizes, deduplicates, and filters branch aliases case-insensitively,
 * excluding the primary branch name. Prevents repetitive phonetic transliterations
 * and bounding UI clutter across DataGrid, Card lists, and Hero banners.
 *
 * @function getCleanAliases
 * @param {Array<string>} [aliases=[]] - Raw aliases array from backend model.
 * @param {string} [primaryName=''] - Primary canonical branch name to exclude.
 * @returns {Array<string>} Array of unique, cleaned alias strings.
 */
export const getCleanAliases = (aliases = [], primaryName = '') => {
  if (!Array.isArray(aliases)) return [];
  const normalizedPrimary = String(primaryName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const seen = new Set();
  const clean = [];

  for (const raw of aliases) {
    const trimmed = String(raw || '').trim();
    const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
    if (!lower || lower === normalizedPrimary || seen.has(lower)) {
      continue;
    }
    seen.add(lower);
    clean.push(trimmed);
  }
  return clean;
};

/**
 * @module utils/ethiopianCalendar
 * @description Bidirectional Ethiopian-Gregorian calendar conversion utility using Julian Day Number (JDN) algorithms.
 * Used for dynamic derivation of Ethiopian dates across reports, date filters, and UI displays.
 */

/**
 * Converts a Gregorian date (year, month 1-12, day 1-31) to Julian Day Number (JDN).
 * @param {number} year - Gregorian year (e.g., 2026).
 * @param {number} month - Gregorian month (1-12).
 * @param {number} day - Gregorian day of month (1-31).
 * @returns {number} Julian Day Number.
 */
export function gregorianToJdn(year, month, day) {
  const a = Math.floor((14 - month) / 12);
  const y = year + 4800 - a;
  const m = month + 12 * a - 3;
  return (
    day +
    Math.floor((153 * m + 2) / 5) +
    365 * y +
    Math.floor(y / 4) -
    Math.floor(y / 100) +
    Math.floor(y / 400) -
    32045
  );
}

/**
 * Converts a Julian Day Number (JDN) to Gregorian date components.
 * @param {number} jdn - Julian Day Number.
 * @returns {{ year: number, month: number, day: number }} Gregorian date components.
 */
export function jdnToGregorian(jdn) {
  const l = jdn + 68569;
  const n = Math.floor((4 * l) / 146097);
  const l2 = l - Math.floor((146097 * n + 3) / 4);
  const i = Math.floor((4000 * (l2 + 1)) / 1461001);
  const l3 = l2 - Math.floor((1461 * i) / 4) + 31;
  const j = Math.floor((80 * l3) / 2447);
  const day = l3 - Math.floor((2447 * j) / 80);
  const l4 = Math.floor(j / 11);
  const month = j + 2 - 12 * l4;
  const year = 100 * (n - 49) + i + l4;
  return { year, month, day };
}

/**
 * Converts a Julian Day Number (JDN) to Ethiopian date components.
 * @param {number} jdn - Julian Day Number.
 * @returns {{ year: number, month: number, day: number }} Ethiopian date components.
 */
export function jdnToEthiopian(jdn) {
  const r = (jdn - 1723856) % 1461;
  const n = (r % 365) + 365 * Math.floor(r / 1460);
  const year = 4 * Math.floor((jdn - 1723856) / 1461) + Math.floor(r / 365) - Math.floor(r / 1460);
  const month = Math.floor(n / 30) + 1;
  const day = (n % 30) + 1;
  return { year, month, day };
}

/**
 * Converts Ethiopian date components to Julian Day Number (JDN).
 * @param {number} year - Ethiopian year (e.g., 2019).
 * @param {number} month - Ethiopian month (1-13).
 * @param {number} day - Ethiopian day (1-30, or 1-6 for Pagume).
 * @returns {number} Julian Day Number.
 */
export function ethiopianToJdn(year, month, day) {
  return 1723856 + 365 * year + Math.floor(year / 4) + 30 * (month - 1) + day - 1;
}

/**
 * Converts a JS Date, Dayjs instance, timestamp, or ISO date string to Ethiopian calendar date components.
 * Safely extracts Gregorian Y-M-D components without timezone distortion (eliminates UTC midnight off-by-one shifts).
 * @param {Date|object|string|number} dateInput - Date object, Dayjs instance, timestamp, or ISO string.
 * @returns {{ year: number, month: number, day: number }|null} Ethiopian date object.
 */
export function toEthiopianDate(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return null;
  let year, month, day;

  // Dayjs instance
  if (dateInput && typeof dateInput.year === 'function' && typeof dateInput.date === 'function') {
    year = dateInput.year();
    month = dateInput.month() + 1;
    day = dateInput.date();
  } else if (typeof dateInput === 'string') {
    const trimmed = dateInput.trim();
    const m = trimmed.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
    if (m) {
      year = parseInt(m[1], 10);
      month = parseInt(m[2], 10);
      day = parseInt(m[3], 10);
    }
  } else if (dateInput instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(dateInput.getTime())) return null;
    year = dateInput.getFullYear();
    month = dateInput.getMonth() + 1;
    day = dateInput.getDate();
  }

  // Fallback for timestamps or arbitrary objects
  if (!year || !month || !day) {
    const d = new Date(dateInput);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      return null;
    }
    year = d.getFullYear();
    month = d.getMonth() + 1;
    day = d.getDate();
  }

  const jdn = gregorianToJdn(year, month, day);
  return jdnToEthiopian(jdn);
}

/**
 * Formats a Gregorian date into an Ethiopian date string formatted as DD-MM-YY.
 * @param {Date|string|number} dateInput - Date object, timestamp, or ISO string.
 * @returns {string|null} Formatted Ethiopian date string (e.g. "11-02-19").
 */
export function toEthiopianDateString(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return null;
  const eth = toEthiopianDate(dateInput);
  if (!eth) return null;
  const dd = String(eth.day).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(eth.month).padStart(2, '0');
  const yy = String(eth.year).slice(-2);
  return `${dd}-${mm}-${yy}`;
}

/**
 * The 13 Ethiopian months with official English names, Amharic script references, and standard day counts.
 * In accordance with Ethiopian calendar laws and application language requirements, the year begins in September:
 * Month 1 (Meskerem) is September, Month 2 (Tikimt) is October, ..., Month 12 (Nehase) is August,
 * and Month 13 is strictly Pagume (5 days, 6 in leap years where year % 4 === 3).
 * Transliterated Amharic names (e.g. Meskerem, Tikimt) are permanently purged in favor of English.
 */
export const ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS = Object.freeze([
  { id: 1, name: 'September', amharic: 'መስከረም', days: 30 },
  { id: 2, name: 'October', amharic: 'ጥቅምት', days: 30 },
  { id: 3, name: 'November', amharic: 'ኅዳር', days: 30 },
  { id: 4, name: 'December', amharic: 'ታኅሣሥ', days: 30 },
  { id: 5, name: 'January', amharic: 'ጥር', days: 30 },
  { id: 6, name: 'February', amharic: 'የካቲት', days: 30 },
  { id: 7, name: 'March', amharic: 'መጋቢት', days: 30 },
  { id: 8, name: 'April', amharic: 'ሚያዝያ', days: 30 },
  { id: 9, name: 'May', amharic: 'ግንቦት', days: 30 },
  { id: 10, name: 'June', amharic: 'ሰኔ', days: 30 },
  { id: 11, name: 'July', amharic: 'ሐምሌ', days: 30 },
  { id: 12, name: 'August', amharic: 'ነሐሴ', days: 30 },
  { id: 13, name: 'Pagume', amharic: 'ጳጉሜ', days: 5 }, // 6 days in leap years where year % 4 === 3
]);

/**
 * Days of the week in English and Amharic, indexed 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.
 */
export const ETHIOPIAN_DAYS_OF_WEEK = Object.freeze([
  { id: 0, short: 'Sun', amharicShort: 'እሁድ', name: 'Sunday' },
  { id: 1, short: 'Mon', amharicShort: 'ሰኞ', name: 'Monday' },
  { id: 2, short: 'Tue', amharicShort: 'ማክሰ', name: 'Tuesday' },
  { id: 3, short: 'Wed', amharicShort: 'ረቡዕ', name: 'Wednesday' },
  { id: 4, short: 'Thu', amharicShort: 'ሐሙስ', name: 'Thursday' },
  { id: 5, short: 'Fri', amharicShort: 'አርብ', name: 'Friday' },
  { id: 6, short: 'Sat', amharicShort: 'ቅዳሜ', name: 'Saturday' },
]);

/**
 * Returns number of days in an Ethiopian month, accounting for leap years in Pagume.
 * @param {number} year - Ethiopian year (e.g. 2019)
 * @param {number} month - Ethiopian month (1 to 13)
 * @returns {number} 30 for months 1-12; 5 or 6 for month 13 (Pagume)
 */
export function getDaysInEthiopianMonth(year, month) {
  if (month >= 1 && month <= 12) return 30;
  if (month === 13) {
    // In Ethiopian calendar, leap year occurs when (year % 4 === 3)
    return year % 4 === 3 ? 6 : 5;
  }
  return 30;
}

/**
 * Gets day-of-week index (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday) for an Ethiopian date.
 * @param {number} year - Ethiopian year.
 * @param {number} month - Ethiopian month (1-13).
 * @param {number} day - Ethiopian day (1-30).
 * @returns {number} 0 (Sun) to 6 (Sat).
 */
export function getDayOfWeekForEthiopianDate(year, month, day) {
  const jdn = ethiopianToJdn(year, month, day);
  return (jdn + 1) % 7;
}

/**
 * Converts Ethiopian date components to Gregorian Date object and YYYY-MM-DD ISO string.
 * @param {number} year - Ethiopian year.
 * @param {number} month - Ethiopian month.
 * @param {number} day - Ethiopian day.
 * @returns {{ date: Date, isoDate: string, year: number, month: number, day: number }}
 */
export function ethiopianToGregorianDate(year, month, day) {
  const jdn = ethiopianToJdn(year, month, day);
  const greg = jdnToGregorian(jdn);
  const yStr = String(greg.year).padStart(4, '0');
  const mStr = String(greg.month).padStart(2, '0');
  const dStr = String(greg.day).padStart(2, '0');
  const isoDate = `${yStr}-${mStr}-${dStr}`;
  // Construct date in UTC noon to avoid timezone shift
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(greg.year, greg.month - 1, greg.day, 12, 0, 0));
  return { date, isoDate, year: greg.year, month: greg.month, day: greg.day };
}

/**
 * Formats Ethiopian date object into full human-readable string in strictly 100% English.
 * @param {{ year: number, month: number, day: number }} eth - Ethiopian date components.
 * @param {boolean} [includeAmharic=false] - Deprecated parameter; app language mandate strictly requires English.
 * @returns {string} Formatted English string, e.g. "February 14, 2019".
 */
export function formatEthiopianFullDate(eth) {
  if (!eth || !eth.year || !eth.month || !eth.day) return '';
  const monthMeta = ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS[eth.month - 1] || { name: `Month ${eth.month}`, amharic: '' };
  return `${monthMeta.name} ${eth.day}, ${eth.year}`;
}

/**
 * Parses an Ethiopian date string (formats: "DD-MM-YY", "YYYY-MM-DD", or { year, month, day }).
 * @param {string|object} input - Ethiopian date string or object.
 * @returns {{ year: number, month: number, day: number }|null}
 */
export function parseEthiopianDate(input) {
  if (!input) return null;
  if (typeof input === 'object' && input.year && input.month && input.day) {
    return { year: Number(input.year), month: Number(input.month), day: Number(input.day) };
  }
  if (typeof input !== 'string') return null;

  const trimmed = input.trim();

  // If input is an ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp), it is strictly Gregorian.
  // Convert directly via toEthiopianDate to avoid treating Gregorian 2026 as Ethiopian year 2026!
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(trimmed)) {
    const parts = trimmed.split('-');
    const yearCandidate = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    // Ethiopian calendar is ~7-8 years behind Gregorian; any 4-digit year >= 2020 is Gregorian.
    if (yearCandidate >= 2020) {
      return toEthiopianDate(trimmed);
    }
    const ethConv = toEthiopianDate(trimmed);
    if (ethConv) return ethConv;
  }

  // Pattern: DD-MM-YY or DD-MM-YYYY
  const parts = trimmed.split('-');
  if (parts.length === 3) {
    let day = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    let month = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
    let year = parseInt(parts[2], 10);

    // If year was passed first (YYYY-MM-DD)
    if (parts[0].length === 4) {
      year = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
      month = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
      day = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
      if (year >= 2020) {
        return toEthiopianDate(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day)));
      }
    } else if (year < 100) {
      // 2-digit year e.g. '19' -> 2019
      year += 2000;
    }

    if (!Number.isNaN(year) && !Number.isNaN(month) && !Number.isNaN(day)) {
      return { year, month, day };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Computes human-readable duration between clockIn and clockOut strings in HH:mm format.
 * @param {string} clockIn - Arrival time (HH:mm).
 * @param {string} clockOut - Departure time (HH:mm).
 * @returns {string} Formatted duration string (e.g. "8h 30m" or "3h 00m").
 */
export function computeShiftDuration(clockIn, clockOut) {
  if (!clockIn || !clockOut) return '';
  const inParts = String(clockIn).split(':').map(Number);
  const outParts = String(clockOut).split(':').map(Number);
  if (inParts.length < 2 || outParts.length < 2) return '';

  let inMinutes = inParts[0] * 60 + inParts[1];
  let outMinutes = outParts[0] * 60 + outParts[1];

  // Handle shift crossing midnight
  if (outMinutes < inMinutes) {
    outMinutes += 24 * 60;
  }

  const diff = outMinutes - inMinutes;
  const hours = Math.floor(diff / 60);
  const minutes = diff % 60;

  if (hours > 0 && minutes > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h`;
  return `${minutes}m`;
}

export default {
  ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS,
  ETHIOPIAN_DAYS_OF_WEEK,
  gregorianToJdn,
  jdnToGregorian,
  jdnToEthiopian,
  ethiopianToJdn,
  toEthiopianDate,
  toEthiopianDateString,
  getDaysInEthiopianMonth,
  getDayOfWeekForEthiopianDate,
  ethiopianToGregorianDate,
  formatEthiopianFullDate,
  parseEthiopianDate,
  computeShiftDuration,
};

/**
 * @module utils/imageOptimizer
 * @description High-fidelity, client-side lossless avatar pre-processing engine.
 * Normalizes images onto an offscreen HTML5 canvas with 512x512 high-DPI supersampling,
 * high-precision Lanczos filtering (imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'), 1:1 center cropping,
 * and zero perceptible optical degradation.
 */

const MAX_AVATAR_DIMENSION = 512;
const JPEG_QUALITY = 0.95;

/**
 * Optimizes an uploaded image file for avatar storage without perceptible quality degradation.
 * Guarantees zero perceptible visual change on any Retina or 4K screen, while shrinking payload
 * weight by ~98% to prevent wire latency and MongoDB Atlas document bloat.
 *
 * @function optimizeAvatarImage
 * @param {File} file - Raw input File object (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
 * @returns {Promise<string>} Base64 data URL of the optimized, retina-crisp avatar
 */
export function optimizeAvatarImage(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!file || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      return reject(new Error('Selected file is not a supported image.'));
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read image file.'));

    reader.onload = () => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to decode image data.'));

      img.onload = () => {
        try {
          const width = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
          const height = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
          if (!width || !height) {
            return reject(new Error('Image dimensions could not be determined.'));
          }

          // 1. Center-crop square dimension calculation (1:1 aspect ratio)
          const cropSize = Math.min(width, height);
          const startX = (width - cropSize) / 2;
          const startY = (height - cropSize) / 2;

          // 2. No-Upscaling Invariant: Never upscale smaller icons to avoid blurriness
          const targetDim = Math.min(cropSize, MAX_AVATAR_DIMENSION);

          // 3. Create Offscreen Canvas
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = targetDim;
          canvas.height = targetDim;

          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) {
            return reject(new Error('Canvas 2D context not available.'));
          }

          // 4. Multi-pass high-precision bicubic/Lanczos antialiasing
          ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
          ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

          // 5. Draw center-cropped square into high-DPI canvas
          ctx.drawImage(
            img,
            startX,
            startY,
            cropSize,
            cropSize,
            0,
            0,
            targetDim,
            targetDim
          );

          // 6. Format selection: preserve PNG alpha transparency; use 0.95 quality JPEG for opaque photos
          const isPng = file.type === 'image/png';
          let outputType = 'image/jpeg';
          let quality = JPEG_QUALITY;

          if (isPng) {
            outputType = 'image/png';
            quality = undefined;
          }

          const base64Data = canvas.toDataURL(outputType, quality);
          resolve(base64Data);
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      };

      img.src = reader.result;
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

export default optimizeAvatarImage;

/**
 * @module utils/validateChatAttachment
 * @description Client-side pre-send validation engine for chat attachments and audio notes.
 * Enforces 4 strict validation gates (MIME whitelist, single file size <= 25MB, count <= 5, batch size <= 50MB)
 * with immediate user toast feedback via react-toastify to conserve mobile bandwidth.
 */

import { toast } from 'react-toastify';
import { ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS, AUDIO_CONSTANTS } from './constants.js';

/**
 * Combined allowed MIME types covering both documents/images and audio recordings.
 * @constant
 * @type {Set<string>}
 */
const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  ...ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES,
  ...AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES,
]);

/**
 * Combined allowed file extensions covering both documents/images and audio recordings.
 * @constant
 * @type {string[]}
 */
const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [
  ...ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS,
  ...AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS,
];

/**
 * Formats bytes into a human-readable megabyte string.
 *
 * @function formatBytesToMb
 * @param {number} bytes - Size in bytes.
 * @returns {string} Formatted size (e.g., '12.4 MB').
 */
export const formatBytesToMb = (bytes) => {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '0 MB';
  const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024);
  return `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

/**
 * Validates a single file against extension and MIME whitelist.
 *
 * @function isFileFormatAllowed
 * @param {File|Blob} file - File or Blob object to inspect.
 * @returns {boolean} True if MIME or extension is supported.
 */
export const isFileFormatAllowed = (file) => {
  if (!file) return false;

  // 1. Check MIME type if present
  if (file.type && ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(file.type.toLowerCase())) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. Check file extension fallback
  const fileName = file.name || '';
  const lowerName = fileName.toLowerCase();
  return ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lowerName.endsWith(ext));
};

/**
 * Checks if a file represents an audio recording or note.
 * Uses centralized AUDIO_CONSTANTS from utils/constants.js.
 *
 * @function isAudioAttachment
 * @param {File|Blob} file - File or Blob object to inspect.
 * @returns {boolean} True if file matches audio MIME or extension.
 */
export const isAudioAttachment = (file) => {
  if (!file) return false;
  const mime = (file.type || '').toLowerCase();
  const cleanMime = mime.split(';')[0].trim();
  const name = (file.name || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.includes(cleanMime) ||
    AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.includes(mime) ||
    cleanMime.startsWith('audio/') ||
    cleanMime === 'video/webm' ||
    cleanMime === 'application/ogg' ||
    AUDIO_CONSTANTS.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => name.endsWith(ext))
  );
};

/**
 * Validates a batch of files before attaching or uploading in chat.
 * Enforces the 4 strict pre-send validation gates:
 * 1. MIME and Extension Whitelist
 * 2. Single File Size Cap (<= 25MB)
 * 3. File Count Cap (<= 5 files per turn)
 * 4. Total Batch Size Cap (<= 50MB per turn)
 *
 * @function validateChatAttachments
 * @param {File[]|FileList} incoming - Incoming file or array of files to attach.
 * @param {File[]} [currentFiles=[]] - Files already selected in the active composer draft.
 * @param {object} [options={}] - Validation options.
 * @param {boolean} [options.showToast=true] - Whether to automatically emit a toast on error.
 * @returns {{
 *   isValid: boolean,
 *   validFiles: File[],
 *   error: string | null,
 *   totalSizeBytes: number,
 * }} Validation result payload.
 */
export const validateChatAttachments = (incoming, currentFiles = [], options = {}) => {
  const showToast = options.showToast !== false;
  const current = Array.isArray(currentFiles) ? currentFiles : [];
  const incomingList =
    typeof FileList !== 'undefined' && incoming instanceof FileList
      ? Array.from(incoming)
      : Array.isArray(incoming)
        ? incoming
        : [incoming].filter(Boolean);

  if (incomingList.length === 0) {
    return {
      isValid: true,
      validFiles: [],
      error: null,
      totalSizeBytes: current.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.size || 0), 0),
    };
  }

  // Gate 1: Check maximum file count (Max 5 files cumulative)
  const totalCount = current.length + incomingList.length;
  if (totalCount > ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILES_COUNT) {
    const error = `You can attach a maximum of ${ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILES_COUNT} files per message. (Attempted to attach ${totalCount}).`;
    if (showToast) toast.error(error);
    return {
      isValid: false,
      validFiles: [],
      error,
      totalSizeBytes: 0,
    };
  }

  // Gate 2: Format Whitelist & Single File Size Check (Max 25MB per file)
  const acceptedFiles = [];
  for (const file of incomingList) {
    if (!isFileFormatAllowed(file)) {
      const error = `"${file.name || 'File'}" is not a supported file format. Allowed types: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, images (JPEG, PNG, WEBP), and audio files.`;
      if (showToast) toast.error(error);
      return {
        isValid: false,
        validFiles: [],
        error,
        totalSizeBytes: 0,
      };
    }

    if (file.size > ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      const error = `"${file.name || 'File'}" (${formatBytesToMb(file.size)}) exceeds the ${formatBytesToMb(ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES)} single file limit.`;
      if (showToast) toast.error(error);
      return {
        isValid: false,
        validFiles: [],
        error,
        totalSizeBytes: 0,
      };
    }

    acceptedFiles.push(file);
  }

  // Gate 3: Batch Size Check (Cumulative <= 50MB)
  const currentTotal = current.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.size || 0), 0);
  const incomingTotal = acceptedFiles.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.size || 0), 0);
  const cumulativeTotal = currentTotal + incomingTotal;

  if (cumulativeTotal > ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_BATCH_SIZE_BYTES) {
    const error = `Total attachment size (${formatBytesToMb(cumulativeTotal)}) exceeds the ${formatBytesToMb(ATTACHMENT_CONSTANTS.MAX_BATCH_SIZE_BYTES)} batch limit.`;
    if (showToast) toast.error(error);
    return {
      isValid: false,
      validFiles: [],
      error,
      totalSizeBytes: cumulativeTotal,
    };
  }

  return {
    isValid: true,
    validFiles: acceptedFiles,
    error: null,
    totalSizeBytes: cumulativeTotal,
  };
};

export default validateChatAttachments;
